cycles.question: For B0 component 'lane', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The B0 'lane' component (operationalized as px_vs_ma20, the normalized deviation of price from its 20-day moving average at snapshot) does NOT contribute predictive information independent of its neighboring B0 terms mom_20, ma20_slope_5, and px_vs_ma50; its historical signal is mechanically a low-pass projection of the same raw return stream that already populates those neighbors.
evidence_for: Mathematical coupling: px_vs_ma20 ≡ (P − SMA_20)/SMA_20, while mom_20 ≡ P/P_t-20 − 1 and ma20_slope_5 ≡ ΔSMA_20/SMA_20. All three are linear/computable transforms of the same overlapping 20-day return window, so 'lane' is not a new information channel but a smoothed re-encoding.

Numeric contrast hierarchy favors the upstream features: standardized deltas between false-negative and selected-winner cohorts are mom_20 = −1.0005, ma20_slope_5 = −0.6815, but px_vs_ma20 = −0.5842 — if 'lane' carried independent signal, its standardized contrast should be at least as large as its inputs after partialling; instead it is strictly smaller.

Case-level concordance: in entity_ead73f4390 (winner) and entity_3472243e0c (ruin) both have near-identical px_vs_ma20 (~0.09) and px_vs_ma50 (~0.07–0.08), yet their outcomes diverge completely, indicating lane-position by itself does not disambiguate risk once slope/momentum disagreement is accounted for.

Snapshot_71486ed83c shows four siblings with px_vs_ma20 in 0.026–0.057 range and mom_20 spanning 0.027–0.32; outcomes split across false_negative_big_winner, false_negative_relative, and selected_winner, confirming lane does not independently resolve the co-moving variables.
evidence_against: Some B0 picks with mid-range lane (~0.05–0.09) plus steep slopes still produced large_wins (entity_28a6ec4601, entity_3adc078f01), leaving open that lane-bucket×slope regime could hold residual structure even if lane's main effect is degenerate.

Pullback-duration and pullback-pct deltas (standardized ~0.64–0.73) are not directly captured by slope or momentum, suggesting a true base-pattern channel that 'lane' could proxy; but this argues for a pullback feature, not for lane-as-defined.
falsifiable_predictions: P1 — Orthogonalization test: regress px_vs_ma20 on mom_20, ma20_slope_5, ma10_slope_5, and px_vs_ma50 within the snapshot panel; the R² should exceed 0.85. If the residual lane component has |β| in a W4-return hurdle regression (controlling for the same four neighbors) whose 95% CI excludes zero in fewer than 5% of bootstraps, the 'lane' causal claim is falsified.

P2 — Ablation: removing the lane feature from the B0 score should change Spearman rank-correlation with W4_return_bucket by less than 0.02 on a held-out backtest; any larger swing implies lane was carrying non-redundant information.

P3 — Regime dependence: if lane were truly independent, bins of (mom_20 × slope × vol_ratio) should show monotone winners across lane levels within each cell; the empirical data shows crossings (winners and ru共存 across all bins), falsifying monotonic lane influence.

P4 — The cleaner replacement (px_vs_ma20 − α·mom_20 − β·ma20_slope_5), estimated per snapshot, when used as the sole feature should NOT improve AUC over mom_20 alone by more than ΔAUC = 0.005; meeting this bound confirms lane is a linear projection.
policy_implications: Drop 'lane' from the B0 composite and reallocate its weight toward the higher-contrast neighbors (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20) where the false-negative/selected-winner deltas are largest; this reduces parameter-count without sacrificing PIT-observable signal.

Replace lane with a 'lane-trap' binary: True only when px_vs_ma20 exceeds its 60-day realized 90th percentile AND ma20_slope_5 is negative — this orthogonalizes the channel and makes it regime-specific rather than a redundant smoother.

Re-run failure archaeology after replacement: expect the false_positive_ruin count (currently 8/27) to fall or hold steady, but the false_negative count (currently 7/27) should NOT deteriorate, since lane adds no incremental recall for missed winners.
Document that any future reintroduction of 'lane' must pass the orthogonalization R² > 0.85 falsifier first; otherwise treat it as a co-linear artifact rather than a mechanism.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The researcher's claim that lane (px_vs_ma20) is a degenerate low-pass projection of mom_20/slope collapses only because the falsification framework is restricted to linear-additive partialling on N=27 observations that are heavily clustered within 7 shared snapshots. Lane is not a re-encoding of momentum: it incorporates asymmetric smoothing weights (a 20-day SMA weights the latest bar and 19 prior bars equally, while mom_20 is a pure endpoint ratio), which means lane captures intraperiod volatility regime and serial correlation of returns — information channels that mom_20 and ma20_slope_5 do not see. A proper falsifier would test whether (P − SMA_20)/SMA_20 retains predictive content AFTER partialling on mom_20, slope, AND a realized-volatility/serial-correlation basis, not just the two neighbors the researcher chose. Under such a basis-conditioned test, the residual lane content is plausibly non-zero and the claim is therefore not yet falsified.

attacks.issue: Mathematical-coupling argument conflates 'derived from same price series' with 'linear redundancy'. px_vs_ma20, mom_20, and ma20_slope_5 are three distinct functionals of the return path; even when R² between them is moderate, the residual variance of lane carries volatility-regime and serial-dependence information (because the SMA smooths idiosyncratic jumps while mom_20 preserves them). The researcher treats these as if they lived in a 1-D subspace of 'overlapping 20-day return window'.
attacks.why_it_matters: If lane is volatile-regime information that is NOT in mom_20 or slope, then partialling on those two will leave a non-trivial lane residual, and P1's R² > 0.85 prediction is empirically falsifiable in the OPPOSITE direction: the true R² will be lower precisely because lane carries orthogonal content, not because lane is degenerate. The researcher's mechanism claim reverses the inference.

attacks.issue: Standardized-delta ranking (mom_20 = −1.0005 > lane = −0.5842) is being misused as an independence test. Standardized univariate contrast measures discriminative power, not marginal information. A feature with smaller univariate delta can have large conditional delta once a co-linear neighbor is partialled out, AND vice versa. The researcher assumes a monotone relationship between contrast and information content that is only valid under linear-additive separability.
attacks.why_it_matters: The conclusion 'lane's standardized contrast is strictly smaller than its inputs, so it is redundant' is a non-sequitur. Smaller univariate contrast is consistent with lane being a 'necessary but not sufficient' gating variable, an interaction term, or a regime indicator — none of which require larger univariate delta. The argument as posed tests the wrong hypothesis.

attacks.issue: Sample structure is snapshot-clustered, not i.i.d. Of the 27 cases, ~14 share snapshot_71486ed83c alone, and several others share 4–5 other snapshots. Within-snapshot entities have correlated market-regime exposure, which inflates apparent concordance between lane and slope/mom (they all move together because they share a market day). The researcher's concordance claims (ead73f4390 vs 3472243e0c) are therefore partly artifacts of same-snapshot covariance, not independent evidence of lane's redundancy.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the dataset has effective N closer to 7 (snapshots) than 27 (entities), the within-snapshot comparisons that the researcher uses to argue lane is degenerate are over-determined by regime. A snapshot-stratified bootstrap, or a leave-one-snapshot-out test, is the appropriate falsifier — and on that test the variance of lane's conditional effect would be much wider than the researcher implies.

attacks.issue: The 'cleaner replacement' P4 (px_vs_ma20 − α·mom_20 − β·ma20_slope_5 should not improve AUC over mom_20 alone by more than 0.005) assumes a 1-D replacement that still lives in the same linear span as the neighbors. But a non-linear replacement — e.g., lane × sign(slope), or lane conditional on a realized-vol band — is exactly the kind of feature that would extract lane's independent information. The researcher's cleaner replacement is engineered to fail by construction.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the falsifier is rigged to operate only in the linear span of the rejected feature, the test cannot distinguish 'lane is degenerate' from 'lane's mechanism is non-linear'. This is a methodological flaw in the proposed P4 that biases the conclusion toward 'lane is redundant' regardless of truth.

attacks.issue: Pullback_pct and pullback_duration_weeks are flagged as 'a true base-pattern channel that lane could proxy' but then dismissed because 'this argues for a pullback feature, not for lane-as-defined'. This conflates two distinct claims: (a) lane has no independent signal, and (b) if it did, it would not be the right operationalization. Pullback features and lane are partly complementary — pullback describes the historical path, lane describes the current position relative to that path. Conflating them removes an axis of variation that could matter.
attacks.why_it_matters: The researcher is implicitly restricting the hypothesis space to 'lane as a univariate scalar against its immediate neighbors'. The falsification claim should be against lane as a scalar carrying NO additional information across ALL functionals of (lane, pullback, slope, mom). The data does not yet support that stronger claim.

counterexamples_to_seek: Within a single snapshot, identify entities whose lane and mom_20 disagree by more than 1.5 standard deviations of the cross-sectional lane|mom residual — if those cases have non-random W4 outcomes, lane's smoothing-vs-endpoint gap is carrying signal that mom_20 alone misses.

Look for cases where lane is in the 0.10–0.20 band with NEGATIVE ma20_slope_5 (extended-and-rolling-over) versus POSITIVE ma20_slope_5 (extended-and-trending) — entity_b6bcccdf6a (lane 0.124, slope 0.045, ruin) versus entity_6618d3e80c (lane 0.168, slope 0.020, ruin) versus entity_ead73f4390 (lane 0.194, slope 0.037, winner) form a near-trio where lane alone fails but lane×slope shows structure the researcher hasn't partialled on.

Find a snapshot in which BOTH selected-winners and false-positives share the SAME mom_20 and ma20_slope_5 quintiles but differ in lane; if W4 outcomes co-vary with lane within those tied strata, lane has conditional content. The current dataset may not have enough such ties, but the absence should be verified, not assumed.

Compute lane's realized volatility contribution: var(lane | mom, slope) across snapshots. If this residual variance is non-trivial AND co-varies with vol_ratio_5_20 bands, then lane is a volatility-regime indicator, not a momentum re-encoding.

Test whether dropping lane changes the false_positive_ruin count differently than dropping mom_20 (counterfactual ablation on the 8 false-positive cases only). If lane removal drops false-positive count by ≥2 while mom_20 removal drops it by 0, lane is doing unique work in the ruin cohort, falsifying the researcher's claim at the cohort level.
what_would_change_my_mind: A snapshot-stratified partial-correlation analysis showing residual R² of lane on (mom_20, ma20_slope_5, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma50) of ≥0.85 across all 7+ snapshots, with bootstrapped CIs tight enough to reject 0.80 — i.e., evidence that lane is genuinely a linear projection rather than a regime indicator. The researcher's P1 is necessary but the threshold and bootstrap protocol must be specified a priori.

A non-linear ablation showing that (lane × sign(slope)) and (lane | high-vol) features ALSO fail to add AUC beyond mom_20 alone — this would extend the falsification from the linear to the non-linear span and would be stronger evidence that lane carries nothing.

A leave-one-snapshot-out backtest in which lane's contribution is statistically indistinguishable from zero across all holdout snapshots (n ≥ 5 holdouts), with effect-size confidence intervals bounded inside ±0.005 AUC. The current N=27 / 7 snapshots is insufficient for this; I would require at least N ≈ 100 with ≥20 independent snapshots before accepting the degeneracy claim.

Independent replication of the contrast ranking (mom_20 > lane > slope on standardized delta) on a non-overlapping sample where the FALSE NEGATIVES are not concentrated in low-vol regimes. If the ranking holds there, the researcher's univariate contrast argument gains credibility.

Demonstration that replacing lane with pure red-noise (randomized lane preserving its marginal distribution) does NOT change B0 score Spearman correlation with W4 by more than 0.02 — this would show lane is information-equivalent to noise, which is the strong form of the degeneracy claim. The researcher only hypothesizes this for the linear ablation, not the noise ablation.

tests.name: within_snapshot_partialled_lane_residual
tests.comparison: Within each snapshot_anon stratum with N>=3, fit lane = a + b1*mom_20 + b2*ma20_slope_5; extract residual. Pool snapshot-level Spearman correlations of residual vs w4_return_bucket (encoded as ordered factor: loss<small_win<large_win<ruin, with ruin treated as ordinal extreme) via Fisher-z. Repeat 500x snapshot-stratified bootstrap for 95% CI on pooled rho.
tests.success_criterion: Pooled |rho_residual| < 0.10 AND bootstrap CI straddles zero — confirms lane is a within-snapshot linear projection of mom_20 + ma20_slope_5.
tests.failure_criterion: Pooled |rho_residual| > 0.25 OR CI excludes zero in >=70% of bootstrap replicates — confirms lane retains snapshot-local information orthogonal to its named neighbors.

tests.name: effective_sample_size_and_minimum_detectable_effect
tests.comparison: Treat snapshot_anon as the clustering unit (not entity). Compute effective N using the Kish formula N_eff = (sum w_i)^2 / sum w_i^2 with w_i = cluster size. Compute minimum detectable |Spearman rho| at 80% power, two-sided alpha=0.05, for: (a) raw lane vs w4 bucket, (b) lane-residual-from-mom-slope vs w4 bucket. Report MDD with bootstrap CI over 1000 cluster-resamples.
tests.success_criterion: MDD on lane-residual < 0.20 across bootstrap replicates — the study is adequately powered to falsify a non-trivial lane effect.
tests.failure_criterion: MDD > 0.40 OR effective N < 12 — declare UNRESOLVED on lane's independence; the case_count=27 with ~7 snapshots cannot distinguish a true zero from a small-but-real residual.

tests.name: red_noise_ablation_against_lane
tests.comparison: Train snapshot-stratified logistic regression for w4 bucket={ruin} vs {not-ruin}. Model A: mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20. Model B: mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + px_vs_ma20 (real lane). Model C: mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + lane_rednoise, where lane_rednoise is sampled within-snapshot to preserve marginal distribution of px_vs_ma20 but break temporal co-movement with mom_20. Compute AUC for each, averaged across 5-fold snapshot-blocked CV, repeated 50 times.
tests.success_criterion: AUC(B) - AUC(C) < 0.005 AND AUC(B) - AUC(A) < 0.005 in median across folds — real lane is information-equivalent to within-snapshot red noise and adds nothing.
tests.failure_criterion: AUC(B) - AUC(C) > 0.020 in median OR AUC(B) - AUC(A) > 0.015 in median — real lane contributes non-redundant information that red noise cannot replicate.

tests.name: lane_monotonicity_within_neighbor_tied_strata
tests.comparison: Bin entities into (mom_20 quintile x ma20_slope_5 quintile) cells within the discovery-train sample. Within each cell with N>=3, split on lane median and compare w4 win-rate (large_win fraction) between high-lane and low-lane halves. Pool cell-level deltas with inverse-variance weighting; report sign-test p-value across cells.
tests.success_criterion: Weighted-mean |delta| < 0.05 AND sign-test p > 0.20 — lane is monotonically inert within tied neighbor strata.
tests.failure_criterion: Weighted-mean |delta| > 0.20 OR sign-test p < 0.05 — lane is conditionally monotone once mom/slope are tied, contradicting pure-redundancy.

tests.name: lane_x_slope_sign_interaction
tests.comparison: Stratify by sign(ma20_slope_5) and vol_ratio_5_20 high/low (median split). Within each of 4 regime cells, compute Spearman(lane, w4_ordinal). Test for interaction via Fisher-z difference between positive-slope and negative-slope cells; report meta-analytic p across cells with Bonferroni correction over the 4 cells.
tests.success_criterion: Max cell |rho| < 0.20 AND between-cell Fisher-z difference < 1.0 — no lane x slope-sign interaction.
tests.failure_criterion: Any cell |rho| > 0.40 with p < 0.05 after correction, OR Fisher-z difference > 2.0 — lane is an interaction term whose contribution vanishes in the linear-additive framing.

tests.name: ruin_cohort_specific_ablation
tests.comparison: Restrict sample to is_b0_pick=true with outcome in {false_positive_ruin, ruin} (n>=8 per failure_archaeology). Compute partial Spearman of px_vs_ma20 vs w4_ordinal controlling for mom_20 and ma20_slope_5 via within-cohort regression residualization. Repeat with lane permuted within snapshot (preserving marginal). Compare |partial rho| to permutation null distribution (1000 perms).
tests.success_criterion: Observed |partial rho| < 90th percentile of permutation null — lane provides no unique ruin-cohort information.
tests.failure_criterion: Observed |partial rho| > 95th percentile of permutation null — lane is doing cohort-specific work that pure linear partialling misses; researcher claim fails at the cohort level.

leakage_checks: Verify every feature in tests[i].features has a defined construction timestamp <= snapshot_anon timestamp; reject any feature that requires data after the snapshot decision point (in particular confirm ibd_entry_* fields are pre-entry and not contemporaneous with the W4 evaluation window).
Confirm w4_return_bucket is used strictly as the response variable; ensure it never enters any model's feature matrix in tests, ablations, or bootstrap resampling.

Confirm snapshot_anon is treated only as a blocking/stratification variable (cluster ID for partialling, CV folds, bootstrap resampling) and is never encoded as an ordinal or categorical predictor — using snapshot identity as a feature would be a calendar-identity leak under the no-calendar-identity rule.

Confirm red_noise construction in test 3 permutes lane only WITHIN-snapshot, preserving the empirical marginal CDF of px_vs_ma20 but breaking any cross-feature temporal alignment; reject any red-noise procedure that pools across snapshots before shuffling.

Confirm all partialling regressions in tests 1, 4, 6 are fit WITHIN-snapshot, not on the pooled panel — pooled regression would mix market-regime covariance with feature relationship and inflate apparent partialling R-squared.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: Within B0's linear-additive composite framing (mom_20 + ma20_slope_5 + px_vs_ma50 + up_day_ratio_20), lane (px_vs_ma20) is largely redundant: its standardized discriminative contrast (|Δ|=0.584) is strictly smaller than its named neighbors' (mom_20: 1.001, ma20_slope_5: 0.682, up_day_ratio_20: 1.188), and case-level concordance within snapshot_71486ed83c shows lane fails to disambiguate siblings whose slope/mom quintiles already separate winners from ruins. However, this falsification is conditional on linear-additive separability and on adequate power. Lane's 20-day SMA applies uniform smoothing across the lookback window, while mom_20 is an endpoint ratio — these are distinct functionals of the same return path that retain different intraperiod volatility and serial-correlation signatures. The sample's effective N is closer to ~7 (Kish-weighted across 7+ shared snapshots clustering 27 entities) than to 27, so a modest non-linear residual effect cannot be distinguished from zero at conventional power. The researcher's proposed 'cleaner replacement' (px_vs_ma20 − α·mom_20 − β·ma20_slope_5) is engineered to live in the same linear span as the rejected feature and therefore cannot distinguish 'lane is degenerate' from 'lane's mechanism is non-linear'. Lane is redundant in the restricted B0 linear-additive sense that the model uses; it is unresolved whether lane carries information through channels B0 does not access (volatility regime, slope-sign interaction, ruin-cohort gating).
falsifiers: F1 — Within-snapshot partialled residual: pool snapshot-level Spearman(rho_residual, w4_ordinal) via Fisher-z across 500 snapshot-stratified bootstraps; pool |rho| > 0.25 with CI excluding zero in >=70% of replicates confirms lane carries orthogonal information to mom_20 + ma20_slope_5. (designer's test 1, hardened)

F2 — Basis-augmented partialling: regress lane on mom_20 + ma20_slope_5 + rv_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 within-snapshot; if residual variance co-varies with vol_ratio_5_20 bands (Kruskal-Wallis p<0.05), lane is a volatility-regime indicator and the linear-additive redundancy claim fails. (skeptic's basis-conditioned test)

F3 — Red-noise ablation: AUC(lane_real) − AUC(lane_within_snapshot_rednoise) > 0.020 in snapshot-blocked 5-fold CV (50 reps) confirms lane carries non-redundant information; AUC gap < 0.005 confirms researcher's claim. Permutation must be within-snapshot, not pooled. (designer's test 3)

F4 — Cohort-specific ablation in ruin cluster: among is_b0_pick=true cases with ruin-class outcome (n>=8), partial Spearman of lane vs w4_ordinal (controlling for mom, slope, vol_ratio) must exceed the 95th percentile of within-snapshot permutation null to reject redundancy at the cohort level. (designer's test 6)

F5 — Tied-strata monotonicity: within (mom_20 quintile × ma20_slope_5 quintile) cells with N>=3, weighted-mean |delta| in win-rate across lane-median split > 0.20 OR sign-test p<0.05 rejects the redundancy claim. Note this test is underpowered given effective N — absence of effect is not proof of absence. (designer's test 4)

F6 — Slope-sign interaction: Fisher-z difference between Spearman(lane, w4_ordinal) in positive-slope vs negative-slope cells > 2.0 (Bonferroni-corrected over 4 regime cells) confirms lane is an interaction term invisible to linear-additive framing. (designer's test 5 + skeptic's interaction hypothesis)
F7 — Power floor: if Kish effective N < 12 OR minimum detectable |rho| > 0.40 at 80% power, declare UNRESOLVED regardless of point estimate; current data likely fails this floor.

F8 — Counterfactual ablation asymmetry: dropping lane reduces false_positive_ruin count by >=2 while dropping mom_20 reduces it by 0 falsifies researcher's cohort-level claim; symmetric reduction supports it.
actionable_design_principles: Report Kish effective N (snapshot-clustered) alongside raw case count for every inferential claim; flag effective N < 12 as underpowered and refuse to claim direction-of-effect from such samples.

Partialling for feature independence must include a realized-volatility/serial-correlation basis (rv_20, vol_ratio_5_20), not only the immediately-named neighbors; otherwise 'redundancy' is a property of the basis chosen, not of the feature.
Red-noise and permutation ablations must operate within-snapshot to preserve market-regime covariance structure; pooled permutation destroys the very signal being tested.
Test non-linear interactions (lane × slope-sign, lane × vol-band) before declaring a feature redundant in main-effect framing; non-redundant interaction terms are common in price-path features.

When proposing a 'cleaner replacement', evaluate it in BOTH the proposed form AND its natural non-linear extensions; rigged replacements that live in the rejected feature's linear span bias the conclusion toward redundancy.
Distinguish 'lane adds no value in B0's current linear-additive composite' from 'lane is a degenerate projection of price'; only the former is falsifiable by the available data.

Treat snapshot identity as a blocking/stratification variable only; never encode it as a predictor, and report any within-snapshot test's N explicitly so cluster-driven spurious concordance can be detected.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: lane_drop
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Pure subtractive test of whether lane carries any signal in B0's current framing; redistributes weight to higher-contrast neighbors without changing feature geometry. Smallest perturbation — establishes the 'zero-information' baseline.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: low — diagnostic only; if Spearman(B0_score, w4_ordinal) changes by less than 0.02 after removal, the linear-additive redundancy claim is supported at the level B0 actually operates.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: lane_residual_basis_augmented
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Replaces raw lane with the within-snapshot residual after regressing on mom_20 + ma20_slope_5 + rv_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 — directly addresses the skeptic's challenge that the researcher's partialling omitted the vol basis. If this residual still fails to predict, the redundancy claim survives its strongest defense.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: high — accommodates the volatility-regime channel the skeptic identifies; if this replacement beats the original lane in AUC by >=0.01, B0 was discarding orthogonal information.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: lane_x_slope_sign
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Multiplicative interaction term that targets the skeptic's extended-and-rolling-over vs extended-and-trending distinction (entity_b6bcccdf6a vs entity_6618d3e80c vs entity_ead73f4390 form the motivating near-trio). Tests whether lane's information is genuinely non-linear rather than absent.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: medium — explicit interaction term; if sign-restricted Spearman diverges across slope-sign cells by >=0.30, lane is an interaction operator and B0's linear composite structurally cannot see it.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: lane_trap_binary
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the researcher's own suggested 'lane-trap' replacement (px_vs_ma20 > 60d_p90 AND ma20_slope_5 < 0) as a binary gate. Makes the regime-specific information lane might carry into an explicit, falsifiable composite feature rather than a continuous smoother.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: medium — orthogonalizes the channel; tests whether lane's information is threshold-based (consistent with trap/risk interpretation) rather than continuous (consistent with momentum re-encoding).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: lane_within_snapshot_permutation_null
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Does not modify B0's feature set but generates the appropriate permutation distribution against which lane's actual predictive content is measured. Establishes the statistical baseline that the researcher's hand-waved concordance claims implicitly assume but do not compute.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: high — meta-policy: provides the rigorous null that all four feature-level policies above should be benchmarked against; without it, no policy decision is statistically grounded given the cluster structure.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'dry_false_penalty', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The 'dry_false_penalty' claims to identify and penalize B0 candidates that resemble historical false-positive ruptures under 'dry' (low-conviction / declining-trend) pre-entry conditions, but frozen failure-archaeology indicates its inputs are co-linear with neighboring B0 terms (momentum, slope, up-day ratio, volume-ratio, px-vs-MA) that already discriminate winners from losers, leaving little incremental information.
evidence_for: The 8 false_positive_ruin cases span an enormous mom_20 range (0.024 to 0.242) and a wide ma10_slope_5 range (-0.006 to 0.091), which is hard to reconcile with a single coherent 'dry' archetype.

Several ruin cases (entity_4fdc3699fd mom=0.185/slope=0.091, entity_3472243e0c mom=0.242, entity_b6bcccdf6a mom=0.176) actually exhibit higher momentum and slope medians than multiple selected_winners, implying the penalty is firing on the opposite of 'dry' in some cases.
up_day_ratio_20 for ruin cases averages ~0.54 versus ~0.60 for winners and ~0.53 for false_negatives — the same direction and magnitude already exploited by base B0 terms.
ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct is elevated (0.034–0.074) in most ruin cases, again overlapping with features captured by the breakout/entry terms of B0.
evidence_against: Numeric contrasts show the four most discriminative features (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50) already achieve standardized |delta| of 0.85–1.19 between selected_winners and false_negatives; a penalty built from the same primitives cannot add orthogonal signal.

False-positive ruins share the lowest up_day_ratio_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 values with false-negatives, suggesting both error modes are read by the same primitive features rather than by a uniquely 'dry' signature.

The mix-label case entity_6618d3e80c (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner) with very high px_vs_ma50 (0.337) and large_win w4 bucket shows the same B0 fingerprint can produce both ruin and success — inconsistent with a clean, reproducible penalty trigger.
Vol_ratio_5_20 for ruin cases ranges 0.91–1.63, overlapping almost entirely with the selected_winner distribution (1.01–1.77), so a 'dry volume' threshold cannot uniquely separate them.
Pullback data is null in 6/8 ruin cases, meaning the penalty is being applied without one of the intended conditioning inputs, weakening any claim of conditional independence from neighboring terms.
falsifiable_predictions: If 'dry_false_penalty' carries independent signal, then after regressing out its value from the sum of all other B0 components, the residual penalty should still produce a statistically significant rank-correlation (Spearman |ρ| > 0.10, p<0.05) with ruin outcomes on an out-of-sample holdout — failure to meet this falsifies independence.

If the penalty is redundant, leave-one-out refitting of B0 without this term should not change hit-rate on ruin cases by more than ±2 percentage points at the same selection rate; a degradation greater than 5 pp would falsify redundancy.

If the 'dry' descriptor is real, restricting ruin analysis to cases with up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.5 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≤ 1.2 should sharply concentrate the penalty's gradient; absence of such concentration (i.e., similar penalty values across dry and non-dry sub-regimes) falsifies the 'dry' framing.

Partial-dependence analysis should show a flat marginal effect of the penalty on ruin probability once mom_20, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20 are held at observed values; a flat curve falsifies incremental information.
policy_implications: Replace the penalty with a residual-based score: regress each ruin-indicator candidate feature on the other B0 components and use only the orthogonal residual (e.g., mom_20_resid, slope_resid) so any retained signal is provably independent of neighbors.
Re-anchor the penalty on a regime-conditional model rather than a static 'dry' threshold, because the current cases violate the dry archetype in ~50% of ruins (mom > 0.15).
Add a double-selection test (e.g., knockoff or controlled-variable inclusion) before allowing the penalty into the production score, so neighboring-term leakage cannot silently inflate B0.

Audit pullback-naN handling: 6/8 ruin cases have null pullback fields, so the penalty is currently firing on incomplete state — a cleaner replacement must explicitly gate on data completeness or impute deterministically.

Consider dropping the component entirely if, after orthogonalization, its out-of-sample hit-rate contribution is inside its bootstrap confidence interval centered on zero — UNRESOLVED pending holdout evaluation.

Disentangle mechanism from portfolio construction: ensure the penalty is evaluated purely on PIT-observable features (up_day_ratio, momentum, slope, vol_ratio at snapshot) and not on the w4_return_bucket or outcome_label fields that appear in the archaeology set.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The researcher's falsification framing is itself tautological: they test whether the penalty's signal collapses into four already-discriminative features (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50) by computing *pooled, cross-snapshot* univariate medians between two non-comparable error cohorts (false_negatives vs selected_winners). But the penalty is a snapshot-conditional, joint-regime detector, so this pooled analysis destroys exactly the structure that would prove or disprove independence. A more honest test would orthogonalize penalty values against the residual of the four features *within snapshot* and ask whether the within-snapshot rank-ordering still tracks ruin probability. The prior researcher never did that, so the 'probably redundant' conclusion is unfalsified, not falsified.

attacks.issue: Wrong control cohort. The numeric contrasts compare false_negatives to selected_winners, but dry_false_penalty is designed to penalize false_positives. The two error modes are mirror images on different B0 features: false_negatives have LOW up_day_ratio/mom/vol, false_positives have HIGH entry_close_vs_trigger with mixed slope signs. Using the wrong contrast understates the penalty's incremental lift against the error mode it actually targets.
attacks.why_it_matters: If you regress 'penalty = f(features)' using false_negative residuals, you fit the wrong loss surface. The penalty could be 100% redundant for false_negatives yet still carry exclusive signal for false_positives — and the researcher's headline claim ('little incremental information') would be wrong precisely when it matters.

attacks.issue: Snapshot heterogeneity is ignored. Of the 27 cases, at least 9 distinct snapshots appear (snap_724342c280, snap_287267e812, snap_eb3d8128cc, snap_c7fa0b9bb6, snap_12ebd0d057, snap_71486ed83c, snap_ad495b6705, snap_39b6f2c49e, snap_3fc4068e83, snap_8aa9111909, snap_edaba651c2, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_01d3e2483b, snap_b8420124eb). Pooling across snapshots is a known confound when features have regime-conditional distributions; the 'overlap in vol_ratio_5_20 between ruins and winners' finding is partly an artifact of mixing sub-distributions.
attacks.why_it_matters: A penalty calibrated per-snapshot could discriminate cleanly even when pooled distributions overlap. The researcher treats overlap as redundancy; that's a category error.

attacks.issue: Selection bias in the archaeology set. The 27 cases are discovered precisely because they share the predictive vocabulary B0 uses — they were flagged by the same primitives. The penalty cannot appear independent of those primitives in this sample, because the sample was constructed by them. The researcher has not bootstrapped the penalty against randomly-sampled non-flagged cases.
attacks.why_it_matters: Any 'redundancy' finding is mechanically guaranteed. A real independence test requires (a) all B0 candidates in the snapshot universe, not just error cases, and (b) an injected placebo penalty. Neither was done.

attacks.issue: Pullback-null handling conflates two hypotheses. Six of eight ruin cases have null pullback fields. The researcher reads this as 'penalty firing on incomplete state' (a defect). Alternative reading: the penalty correctly *refrains* from using pullback and instead relies on a regime indicator that is complete — meaning the null-pullback cases are the cleanest test set, not the dirtiest.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the penalty is robust to missing pullback and still discriminates on those 6 cases, that is evidence of an independent channel, not a defect.

attacks.issue: The entity_6618d3e80c 'mix-label' case is misread as evidence against the penalty. This case has px_vs_ma50 = 0.337, mom_20 = 0.251, up_day_ratio_20 = 0.55 — strong trend — yet is labeled false_positive_ruin|selected_winner. The researcher calls this 'inconsistent with a clean penalty trigger.' But a correctly-designed penalty should *not* fire on this case (it isn't dry). The fact that ruin still occurred is a label-noise / market-regime issue, not a penalty-design failure. Citing it as counter-evidence reverses the inference.
attacks.why_it_matters: This single case could be the strongest defense of the penalty's selectivity — it correctly stayed quiet on a non-dry setup that happened to ruin anyway. The researcher inverts this.

attacks.issue: Falsifiable predictions are symmetric rather than asymmetric. The researcher's 'partial dependence flat = falsifies incremental info' test would also fire if the penalty operates through a thresholded interaction (e.g., mom_20 > 0.15 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.1 AND ma20_slope_5 < 0). Such interactions show flat marginals but sharp conditional effects. The proposed test cannot distinguish redundancy from non-linear interaction.
attacks.why_it_matters: The proposed falsifier is too weak — it would falsely reject a legitimately informative non-linear component.

attacks.issue: The 'high mom ruins' complaint is selection-driven, not a mechanism failure. entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_3472243e0c, entity_b6bcccdf6a show high mom_20 in ruin cases. But these are conditional on already being B0 candidates — i.e., they passed the base entry filter. The penalty's job is to penalize *residual risk* after base entry, not to override the entry. High mom in ruins is expected; the relevant question is whether the penalty correctly down-weights them relative to equally-high-mom winners, which requires within-bucket comparison.
attacks.why_it_matters: The researcher is implicitly asking the penalty to reject entries that B0 itself approved. That's a scope-mismatch critique, not a redundancy critique.

counterexamples_to_seek: A pair of cases within the same snapshot where mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, px_vs_ma50 are within 5% of each other, but penalty_value differs by >1 std and the higher-penalty case ruins while the lower-penalty case wins. Existence of such a pair would prove conditional independence directly.

Snapshot-level Spearman correlation between orthogonalized-penalty-residual and ruin indicator, computed within snapshot and then meta-analyzed across snapshots. If Fisher-combined p < 0.05 in the within-snapshot analysis but not in the pooled analysis, the pooled 'redundancy' finding is an aggregation artifact.

A placebo penalty constructed by permuting penalty_values across cases within snapshot. Compare its ruin-association strength to the real penalty. If the real penalty is no stronger than the placebo, redundancy holds; if it is, independence holds. This is the cleanest falsifier and was not run.
Cases where the four 'redundant' features are missing or NaN (true data outage) but the penalty is still computable and still tracks outcome. Existence of these would prove an independent channel.
Knockoff-style test: for each ruin case, find the closest non-ruin B0 candidate in feature space and check whether penalty rank-ordering still picks the ruin case. If yes, redundancy is refuted.
what_would_change_my_mind: A within-snapshot, partial-dependence analysis showing that, holding mom_20, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, px_vs_ma50, and ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct at their actual observed values, the penalty's partial contribution to ruin probability is statistically indistinguishable from zero (p > 0.20) on a held-out sample — AND this holds under both linear and tree-based conditional models. The researcher's proposed test used pooled data and a single model class; both would need to be addressed.

A leave-one-out refit where dropping the penalty changes the within-snapshot ruin-selection AUC by less than 0.005 (i.e., well inside bootstrap noise). Anything larger would establish real incremental signal and refute redundancy.

A demonstration that the 6 pullback-null ruin cases show penalty values statistically indistinguishable from the 2 pullback-non-null ruin cases — i.e., the penalty carries no signal in the subset where it could be an independent channel. If penalty values differ systematically between null and non-null pullback ruins, an independent 'volume-only' channel exists.

Replication of the contrast analysis on a randomly-sampled control set of B0 candidates that were NOT flagged as errors (i.e., typical winners and typical losers). If the four features still show large standardized deltas and the penalty is fully absorbed, the redundancy finding generalizes; if the deltas shrink, the original 27-case set was artifactually inflated.

Honest reporting that a non-linear interaction (e.g., hinge on mom_20 > 0.15 ∧ vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.1) explains the ruin pattern better than any linear combination — if this is shown, the penalty as currently formulated (likely linear or additive) is indeed defective, but the underlying regime is real and the right replacement is a hinge/interaction term, not removal.

tests.name: Slot 1 — Within-snapshot orthogonal-residual meta-analysis
tests.comparison: Within each snapshot separately, fit OLS: penalty_value ~ mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 + px_vs_ma50 + ma10_slope_5 + ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct; take the residual. Compute Spearman( residual, is_ruin ) within that snapshot using only cases with all six predictors non-null. Fisher-combine per-snapshot p-values (exclude snapshots with n_ruin < 2). Build a within-snapshot permutation null by shuffling penalty values within snapshot 1000 times and recomputing the Spearman distribution; compare observed combined χ² against the permuted combined χ² distribution.
tests.success_criterion: Observed Fisher-combined χ² exceeds the 95th percentile of the permuted combined-χ² distribution, meta p < 0.05, AND ≥ 60% of usable snapshots show ρ of the same sign as the combined effect. This would confirm penalty carries residual signal beyond the five B0 neighbors.
tests.failure_criterion: Observed combined χ² ≤ 50th percentile of the permuted null, OR per-snapshot ρ signs are inconsistent (no consistent direction in >50% of snapshots). On failure, declare redundancy at the within-snapshot level — escalate to Slot 3 for replacement.

tests.name: Slot 2 — Within-snapshot 1:1 matched-pair nearest-neighbor test
tests.comparison: For each ruin case, find its nearest non-ruin B0 candidate in standardized 6-feature Euclidean distance within the same snapshot (ties broken by Mahalanobis distance using the snapshot's empirical covariance). Form one matched pair per ruin case. Compute Δpenalty = penalty_ruin − penalty_control. Run a one-sided sign test on Δpenalty > 0; build permutation null by swapping ruin/control labels within each pair across 1000 iterations. As a robustness secondary, recompute with pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct added to the distance metric for snapshots where both members are non-null.
tests.success_criterion: ≥ 70% of matched pairs show Δpenalty > 0 AND one-sided permutation p < 0.05. Establishes that the penalty ranks an indistinguishable-from-feature-space twin lower than the actual ruin case, i.e., conditional independence exists.
tests.failure_criterion: Sign rate ≤ 55% (indistinguishable from coin flip) OR mean Δpenalty lies inside the permutation-derived 95% CI of zero. On failure, the penalty contains no conditional information even after exact-feature matching, supporting redundancy.

tests.name: Slot 3 — Additive-vs-tree interaction ablation to specify the cleaner replacement
tests.comparison: Within each snapshot with ≥ 3 ruin and ≥ 3 non-ruin cases, fit three ruin classifiers using only cases with all six predictors non-null: (a) logistic regression on the six features (additive baseline); (b) logistic regression on the six features + penalty_value (tests linear-conditional additive lift); (c) depth-3 GBM on the six features only (tests tree-based interaction lift without penalty). Compute per-snapshot AUC for each, then average across snapshots. Run DeLong test pairwise (a) vs (b) and (b) vs (c) on the pooled within-snapshot predictions.
tests.success_criterion: Two distinct wins are valid: (i) (b) AUC − (a) AUC > 0.02 with non-overlapping DeLong 95% CIs ⇒ additive-conditional signal exists, keep penalty as linear correction; (ii) (c) AUC − (b) AUC > 0.02 with non-overlapping CIs ⇒ underlying regime is real but non-additive, replace penalty with a depth-3 tree / explicit hinge (e.g., mom_20 > 0.15 ∧ vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.1).
tests.failure_criterion: All pairwise AUC gaps ≤ 0.01 with fully overlapping 95% CIs ⇒ neither formulation beats baseline; declare UNRESOLVED and require out-of-sample holdout before any production swap.

leakage_checks: Audit penalty_value computation against every feature field in the archaeology set — reject any code path referencing outcome_label, w4_return_bucket, pullforward W4 close, or any post-snapshot return field. If found, flag the penalty as forward-leaking and exclude Slot 1/2/3 results.
Verify pullback_duration_weeks end-date and pullback_pct reference date are ≤ snapshot_anon date for every case; drop any snapshot-row where the pullback window closes after the decision snapshot.

Confirm snapshot_d0d57b1e40 (contains entity_6618d3e80c mixed-label plus several high-px_vs_ma50 winners and ruins) is treated as a sanity slice: re-run Slot 1 and Slot 2 with and without it; large Δ in either result indicates snapshot-driven artifacts and triggers snapshot stratification.

Re-run Slot 2 with the matching-distance restricted to mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20 only (the four 'most redundant' features from the researcher's contrasts) to confirm that adding the extra dimensions does not flip the sign-rate — if it does, the conditional-independence finding depends on the matching metric and is non-robust.

Block any test from using ticker identity or calendar features (week-of-year, month, day-of-week) in the matching distance, classifier features, or permutation strata — these are explicitly disallowed per the PIT allowlist.

Drop cases where snapshot_anon appears in fewer than 2 ruin and 2 non-ruin rows from Slot 1 and Slot 3 estimators (insufficient within-snapshot sample for stable Spearman / AUC); report which snapshots are excluded and why in the result write-up.

Run all three slots on entity_6618d3e80c as a held-out single case: the penalty should NOT fire (case is not dry). If penalty_value for this case is in the upper tercile of ruin-case penalty values, the gating condition is broken and all three slot results are tainted.
priority_order: Slot 3 — Additive-vs-tree interaction ablation to specify the cleaner replacement

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: 'dry_false_penalty' claims to detect and down-weight B0 candidates whose pre-entry condition resembles a 'dry' (low-conviction) profile that historically precipitated false-positive ruptures. The frozen failure-archaeology set can neither confirm nor refute this claim because (a) the dominant numeric contrasts compare false_negatives to selected_winners, but the penalty targets the false_positive error mode — these are mirror-image cohorts and the wrong contrast for testing conditional independence on the penalty's claimed axis; (b) the 27 archaeology cases were surfaced by B0's own primitives, so any 'redundancy' finding is partly a selection artifact that would persist even for an informative component; (c) at least 9 distinct snapshots are pooled, destroying the snapshot-conditional structure a regime detector would need to exhibit signal; (d) pullback inputs are null in 6/8 ruin cases, so the penalty is firing under undefined state; (e) the mix-label case entity_6618d3e80c is misread as counter-evidence when its very non-'dry' profile (px_vs_ma50=0.337, mom_20=0.251) makes it the ideal test that a correctly-gated penalty should NOT penalize. The researcher identifies real architectural concerns (overlap of primitives, completeness gaps, snapshot heterogeneity); the skeptic correctly identifies that the headline redundancy claim was earned on the wrong comparison and that a within-snapshot matched-pair + placebo-penalty test has not been run. Both readings are consistent with the data; cleaner evidence (Slot 1, 2, 3 of the experimental designer's protocol) is required before any production swap.
falsifiers: F1 — Within-snapshot matched-pair sign test (Slot 2): if ≤55% of pairs have Δpenalty(ruin−control) > 0 with permutation p > 0.05, redundancy is supported and the component should be either orthogonalized or removed.

F2 — Within-snapshot orthogonal-residual meta-analysis (Slot 1): if Fisher-combined χ² is below the 95th percentile of the within-snapshot permutation null OR >40% of usable snapshots carry ρ of the opposite sign, the 'independence beyond B0 neighbors' claim is falsified.

F3 — Placebo-penalty test: if permuted-penalty ruin-association strength (within-snapshot Spearman meta) is statistically indistinguishable from the real penalty at α=0.10, the penalty is redundant with the six-feature vector it claims to complement.

F4 — Restricted-regime concentration: within the claimed 'dry' slice (up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.50 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≤ 1.20 AND ma20_slope_5 ≤ 0), penalty's ruin-gradient must be statistically sharp (pooled AUC ≥ 0.65); flat gradient falsifies the 'dry' framing specifically, distinct from generic redundancy.

F5 — Additive-vs-tree ablation (Slot 3): if additive (b) AUC − baseline (a) AUC ≤ 0.01 AND tree (c) AUC − additive (b) AUC ≤ 0.01 with overlapping CIs, BOTH interpretations (linear lift and non-linear hinge) are refuted — component is uninformative, not merely mis-specified.

F6 — Held-out single-case gate: entity_6618d3e80c (mix-label, non-dry profile) must NOT be in the upper tercile of penalty_value across ruin cases; if it is, the gating condition is broken and all retrospective findings are tainted by selection-on-condition.

F7 — Holdout generalization: on an out-of-sample snapshot withhold, Spearman(penalty_residual, ruin) must exceed |ρ|=0.10 at p<0.05; failure falsifies incremental information in production-relevant regime.

F8 — Leave-one-snapshot-out stability: if Slot 1 result is driven by a single snapshot (any single holdout flips the combined sign or moves combined χ² below median), the component's claimed snapshot-conditional independence is unstable and falsified.

F9 — Completeness-aware rerun: restricting Slot 1/2 to cases with all six features AND pullback fields non-null must replicate the headline Spearman result; failure means the current signal is partially an artifact of asymmetric missingness.

F10 — Forward-leakage audit: any code path from penalty_value to outcome_label / w4_return_bucket / post-snapshot return field automatically falsifies the component's PIT-clean status regardless of predictive performance.
actionable_design_principles: Test the error cohort the component targets. dry_false_penalty exists to discriminate false_positives from selected_winners conditioned on B0-entry approval — never use false_negatives as the control set, since the cohorts occupy opposite quadrants of the feature space and pooled medians across them are uninformative for this component.

Use within-snapshot matched-pair designs, not pooled contrasts, when the component is claimed to be a regime detector. Snapshot heterogeneity is non-trivial here (≥9 snapshots, distinct vol_ratio_5_20 and up_day_ratio_20 distributions), and pooling destroys exactly the conditional structure that would prove or disprove independence.

Audit data-completeness gates before applying any signal. With pullback null in 75% of ruin cases, the penalty is firing on incomplete state. Either impute deterministically and document, or gate penalty activation on full-feature availability and treat incomplete rows as 'penalty-inactive' rather than 'penalty-zero'.

Separate the falsification of redundancy from the falsification of the 'dry' descriptor. A component can be redundant yet the 'dry' concept can be real (encoded elsewhere); a component can carry weak signal under a non-'dry' framing. Test four orthogonal hypotheses — redundancy, regime-fit, linearity, calibration — rather than collapsing them.

Build snapshot-level placebo penalties before drawing falsification conclusions. Because the archaeology set is selected by B0 primitives, any redundancy finding is mechanically guaranteed without a placebo baseline. Permute penalty_value within snapshot 1000 times and compare Spearman distributions.

Keep matched-pair matching distance interpretable and auditable. Restrict to the six claimed 'most redundant' primitives (mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct) as the primary distance, with pullback features as a robustness secondary — never distance on outcome or label fields.

When ablation indicates non-linear conditional lift (Slot 3c wins), replace the additive penalty with a depth-3 hinge or interaction feature, not a deeper black-box — the conditional structure should be auditable, and 'dry' should resolve to a transparent conjunction.

Insist on a holdout snapshot set for every slot. In-sample archaeology is necessary but insufficient; the component's claim is about future snapshot generalization, and leave-one-snapshot-out is the right unit.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: snapshot_matched_pair_falsifier
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Existing failure archaeology computes pooled medians across false_negatives vs selected_winners — the wrong cohort contrast for a false-positive-targeting component, and it ignores snapshot heterogeneity. This slot anchors a per-snapshot 1:1 matched-pair design (nearest neighbor in 6-feature standardized Euclidean within snapshot, ties broken by Mahalanobis) and tests Δpenalty via a permutation sign test on the matched pairs only.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Pre-experimental verification gate (must pass before any production insertion); runtime audit on each new snapshot to detect drift in matched-pair sign rate; schema-level requirement defining how snapshots are bucketed for matched-pair sampling.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: placebo_penalty_injection_redundancy_test
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Because the archaeology set was selected by B0 primitives, structural redundancy cannot be diagnosed against itself alone. This slot injects a placebo penalty constructed by within-snapshot permutation of the real penalty_value, then compares (a) real-penalty ruin-association strength to (b) placebo-penalty ruin-association strength via within-snapshot Spearman meta-analysis (Fisher combined). Equality of distributions is the redundancy verdict; strictly larger real-penalty effect is the independence verdict.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Pre-experimental verification (mandatory before any swap to a residual-based replacement); holdout validation layer for the falsifier suite; capacity to run at runtime on each new snapshot via fixed-seed within-snapshot permutation to detect drift.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: data_completeness_gate_before_penalty
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Current state allows penalty_value to be non-null when pullback features are null, producing asymmetric activation that confounds the falsification. This slot defines a deterministic gate: penalty_value is 'active' only when all six primitives and both pullback fields are present, and 'inactive' (not zero — distinct) otherwise. The gate itself becomes an audit field tracked alongside penalty_value so retrospective analyses can distinguish 'inactive-on-incomplete' from 'active-and-low'.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Runtime gating in production score (penalty contributes only when activation_state='active'); audit field for any retrospective Slot 1/2/3 rerun to control for asymmetric missingness; schema-enforced via dependency constraint.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: orthogonal_residual_score_replacement
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: If Slot 1/2/3 results support non-redundancy, the existing penalty_value cannot be retained as-is because it conflates its own signal with the six primitives. This slot specifies a replacement score: regress each of {mom_20, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, px_vs_ma50} on the other five within snapshot, take the standardized residual vector, and use the residual magnitude (or a depth-3 hinge on it) as the new penalty. This makes 'independence from B0 neighbors' a property of the construction, not a future empirical finding.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Production score replacement when Slot 1+2 confirm non-redundancy AND Slot 3 indicates non-linearity; schema requirement defining residual computation per snapshot; runtime audit on residual distributions to detect snapshot-induced skew.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'evidence_risk', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The B0 'evidence_risk' component is an aggregator of confirmation-style features (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, mom_20) whose historical value is almost entirely absorbed by neighboring B0 terms — specifically a momentum_b0, a trend_b0, and a volume_b0 — because its constituent features are already load-bearing inputs of those neighbors and load together in the same direction (selected_winner > false_negative across the board).
evidence_for: Numeric contrasts rank the 'evidence-style' features as the top discriminators of false_negative vs selected_winner: up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19σ), vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05σ), mom_20 (-1.00σ), px_vs_ma50 (-0.85σ), ma10_slope_5 (-0.68σ), ma20_slope_5 (-0.60σ), px_vs_ma20 (-0.58σ) — every one of these is a canonical input to a momentum, trend, or volume sub-score, none is unique to a 'risk' interpretation.

Directionality is monotone: selected_winners sit above false_negatives on all confirmation features simultaneously (e.g., mom_20 median 0.163 vs 0.058; vol_ratio_5_20 median 1.424 vs 1.179; up_day_ratio_20 median 0.625 vs 0.500). Co-monotone movement across these features is exactly the signature of latent common factor(s), not independent risk signal.

Case inspection: entity_440e297253 (selected_winner) has moderate mom_20 (0.058) and px_vs_ma50 (0.073) but wins because up_day_ratio_20 is only 0.50 and vol_ratio_5_20 is 1.59 — the win is driven by the same features a standalone momentum_b0 would already score. Conversely entity_535a1beed7 (false_negative_big_winner) is rejected despite vol_ratio_5_20 of 1.17 and mom_20 of 0.028 — confirming the rejection is the absence of the very evidence neighbors already encode.

Outcome classes selected_winner (n=11) and false_positive_ruin (n=8) are not cleanly separable on any single evidence feature (e.g., false_positive_ruin cases have mom_20 medians similar to winners and higher vol_ratio_5_20 than many winners), indicating evidence_risk conflates 'signal present' with 'signal quality' rather than isolating a distinct risk dimension.
evidence_against: up_day_ratio_20 has the largest single standardized delta (-1.19σ) — larger than mom_20 itself — which is consistent with a binary/quantized variable carrying categorical information (broad up-day tape vs choppy tape) that a continuous momentum_b0 may smooth away. This is the strongest candidate for residual content.

pullback_duration_weeks (-0.73σ) and pullback_pct (+0.64σ) co-move with selected_winners in the archaeology; a true pullback_b0 may not be in the B0 panel, in which case evidence_risk would be a de facto proxy for base maturity — non-redundant by construction.

ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct (-0.70σ) describes entry-execution quality relative to the trigger; this is structurally distinct from contemporaneous trend/momentum and could in principle carry execution-alpha information independent of neighbors.

Without the actual B0 coefficient table or partial-correlation matrix, the redundancy claim is inferred from feature overlap, not directly measured — the case for replacement must remain probabilistic.
falsifiable_predictions: In a regression of W4 forward return on (momentum_b0, trend_b0, volume_b0, pullback_b0), adding evidence_risk should raise adjusted R² by less than 1% OOS; a gain >3% OOS would falsify the redundancy claim.

Partial-correlation |corr(evidence_risk, W4_ret | momentum_b0, trend_b0, volume_b0)| should be <0.03 on held-out discovery-train; if it exceeds 0.06, evidence_risk has independent predictive content and should be retained.

Factor loadings: the top 3 PCA components of {mom_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20} should explain >85% of variance; if they explain <70%, evidence_risk spans an orthogonal subspace and the claim collapses.

If evidence_risk is decomposed into sub-scores, the sub-score loadings should correlate >0.7 with neighboring B0 terms' loadings on identical features; lower cross-loadings would indicate evidence_risk captures genuine orthogonal risk content.

Decile-sort test: sorting the universe by evidence_risk alone should reproduce the same false_positive_ruin concentration (n=8 cases) seen in B0-pick archaeology; if it does not, evidence_risk is selecting a different population than its neighbors claim to.
policy_implications: Drop evidence_risk from the B0 panel and re-estimate; expected effect is near-zero performance delta and reduced overfitting risk because redundant dimensions inflate condition-number without adding signal.

Replace evidence_risk with a narrow, orthogonal residual: either (a) data-quality/availability flags (snapshot completeness, price-history length, earnings-imminent flag) which carry no overlap with trend/momentum/volume neighbors; or (b) a regime-interaction term (evidence_risk × vol_regime) which is genuinely nonlinear and cannot be absorbed by linear neighbors; or (c) pullback_base_quality if pullback_b0 is currently absent.

If retained for governance/interpretability reasons, restrict evidence_risk to up_day_ratio_20 and pullback fields only — drop the ma-slope and px-vs-ma members since they are linearly dependent on trend_b0 and relative_strength_b0.

Monitor OOS decay: evidence_risk's IC half-life should match the slowest-decaying neighbor (momentum_b0 ~5 days); a meaningfully shorter half-life would indicate it is picking up noise rather than durable risk content.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The 'evidence_risk is redundant with neighbors' claim is methodologically untestable from the supplied archaeology because (a) the diagnostic used — univariate numeric contrasts between selected_winner and false_negative groups — measures marginal association, not conditional independence; (b) the within-bar feature up_day_ratio_20 is a fundamentally different statistic from net-price mom_20 and is NOT a proxy for it even when they correlate; (c) snapshot-level clustering inflates apparent feature co-movement without implying redundancy; and (d) the single mixed-outcome case (entity_6618d3e80c carries BOTH 'false_positive_ruin' and 'selected_winner' labels) is direct evidence that evidence_risk is missing a temporal/path-dependent dimension, not that it is duplicative. The redundancy conclusion is almost certainly false on closer inspection.

attacks.issue: Wrong counterfactual: marginal contrasts do not establish conditional redundancy
attacks.why_it_matters: Showing that selected_winners sit above false_negatives on {up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, ...} only proves these features share a common cause. To claim evidence_risk is absorbed by neighbors you must compare cases bucketed on equal neighbor values and ask whether evidence_risk still discriminates within the bucket. The archaeology provides exactly zero within-bucket evidence. A feature can be 95% redundant in expectation yet carry 100% of the signal in the tails — that tail content is what matters for ruin avoidance.

attacks.issue: up_day_ratio_20 is NOT a proxy for mom_20 — different information channel
attacks.why_it_matters: mom_20 measures net log-return over 20 sessions; up_day_ratio_20 counts the fraction of up-close sessions. A stock can have mom_20 ≈ 0 with up_day_ratio_20 = 0.7 (choppy net-flat grind higher) or mom_20 = 0.3 with up_day_ratio_20 = 0.5 (one-gap melt-up). The two statistics have different noise floors, different sensitivities to overnight gaps, and different decay profiles. Treating them as redundant because they correlate in-sample ignores that up_day_ratio_20 is closer to a breadth/tape-strength latent while mom_20 is closer to drift. Conflating correlated with redundant is the central methodological error.

attacks.issue: Snapshot clustering inflates cross-feature correlation without implying redundancy
attacks.why_it_matters: Multiple cases share snapshot_anon IDs (e.g., snap_71486ed83c carries 6 cases; snap_d0d57b1e40 carries 5). Within a single snapshot, all stocks experienced the same regime, the same breadth, the same liquidity. This forces every feature in that snapshot toward mutual correlation through a shared regime factor. Numeric contrasts computed across pooled snapshots are therefore biased toward high cross-feature correlation, which the researcher then misreads as redundancy. Snapshot-stratified contrasts would shrink every standardized delta substantially — likely by 40–60% — and the entire redundancy argument collapses on rescaling.

attacks.issue: Standardized deltas computed on n=7–11 are unstable and the ordering is an artifact
attacks.why_it_matters: With 7 false_negative cases and 11 selected_winner cases, the median difference has a bootstrap CI width that easily spans 0.5σ. The researcher reports up_day_ratio_20 as 'largest single standardized delta at -1.19σ' — but with so few observations, swapping one entity's label would reorder the top three. The claim that 'evidence-style features rank at the top' is therefore a labeling-robustness claim that has not been validated. Even more importantly, rank-order of standardized deltas is not evidence of redundancy; it's evidence of univariate separation.

attacks.issue: The mixed-outcome case (entity_6618d3e80c) is a smoking gun for the OPPOSITE conclusion
attacks.why_it_matters: entity_6618d3e80c carries 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner' — meaning at some horizon it was picked and won, at another it was picked and ruined. A purely point-in-time evidence_risk cannot produce two contradictory outcomes for the same entity unless either (i) the feature panel changed between the two snapshots (it didn't — same feature set), or (ii) the feature failed to capture the path-dependent structure that determined the divergent outcomes. This is direct evidence that evidence_risk is UNDER-SPECIFIED, not over-specified. The clean replacement would be a path-dependent or regime-conditional feature, not removal.

attacks.issue: Pullback dimensions appearing in archaeology but absent from evidence_risk's feature list implies MISSING orthogonal content, not redundancy
attacks.why_it_matters: pullback_duration_weeks (-0.73σ) and pullback_pct (+0.64σ) are top discriminators in the false_negative vs selected_winner contrast, yet they are not enumerated among evidence_risk's constituents. If evidence_risk is currently absorbing pullback information incidentally, then evidence_risk is functioning as a hidden pullback proxy — orthogonal to momentum/trend/volume. Dropping it would delete pullback signal. The researcher notes this possibility in passing but does not let it falsify the redundancy claim; instead they propose adding it back as a 'cleaner replacement,' which concedes that evidence_risk was doing real work.

attacks.issue: false_positive_ruin definition is path-dependent but the feature panel is snapshot-fixed — measurement mismatch is being misattributed to redundancy
attacks.why_it_matters: A false_positive_ruin label requires the stock to be selected, then to decline. This depends on features observed AFTER the snapshot (post-entry trajectory) combined with features at the snapshot. Any feature that doesn't capture post-entry dynamics will look 'redundant' — not because it is, but because the diagnostic conflates 'predicts at t' with 'predicts over t→t+W'. Evidence_risk features are computed at snapshot time; the ruin label depends on a window AFTER. The redundancy claim is partially an artifact of testing a static feature against a dynamic outcome.

attacks.issue: The 'nonlinear interaction' alternative was dismissed as a residual option but is actually the strongest competitor explanation
attacks.why_it_matters: vol_ratio_5_20 × up_day_ratio_20 jointly may carry product-moment information that no linear combination of the constituent terms captures. If momentum_b0 = w1·mom_20, trend_b0 = w2·px_vs_ma50, and volume_b0 = w3·vol_ratio_5_20, none of them can reproduce the interaction surface evidence_risk may be estimating. The researcher's policy implication lists 'evidence_risk × vol_regime' as a residual — but this is the natural conclusion if redundancy is rejected. The replacement they recommend is functionally evidence_risk under another name.

counterexamples_to_seek: Within snapshot_anon = snap_71486ed83c, compare entity_ead73f4390 (B0-pick, selected_winner) against entity_de1c657364 (B0-reject, false_negative_big_winner) on the conditional distribution of evidence_risk given identical (mom_20, ma10_slope_5, vol_ratio_5_20). If evidence_risk still separates them, redundancy is rejected in its strongest test.

Find cases where mom_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 are both above the selected_winner median but evidence_risk is below — these are the 'neighbors say yes, evidence_risk says no' counterexamples. The archaeology does not contain any, but extending the snapshot window should reveal some. Their absence would support redundancy; their presence would kill it.

Re-run the numeric contrasts after replacing evidence_risk with a random permutation of itself (same marginal distribution, no real content). If the standardized deltas barely move, evidence_risk is contributing nothing. If they collapse to ~0, evidence_risk was the load-bearing feature. This is the cheapest available placebo test.

Compute the rank correlation between evidence_risk and a synthetic 'redundant aggregator' constructed as a weighted sum of the three neighbor features. If rank correlation is <0.85, evidence_risk is not redundant. If >0.95, redundancy is empirically supported. The test takes five minutes and was not run.

Examine the within-bar distribution conditional on outcome: for false_positive_ruin cases, is up_day_ratio_20 high but with low average up-day magnitude (narrow bars, high count) vs for selected_winner high with high magnitude? If the moment structure differs, up_day_ratio_20 is carrying genuinely different content than mom_20.
what_would_change_my_mind: An OOS test (held-out discovery-train) where W4 return is regressed on (momentum_b0, trend_b0, volume_b0) versus (+ evidence_risk), and the Δadjusted-R² is below 0.5% AND the OOS IC decay profile of evidence_risk matches the slowest neighbor to within 1 day. Both conditions are required; one is insufficient.

Snapshot-stratified numeric contrasts (computed within snap_71486ed83c alone, then within snap_d0d57b1e40 alone) showing that within-snapshot evidence_risk signal collapses to <0.3σ standardized delta — i.e., the apparent evidence_risk content was a snapshot confound, not a real feature.

A rank-correlation matrix showing corr(evidence_risk, momentum_b0) > 0.92 AND corr(evidence_risk, trend_b0) > 0.85 AND corr(evidence_risk, volume_b0) > 0.80 in held-out data. Only if all three exceed these thresholds does redundancy become the most parsimonious model.

Demonstration that the mixed-outcome case (entity_6618d3e80c) is an artifact of overlapping snapshot windows — i.e., the two outcome labels were assigned at non-comparable time points, and at any single consistent timestamp only one outcome applies. If path-dependence can be ruled out, the strongest objection to the redundancy claim is defanged.

Replication on a temporally disjoint sample (different macro regime, different breadth regime) showing the same co-monotonic feature ranking and the same within-bucket evidence_risk non-discrimination. The current n=27 sample is regime-concentrated and may not generalize.

tests.name: within_snapshot_conditional_discrimination
tests.comparison: Within each snapshot_anon bucket (snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_b8420124eb hold >=4 cases), compute the rank of evidence_risk among cases sharing that snapshot. Compare the rank distribution of is_b0_pick=true winners vs is_b0_pick=false false_negatives WITHIN the bucket using a one-sided Mann-Whitney on within-snapshot rank. Pool across all buckets with at least 2 outcome-class members using Fisher's combined p-value.
tests.success_criterion: Combined p < 0.10 with consistent directional sign across >=3 populated buckets (evidence_risk still orders outcomes even after neighbor-style features are equalized by snapshot regime)
tests.failure_criterion: Combined p >= 0.30 OR sign inconsistency across >=2 populated buckets (evidence_risk loses all separation once snapshot regime is held fixed; signal was a regime-confound artifact)

tests.name: synthetic_redundant_aggregator_placebo
tests.comparison: Construct synthetic_redundant = z(mom_20) + z(ma10_slope_5) + z(px_vs_ma50) + z(vol_ratio_5_20) using equal weights, where z() denotes within-snapshot rank standardization (this strips cross-snapshot regime confounding AND removes any idiosyncratic evidence_risk content). Compute the false_negative vs selected_winner standardized delta of synthetic_redundant and compare to evidence_risk's standardized delta in the same data. Bootstrap CI on the delta-difference with 1000 resamples stratified by snapshot_anon.
tests.success_criterion: evidence_risk delta - synthetic_redundant delta is within [-0.15σ, +0.15σ] (evidence_risk contributes no detectable content beyond what a uniform-weights neighbor aggregator already encodes)
tests.failure_criterion: evidence_risk delta exceeds synthetic_redundant delta by >0.30σ with bootstrap p<0.05 (evidence_risk carries at least one piece of orthogonal information not captured by a hand-built redundant aggregator)

tests.name: up_day_ratio_orthogonal_to_mom_20
tests.comparison: Restrict the 27 cases to the bucket where |mom_20| <= 0.05 (near-zero drift subset; pre-identify as mom_20 bucket B). Within bucket B, compute the false_negative vs (selected_winner ∪ false_positive_ruin) separation on up_day_ratio_20 alone using Mann-Whitney. If up_day_ratio_20 is a pure proxy for mom_20, this bucket should be empty of separation; if up_day_ratio_20 captures breadth/tape-strength independently of drift, it should still discriminate.
tests.success_criterion: Mann-Whitney p < 0.20 with separation in the SAME direction observed in the full-sample contrast (up_day_ratio_20 carries content orthogonal to mom_20 drift)
tests.failure_criterion: p >= 0.50 with separation <0.10 in either direction (up_day_ratio_20's apparent signal collapses once mom_20 is fixed — these two features are measuring the same latent quantity)

tests.name: mixed_outcome_feature_geometry
tests.comparison: For entity_6618d3e80c (carries BOTH 'false_positive_ruin' AND 'selected_winner'), project its 8-feature vector onto the centroid of (a) all 8 false_positive_ruin cases and (b) all 11 selected_winner cases, using Mahalanobis distance computed on the within-snapshot rank-standardized features. If evidence_risk's feature panel is sufficient, the case should land in the overlap region of the two outcome-class density estimates; if evidence_risk is under-specified for path-dependent outcomes, the case should land unambiguously closer to ONE centroid despite the dual label.
tests.success_criterion: Mahalanobis distance to false_positive_ruin centroid within 0.5 units of distance to selected_winner centroid (case sits in ambiguity zone; evidence_risk feature set honestly signals this ambiguity — consistent with redundancy to neighbors)
tests.failure_criterion: Distance to one centroid exceeds the other by >1.5 units (evidence_risk's static feature vector predicts a single outcome with high confidence, but reality produced both → evidence_risk is missing a temporal/path-dependent dimension)

tests.name: interaction_surface_vol_x_upday
tests.comparison: Compute interaction = z(vol_ratio_5_20) * z(up_day_ratio_20) within each snapshot_anon bucket. Add this interaction to a base model of (mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 + vol_ratio_5_20 + up_day_ratio_20) and test whether the interaction coefficient is non-zero in a logistic regression on outcome (with is_b0_pick and selected_winner combined vs false_negative + false_positive_ruin as the binary target). Pre-specify the interaction must move pseudo-R^2 by >=0.02 to count as orthogonal content.
tests.success_criterion: Interaction term p < 0.10 AND pseudo-R^2 lift >= 0.02 (vol_ratio × up_day_ratio product carries information that no linear combination of constituents reproduces — strong evidence evidence_risk is encoding an interaction surface)
tests.failure_criterion: Interaction term p >= 0.30 AND pseudo-R^2 lift < 0.01 (the product term adds nothing; evidence_risk's information is purely linear and fully absorbed by individual neighbor components)

tests.name: clean_replacement_construction_test
tests.comparison: Construct two candidate replacement scores using ONLY PIT features NOT load-bearing on momentum/trend/volume neighbors: (R1) pullback_residual = z(pullback_duration_weeks) + z(-pullback_pct) (base-maturity proxy, currently absent from B0), and (R2) execution_quality = z(ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct) + z(ibd_entry_close_position). Evaluate each on the false_negative vs selected_winner Mann-Whitney contrast and on the within-snapshot conditional discrimination test defined above. The cleaner replacement is the candidate that (i) achieves higher within-snapshot separation than evidence_risk and (ii) has zero cross-loading >0.50 with mom_20, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20 in the 27-case snapshot-stratified correlation matrix.
tests.success_criterion: At least one candidate (R1 or R2) satisfies both (i) and (ii); that candidate becomes the prescribed replacement and falsifies the 'evidence_risk has no orthogonal role' claim by constructive demonstration
tests.failure_criterion: Neither R1 nor R2 satisfies (i) and (ii); this means ALL non-neighbor-overlapping PIT features also lack orthogonal content in this sample, supporting the redundancy claim by elimination

leakage_checks: Verify that pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct are computed at snapshot time t and reference only base-formation history prior to t (not post-entry drawdown). If either field was filled using post-snapshot data, exclude from replacement candidates R1/R2.
