Verify ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct is the gap between actual fill and the trigger price as observed at entry execution, not a forward-looking quality score; if it uses post-snapshot fill data it must be flagged and either dropped from the test panel or restricted to cases where entry occurred before snapshot.

Confirm snapshot_anon IDs are clustered by approximate calendar week (audit a sample of two snapshots to verify within-snapshot cases share a regime date) before treating within-snapshot pooling as a valid regime-equalization step; if snapshot IDs are arbitrary groupings, the within-snapshot tests lose their conditioning power.

Confirm none of the 27 archaeology cases were retroactively relabeled using information that postdates the snapshot; if a false_positive_ruin label was assigned using a close at t+W4 that became available AFTER the snapshot, the within-bucket tests would inherit a labeling-side leakage that biases toward 'evidence_risk is under-specified.' Pre-commit to using only labels timestamped <= snapshot t.

Audit is_b0_pick assignment for any case where evidence_risk was itself the selection criterion (circular selection bias); if evidence_risk features participated in B0 selection, the false_negative pool is selection-biased by construction and ALL redundancy tests in this cycle are uninterpretable — flag as UNRESOLVED rather than running tests.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The Researcher, Skeptic, and Experimental Designer outputs are not in flat contradiction; they describe DIFFERENT failure modes that have not yet been empirically separated. The Researcher's redundancy claim rests on unconditional co-monotonicity of confirmation features across outcome classes — which the Skeptic correctly notes is consistent with either (a) true redundancy absorbed by neighbors, (b) snapshot-regime confounding inflating cross-feature correlation, or (c) a common latent cause that all confirmation features tap without any one of them being uniquely informative. The Skeptic's mixed-outcome case (entity_6618d3e80c) is the strongest single piece of evidence in this cycle, but it cuts against the redundancy claim in a subtle way: the same feature vector producing both winner and ruin outcomes is the EXACT signature of an under-specified static aggregator, not an over-specified redundant one. Therefore the question 'does evidence_risk carry independent content?' cannot be answered by the current evidence: (i) we lack the B0 coefficient table / partial-correlation matrix the Researcher admits is missing; (ii) we lack the within-snapshot conditional tests the Experimental Designer proposes but has not executed; (iii) the standardized deltas on n=7–11 are too noisy to discriminate redundancy from common latent causation; (iv) the cross-feature correlation pattern is inflated by snapshot clustering (snap_71486ed83c alone carries 6 cases, snap_d0d57b1e40 carries 5). The honest verdict is that the question is undecided, with a slight lean toward CONTEXT_DEPENDENT — specifically, that ma-slope and px-vs-ma sub-features are plausibly redundant with trend_b0/relative_strength_b0 while up_day_ratio_20 plausibly carries orthogonal breadth/tape-strength content, and the right policy is to decompose rather than wholesale drop or wholesale retain.
falsifiers: PRIMARY: Run the Experimental Designer's within_snapshot_conditional_discrimination test. If combined Fisher p < 0.10 with consistent sign across >=3 populated buckets, evidence_risk carries content orthogonal to neighbors after regime-equalization — REFUTING the wholesale-redundancy claim. If combined p >= 0.30 OR sign inconsistency across >=2 buckets, the Researcher's redundancy claim is SUPPORTED. The test has not been run; until it is, the verdict is UNRESOLVED by construction.

SECONDARY: Run the synthetic_redundant_aggregator_placebo test. If evidence_risk delta exceeds synthetic_redundant delta by >0.30σ with bootstrap p<0.05, evidence_risk contains orthogonal content not captured by uniform-weights neighbor aggregators — SUPPORTS retention. If the delta-difference is within [-0.15σ, +0.15σ], SUPPORTS redundancy. Equal-weights synthetic may itself be too generous; a tighter falsifier is whether ANY convex combination of mom_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20 can match evidence_risk's within-snapshot separation.

THIRD: Decomposition falsifier. Fit evidence_risk as a weighted sum of its sub-features (up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct) and inspect the loadings. If up_day_ratio_20's loading weight is more than 2σ above its proportional share (1/7), up_day_ratio_20 is the orthogonal core and the rest are padding — this would SUPPORT a 'keep only up_day_ratio_20' policy that neither Researcher nor Skeptic explicitly proposed.

MIXED-OUTCOME RESOLUTION: Compute the within-snapshot Mahalanobis distance from entity_6618d3e80c to the false_positive_ruin centroid versus the selected_winner centroid in the 8-feature space. If the case sits closer to false_positive_ruin by >1.0 unit, evidence_risk DID predict the ruin side (consistent with redundancy producing shared fate across multiple snapshots rather than under-specification). If it sits in the ambiguity zone (<0.5 unit difference), under-specification is supported. This single test resolves the strongest Skeptic argument against the Researcher's redundancy claim.

PATH-DEPENDENCE PROBE: For all 27 cases, check whether the time-between-snapshot-and-W4-outcome is correlated with outcome class (selected_winner vs false_positive_ruin). If path-dependent timing matters but is NOT represented in any B0 feature, this is direct evidence of under-specification and falsifies the 'drop evidence_risk' policy recommendation.

BOOTSTRAP STABILITY: Resample the 27 cases 1000 times with snapshot stratification, recompute the standardized delta ordering, and check whether up_day_ratio_20 stably ranks #1. If it does, the Researcher's ranking claim survives and 'up_day_ratio_20 carries unique content' becomes more credible. If it doesn't, the Researcher's evidence-against section loses its strongest specific claim.
actionable_design_principles: Do not conflate unconditional co-monotonicity across outcome classes with conditional redundancy. Two features can both separate winners from losers (showing common latent cause) without either being redundant with the other once the latent is fixed.

Snapshot clustering (snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_b8420124eb) acts as a free stratification axis that MUST be honored before computing any cross-feature correlation or contrast; pooling across snapshots inflates mutual correlation through shared regime factors.

The mixed-outcome case entity_6618d3e80c is the most information-dense observation in the archaeology and should anchor the analysis: a static feature vector producing both winner and ruin outcomes is the canonical signature of an under-specified (not over-specified) aggregator, and the policy implication flips from 'drop' to 'expand with path/regime dimensions.'

Sub-feature decomposition must precede any retention/drop decision: ma10_slope_5 and ma20_slope_5 are likely absorbed by trend_b0, px_vs_ma20 and px_vs_ma50 by relative_strength_b0, but up_day_ratio_20 (count statistic, distinct noise floor from mom_20's net-return statistic) plausibly carries orthogonal breadth/tape-strength content and vol_ratio_5_20 may carry orthogonal short-horizon volatility content.

The researcher's policy implication to drop evidence_risk entirely is NOT supported by the evidence available in this cycle. Both wholesale-drop and wholesale-retain are premature; the falsifier battery above must complete before either policy is locked in.

Bootstrap with snapshot stratification is the minimum credible test of any cross-feature claim on n=27 — uns stratified bootstrap standard errors on these contrasts will be 2-3× larger than naive bootstrap, which alone shifts the verdict toward UNRESOLVED.

Mixed-outcome cases are rare and should be preserved as diagnostic specimens rather than averaged into outcome-class statistics; they carry more information about under-specification than 10 single-outcome cases.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Decompose evidence_risk into a primary breadth component (up_day_ratio_20 with explicit anti-proxy guard: |corr(up_day_ratio_20, mom_20)| < 0.7 within snapshot) and a secondary confirmation component (vol_ratio_5_20), and drop the ma-slope and px-vs-ma sub-features that are demonstrably collinear with trend_b0 and relative_strength_b0.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Neither Researcher's 'drop everything' nor Skeptic's 'expand everything' — this preserves the most defensible orthogonal sub-feature (up_day_ratio_20) while removing demonstrably redundant members. Directly addresses the sub-feature decomposition falsifier above.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Reduces evidence_risk dimensionality from 7+ features to 2, lowering condition-number contribution to the B0 score while preserving breadth signal that mom_20 cannot capture (different noise floor, different sensitivity to overnight gaps).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add a regime-conditional interaction term evidence_x_regime = z(up_day_ratio_20) * z(vol_ratio_5_20) computed within snapshot, tested for nonzero coefficient in a logistic regression with the existing B0 neighbors as baseline.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Captures the nonlinear tape-strength × short-volatility structure the Experimental Designer's interaction_surface_vol_x_upday test was designed to detect. If the interaction pseudo-R² lift >= 0.02, this is the constructive demonstration that evidence_risk's content is interactional rather than additive — a third failure mode distinct from both pure redundancy and pure under-specification.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Increases capacity for capturing tape-conditional volatility regimes that no linear B0 neighbor encodes; capacity gain is bounded by interaction depth (max order 2 to keep interpretation tractable).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add a base-maturity component base_quality_score = z(pullback_duration_weeks) + z(-pullback_pct) (currently absent from B0 panel, identified by both Researcher and Skeptic as plausibly orthogonal), gated by the absence of a dedicated pullback_b0 neighbor.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Pullback_b0 is not enumerated in the available B0 panel; if it is genuinely absent, then base_quality is genuinely orthogonal to all neighbors. The Researcher's 'replacement R1' candidate. If a pullback_b0 exists, the gate prevents double-counting.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Fills a structural gap (base-maturity) that the current B0 panel leaves unaddressed; directly relevant to entity_6618d3e80c-type mixed-outcome cases where pullback structure may have been the under-captured dimension.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add a path-uncertainty penalty path_entropy_proxy = z(realized_volatility_residual) where the residual is the part of rv_20 unexplained by |mom_20|, computed within snapshot. Use this as a soft DOWN-weight on cases where the static feature panel cannot disambiguate (analogous to entity_6618d3e80c).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the Skeptic's strongest point: when static features are insufficient to discriminate, the policy should be CAUTION (lower position size or skip) rather than DROPPING the score entirely. This converts 'evidence_risk is under-specified' from a verdict into an actionable risk-management signal.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Increases risk-management capacity at the cost of a small additional feature computation; orthogonal to score-capacity since this gates position size rather than score value.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Snapshot-stratified standardization gate: any new evidence-feature must satisfy the within-snapshot |correlation| < 0.5 with all existing B0 neighbor loadings BEFORE being admitted to the B0 panel.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the Experimental Designer's clean_replacement_construction_test (criterion ii) as a permanent guardrail rather than a one-time test. Prevents future reintroduction of redundant features through model-iteration drift.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Reduces capacity wasted on collinear features; preserves capacity for genuinely orthogonal additions. The gate threshold (0.5) is a tunable policy parameter.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'freshness', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: If B0 'freshness' represents recent and sufficiently deep corrective price-time activity, it should add predictive information beyond neighboring B0 terms such as momentum, moving-average trend, entry extension, and volume. The supplied cases do not establish that role: shorter and shallower pullbacks among false negatives instead suggest that freshness may be redundant with a broader recent-strength or early-breakout state.
evidence_for: All listed covariates are point-in-time observable: pullback duration and percentage, moving-average slopes and price extensions, momentum, up-day ratio, volatility ratio, entry extension, and selection status were available at the decision snapshot.

False-negative cases generally resemble selected winners on several strength features, making the selection miss potentially consistent with an omitted recency attribute. For example, false negatives with median up_day_ratio_20 of 0.50, vol_ratio_5_20 of 1.179, and mom_20 of 0.058 are not trivially weak, although these values are below selected-winner medians of 0.625, 1.424, and 0.163.

Selected winners often combine strong trend measures with a documented pullback: examples include 3 weeks at -1.5%, 5 weeks at -6.7%, 6 weeks at -25.1%, and 9 weeks at -42.3%. This is compatible with freshness meaning a recently completed setup rather than simply a low base age.

Among the reported 27 cases, false positives are not restricted to one obvious lack-of-freshness profile. For example, entity_3472243e0c has no recorded pullback, while entity_8f0df3d38e has a 7-week, -16.2% pullback. Pullback non-availability is itself evidence of missing or incomparably measured state information, not evidence of staleness.
evidence_against: The strongest numeric contrast points opposite to a simple long-or-deep-pullback definition of freshness: false negatives have a median pullback_duration_weeks of 4.0 versus 5.5 for selected winners, and a median pullback_pct of -7.3% versus -15.9% for selected winners. Missing pullbacks prevent a valid full-sample median test, but the observed pattern does not show that greater depth or longer duration improves W4 selection.

Freshness-related features move together with multiple neighboring B0 terms. False negatives have lower medians than selected winners for mom_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20, and ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct. The supplied evidence contains no nested model or partial-correlation estimate showing incremental value after controlling for these terms.

Several selected winners have weak or flat measured trends despite winning labels, including entity_2f86543bf6 with mom_20 near zero and a negative ma20_slope_5, and entity_8ad5cd4795 with slightly negative moving-average slopes. Conversely, strong trend states appear in both selected winners and false positives. This weakens any claim that freshness primarily filters exhausted or overextended names.

Outcome labels are post-decision quantities: selected_winner, false_positive_ruin, false_negative_relative, and false_negative_big_winner|false_negative_relative encode W4 performance relative to the selected cohort. They are not mechanisms and must not be treated as inputs when testing whether freshness adds predictive information.

The false-positive_ruin|selected_winner combined label indicates that the same entity can be classified differently across operational rules or horizons. This creates label ambiguity that can make a measured feature appear predictive without proving a stable B0 mechanism.

No direct definition, timestamp, or event date for 'freshness' is supplied. Neither null pullback fields nor null base fields should be interpreted as no pullback or no base; they create missingness patterns that may reflect setup eligibility rather than economic state.
falsifiable_predictions: In a strictly point-in-time, grouped-time evaluation, a preregistered freshness feature should improve out-of-sample W4 return or calibrated win probability after controlling for mom_20, moving-average slopes, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, entry extension, and volume. A non-positive out-of-sample incremental coefficient, likelihood-ratio test, or change in partial R-squared would falsify the claimed independent role.

After controlling for those neighboring terms, each additional week or percentage point of pullback depth should not lower predicted forward return or increase ruin probability. If the incremental effect is non-positive in out-of-sample folds, a depth/duration freshness component should be rejected.

Within matched strata defined by momentum, trend slopes, price extension, and volume, recently initiated pullbacks and older pullbacks should exhibit different conditional return distributions. Failure to reject the same conditional distribution across the full freshness range would falsify freshness as a distinct signal.

Feature ablations that add freshness to a baseline model should not worsen calibration, ruin rate, or net performance after realistic transaction costs. Conversely, a model whose apparent freshness gain disappears when pullback records are missing, excluded, or required to be complete would indicate a selection artifact rather than a mechanism.

The estimated effect of freshness should remain directionally stable across separate time regimes, market directions, and liquidity buckets. Sign reversals or insignificant effects in a held-out regime would reject portability of the claimed role.
policy_implications: Treat freshness as UNRESOLVED rather than adding it to B0 production scoring. Require a precise point-in-time definition and explicit missing-state category before estimation.

Estimate a nested baseline containing momentum, short- and medium-term moving-average slopes, price-to-MA extensions, entry extension, and volume, then test freshness by likelihood-ratio, partial R-squared, and out-of-sample calibration comparisons. Penalize its score if those tests show redundancy.

Do not encode freshness as pullback depth times duration. The current contrast is more consistent with a recent-strength or pullback-status feature than with deeper or longer correction being intrinsically beneficial.

A cleaner replacement is a two-part 'setup recency' variable: time from a mechanically detected pullback or base pivot to the decision date, with separate positive indicators for a completed contraction and a fresh breakout. Its parameters should be estimated jointly with the neighboring trend and extension terms, with missingness handled as a neutral setup-status category rather than as zero or stale.

Keep portfolio effects outside the mechanism test. Selection thresholds, portfolio limits, and liquidity can alter realized outcomes independently of a stock-level freshness mechanism, so component validation should use conditional stock-level outcomes before applying any portfolio construction.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: B0 'freshness' is not an independent corrective-recency signal but a redundant re-encoding of an early-breakout / vol-regime composite already captured by vol_ratio_5_20, px_vs_ma20/ma50, and ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct; in the 27-case archaeology the pullback-depth/duration framing obscures a multicollinearity structure in which the largest false-negative contrast (vol_ratio_5_20, standardized delta -1.05) belongs to a neighboring B0 term, not to any freshness construct, and several high-freshness setups (deep, recent pullbacks) underperform.

attacks.issue: The freshness construct is not identified separately from its supposed neighbors because the candidate control set was chosen to exclude ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct from the 'neighboring' family, even though this variable is itself a point-in-time recency/extension measure (-0.70 standardized delta vs. selected winners). Treating freshness as separable while omitting the single most temporally local neighbor is construct laundering.
attacks.why_it_matters: Any apparent incremental value of freshness is an arithmetic consequence of the omitted variable: the very proxy for 'how recent is the trigger relative to the prior pivot' is hidden in a competing term, so any 'independent' freshness contribution measured against the remaining covariates is partly the masked ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct effect.

attacks.issue: Conditional inclusion bias: pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct are undefined for entities that never entered a recognized pullback state under B0 rules. The 27-case panel is therefore not random with respect to freshness - it oversamples setups that satisfied prior eligibility filters. A freshness coefficient estimated on this conditional sample is mechanically biased toward zero (range restriction) and any signal it surfaces is confounded with the upstream eligibility filter that created the missingness.
attacks.why_it_matters: Even a real freshness effect would be attenuated by the missing-not-at-random truncation, and the sign of any observed effect is not identifiable without modeling the missingness mechanism. Null findings would be falsely reassuring; positive findings would be confounded with the eligibility filter.

attacks.issue: The 27 cases contain a single entity (entity_6618d3e80c) carrying the joint label false_positive_ruin|selected_winner, plus cases with null pullback fields that are silently treated as 'no pullback'. Together these create label/feature ambiguity that, in a small n=27 panel, can flip any 'freshness' effect across a sign-change threshold purely by reclassifying one or two outliers.
attacks.why_it_matters: With n=27 the effective degrees of freedom are too few to survive even one such reclassification. Any claim that freshness carries independent predictive content is therefore not statistically falsifiable at this sample size, and the point estimates are dominated by edge-case label noise rather than a mechanism.

attacks.issue: Counterexample density: at least three large-freshness setups underperformed (entity_8f0df3d38e: 7wk/-16.2% -> ruin; entity_ccc90a671f: 7wk/-14.4% -> ruin; entity_55c2da490e: 7wk/-12.3% -> ruin), while a low-freshness setup won (entity_440e297253: 3wk/-1.5% -> large_win). This is a higher concentration of deep-pullback failures than shallow-pullback wins, opposite to the directional reading of a depth-based freshness hypothesis.
attacks.why_it_matters: If freshness were truly a corrective-recency signal, deep-recent pullbacks should dominate the selected_winner bucket relative to false_positive_ruin. The observed pattern - deep pullbacks concentrating in false positives - is evidence against, not for, the depth/duration reading of freshness.

attacks.issue: The single largest standardized delta in the false-negative vs. selected-winner contrast is vol_ratio_5_20 at -1.05, larger than any pullback-related feature. Freshness is most plausibly reading off this volatility-regime variable rather than off pullback structure; the 'freshness' label is therefore misnamed and its claimed mechanism (price-time corrective activity) is unsupported by the dominant contrast.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the underlying signal is recent volatility expansion - the canonical signature of an early breakout - then freshness collapses into a duplicate of an existing B0 term and cannot survive a partial-correlation test controlling for vol_ratio_5_20. Any claim that freshness has independent predictive content must first survive this specific control.

attacks.issue: The researcher output treats post-decision labels (selected_winner, false_positive_ruin, false_negative_relative) as inputs to the falsification logic. These labels encode W4 relative-to-cohort outcomes and therefore embed the very selection rule whose freshness component is being tested. Using a label that already depends on the B0 score to evaluate the B0 score is circular and inflates apparent sharpness.
attacks.why_it_matters: Any 'freshness correctly distinguishes winners from losers' finding that uses these labels is partly a tautology: the labels were constructed from a rule that already weighted the same family of inputs. Circular evaluation makes the mechanism unfalsifiable from within the supplied evidence.

attacks.issue: Within-stratum testability is undermined: freshness is supposed to refine selection inside cohorts that already pass mom_20, slope, and extension filters. The 27 cases are too sparse to support stratum-conditional analysis (most strata have n<5), so any 'no within-strata effect' claim is an artifact of insufficient power, not evidence of redundancy.
attacks.why_it_matters: A cleaner falsification requires matched strata of size sufficient for conditional inference. The current evidence cannot distinguish 'freshness is redundant' from 'freshness is real but undetectable at n=27 per stratum', so the researcher output's redundancy reading is itself unfalsifiable.

counterexamples_to_seek: A selected_winner with a null or extremely stale (>= 12-week) pullback record: this would directly contradict a recency-based freshness specification, since a 'fresh' corrective event is conspicuously absent yet the setup still wins.

A false_positive_ruin with a textbook-deep recent pullback (>= 6 weeks, >= -15%) AND a large positive vol_ratio_5_20: this isolates the case where freshness mechanisms and breakout mechanisms conflict, and would localize which component (pullback vs. vol-regime) is driving outcomes.

A pair of snapshots from the same cohort window where one candidate has shallower/shorter pullback and wins while the matched deeper/longer pullback candidate loses: this directly inverts the freshness directional hypothesis at fixed sector/regime.

An entity where ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct is high (>= 0.05) but pullback recency is also 'fresh', testing whether the freshness construct is additive to or substitutable with the existing entry-extension B0 term.

A false_negative_big_winner entity whose ma10_slope_5 and ma20_slope_5 are above selected-winner medians yet was missed: this isolates whether the exclusion was driven by freshness or by upstream rules; if upstream rules explain the miss, freshness is non-additive by construction.
what_would_change_my_mind: A pre-registered, point-in-time freshness construct with explicit missingness categories, evaluated in a held-out window with nested likelihood-ratio or partial R-squared tests against the full neighboring-B0 set INCLUDING ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct and vol_ratio_5_20, yielding a directionally stable, statistically positive incremental contribution at adequate per-stratum n.

A within-stratum matched comparison (mom_20, slopes, extension, vol_ratio_5_20 all matched to within tight bands) showing that high-freshness and low-freshness candidates differ in conditional W4 return distribution at conventional significance levels, replicated across two independent time regimes.

An ablation in which freshness is added to a baseline that already contains vol_ratio_5_20 and ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct and produces a calibration improvement (Brier score, ruin rate) that survives a 5pp transaction-cost haircut - showing the mechanism, not the collinearity, is what carries the value.

Direct evidence that freshness is NOT simply vol_ratio_5_20 in disguise: namely a construct whose partial correlation with vol_ratio_5_20 is low (<0.3) and whose incremental coefficient in a regression with both terms included remains significant out-of-sample.

Re-labeling of the n=27 archaeology under independent rules (e.g., fixed forward-return thresholds rather than cohort-relative labels) that reproduces the freshness direction - this would break the circular dependency between the evaluation label and the B0 score.

tests.name: freshness_block_vs_neighbor_trio_incremental
tests.comparison: Fit nested models on the 27-case archaeology (only cases with non-null pullback fields) and require estimation on a larger held-out discovery cohort. Compare (A) baseline trio (mom_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma20) versus (B) baseline trio + freshness block as the 4th-6th slot. W4 discrimination is the calibration metric.
tests.success_criterion: Adding the freshness block to the baseline trio yields a positive partial contribution (likelihood-ratio test p<0.10, or increment in Brier score >0) and a directionally stable coefficient on at least one of pullback_duration_weeks / pullback_pct across two independent time regimes, holding vol_ratio_5_20 and the baseline trio fixed.
tests.failure_criterion: Coefficient on pullback_duration_weeks or pullback_pct is non-positive in out-of-sample folds, OR the block contributes no measurable partial information once vol_ratio_5_20 is included, OR the coefficient sign flips across regimes. Any of these fails the test.

tests.name: vol_regime_substitution_test
tests.comparison: Hypothesis: 'freshness' is a re-labelled early-breakout / volatility-regime composite already encoded in vol_ratio_5_20. Substitute the vol-regime trio for any freshness specification and test whether W4 discrimination (Brier, ruin-rate at the B0 cut) is indistinguishable. Compare to the explicit pullback-recency block.
tests.success_criterion: The vol-regime trio replicates within tolerance (AUC delta < 0.02 absolute; ruin-rate delta < 2pp) the W4 discrimination attributed to the freshness block, and partial correlation between vol_ratio_5_20 and any freshness proxy exceeds 0.5.
tests.failure_criterion: Vol-regime trio fails to replicate the freshness block's discrimination (AUC delta > 0.05), OR partial correlation between vol_ratio_5_20 and the freshness specification is below 0.3, AND the freshness block retains incremental value after vol_ratio_5_20 is partialled out.

tests.name: entry_extension_substitution_test
tests.comparison: Hypothesis: 'freshness' is a recency-of-trigger proxy already encoded by entry-extension trio. Replace freshness block with the entry-extension trio and compare W4 discrimination and ruin rate. The skeptic's omitted-variable attack lives here.
tests.success_criterion: Entry-extension trio reproduces the freshness block's W4 separation (AUC delta < 0.02) and the freshness block contributes nothing once the entry-extension trio is added (likelihood-ratio p>0.5).
tests.failure_criterion: Entry-extension trio fails to reproduce freshness discrimination (AUC delta > 0.05) AND the freshness block survives inclusion of the entry-extension trio at p<0.10.

tests.name: within_stratum_matched_comparison
tests.comparison: Within strata defined by the three-slot triple (mom_20 quintile x vol_ratio_5_20 quintile x px_vs_ma20 quintile), compare W4 returns of fresh vs. stale pullback candidates. Minimum per-stratum n=10 for inclusion; otherwise stratum is pooled. This separates freshness from neighborhood by construction.
tests.success_criterion: Across matched strata, fresh-pullback candidates show a W4 median return at least 3pp higher than stale-pullback candidates, with the same direction in >=70% of qualifying strata and joint sign-rank test p<0.10.
tests.failure_criterion: No median W4 return gap >1pp across matched strata, OR the sign of the gap is inconsistent across qualifying strata (binomial sign-rank test p>0.5), OR fewer than 4 strata qualify at n>=10 (UNRESOLVED declared for power).

tests.name: missingness_pattern_status_test
tests.comparison: Split the cohort by null/non-null pullback_duration_weeks. Treat missingness as a neutral status category (not zero-imputed). Test whether the null/non-null split alone, plus the baseline trio, predicts W4 outcome independently of any pullback magnitude. Isolates whether freshness is partly an upstream-eligibility artifact.
tests.success_criterion: A model that uses only the missingness indicator plus baseline trio reaches AUC within 0.02 of a model that adds pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct magnitudes on the non-null subset; and the magnitude coefficients among non-null records are not significantly different from zero.
tests.failure_criterion: Adding pullback magnitudes strictly on the non-null subset improves out-of-sample AUC by >0.03 AND coefficient tests reject the null at p<0.10.

tests.name: recency_composite_alt_spec
tests.comparison: Specification contest: pullback-only recency (duration, pct) versus a 'time-since-base-pivot' composite that uses base_duration_weeks and base_depth_pct to define recency more comprehensively. The cleaner replacement candidate is evaluated head-to-head against the pullback-only spec using identical W4 discrimination metrics.
tests.success_criterion: The recency-composite specification, when replacing pullback-only freshness, improves W4 Brier score and reduces ruin-rate by >=2pp at the B0 cut, and direction is stable across two independent time regimes.
tests.failure_criterion: Recency-composite AUC is no better than pullback-only (delta <0.01) or the gain disappears under transaction-cost haircut of 5pp. Either outcome means neither current freshness spec nor the composite alternative carries true mechanism value.

leakage_checks: Verify that ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct, and ibd_entry_close_position are all computed at the decision snapshot using only prices and levels observable at or before that snapshot - no use of any W4 or later prices in the numerator or denominator.

Verify that the w4_return_bucket label is the 4-week forward return computed from the snapshot date plus 20 trading days; reject any test that uses returns beyond W4 or uses returns aggregated across non-overlapping horizons.

Verify the outcome_label categories (selected_winner, false_positive_ruin, false_negative_relative, false_negative_big_winner) are constructed from rules that do NOT themselves use the freshness candidate variable - i.e., labels are independent of the construct being tested.

Verify that pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct are computed from a pullback detection rule that precedes the decision snapshot and does not use forward prices; missingness on these fields must be encoded as a separate neutral category, never zero-imputed.
Verify that base_duration_weeks, base_mbox_count, and base_depth_pct are likewise PIT: derived from a base-detection algorithm applied to data through the snapshot date only.
Verify that no test feature is constructed using entity_id, calendar_date, snapshot_id, or any surrogate thereof as an input - reject calendar or identity features absolutely.
Verify that vol_ratio_5_20 and atr_14_pct are computed over rolling windows entirely contained in [snapshot_date - window, snapshot_date], with no look-ahead in normalization or clipping.
Confirm that the same fold-time partitions are used for baseline and treatment fits to prevent fold leakage; missingness indicator must be carried as a feature column, not silently imputed.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The B0 'freshness' component, as currently operationalized via pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct, does not display a directional pattern in the 27-case archaeology consistent with an independent corrective-recency mechanism. Selected winners exhibit longer and deeper pullbacks (median 5.5 weeks / -15.9%) than false negatives (4.0 weeks / -7.3%), which is the opposite of a depth-as-freshness hypothesis. However, the construct is not cleanly identifiable: (a) pullback fields are undefined for a non-trivial subset, producing missing-not-at-random truncation; (b) the temporally most local neighbor (ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, std delta -0.70) was excluded from the 'neighboring' control set; (c) vol_ratio_5_20 and entry-extension trio capture adjacent recency/regime information; (d) n=27 with one dual-labeled entity yields insufficient statistical power to reject any directional claim. The cleaner reading is that 'freshness' as pullback recency/depth is probably a redundant re-labeling of recent-strength or extension state already encoded by the neighbor block, but the evidence cannot prove that without a preregistered nested-model test on a larger held-out cohort.
falsifiers: Out-of-sample incremental test: a preregistered freshness block added to a baseline of mom_20 + ma10_slope_5 + ma20_slope_5 + px_vs_ma20 + px_vs_ma50 + ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct + vol_ratio_5_20 yields non-positive partial coefficient, likelihood-ratio p>0.5, or AUC delta <0.005 on a held-out discovery cohort — falsifies independent contribution.

Substitution test: vol_ratio_5_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + atr_14_pct replicates the freshness block's apparent W4 separation within AUC delta <0.02 AND partial correlation between vol_ratio_5_20 and any freshness proxy exceeds 0.5 — falsifies freshness as separable from volatility-regime state.

Substitution test: ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct + current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct + ibd_entry_close_position reproduces freshness discrimination within AUC delta <0.02 and freshness contributes nothing once this entry-extension trio is added — falsifies freshness as separable from recency-of-trigger.

Within-stratum matched comparison (mom_20 quintile x vol_ratio_5_20 quintile x px_vs_ma20 quintile): across qualifying strata (n>=10), fresh vs. stale pullback candidates show <1pp median W4 return gap, or sign-rank test p>0.5, or fewer than 4 qualifying strata — falsifies freshness as a within-strength-bucket effect.

Missingness-pattern test: a model using only the null/non-null pullback indicator plus the baseline trio reaches AUC within 0.02 of a model adding pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct magnitudes on the non-null subset — falsifies the magnitude content of freshness.

Direction reversal: coefficient on pullback_duration_weeks flips sign across two independent time regimes, or the incremental AUC gain disappears under a 5pp transaction-cost haircut — falsifies portability and economic significance of the mechanism.

Label-reclassification sensitivity: reclassifying the one dual-labeled entity (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner) and two ambiguous null-pullback cases flips the apparent freshness sign in the 27-case archaeology — falsifies identifiability of the effect at this sample size.
actionable_design_principles: Do not promote freshness to B0 production scoring until a nested-model incremental test on a larger held-out cohort with explicit entry-extension and vol-regime controls passes at p<0.10 and AUC delta >=0.01.
Reject any freshness specification that omits ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct from its control set; this is the temporally most local neighbor and excluding it amounts to construct laundering.

Encode pullback-field missingness as an explicit neutral setup-status category (e.g., 'no_qualifying_pullback_detected') rather than zero-imputing it; treat the missingness indicator as a candidate feature on equal footing with the magnitudes.

Require point-in-time documentation for every freshness input: the detection algorithm, the window over which the pullback was identified, and the timestamp of the candidate event must be auditable from data through the snapshot date only.

Separate stock-level mechanism validation from portfolio-construction effects; freshness must demonstrate incremental conditional stock-level W4 discrimination before being folded into B0 composite scoring.

Cap any freshness coefficient's contribution to B0 score until the vol-regime substitution test and entry-extension substitution test are both run; redundancy at either step caps weight at the residual partial R-squared.
Mandate a minimum per-stratum cell size (n>=10) before drawing conclusions about freshness within matched mom_20 x vol_ratio_5_20 x px_vs_ma20 strata; pool or declare UNRESOLVED otherwise.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: two_part_setup_recency
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Replaces the single pullback-duration/depth construct with an explicit pair: (1) time_since_pivot — the elapsed weeks between a mechanically detected pivot (pullback trough or base breakout) and the snapshot date; (2) setup_state_indicator — a three-valued categorical {fresh_breakout, in_pullback, no_qualifying_setup}. This is distinct because it separates 'how recent' from 'what stage', neither of which the current pullback block encodes, and it treats the no-setup state as a first-class category instead of an implicit null.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Two-part encoding forces the model to allocate capacity between recency magnitude and stage identity, preventing the current collinear pullback-duration/depth interaction from saturating one weight; the stage indicator also captures the missingness-as-signal structure that current specifications waste.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: missingness_aware_freshness_status
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Introduces a dedicated freshness_status categorical with levels {detected_fresh, detected_stale, not_detected, ambiguous} that is consumed as a feature in its own right rather than as a column of nulls. Distinct because it makes the upstream detection filter an explicit input to the B0 score, so the filter's effect can be partialed out cleanly before testing any magnitude coefficient.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Carrying freshness_status as a categorical rather than letting missingness leak through silently prevents one column of nulls from being treated as either zero or as a numeric, and gives the B0 scorer a chance to learn the eligibility-filter effect separately from the magnitude effect.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: recency_residual_against_neighbor_trio
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Defines freshness as the residual of pullback recency after regressing out ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct, and ibd_entry_close_position. Distinct because it operationalizes the skeptic's omitted-variable attack constructively: if the residual still predicts W4 incrementally, freshness carries information orthogonal to entry extension; if it does not, freshness is construct laundering and can be dropped.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Residual-against-neighbor specification consumes a single feature slot for freshness while enforcing the independence criterion as part of the feature definition itself, so downstream models cannot accidentally reabsorb the omitted entry-extension signal.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: vol_regime_aware_recency_band
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Conditions any freshness contribution on a discrete vol_regime band derived from vol_ratio_5_20 quantiles, allowing the freshness coefficient to vary by regime rather than be pooled. Distinct because the 27-case archaeology shows false-negative vs. selected-winner separation is partly a regime phenomenon (vol_ratio_5_20 std delta -1.05), so a single global freshness weight likely conflates regimes; a banded weight isolates the freshness mechanism from the regime confound.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Banded coefficients cost more capacity than a pooled coefficient but prevent the regime-freshness confound from biasing a single weight toward zero (range restriction under a pooled fit).

cycles.question: For B0 component 'eps_preference', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: B0's 'eps_preference' term is NOT an independent predictive signal; it is a redundant proxy that primarily captures information already encoded in neighboring B0 technical/momentum terms (mom_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5) plus lagging fundamentals that price has already impounded.
evidence_for: Frozen evidence does NOT contain 'eps_preference' as a measured feature; the strongest standardized-delta predictors are all technical/relative-strength terms (up_day_ratio_20 stdΔ=-1.19, vol_ratio_5_20 stdΔ=-1.05, mom_20 stdΔ=-1.00, px_vs_ma50 stdΔ=-0.85) — these are precisely the 'neighboring B0 terms' that would absorb any variance eps_preference could contribute.

False-positive ruins (n=8 of 27 cases) cluster with positive mom_20 (e.g., entity_3472243e0c mom_20=0.242, entity_b6bcccdf6a mom_20=0.176, entity_4fdc3699fd mom_20=0.185) yet failed — indicating that whatever fundamental screening eps_preference performs was insufficient to override deteriorating momentum/structure that price already disclosed.

Entity_6618d3e80c (selected_winner with ruin component) shows extreme px_vs_ma50=0.337 and mom_20=0.251 yet ended in partial ruin — classic pattern where pre-existing earnings strength (the eps_preference signal) failed to prevent a momentum break, consistent with eps_preference being a lagging, redundant filter.

EPS data is quarterly and stale-by-definition at the snapshot date, while mom_20, px_vs_ma20, ma10_slope_5 are real-time; in any horse-race, the real-time terms will dominate, leaving eps_preference as a near-zero marginal contributor.

Discovery-train contrast table shows mom_20 (median 0.058 vs 0.163) and px_vs_ma50 (median 0.056 vs 0.127) separate false_negatives from selected_winners with standardized deltas of -1.00 and -0.85 — magnitude consistent with these being the operative signal, not eps_preference.
evidence_against: ABSENCE OF DIRECT EVIDENCE: eps_preference is not in the frozen feature set, so its coefficient, importance, or partial R² cannot be directly tested against neighbors from this evidence alone — any claim of redundancy rests on inference, not measurement.

Counter-example: entity_2c58cebc59 (selected_winner, large_win) has mom_20=0.321 with pullback_pct=-25.1 (deep prior drawdown) — a deep base with strong EPS+price rebound; here eps_preference COULD carry independent signal about fundamental quality surviving the drawdown, which technicals alone don't fully express.

entity_05b4c6b1f7 (false_negative_relative, large_win) shows mom_20=0.070 (modest) yet produced a large_win — this is the regime where fundamental quality (eps_preference proxy) might rescue names that momentum screens would reject; we cannot rule out eps_preference adding value in the low-momentum tail.
The numeric_contrasts array is truncated; we cannot inspect whether an EPS-related feature appears further down with a non-trivial standardized delta that would refute the redundancy claim.
falsifiable_predictions: P1 (falsifies independence): In a logistic/horse-race regression of w4 outcome on {mom_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20} plus eps_preference, the partial standardized coefficient on eps_preference should be |β|<0.10 and Wald p>0.20. If |β|>0.20 with p<0.05 after conditioning on the five momentum terms, eps_preference IS independent and the redundancy claim is falsified.

P2 (falsifies timing claim): Compute point-bical correlation between eps_preference and mom_20 across all B0 candidates in the discovery train; if |r|>0.55 the redundancy claim is supported; if |r|<0.30, eps_preference carries orthogonal information and the claim is falsified.

P3 (falsifies failure-archaeology role): Among false_positive_ruin cases (n=8), the median eps_preference should NOT be distinguishable from selected_winner median (Mann-Whitney p>0.30). If p<0.10 with ruin cases having HIGHER eps_preference, eps_preference actively HURTS selection and the cleaner replacement (see below) is mandatory.

P4 (decay test): eps_preference measured at snapshot T versus next-reported-EPS-revision at T+20 trading days should show correlation |ρ|<0.20 — if revisions cluster above zero for selected_winners and below zero for false_positive_ruins, then eps_revisions (not eps_level) is the operative signal and 'eps_preference' as currently constructed is misspecified.
policy_implications: REPLACE 'eps_preference' (level/lagging) with 'eps_revision_z' (normalized 30/60-day EPS-revision score from the estimate-change series). Revision is a leading indicator that has lower correlation with mom_20 (typically |r|≈0.25-0.40) and higher information ratio for fundamental regime change.

If eps_revisions are unavailable, REPLACE with a composite 'fundamental_quality_residual': regress EPS-growth/ROE/accruals on {mom_20, px_vs_ma50} and use the residual — this explicitly removes the collinear component and isolates any truly orthogonal fundamental content.

ADD an interaction term eps_revision_z × mom_20_z: if eps_preference truly mattered independently, this interaction should be the dominant term, not the level — the absence of interaction significance is itself evidence the main effect is redundant.

FAIL-SAFE THRESHOLD: Until P1 is tested, do not weight eps_preference above 0.10× in the B0 composite; cap its contribution so that momentum terms (which ARE measured in the frozen evidence) remain the primary signal.

PORTFOLIO SEPARATION: Even if eps_preference adds small orthogonal signal, its contribution should be evaluated at the single-name selection layer, not at portfolio construction — a 0.5pp hit rate improvement at single-name level can be wiped out by correlation with the momentum factor at the portfolio level.

NEXT-STAGE DATA REQUIREMENT: Mark eps_preference as RESOLVABLE-ONLY-WITH-DATA — the current frozen evidence is INSUFFICIENT to definitively settle redundancy vs. independence; request the eps_preference vector for the 27 case entities plus 200+ B0 candidates to run P1-P4.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: eps_preference likely functions as a categorical gate (fundamental eligibility filter applied BEFORE technical ranking) and/or a leading indicator with a 60-90 day lead over price, neither of which is detectable in the failure archaeology's W4-label, continuous-coefficient, single-snapshot frame. The prior's redundancy claim is built on an artifact: eps_preference is UNMEASURED in the frozen evidence, so its absence from the numeric_contrasts array is a measurement gap dressed up as evidence of redundancy. Once you (a) treat it as a gate rather than a continuous weight, (b) use the correct outcome horizon for fundamental signals, and (c) stratify by regime, the redundancy story collapses.

attacks.issue: Measurement-gap artifact masquerading as evidence of redundancy
attacks.why_it_matters: The numeric_contrasts table only reports standardized deltas for FEATURES THAT WERE MEASURED. eps_preference is not in the frozen feature set, so its delta is structurally forced to be 'unknown.' The prior correctly notes this absence but then inverts it into a positive claim of redundancy — that is the logical fallacy of argument from silence. A feature being unobserved in the contrast table proves nothing about its relationship to momentum terms; it proves only that this archaeology cannot test it.

attacks.issue: Outcome-horizon mismatch — W4 label is wrong for testing a fundamental signal
attacks.why_it_matters: EPS preferences operate through post-earnings drift and estimate-reversion channels with typical half-lives of 60-90 trading days. The 'selected_winner' / 'false_negative_relative' labels are scored on W4 returns (~20 trading days). Any eps_preference effect at the W4 horizon is heavily attenuated; a feature can be the dominant fundamental signal and still look redundant in a W4 horse-race because its information content hasn't materialized yet. The prior's P1 (logistic regression on W4 outcome) is a textbook horizon-mismatched test.

attacks.issue: Gate vs. continuous-weight model misspecification
attacks.why_it_matters: IBD/Can-Slim-style models apply EPS rank as a hard eligibility filter FIRST (e.g., EPS rank >= 80 required to even enter the technical ranking). If eps_preference is a gate that excludes ~50-70% of candidates before momentum scoring, its variance is concentrated in the survival indicator, not in a continuous partial β. The prior's P1 (test |β| on a continuous term) and P4 (correlate revisions continuously) both assume linearity; gate effects produce near-zero main-effect coefficients while doing massive work via the selection step. The prior's own counterexample (entity_05b4c6b1f7, modest mom_20=0.070 yet large_win) is actually evidence FOR a gate, not against it — if eps_preference filtered this name out at entry, the 'large_win' is correctly excluded by the model, and the prior's interpretation inverts the causal direction.

attacks.issue: Hindsight bias in 'false_positive_ruin' interpretation
attacks.why_it_matters: The prior reads positive-mom_20 false_positive_ruin cases (entity_3472243e0c, entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_4fdc3699fd) as evidence that 'whatever fundamental screening eps_preference performs was insufficient.' But these names failed AFTER entry, often weeks later. If eps_preference was correctly HIGH at entry (fundamentals were strong at the time of the snapshot), then the ruin reflects a regime change AFTER entry — not a failure of eps_preference. The prior conflates 'eps_preference was strong at T' with 'eps_preference should have predicted ruin at T+30,' which is the very lead-lag relationship it claims doesn't exist.

attacks.issue: Cross-sectional vs. time-series predictive-power confusion
attacks.why_it_matters: Redundancy in a cross-sectional correlation (P2: |r|>0.55 between eps_preference and mom_20) does NOT imply redundancy in predictive power for forward returns. Two features can have |r|=0.85 and still have very different partial effects on y because each predicts a different component of y's variance. Conversely, eps_preference could have |r|=0.20 with mom_20 yet still dominate in a subset of names where fundamentals diverge from price. The prior collapses these two distinct senses of 'redundancy.'

attacks.issue: Label-definition circularity reinforces the bias
attacks.why_it_matters: 'false_negative_relative' is defined as 'B0 didn't pick it AND it produced large_win.' If eps_preference was the reason B0 didn't pick entity_05b4c6b1f7 (e.g., low EPS rank because of a transient earnings dip), then this case is NOT evidence that B0 missed a winner — it's evidence that B0 correctly applied a fundamental filter, and the W4 'win' was either noise or a transient rebound the filter was designed to avoid. The prior treats this as a failure of eps_preference when it's actually a successful application of it.

attacks.issue: Regime heterogeneity is averaged out
attacks.why_it_matters: 27 cases pooled across multiple snapshots (snap_724342c280, snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, etc.) span different market regimes. In growth-leading regimes eps_preference may be redundant; in value-rotating or earnings-revision regimes it may dominate. A pooled analysis with n=27 has zero power to detect regime-conditional effects. The prior's claim of 'generally redundant' is a no-power finding, not a positive finding.

attacks.issue: Prior's P3 prediction is self-defeating
attacks.why_it_matters: P3 says: 'Among false_positive_ruin cases, median eps_preference should NOT be distinguishable from selected_winner median.' But if eps_preference is a leading indicator, the EXPECTED pattern is that ruin cases had HIGHER eps_preference at entry (fundamentals were strong at snapshot, deteriorated after) — which P3 itself notes would 'mandate the cleaner replacement.' The prior constructs a falsification test where a positive result for eps_preference (higher in ruins) is interpreted as evidence AGAINST eps_preference, when it is actually evidence of the correct lead-lag mechanism.

counterexamples_to_seek: In every false_negative_relative case, retrieve the eps_preference value at entry. If eps_preference is systematically LOW (e.g., below the B0 threshold), the model was RIGHT to filter these names — the 'missed winners' are false positives of the test, not the model. This would directly falsify the prior's framing of false_negatives as a problem for eps_preference.

For each false_positive_ruin case with positive mom_20 at entry, check whether eps_preference was ALSO positive at entry but then deteriorated before the ruin. If so, eps_preference was correctly signaling risk at snapshot; the issue is execution (re-checking fundamentals post-entry), not signal redundancy.

Re-split the 27 cases by snapshot date and compute eps_preference's relationship to outcome WITHIN each snapshot. If eps_preference shows opposite-signed effects in growth-leading vs. value-rotating snapshots, the prior's pooled-redundancy conclusion is wrong.

Run the 'partial-out' test properly: regress forward W13 (not W4) returns on mom_20 alone, then add eps_preference. If the R² increment is non-trivial at W13, the redundancy claim fails on the correct horizon.

Among B0 candidates where mom_20 and eps_preference DIVERGE (eps_preference positive, mom_20 negative, or vice versa), compare forward returns across the four quadrants. If the eps_preference-positive-but-mom_20-negative quadrant has negative expected returns, eps_preference is doing independent work as a NEGATIVE filter, not a redundant positive signal.

Test whether eps_preference acts as a categorical gate: bin eps_preference into [bottom quartile, top three quartiles] and see if bottom-quartile names are systematically absent from selected_winners regardless of mom_20. If the bottom-quartile exclusion rate exceeds 80% even at high mom_20, the gate mechanism is confirmed.

Check whether the 11 'selected_winners' include any names with eps_preference below the model's own threshold. If all 11 had eps_preference above threshold, the threshold itself (not the continuous value) is the operative parameter, and the prior's continuous-β test is misspecified.
what_would_change_my_mind: Direct measurement of eps_preference across the 27 case entities AND ≥200 B0 candidates, with all four tests (P1-P4) re-run on the correct horizon (W13 and W26, not W4). If at W13 the partial |β| on eps_preference is <0.05 with p>0.5 after momentum controls, AND the gate test shows the bottom-quartile exclusion doesn't predict forward returns, AND the divergence-quadrant test shows no independent signal — only then do I accept the redundancy claim.

A threshold/gate analysis (e.g., CART or causal forest) showing that eps_preference adds zero incremental value as a categorical filter at any threshold. If a non-trivial threshold exists that improves selection even after momentum ranking, the gate mechanism is real and the prior is wrong.

Demonstration that the false_positive_ruin cases had LOW eps_preference at entry (not high), which would mean eps_preference was correctly absent as a warning AND the prior's hindsight reading was right. If instead the ruins had HIGH eps_preference at entry, eps_preference is a leading indicator and the prior's claim that 'price already impounded it' is falsified.

Out-of-sample evidence from a held-out period (post-discovery) showing that reweighting eps_preference to zero (or removing the gate) does not change hit rate but does increase drawdown. This would show the prior is right ONLY about hit rate (mechanistic redundancy) but wrong about risk-adjusted signal.

A regime-decomposition showing that eps_preference is redundant in EVERY regime (growth, value, sideways, high-vol). If it has regime-conditional value, the unconditional redundancy claim fails and the prior's conclusion needs to be scoped.

An honest null result on the partial-out test (eps_preference residuals after controlling for momentum do NOT predict W4 returns even when eps_preference is measured correctly) AND on the gate test (bottom-quartile exclusion has no predictive value) AND on the horizon test (W13/W26 also show no effect). All three nulls are required to overturn the gate/leading-indicator hypothesis.

tests.name: M3_momentum_monotonicity_vs_threshold_test
tests.comparison: For the 11 selected_winners and 7 false_negative cases (false_negative_relative + false_negative_big_winner), fit a logistic regression of outcome on these three features. Then test H0: the relationship is a smooth monotonic function (linearity in logit, no interactions) vs. H1: there is a discrete jump/discontinuity in the predicted probability surface. Operationalized via: (a) comparison of AUC for linear-logit vs. classification-tree model with max_depth=2; (b) Hartigan dip-test on the predicted-probability distribution to detect multimodality; (c) gap-statistic on the 1-D projection onto the linear predictor. If the tree model does not improve AUC by >0.05 AND the predicted-probability distribution is unimodal AND no gap exceeds 0.20 in the projection, B0 operates as a smooth continuous scorer on these features (continuous-proxy frame supported). If any of the three fail, the gate hypothesis for analogous B0 components (eps_preference) gains prior plausibility because B0 itself uses threshold structure on measured features.
tests.success_criterion: Linear-logit AUC > 0.85 AND tree-AUC − linear-AUC < 0.05 AND dip-test p > 0.10 AND max gap < 0.20 — supports the researcher’s claim that B0’s measured feature block is a continuous scorer, which by parallel construction makes eps_preference’s continuous-proxy interpretation more defensible.
tests.failure_criterion: Tree-AUC > linear-AUC + 0.05 OR dip-test p < 0.10 OR max gap > 0.20 — falsifies the continuous-proxy frame for the measured block and raises prior probability that eps_preference is also operating as a categorical gate rather than as a smooth weight.

tests.name: M3_residual_capacity_after_momentum_controls
tests.comparison: Estimate pseudo-R² (McFadden) of a logistic model predicting outcome_label ∈ {selected_winner, false_positive_ruin, false_negative_relative, false_negative_big_winner} (multinomial) using only these three features on the 27 case entities plus the matched non-case B0 candidates available in each snapshot. Decompose total variance into (i) explained by the three momentum features and (ii) residual. The residual-capacity fraction bounds the maximum additional signal any orthogonal feature (including eps_preference) could contribute. Cross-validate with leave-one-snapshot-out to prevent snapshot-specific overfit. If the residual-capacity fraction is < 0.15 AND the three-feature model’s misclassification rate among ruins vs. winners is < 25%, then there is structurally little room for eps_preference to add orthogonal information, supporting the redundancy claim. If the residual-capacity is > 0.35 OR the misclassification rate among ruins vs. winners is > 40%, then substantial unexplained structure remains that eps_preference (or another unmeasured fundamental feature) could plausibly fill, supporting the skeptic’s orthogonal-information frame.
tests.success_criterion: Three-feature pseudo-R² (McFadden) > 0.30 AND residual-capacity < 0.15 AND cross-validated ruin-vs-winner misclassification < 0.25 — the momentum block is sufficient, eps_preference’s independent contribution is bounded to a narrow band, redundancy hypothesis supported.
tests.failure_criterion: Pseudo-R² < 0.15 OR residual-capacity > 0.35 OR cross-validated ruin-vs-winner misclassification > 0.40 — leaves room for eps_preference or analogous orthogonal information to be operative; the redundancy claim as stated is not supported by the measured-feature evidence.

tests.name: M3_regime_heterogeneity_across_snapshots
tests.comparison: Stratify the 27 cases by snapshot_anon and recompute the three-feature logistic coefficients (mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct) within each snapshot stratum that contains ≥3 cases. Test coefficient heterogeneity via a Chow-type breakpoint test (permutation-based, n_perm=2000, given small n per stratum). If coefficients are stable (sign and rank-order preserved across snapshots, p > 0.30 for heterogeneity test), then the pooled redundancy conclusion is internally consistent and can be carried across regimes. If coefficients flip sign or magnitude across snapshots (p < 0.10 for heterogeneity), then the redundancy of eps_preference (and of any B0 term) is regime-conditional: in some snapshots momentum terms dominate, in others a different feature class may dominate. This would NOT falsify the redundancy claim outright but would scope it: eps_preference’s role can only be assessed conditional on regime, and the prior’s unconditional-redundancy language is wrong.
tests.success_criterion: Coefficient sign-rank concordance ≥ 80% across snapshot strata AND permutation heterogeneity p > 0.30 — the pooled redundancy story is stable; researcher’s mechanism claim holds unconditionally.
tests.failure_criterion: Sign-rank concordance < 70% OR heterogeneity p < 0.10 — the redundancy story is regime-dependent; the researcher’s unconditional claim must be scoped or replaced with a regime-conditional formulation, and the skeptic’s regime-heterogeneity attack is corroborated.

leakage_checks: Verify each of the nine features listed in the three tests is computed strictly from data dated at or before snapshot_anon for every case entity; reject any case where the feature’s computation window extends past the snapshot date.

Confirm that snapshot_anon identifiers do not encode calendar information (e.g., year, quarter, month) usable as a predictive feature; if such encoding exists, recompute the three tests after permuting snapshot labels within strata and check that the success criteria remain stable.

Verify that the 27 case entities and any matched controls are uniquely identified and that no entity appears in both the selected_winner and false_positive_ruin sets for the same snapshot (which would indicate label leakage).

Check that vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, and ma10_slope_5 do not include the snapshot-date close in their computation windows in a way that creates a same-day autocorrelation with outcome_label; recompute with a 1-day lookback buffer and require <5% change in test statistics.

Audit the labels definition (false_negative_relative requires future W4 >=8% and >=5pp above B0 selected median, or >=5pp above worst B0 pick): ensure the threshold comparators (selected_median, worst B0 pick) are computed only from contemporaneous cases in the same snapshot, not from the full pooled set.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The question cannot be settled from frozen evidence because eps_preference is unmeasured in the 27-case archaeology. The researcher's redundancy claim derives from momentum features' large standardized deltas (up_day_ratio_20 -1.19, vol_ratio_5_20 -1.05, mom_20 -1.00, px_vs_ma50 -0.85) but commits an argument-from-silence: an unobserved feature's delta is structurally unknown, not zero. The skeptic raises four structurally valid objections the synthesis must absorb: (i) W4 ~20-day horizon is too short for fundamental signals whose half-life is 60-90 trading days, making any W4-scored redundancy test horizon-mismatched; (ii) IBD/Can-Slim-style models typically deploy EPS rank as a hard eligibility gate, not a continuous partial beta, so the researcher's P1 (continuous logistic coefficient) is mis-specified for the most likely functional form; (iii) the false_negative_relative label is partially circular - cases where B0 rejected a name that subsequently won may be correctly-applied gates, not missed winners; (iv) n=27 pooled across heterogeneous snapshots has no power to distinguish unconditional vs regime-conditional redundancy. The experimental designer's three tests (monotonicity, residual capacity, regime heterogeneity) would resolve the question but require the eps_preference vector itself plus adequate sample size. New analytical layer not in prior outputs: the construct of 'eps_preference' itself is ambiguous - it could be EPS rank, growth, stability, surprise, or revision, each with a different correlation with momentum and a different signal horizon - so 'redundancy' is not a single hypothesis but a family of at least five distinct sub-claims. Net: the redundancy hypothesis is neither supported nor falsified by frozen evidence; the prior probability of simple-additive redundancy should be lowered below the researcher's confident framing, but the independence hypothesis also lacks positive support here.
falsifiers: FOR INDEPENDENCE (would falsify redundancy claim): A horse-race regression of W4 outcome on {mom_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20} plus the eps_preference vector produces partial |beta_eps| > 0.20 with Wald p < 0.05 - establishes that eps_preference adds orthogonal predictive information.

FOR INDEPENDENCE: Conditional mutual information I(W4_outcome; eps_preference | momentum_block) is significantly positive (non-parametric permutation test p < 0.05) - any non-zero information is sufficient to reject strong redundancy.

FOR INDEPENDENCE: The eps_preference x mom_20 interaction term is significant (|beta_int| > 0.15, p < 0.05) - eps_preference operates as a regime-conditional modulator, falsifying the simple-additive redundancy frame.

FOR INDEPENDENCE: After orthogonalizing eps_preference against the momentum block via residualization, the residual still separates selected_winners from false_positive_ruins with AUC > 0.65 - residual content is meaningful.

FOR REDUNDANCY (would falsify independence claim): Cross-sectional |r(eps_preference, mom_20)| > 0.55 across the B0 candidate universe AND partial |beta_eps| < 0.10 with p > 0.20 in the horse-race - convergence of two independent tests supports near-full redundancy.
FOR REDUNDANCY: SHAP or permutation importance of eps_preference in a gradient-boosted outcome model is < 5% of total importance AND < 50% of the largest momentum-feature importance.

REGIME SCOPE: If eps_preference importance varies by more than 2x across snapshot strata (as measured by within-stratum partial R^2), the unconditional redundancy claim must be replaced by a regime-conditional formulation - this is itself a partial falsification of the simple-redundancy frame.
actionable_design_principles: DO NOT retire or retain eps_preference on the basis of frozen evidence alone - the test is structurally undefined without the feature vector itself; any policy decision made from this evidence carries irreducible model risk.

PRE-REGISTER the operational definition of eps_preference (EPS rank vs. EPS growth vs. EPS revision vs. EPS surprise vs. EPS stability) before testing - each construct implies a different correlation profile with momentum and a different signal horizon, so 'redundancy' must be sub-claim-specific.

USE horizon-appropriate outcome labels: if testing fundamental-signal contribution, run the horse-race on W12 and W26 outcomes in addition to W4; a fundamental signal can be a zero at W4 and the dominant factor at W26 - using only W4 guarantees horizon-mismatched inference.

DISTINGUISH gate-form vs score-form tests: if eps_preference is a hard eligibility filter, test by survival analysis (Kaplan-Meier on candidate pool filtered vs unfiltered) rather than by continuous partial beta; the score-form test systematically under-detects gate-form signal.

PRE-REGISTER falsification thresholds in BOTH directions before unblinding the eps_preference vector, to prevent researcher-degree-of-freedom bias in choosing the test that 'supports' the preferred conclusion.

ACCOUNT for selection bias in failure archaeology: the 27 cases are curated failure/edge cases, not random draws; any inference about unconditional redundancy vs independence must be corrected for the conditioning on selection failure - report sensitivity analysis under reweighting toward the full B0 candidate pool.

SEPARATE predictive mechanism from portfolio construction: even if eps_preference has small marginal signal at single-name level, evaluate its net portfolio contribution after accounting for correlation with the momentum factor; a 0.5pp hit-rate improvement can be wiped out by factor correlation at the portfolio level.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: eps_preference as a GATING (eligibility) signal rather than as a continuous additive weight in the composite score
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Treats eps_preference as a pre-score filter that operates on the candidate universe BEFORE momentum scoring. Its information content lives in the survival indicator (passes/fails the gate), not in a continuous partial beta. This functional form matches how IBD/Can-Slim-style models typically deploy EPS rank and avoids the horizon-mismatch and gate-vs-score misspecification issues raised by the skeptic.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Bounded - the gate removes an estimated 30-50% of candidates, leaving the momentum block to score survivors; capacity of eps_preference as a continuous additive term is forced to zero by construction, but its information is captured in the survival step which must be scored separately.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Replace lagging EPS level (eps_preference) with leading EPS revision (eps_revision_z)
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: EPS revisions are a forward-looking, leading indicator with shorter signal half-life (typically 30-60 trading days) and lower cross-sectional correlation with momentum (|r| ~0.25-0.40 typical). This directly addresses the horizon-mismatch objection: W4 outcomes are informative for revisions but not for stale EPS levels. The replacement is construct-distinct from the original 'eps_preference' and tests a falsifiable sub-claim (P4 from the researcher).
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Higher than lagging EPS level - revisions are leading and have known lower correlation with price momentum; expected information-ratio contribution is bounded below by the level-feature capacity and above by the construct's leading-indicator property.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Regime-conditional eps_preference: enters the model only when momentum regime is uncertain (mid-quartile of mom_20)
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Explicitly encodes the regime-heterogeneity hypothesis from the skeptic's attack: eps_preference is redundant in strong-trend regimes (where momentum dominates) but informative in transition/uncertain regimes. The interaction term eps_preference_z x mom_20_z is the dominant term, not the level. This avoids both the unconditional-redundancy over-claim AND the unconditional-independence over-claim by scoping the contribution to a specific regime band.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Bounded by degrees-of-freedom cost - interaction terms consume capacity; effective only if regime heterogeneity is real (i.e., the experimental designer's M3_regime_heterogeneity test rejects the null).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Fundamental-quality residual scorer: explicitly orthogonalize eps_preference against the momentum block and use only the residual
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Constructs the test OF redundancy INTO the feature definition itself: regress eps_preference on {mom_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20} and use only the orthogonal residual. This directly operationalizes the redundancy hypothesis and produces a feature whose relevance IS the answer to the question. If the residual has no predictive power, redundancy is established; if it does, independence is established. This converts an unfalsifiable argument-from-silence into a directly testable construct.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: By construction bounded near zero - whatever survives orthogonalization IS the test of redundancy. The capacity is exactly the partial-R^2 contribution of the residual in a horse-race against the same momentum block.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'weekly_volume', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The 'weekly_volume' B0 component as instantiated (likely vol_ratio_5_20 and/or ibd_entry_volume_ratio) does NOT draw predominantly on predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms (mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, ma10_slope_5). Its incremental signal is confined to the short-window ratio (5d/20d), while broader 'volume_ratio' shows near-zero discrimination (+0.23 std delta), indicating most of the apparent volume contribution is a redundant encoding of recent up-day intensity and short-horizon momentum rather than independent institutional-flow information.
evidence_for: vol_ratio_5_20 ranks #2 in standardized contrast between selected_winners and false_negatives at -1.0455 (median 1.424 vs 1.179), the strongest volume-related signal in the contrast table.

Selected winners cluster vol_ratio_5_20 above 1.4 in 8/11 cases (e.g., entity_440e297253=1.588, entity_ead73f4390=1.772, entity_b00579f203=1.576), while 5/7 false_negatives sit below 1.2 (e.g., entity_535a1beed7=1.174, entity_bfb308b24a=1.187, entity_de1c657364=1.147).

ibd_entry_volume_ratio carries a moderate -0.5013 standardized delta, suggesting that a *different* volume measurement (likely entry-day vs trailing average) does carry non-trivial signal that is not fully captured by price/momentum terms.
The directional sign is consistent with the weak-form claim: winners need rising, above-average volume confirmation.
evidence_against: volume_ratio (a third volume metric, undefined window) shows standardized delta +0.229, meaning the bulk of volume measurements add zero marginal information — only the short-window ratio works. This is a smoking gun for redundancy, not for an independent volume mechanism.

vol_ratio_5_20 and up_day_ratio_20 are mechanically co-monotone: a 5-day window with more up-days and larger up-moves will mechanically exhibit higher 5d/20d volume ratio. The two features share the same top standardized delta magnitude (-1.05 and -1.19), implying they are tracking overlapping information.

Distribution overlap is severe: false_positive_ruin cases span vol_ratio_5_20 = 0.906 (entity_40ea0cfb3b) to 1.625 (entity_84824e6a20), fully enclosing the selected_winner range. The feature does not stratify the ruin vs winner decision boundary cleanly.

Case entity_8ad5cd4795 (selected_winner) has vol_ratio_5_20 = 0.996 — below 1.0 — yet mom_20 = 0.0037 and up_day_ratio_20 = 0.70, showing winners can arise when volume is *not* confirming; volume is necessary for some picks but insufficient as a standalone axis.

No correlation matrix or partial-dependence output between weekly_volume and neighboring B0 terms is provided in frozen evidence — the independence question cannot be settled from contrast medians alone.
falsifiable_predictions: FALSIFICATION TEST 1 (independence): Regress vol_ratio_5_20 on {mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma20}; if R^2 > 0.55, the B0 component is dominated by redundant price/tempo information and should be down-weighted.

FALSIFICATION TEST 2 (marginal AUC): Compute AUC of selected_winner vs {false_positive_ruin ∪ false_negative_relative} using only weekly_volume features; expect AUC < 0.62. If AUC ≥ 0.70, the claim of redundancy is rejected and weekly_volume is genuinely independent.

FALSIFICATION TEST 3 (ablation): Remove weekly_volume from the B0 scorecard and recompute selected_winner rate on the 27 archaeology cases. A drop > 5pp falsifies redundancy; a drop < 2pp confirms the feature is replaceable.
