FALSIFICATION TEST 4 (regime split): If the vol_ratio_5_20 win/loss contrast inverts sign across sub-periods (e.g., pre-2020 bull vs 2022 bear), the 'institutional accumulation' narrative is wrong and the signal is just a regime-conditioned momentum proxy.

PREDICTIVE PREDICTION: A sector-relative volume z-score (weekly_volume vs sector median, 13-week window) will outperform the absolute vol_ratio_5_20 by ≥ 0.04 AUC because it strips out the market-beta component that overlaps with mom_20.
policy_implications: Replace raw weekly_volume with a sector-relative volume z-score to remove correlation with market-wide mom_20; this is the 'cleaner replacement' the question requests.

If sector-relative data is unavailable, drop the 20-day or longer volume_ratio entirely (since it has +0.23 std delta — it adds noise) and keep ONLY vol_ratio_5_20 with a cap at 1.5 to prevent ruin-prone high-volume blowoff tops (e.g., entity_84824e6a20 ruin at 1.625).
Treat weekly_volume strictly as a *confirmation filter* on momentum candidates, never as a primary axis. Require mom_20 ≥ some threshold BEFORE applying the volume gate.

Audit ibd_entry_volume_ratio separately — its -0.50 std delta is not negligible and may be capturing breakout-day institutional flow that weekly_volume misses; consider promoting it to a distinct B0 term rather than collapsing into weekly_volume.

UNRESOLVED: Without an explicit correlation matrix between weekly_volume and its siblings, the independence coefficient cannot be quantified. Recommend running a frozen-evidence extension that exposes pairwise Spearman/Bhatt coefficients before final policy decisions.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The 'weekly_volume' B0 component (vol_ratio_5_20 / ibd_entry_volume_ratio) is NOT redundant with neighboring price/tempo B0 terms; it encodes a distinct SHORT-HORIZON VOLUME ACCELERATION (5d vs 20d ratio) that momentum averages and 20-day up_day_ratio are mechanically incapable of reproducing. The prior's 'redundancy' verdict is a sample-conditioned artifact of post-hoc archaeology on a small (n=27) selected-failure cohort where within-feature collinearity has been conflated with between-feature substitutability, and where the proposed sector-relative replacement is an untested refactor of the feature that carries the #2 largest contrast in the available data.

attacks.issue: Internal contradiction in the prior argument: vol_ratio_5_20 is simultaneously ranked #2 in standardized contrast (evidence_for) AND claimed redundant with up_day_ratio_20/mom_20 (evidence_against). A feature cannot be both the 2nd-strongest discriminator and a redundant re-encoding of the 1st-strongest discriminator — at most one of these can hold.
attacks.why_it_matters: The redundancy verdict inherits weight from the magnitude of the contrast, but the magnitude argument cuts the opposite direction. The Skeptic position is that the prior collapses two inconsistent positions into one conclusion without reconciling them.

attacks.issue: Selection on the dependent variable: the contrast table is computed on a 'failure archaeology' cohort (n=27) chosen specifically because B0 outcomes diverged from realized W4 returns. Range-restricting on an outcome variable inflates observed correlations among predictors by shrinking within-stratum variance, so the apparent vol_ratio ↔ mom_20 co-movement may be a sampling artifact rather than a structural relationship.
attacks.why_it_matters: Without an unconditional sample to compare against, every independence claim is conditional on 'cases where B0 was wrong' — which is precisely the population least informative about whether the features substitute for one another in cases where B0 was right.

attacks.issue: Counter-case entity_8ad5cd4795 (vol_ratio_5_20 = 0.996, mom_20 = 0.0037, selected_winner, large_win): a winner realized with sub-1.0 volume AND negligible momentum. The 'winners need rising volume confirmation' rule is violated here, but volume was clearly not load-bearing either — which means the prior's redundancy claim is silent on what actually drove the win, leaving the mechanism under-specified.
attacks.why_it_matters: If volume is redundant, this winner should have been driven by another axis (slope? pullback? up_day_ratio at 0.70?). The prior doesn't explain this case; it simply averages it into the median.

attacks.issue: Counter-case entity_2f86543bf6 (vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.558, mom_20 = -0.008, selected_winner, large_win): high short-window volume contradicts near-zero / slightly negative 20-day momentum. If vol_ratio_5_20 were a clean re-encoding of mom_20, it should track mom_20's sign — it does not. This is exactly the divergence pattern an independent volume signal would produce.
attacks.why_it_matters: A single high-volume + negative-momentum winner is more damaging to the redundancy thesis than ten low-volume + high-momentum winners are to it, because divergence is rarer than co-movement in the joint distribution.

attacks.issue: The 'mechanical co-monotonicity' claim between vol_ratio_5_20 and up_day_ratio_20 overstates the structural link: vol_ratio_5_20 is built from raw share-volume windows, up_day_ratio_20 is built from sign-of-return windows. They share a denominator horizon (20d) but not a numerator horizon (5d volume vs 20d direction count), and they decouple when 5d volume surges on mixed-direction days (churn/distribution patterns that momentum cannot see).
attacks.why_it_matters: If the two features co-moved mechanically, partial correlations in any reasonable window would be > 0.85; the prior's own Falsification Test #1 admits this has not been run.

attacks.issue: Label asymmetry: false_positive_ruin uses 'ruin' and 'loss' buckets (directional losses); false_negative uses +8%/+5pp thresholds (directional gains). The contrast table mixes asymmetric outcome definitions on either side of the comparison, and the 'redundancy' verdict inherits this asymmetry without correction.
attacks.why_it_matters: A volume feature could legitimately discriminate ruin outcomes (where it is showing blowoff-top behavior) while showing no signal on winner outcomes (where momentum already carries the signal). Pooling them under a single 'redundancy' label hides this asymmetry.

attacks.issue: Counter-case entity_40ea0cfb3b (vol_ratio_5_20 = 0.906 — the lowest in the sample, mom_20 = 0.024, false_positive_ruin): the lowest-volume pick was a ruin. If volume were a confirmation filter, sub-1.0 readings should be DEFENSIVE, not ruinous. The case demonstrates that low volume is not protective and therefore not a simple gating signal.
attacks.why_it_matters: The prior's policy recommendation to cap vol_ratio_5_20 at 1.5 addresses only the high-volume ruin tail (entity_84824e6a20, etc.) and ignores the low-volume ruin tail. A genuine redundancy claim would have to explain both tails.

attacks.issue: The proposed 'sector-relative volume z-score over 13 weeks' is an untested refactor recommended as policy. There is no evidence in the frozen dataset that sector-relative volume is computable for IBD-style entries, no backtest showing it outperforms absolute vol_ratio_5_20, and no ablation isolating its contribution. Recommending it without these tests is speculation dressed as mechanism.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the proposed replacement is itself unverified, then the 'cleaner replacement' the question asks for is not actually identified — only hypothesized. The skeptic verdict must therefore be UNRESOLVED rather than 'replace weekly_volume with sector-relative volume'.

attacks.issue: Snapshot heterogeneity: the 27 cases span at least 9 distinct snapshot IDs (snap_724342c280, snap_287267e812, snap_eb3d8128cc, …). Each snapshot may encode a different market regime (post-COVID rally, 2022 bear, 2023 chop). Pooling without regime conditioning produces a 'redundancy' finding that may invert in any single sub-period — the prior's own Falsification Test #4 anticipates this but reports no result.
attacks.why_it_matters: A regime-conditional analysis is the natural disconfirmation path. Without it, the redundancy verdict is a regime-averaged pseudo-fact, not a structural claim.

counterexamples_to_seek: Selected-winner cases with mom_20 > 0.15 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.0: if volume is redundant with momentum, B0 should reject these; if B0 still selects them, volume is not load-bearing for rejection.

Selected-winner cases with vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.5 AND mom_20 < 0.05: these are the divergence tail — cases where volume and momentum disagree — and they test whether volume adds orthogonal information when momentum is silent.

False-positive-ruin cases with vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.5 in tech/consumer sectors but < 1.2 in industrial/utility sectors at the same snapshot: tests whether volume is sector-conditional and therefore cannot be a uniform B0 input.

Within each momentum quintile (mom_20 binned), does vol_ratio_5_20 still rank-order winners from losers? A positive answer falsifies redundancy at the conditional level; a negative answer confirms it.

Cases where weekly_volume and ibd_entry_volume_ratio DIVERGE (one > 1.5, the other < 0.9): which one predicts the outcome? This isolates whether ibd_entry_volume_ratio deserves its own B0 term or is also redundant.

Pre-2020 bull-market subset: do selected_winners and false_positive_ruins show different vol_ratio_5_20 medians than the 2022 bear subset? Sign-inversion would falsify the 'volume as confirmation' narrative.

Snapshot snap_d0d57b1e40 contains both entity_6618d3e80c (vol_ratio=1.446, ruin|winner hybrid) and entity_ad2bfdee3f (vol_ratio=1.179, false_negative). At matched snapshot regime, does volume still discriminate, or is regime the dominant factor?
what_would_change_my_mind: An R² > 0.55 from regressing vol_ratio_5_20 on {mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma20} on an UNCONDITIONAL (non-archaeology) sample — would convert the redundancy hypothesis from unfalsified theory into finding.
An AUC < 0.62 from a weekly_volume-only classifier on a held-out test set with at least 100 picks — would confirm marginal information is below the threshold of practical relevance.
An ablation in which dropping weekly_volume from B0 changes selected_winner rate by < 2pp on the full pick set (not just the 27 archaeology cases) — would confirm the feature is replaceable.

A documented sign-inversion of the vol_ratio_5_20 contrast across a clean regime split (e.g., pre-2020 vs 2022-2023), where in one regime high volume predicts wins and in the other it predicts losses — would refute the 'institutional accumulation' mechanism entirely.

A successful backtest of sector-relative volume z-score beating absolute vol_ratio_5_20 by ≥ 0.04 AUC on a frozen out-of-sample window — would convert the proposed replacement from speculation into evidence.

Demonstration that entity_8ad5cd4795 (low volume, low momentum, selected_winner) and entity_2f86543bf6 (high volume, negative momentum, selected_winner) were selected via a non-volume pathway (e.g., pullback depth or base count) and that the volume value was ignored by the scoring rule — would remove the orthogonal-signal evidence and strengthen the redundancy verdict.

tests.name: within_momentum_quintile_conditional_discrimination
tests.comparison: Compute the rank-correlation (Spearman) and AUC of vol_ratio_5_20 against the outcome label (selected_winner vs {false_positive_ruin ∪ false_negative_*}) UNCONDITIONALLY, then recompute within each mom_20 quintile (q1=lowest momentum through q5=highest) using only case-level PIT features. The contrast between unconditional AUC and the volume-weighted mean of within-quintile AUCs is the test statistic. up_day_ratio_20 is the matched-tempo control feature whose within-quintile AUC acts as the redundancy benchmark.
tests.success_criterion: Mean within-quintile AUC of vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 0.60 AND (within-quintile AUC) / (unconditional AUC) ≥ 0.70. A genuine independent mechanism must continue to rank-order winners from losers AFTER the dominant price-tempo axis is held fixed by stratification.
tests.failure_criterion: Mean within-quintile AUC of vol_ratio_5_20 ≤ 0.52 AND the ratio (within-quintile / unconditional) ≤ 0.50, while up_day_ratio_20 retains a comparable or larger within-quintile AUC. This pattern means vol_ratio_5_20's signal is entirely explained by the price-tempo bin it falls into, and it should be dropped as a redundant encoding of momentum.

tests.name: sign_disagreement_divergence_quadrant_test
tests.comparison: Cross-tabulate the 27 archaeology cases into four quadrants defined by thresholds vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.2 and mom_20 = 0.05: Q1={high_vol, high_mom}, Q2={high_vol, low_mom}, Q3={low_vol, high_mom}, Q4={low_vol, low_mom}. For each quadrant, compute the empirical outcome distribution (selected_winner rate vs false_positive_ruin rate). Apply Fisher's exact test on the 2x2 of Q2 vs Q4 (the two quadrants where mom_20 is held at 'low' but vol_ratio_5_20 differs). Repeat for Q1 vs Q3 (the 'high-mom' counterpart).
tests.success_criterion: Within the low-mom stratum, Q2 (high volume) outcome rate differs from Q4 (low volume) outcome rate by ≥ 25 percentage points AND Fisher p < 0.15. This would demonstrate that vol_ratio_5_20 carries orthogonal information when momentum is silent — supporting the independent-acceleration mechanism and falsifying pure redundancy.
tests.failure_criterion: Within the low-mom stratum, Q2 and Q4 outcome rates differ by ≤ 10pp (Fisher p ≥ 0.40), AND within the high-mom stratum Q1 vs Q3 differ by ≤ 10pp. This means vol_ratio_5_20 never changes the outcome conditional on momentum sign, confirming it is a redundant momentum proxy regardless of which way momentum is signed.

tests.name: up_day_ratio_stratified_volume_mechanism_decomposition
tests.comparison: Stratify cases by up_day_ratio_20 into tight bands (e.g., [0.40-0.50], [0.55-0.65], [0.65-0.75]). Within each band, compute Spearman rank correlation of vol_ratio_5_20 against w4_return_bucket rank (ruin < loss < small_win < large_win) AND against outcome_label binarized as {selected_winner, not}. Compare to the same statistic computed within ma10_slope_5 strata as a secondary control. If vol_ratio_5_20 within up_day_ratio_20 strata still discriminates, it is encoding something beyond 'number of green days in 20d'.
tests.success_criterion: Mean within-band Spearman ρ(vol_ratio_5_20, outcome) ≥ 0.25 with the sign matching the unconditional direction. This indicates vol_ratio_5_20 carries information beyond the up-day-count tempo axis — i.e., 'pure volume acceleration' rather than 'tempo-confirmation' — and the B0 component has a separable mechanism.
tests.failure_criterion: Mean within-band Spearman ρ ≤ 0.10 (and not significantly different from zero), while the analogous ρ for up_day_ratio_20 within ma10_slope_5 strata remains ≥ 0.20. This would confirm vol_ratio_5_20 is a tempo-confirmation re-encoding of up_day_ratio_20, and the cleaner replacement is to drop vol_ratio_5_20 and let up_day_ratio_20 carry the tempo signal alone.

leakage_checks: Outcome variables (w4_return_bucket, outcome_label, is_b0_pick) must never appear in feature lists; is_b0_pick is the selection label itself and using it would be target leakage.

snapshot_anon must be excluded as a feature — it is a calendar/regime proxy and would let the model exploit look-ahead market context; it can only be used as a stratification axis for the conditional tests, never as a predictor.
entity_anon must be excluded — using entity identity as a feature would constitute identity leakage across cases.

All volume and price features must be point-in-time: vol_ratio_5_20 must be computed from intraday/daily data available strictly before the IBD entry timestamp; any feature computed using post-entry bars is forward leakage and invalidates the test.

ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct and pullback_duration_weeks must be confirmed PIT (anchored to the IBD entry date) before inclusion in any control regression; if either embeds post-entry lookback it cannot be used as a sibling-conditional control.

Test 1's unconditional AUC and Test 3's within-band correlation must be computed on the SAME case set under the SAME PIT cutoff; reporting a stronger unconditional AUC on a wider window and a weaker conditional AUC on a narrower window would invalidate the comparison.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The 'weekly_volume' B0 component as currently instantiated (most likely vol_ratio_5_20, possibly with ibd_entry_volume_ratio support) cannot be cleanly classified as either independent of or redundant with the surrounding momentum/tempo B0 terms on the available frozen evidence. Three competing interpretations remain live: (a) redundancy — the standardized contrast deltas of vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05), up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19), and mom_20 (-1.00) cluster so tightly that they are tracking overlapping information, and the long-window volume_ratio shows near-zero discrimination (+0.23) consistent with most of the apparent volume signal collapsing into short-horizon price tempo; (b) partial independence — divergence cases such as entity_2f86543bf6 (vol_ratio=1.558, mom_20=-0.008, large_win) and the sub-1.0-volume winners (entity_8ad5cd4795) demonstrate configurations where volume and momentum carry non-overlapping information; (c) regime-conditioned signal — the 9+ snapshot IDs in the archaeology span materially different market regimes, and a single redundancy verdict averaged across regimes may invert in any sub-period. The Synthesizer rules UNRESOLVED because the empirical conditional tests designed by the Experimental Designer (within-momentum-quintile AUC, divergence quadrants, up-day-ratio stratification) have not yet been executed, the sample is outcome-conditioned (n=27 failure-archaeology cases) which inflates apparent predictor correlation by range-restriction, and no pairwise Spearman/Bhatt matrix between weekly_volume and its sibling B0 terms is exposed in frozen evidence. The mechanism lean is toward 'mostly redundant confirmation filter with a small, possibly sector/regime-gated residual' but this is not sufficient for policy commitment.
falsifiers: REFUTES INDEPENDENCE (supports redundancy): Regress vol_ratio_5_20 on {mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma20} across the unconditional B0 universe (not the n=27 outcome-conditioned archaeology); R^2 ≥ 0.55 with VIF > 4 indicates dominant collinearity, in which case weekly_volume should be down-weighted to a confirmation filter.

REFUTES INDEPENDENCE (supports redundancy): Mean within-mom_20-quintile AUC of vol_ratio_5_20 ≤ 0.52 AND ratio (within-quintile AUC / unconditional AUC) ≤ 0.50 across the unconditional universe; this is the experimental designer's Test 1 failure criterion and confirms price-tempo bin carries the signal.

SUPPORTS INDEPENDENCE (falsifies redundancy): Within the low-mom_20 stratum (mom_20 < 0.05), high-volume vs low-volume quadrants differ in selected_winner rate by ≥ 25pp with Fisher p < 0.15 across the unconditional universe — the experimental designer's Test 2 success criterion, demonstrating orthogonal information when momentum is silent.

SUPPORTS INDEPENDENCE (falsifies redundancy): Mean within up_day_ratio_20 band Spearman ρ(vol_ratio_5_20, w4_return_bucket) ≥ 0.25 with sign matching unconditional direction — the experimental designer's Test 3 success criterion, indicating separable 'pure volume acceleration' rather than tempo-confirmation.

REGIME-DEPENDENT FALSIFIER: Pre-2020 vs post-2022 sub-period sign-inversion in the vol_ratio_5_20 win/loss contrast (the researcher's Test 4 anticipation). If the contrast inverts, the 'institutional accumulation' mechanism is wrong and weekly_volume is a regime-conditioned momentum proxy rather than a structural B0 input.

SELECTION-ARTIFACT FALSIFIER: An unconditional sample (all B0 candidates at each snapshot, not just outcome-divergent cases) showing vol_ratio_5_20 partial-correlation with mom_20 dropping below 0.30 compared to ≥ 0.60 on the archaeology subset would confirm the apparent redundancy is a range-restriction artifact, not a structural relationship.
actionable_design_principles: Do NOT drop weekly_volume from the B0 scorecard at this evidence stage. The counter-cases (entity_2f86543bf6, entity_8ad5cd4795) establish that winners exist in configurations where volume disagrees with momentum, which a redundancy claim cannot accommodate.

Do NOT promote weekly_volume to a primary B0 axis either. The standardized contrast deltas cluster tightly with up_day_ratio_20 and mom_20, indicating shared information content; using weekly_volume as a primary gate would double-count tempo.

Treat weekly_volume strictly as a confirmation modifier on momentum candidates — apply the volume gate only AFTER mom_20 passes a primary threshold. This is the cheapest policy that respects both the redundancy-leaning evidence and the divergence counter-cases.

Cap vol_ratio_5_20 at 1.5 to suppress blowoff-top ruins (entity_84824e6a20 at 1.625 → ruin) but DO NOT cap from below at 1.0 — entity_40ea0cfb3b (vol=0.906) was a ruin, demonstrating low volume is not protective and a floor would mis-rank.

Audit ibd_entry_volume_ratio as a SEPARATE B0 term from weekly_volume. Its standardized delta (-0.50) is non-trivial and may capture breakout-day institutional flow that the rolling 5d/20d ratio misses; collapsing the two into one B0 slot is an unsupported conflation.

Run all three Experimental Designer tests on the UNCONDITIONAL B0 universe (not the n=27 archaeology subset) before any replace/drop decision. The selection-on-dependent-variable bias (Skeptic attack #2) makes archaeology-only verdicts unreliable for policy.

Pool snapshots into regime buckets (pre-2020 bull, 2022 bear, 2023 chop, post-AI-rally) and report vol_ratio_5_20 conditional statistics within each. A single redundancy verdict pooled across regimes is not actionable.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Conditional volume-gate DSL: weekly_volume_gate activates only when mom_20 > threshold_t and px_vs_ma50 > 0; below the gate, vol_ratio_5_20 contributes zero weight to the B0 composite. Above the gate, it contributes as a confirmation multiplier capped at 1.5.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Unlike a static drop-in or static cap, this DSL makes volume a regime-conditional modifier rather than a primary or peer feature, which is the minimal change that respects both the redundancy-leaning evidence (don't double-count tempo) and the divergence counter-cases (volume can matter when momentum is silent).
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Moderate: gates prevent over-trading in low-momentum universes where volume is noise, but require the gate threshold itself to be calibrated — arbitrary thresholds are the failure mode.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Divergence-flag DSL: produce a binary 'volume-momentum divergence' feature that fires when vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.4 and mom_20 < 0.05 (high-vol + low-mom), routing these cases into a separate outcome bucket for outcome-conditioned analysis rather than collapsing them into the same B0 composite.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Entity_2f86543bf6 (vol=1.558, mom=-0.008, large_win) is the existence proof that this divergence quadrant carries non-redundant information. A divergence flag operationalizes the experimental designer's Test 2 quadrant structure as a first-class signal rather than a hidden interaction.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: High diagnostic value but low standalone capacity — the divergence quadrant is rare in the unconditional universe, so it functions as an exception handler rather than a primary edge source.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Sector-relative volume z-score DSL: replace absolute vol_ratio_5_20 with a 13-week sector-relative z-score, intended to strip out the market-beta component that co-varies with mom_20.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Hypothesized by the researcher as a cleaner replacement, but explicitly UNVALIDATED — the Skeptic correctly notes no evidence in frozen data confirms it is computable for IBD-style entries, no backtest shows it outperforms absolute vol_ratio_5_20. Include as an experimental DSL slot for backtest, NOT as a policy commitment.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Unknown — depends on whether sector decomposition is available in production data and whether the unconditional universe shows better orthogonal discrimination. Cannot be capacity-rated without empirical test.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Regime-conditional volume bands DSL: segment snapshots into regime tags (post-COVID-rally, 2022-bear, 2023-chop, post-AI-rally) and apply regime-specific vol_ratio_5_20 weights within each band rather than a single global weight.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Addresses the snapshot heterogeneity (Skeptic attack #9) and the researcher's Falsification Test 4 directly. Rather than averaging volume signal across regimes — which produces the apparent redundancy — this preserves regime-specific discriminative power and lets the B0 scorecard adapt.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity risk: regime tags themselves become a leakage vector if used as predictors rather than stratification axes. Must be enforced as a stratification layer only, per the experimental designer's leakage checks.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'entry_volume', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The B0 'entry_volume' term (ibd_entry_volume_ratio: entry-day volume vs ~50-day baseline) captures day-of-breakout demand intensity, providing incremental discriminatory signal beyond neighboring B0 terms (vol_ratio_5_20, ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position). It is hypothesized to reflect the conviction behind the breakout event itself rather than the prevailing volume regime.
evidence_for: Standardized delta of -0.5013 between false_negative_median (1.5987) and selected_winner_median (1.8134) shows selected winners have meaningfully higher entry-day volume ratios, consistent with a demand-conviction mechanism.

Direction asymmetry vs. general volume_ratio: ibd_entry_volume_ratio has negative delta (-0.5013) while volume_ratio has positive delta (+0.229). This sign disagreement indicates entry_volume is not a monotone proxy for recent volume regime and likely captures a distinct, event-anchored phenomenon.

Internal coherence with other entry-quality B0 terms: ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct (-0.6952) and ibd_entry_close_position (-0.464) also show winners above losers, forming a mutually consistent 'breakout conviction' cluster.

Entity_ead73f4390 (large_win, vol_ratio_5_20=1.77, entry implied high) and entity_2c58cebc59 (large_win, vol_ratio_5_20=1.62) illustrate cases where both regime and entry-day volume are aligned with the claim.

Within false_positive_ruin set, several cases (entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_8f0df3d38e) show high regime vol_ratio_5_20 but moderate entry_day volume_ratio, suggesting entry volume may add corrective information.
evidence_against: Entry_volume's standardized delta (-0.5013) is materially weaker than vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.0455), implying the latter may subsume much of the former's variance; partial independence is plausible but full independence is not supported.

Small archaeology sample (n=27, with only 5 false_negatives) lacks statistical power to reject collinearity with breakout_range_ratio (+0.1186 delta) or close_position (-0.464 delta) — these are the most plausible neighbors to absorb entry_volume signal.

Cases like entity_6618d3e80c (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner, vol_ratio_5_20=1.45, mom_20=0.25) achieved a large_win despite ambiguous entry_volume behavior, weakening the necessity of entry_volume as an independent gate.

No conditional or partial-correlation evidence is available in the frozen set to demonstrate that entry_volume's effect survives conditioning on vol_ratio_5_20 and breakout_range_ratio; the univariate contrast alone is insufficient for an independence claim.

volume_ratio (general recent volume) has a near-zero and positively-signed delta (+0.229), which complicates interpretation: if 'volume regime' is confounded across these features, the apparent entry_volume signal may be partially an artifact of definition rather than mechanism.
falsifiable_predictions: If entry_volume is truly independent, then within fixed vol_ratio_5_20 quintiles, the w4_return spread between high vs. low ibd_entry_volume_ratio bins should remain statistically significant (p < 0.05) on a held-out sample of at least 200 B0 candidates.

In a logistic regression of w4_win on [vol_ratio_5_20, ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position, up_day_ratio_20], the marginal partial R² contributed by ibd_entry_volume_ratio should exceed 0.005 if the component carries independent signal; below this threshold, the component should be retired.

A residualized 'volume thrust' feature defined as ibd_entry_volume_ratio / vol_ratio_5_20 (event-specific volume in excess of regime) should show a higher standardized delta than raw ibd_entry_volume_ratio if entry_volume's mechanism is genuinely breakout-anchored demand rather than regime.

If entry_volume is collinear with breakout_range_ratio, then cases where the two disagree (high entry_volume but tight range, or vice versa) should show no differential performance — falsifying entry_volume as a standalone predictor.

Across snapshots with consistent market regime (e.g., grouped by snapshot_anon), the rank correlation between ibd_entry_volume_ratio and ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio should be below 0.5 for the mechanism to be considered independent.
policy_implications: If the residualized volume-thrust test (entry_volume / vol_ratio_5_20) outperforms raw entry_volume, replace the B0 term with the ratio form to remove regime confounding and improve signal-to-noise.

Consider collapsing the four IBD entry features (close_vs_trigger, volume_ratio, close_position, breakout_range_ratio) into a single composite 'breakout conviction' z-score, since their deltas are individually modest and likely carry overlapping information.

Pending a conditional independence test, do not over-weight entry_volume in the B0 composite; cap its contribution at the rank-equivalent of vol_ratio_5_20's observed effect size until independence is established.

If the falsification tests fail (entry_volume adds no incremental partial R² beyond its neighbors), retire entry_volume from B0 entirely and redistribute its weight to vol_ratio_5_20 and mom_20, which dominate the contrast ranking.
Track entry_volume separately as a 'shadow feature' in production for one quarter: if its realized IC is below 0.02 while vol_ratio_5_20 IC exceeds 0.04, this is actionable evidence for removal.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: ibd_entry_volume_ratio is not an independent B0 signal — it is mechanically and statistically a downstream artifact of (a) the prevailing volume regime captured by vol_ratio_5_20, and (b) the magnitude of the breakout event itself captured by ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio and ibd_entry_close_position. Once either neighbor is conditioned on, entry_volume contributes no incremental information and should be retired or replaced with a regime-normalized thrust metric.

attacks.issue: Mechanical/definitional overlap with volume_ratio
attacks.why_it_matters: ibd_entry_volume_ratio is computed as entry-day volume divided by a multi-week baseline that almost certainly overlaps with the window used to construct general volume_ratio. By construction these two features share variance — they are not 'neighboring' independent terms, they are algebraically related. The sign disagreement the prior researcher flagged (-0.5013 vs +0.229) is therefore not evidence of distinctness but of denominator/definition mismatch across lookback windows. This alone invalidates any independence claim.

attacks.issue: Snapshot-level clustering of false negatives (4 of 5 from snap_71486ed83c)
attacks.why_it_matters: The entire false-negative cohort is not a random sample — it is dominated by a single snapshot whose B0-selection criterion, sector exposure, and macro context are constant across all four cases. Any observed feature delta between false_negatives and selected_winners is therefore confounded with a snapshot-fixed effect (regime, sector, screening thresholds), not with entry_volume. The standardized delta of -0.5013 has effective n≈2 once snapshot is fixed, making the 'evidence' statistically indistinguishable from noise.

attacks.issue: Sign asymmetry across volume-related features is a red flag, not confirmation
attacks.why_it_matters: The prior reads opposite-signed deltas as evidence entry_volume is 'event-anchored.' But if entry_volume were a clean event-conviction signal, we would expect it to correlate positively with mom_20 and breakout_range_ratio across the same cohort. Instead mom_20 (-1.0005) and breakout_range_ratio (+0.1186) show heterogeneous signs versus entry_volume's neighbors. The combination of +0.1186 (breakout_range_ratio) and -0.5013 (entry_volume) means in winners, breakout is bigger but entry_volume is only modestly higher — i.e. event magnitude moves while event-volume stays roughly flat, undermining the 'demand conviction' narrative.

attacks.issue: No falsification of the breakout-magnitude confound
attacks.why_it_matters: Entry-day volume on a stock breaking out is mechanically larger for larger-range breakouts (more shares change hands). Without conditioning on ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, every apparent entry_volume effect can be re-expressed as a breakout-magnitude effect. The prior's predicted test #5 (rank correlation < 0.5) was not actually run; the contrast that WAS run shows breakout_range_ratio with a positive delta and entry_volume with a negative delta in false negatives, which is the opposite pattern one would expect if they captured the same construct — suggesting they are noisy and partially overlapping, not cleanly decomposable.

attacks.issue: Sample artifact: B0 picks are not the relevant population for testing entry_volume independence
attacks.why_it_matters: All B0 candidates were pre-selected on a composite that may itself contain volume. The labels 'selected_winner' vs 'false_positive_ruin' are defined relative to a B0-gated process, so any feature surviving in that contrast is partly redundant with the gating logic. The only valid falsification sample is the full pre-screened candidate pool with known outcomes — which is not what failure_archaeology provides. The -0.5013 delta is therefore a circular measurement of how well the existing composite works, not a test of marginal contribution.

attacks.issue: Case-level inspection contradicts a clean entry_volume mechanism
attacks.why_it_matters: entity_6618d3e80c (large_win with vol_ratio_5_20=1.45 but only middling entry-day conditions) and entity_40ea0cfb3b (false_positive_ruin with vol_ratio_5_20=0.91, the lowest regime volume among B0 picks) show that winners and losers are well-explained by vol_ratio_5_20 regime alone, with entry_volume adding nothing observable. Meanwhile entity_8ad5cd4795 won (large_win) with vol_ratio_5_20=0.996 — i.e. a regime-vol-neutralized case where entry_volume would have to carry the signal, yet mom_20 and slope terms alone seem to suffice.

attacks.issue: Modest effect size (-0.5013) ranks 11th in the contrast table, behind 10 other features
attacks.why_it_matters: If entry_volume were the genuinely distinct event-anchored signal the claim requires, it should dominate the contrast ranking — not sit in the middle of the table. Its standardized delta is below up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50, pullback_duration_weeks, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, ma10_slope_5, pullback_pct, ma20_slope_5, and px_vs_ma20. A 'special' mechanism with the 11th-strongest univariate association is more parsimoniously explained as a noisy linear combination of the top-10 features.

counterexamples_to_seek: B0 picks with ibd_entry_volume_ratio in the bottom decile that nevertheless produced large_win outcomes — if entry_volume is necessary, such cases should be rare; if it is not, they should be common.

Cases where ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio is held within a tight band (e.g. 0.50–0.55) and ibd_entry_volume_ratio varies across the full observed range; in such a conditional slice, the entry_volume effect should vanish if it is purely a magnitude artifact.

Within-snapshot comparisons of B0 picks (e.g. all picks from snap_71486ed83c) where one win and one ruin have similar vol_ratio_5_20 but differ sharply in entry_volume; if entry_volume is causal, the wins should cluster on the higher entry_volume side.

Time-shifted counterfactual: compute ibd_entry_volume_ratio using a window ENDING one day before the actual entry (i.e. remove the entry day). If this 'pre-entry volume' proxy has a similar or stronger delta than the true entry_volume, then the 'entry-anchored' mechanism is a measurement artifact of the window definition.

Stocks that triggered IBD entry but on the lowest-volume day of their base — if entry_volume is essential, the B0 model should systematically reject these; if not, they should be present in the winner set at base rate.
False negatives from snapshots OTHER than snap_71486ed83c — currently we have only one such case; the entire feature delta could be a single-snapshot artifact.
what_would_change_my_mind: A conditional partial-correlation test on at least 200 pre-screened B0 candidates (not just failure-archaeology), holding vol_ratio_5_20, ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, and ibd_entry_close_position fixed, showing ibd_entry_volume_ratio's marginal contribution is statistically significant (p < 0.01) and partial R² ≥ 0.01. Anything weaker leaves the null of 'redundant' unrejected.

An ablation study in which ibd_entry_volume_ratio is recomputed with entry-day excluded from the numerator (i.e. pre-event volume thrust); if the re-engineered feature carries the same or larger effect, it confirms the mechanism is regime-driven and the entry-anchoring is incidental. If the re-engineered feature loses ALL signal, then the entry day is genuinely special — but this test has not been performed.

A within-snapshot fixed-effects regression on snap_71486ed83c (which provides the bulk of the false-negative signal) showing that, after removing snapshot fixed effects, the entry_volume coefficient is indistinguishable from zero. If it survives, the snapshot-clustering concern is mitigated.

An out-of-time test on a later cohort: a delta of similar magnitude (-0.5 standardized) with the SAME sign direction. Given the prior's noted sign instability across neighboring volume features, sign-flipping in a fresh sample would be strong evidence the mechanism is unstable noise.

Demonstration that removing ibd_entry_volume_ratio from B0 and re-weighting the remaining components produces equal or better realized W4 hit-rate on a held-out sample of ≥300 B0 candidates. Equivalence here would mean entry_volume's contribution is zero net of its neighbors, retiring it cleanly.

tests.name: within_snapshot_volratio_conditioned_isolation
tests.comparison: Restrict the archaeology set to snapshots contributing at least 4 B0 candidates. Within each surviving snapshot, cross-tab candidates into (vol_ratio_5_20 quintile × ibd_entry_volume_ratio quintile). For every vol_ratio_5_20 quintile, compute the high-minus-low ibd_entry_volume_ratio win-rate spread across a fixed, pre-specified W4 win definition (large_win or small_win pooled). The mechanism claim requires that within a single, fixed vol_ratio_5_20 quintile the entry_volume spread remains positive in at least 3 of 5 quintile slices, and that this pattern holds in 2+ snapshots independently.
tests.success_criterion: Sign of (high − low entry_volume) win-rate is positive in ≥3/5 vol_ratio_5_20 quintiles AND the same sign recurs in ≥2 independent snapshots, with Fisher-combined one-sided p < 0.05 across snapshot-specific 2x2 tables.
tests.failure_criterion: Sign agreement ≤2/5 quintile slices, OR only one snapshot supports the direction, OR combined p ≥ 0.10. Failure means entry_volume contributes nothing once the prevailing volume regime is fixed, and the slot is redundant.

tests.name: magnitude_partialed_event_residual_decile
tests.comparison: Refit, on the full archaeology sample only, the pre-registered OLS ibd_entry_volume_ratio ~ ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio + ibd_entry_close_position + ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct. Compute the residual r_i for each B0 candidate. Re-evaluate the false_negative vs selected_winner standardized delta on r_i. Compare against the raw ibd_entry_volume_ratio delta reported in the archaeology contrast table.
tests.success_criterion: |standardized_delta(r)| ≥ 0.70 × |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)| AND |standardized_delta(r)| ≥ 0.40 AND selected_winner median r exceeds false_negative median r. A residual that survives magnitude-partialing is consistent with genuine event-anchored demand.
tests.failure_criterion: |standardized_delta(r)| < 0.40 OR sign inversion. Failure means entry_volume is a near-redundant linear re-encoding of breakout magnitude and the slot should be retired or fused with breakout features.

tests.name: slot_swap_thrust_normalization_decision
tests.comparison: Pre-specify a regime-normalized thrust t_i = ibd_entry_volume_ratio_i / max(vol_ratio_5_20_i, q05(vol_ratio_5_20)), where q05 is the within-archaeology 5th percentile floor. Recompute the false_negative vs selected_winner standardized delta on t_i. Treat the slot as a budgeted B0 seat: decide which definition earns the seat based on the magnitude test below. This directly addresses the 3-slot accounting question by testing whether the slot should hold raw event volume or its regime-normalized form.
tests.success_criterion: |standardized_delta(t)| ≥ |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)| + 0.10 AND direction preserved. If thrust wins, retire raw ibd_entry_volume_ratio from B0 and substitute t_i in its slot.
tests.failure_criterion: |standardized_delta(t)| < |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)| − 0.10 OR sign inversion. Failure means regime normalization destroys signal: raw entry_volume is the correct slot occupant, but the mechanistic claim still requires the partial-residual test (Test 2) to pass before the slot is endorsed.

tests.name: placebo_preentry_window_deflation
tests.comparison: Construct a placebo entry-volume proxy v_placebo using only pre-entry days (volume averaged over days t-2 and t-1 relative to the IBD entry trigger, divided by the same multi-week baseline used for ibd_entry_volume_ratio). Re-run the false_negative vs selected_winner standardized delta on v_placebo. The entry-anchoring mechanism is genuinely special only if the actual entry-day feature carries materially more signal than this strictly-pre-entry placebo.
tests.success_criterion: |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)| ≥ 1.40 × |standardized_delta(v_placebo)| AND same sign. A sizeable gap confirms the entry day itself is the information source.
tests.failure_criterion: |standardized_delta(v_placebo)| ≥ 0.70 × |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)|. Failure means the slot is mis-named — the underlying information is pre-event thrust, not entry-anchored conviction — and the B0 component should be relabeled and re-defined using a pre-entry window before any production re-weighting.

leakage_checks: ibd_entry_volume_ratio, vol_ratio_5_20, ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, and up_day_ratio_20 must all be PIT-resolved: their computation windows must terminate on or before the snapshot_anon date and must not overlap with the W4 outcome measurement window. Verify by cross-tabulating each feature's timestamp metadata against snapshot_anon and the w4_return_bucket boundary.

snapshot_anon is permitted strictly as a stratification/blocking variable (e.g. for the within-snapshot fixed-effect logic in Test 1). It must never be one-hot encoded and supplied to a predictive model, since it acts as a calendar-ish batch identifier that could absorb training-time leakage when reused across cycles.

Test 2's magnitude-partialing regression must be fit on a sample disjoint from the false_negative/selected_winner label set used to score the residual; otherwise r_i is contaminated by the very labels it is being scored against. Pre-specify a leave-one-snapshot-out scheme for the OLS fit so residual scoring uses out-of-fold coefficients.

Test 3's denominator floor q05(vol_ratio_5_20) must be computed on the archaeology set alone and frozen before any delta comparison; recomputing the floor after seeing the headline delta would be a form of post-hoc tuning.

Test 4's placebo v_placebo must use only strictly pre-entry day windows (t-2 and t-1). Any inadvertent inclusion of the entry day's own volume collapses the placebo into a noised clone of ibd_entry_volume_ratio and the comparison becomes uninformative.

None of the four tests may consume outcome_label, w4_return_bucket, or pullback_pct/pullback_duration_weeks as input features; these are downstream outcomes. The only permissible label-side statistic is the false_negative vs selected_winner contrast used in the success/failure criteria.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The univariate false_negative-vs-selected_winner contrast (standardized delta -0.5013) is consistent with the claim that ibd_entry_volume_ratio carries some signal, but no conditional or partial-correlation evidence has been generated to demonstrate that this signal is incremental over the neighboring B0 volume regime term (vol_ratio_5_20, delta -1.0455) or the breakout-magnitude terms (ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct). The mechanisms claim — that entry_volume captures day-of-breakout demand conviction distinct from prevailing volume regime and breakout mechanics — is plausible but neither supported nor refuted by the frozen evidence. The skeptic's definitional-overlap objection (entry_volume_ratio and volume_ratio share arithmetic structure via overlapping baselines) and snapshot-cluster confound (4/5 false negatives from a single snapshot) jointly prevent any independence claim from being defensible at this stage. Verdict must be UNRESOLVED until the experimental-designer battery is executed.
falsifiers: Refutation #1 — Definitional redundancy: After standardizing both ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20 on the archaeology set, the absolute Pearson |r| exceeds 0.7 across snapshots. If so, the two are effectively one feature with two windows and the slot is mis-named.

Refutation #2 — Magnitude-collapsing partial residual: The Test 2 OLS residual r_i of ibd_entry_volume_ratio regressed on (ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct) has |standardized_delta(r)| < 0.40 vs the unselected false_negative/selected_winner contrast. This proves entry_volume is an upcoded breakout-magnitude proxy.

Refutation #3 — Pre-entry placebo parity: A strictly pre-entry (t-2, t-1) volume ratio produces |standardized_delta(v_placebo)| ≥ 0.70 × |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)|. This shows the information is pre-event regime thrust, not entry-day conviction, and the slot label is false.

Refutation #4 — Within-quintile null: Within each vol_ratio_5_20 quintile, the high-minus-low entry_volume win-rate sign is positive in ≤2 of 5 slices across the archaeology set. Independence of the two volume features is rejected at the conditioning level.

Refutation #5 — Slot-swap non-improvement: The thrust-normalized definition t_i = ibd_entry_volume_ratio_i / vol_ratio_5_20_i does NOT show |standardized_delta(t)| ≥ |standardized_delta(ibd_entry_volume_ratio)| + 0.10, indicating regime normalization destroys rather than enhances signal — the slot's content does not behave as a regime-demeaned thrust should.

Refutation #6 — Cohort transfer failure: Train on non-archaeology snapshots and predict false_negative/selected_winner status on the archaeology sample using ibd_entry_volume_ratio alone (logistic, IC, or decile monotone test); out-of-sample AUROC < 0.52. Generalization is required for the mechanism to be considered real.

Refutation #7 — Snapshot clustering confound: A leave-one-snapshot-out re-fit of the false_negative vs selected_winner median delta yields sign inversion or magnitude collapse when the snap_71486ed83c-dominated false-negative cohort is removed. The original delta was an artifact of snapshot-level regime, not a feature-level mechanism.
actionable_design_principles: Execute the experimental-designer test battery in a fixed pre-registered order on the archaeology set before any production re-weighting of ibd_entry_volume_ratio; do not back-fit thresholds based on this run.

Treat ibd_entry_volume_ratio as a SLOT LABEL QUESTION rather than a feature question: the slot must be filled by whichever (raw event volume, regime-normalized thrust, pre-entry placebo, breakout-orthogonal residual) maximizes out-of-sample information. Pick the winner; do not provision all four simultaneously.

Pre-compute and freeze q05(vol_ratio_5_20), the inter-snapshot fixed effect, and the leave-one-snapshot-out OLS coefficients BEFORE looking at residuals; this prevents post-hoc tuning and aligns with the time-stamp discipline of the B0 selection chain.

Quarantine snapshot_71486ed83c as a calibration/stratification variable — never a feature — because the false-negative cohort is over-concentrated there; require ≥2 independent snapshots to confirm any sign claim about entry_volume.

If the conditional tests fail, retire entry_volume as a standalone slot and replace it with the best of (residualized event volume, regime-normalized thrust, composite z-score over all four IBD entry features); redistribute the freed weight to vol_ratio_5_20 and mom_20 which dominate the contrast ranking.

Add a one-quarter shadow-tracking policy: alongside the production B0, log ibd_entry_volume_ratio's realized IC in decile sorts and compare to vol_ratio_5_20's IC; a gap > 0.02 standard deviations favors retirement of the entry_volume slot.

Distinct from prior outputs: explicitly test INTERACTION (vol_ratio_5_20 × ibd_entry_volume_ratio) rather than only conditional main effects — a demand-conviction mechanism predicts synergy, not just independence, so the interaction term's delta is the cleanest single-number test of the demand-conviction narrative.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a 'volume isolation' feature set: {ibd_entry_volume_ratio, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20} and require that within a frozen 3-fold split the conditional partial correlation of entry_volume with the W4 label, given vol_ratio_5_20 + up_day_ratio_20, satisfy |r_partial| ≥ 0.10 to keep the slot. Below this the slot auto-retires and the policy reverts to vol_ratio_5_20 alone.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Adds an explicit non-linearity check via partial correlation and an auto-retire threshold; prior outputs framed this only as 'partial R² contribution' which is not policy-executable. This idea gives the slot a falsifiable numeric gate rather than a researcher's qualitative judgment.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Selects whether the 'volume regime + entry-day event' two-slot architecture is justified or collapses to one slot. Drives the B0 z-weight allocation between regime and event.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add a 'thrust-quotient' slot swap policy: if the slot-swap test yields |standardized_delta(t_i)| ≥ |standardized_delta(raw)| + 0.10, the DSL rule rewrites B0 so the entry_volume term becomes t_i = ibd_entry_volume_ratio / max(vol_ratio_5_20, q05_frozen). Same data, different algebra; the policy encodes the regime-demeaning automatically.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Provides a single deterministic rewriter rather than a research open question. Prior outputs treated raw vs thrust as competing candidates; this idea elevates the test result to a runtime branch in the B0 expression.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Determines the slot arithmetic. If thrust wins, the B0 becomes more regime-invariant and should generalize across macro regimes better; if raw wins, the entry-anchored narrative survives but independence is still questioned.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Implement a placebo-pre-entry gate: for any production B0 candidate, compute v_placebo from days t-2 and t-1; require |standardized_delta(entry_volume)| ≥ 1.40 × |standardized_delta(v_placebo)| on the rolling 90-day history before allowing entry_volume to enter the composite. Otherwise drop it and emit a 'pre_event_only' flag.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the placebo test as a runtime data-quality filter rather than a one-off research diagnostic. This is a per-candidate gate that protects against the simplest falsifier (pre-event information being labeled as entry-anchored).
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Adds a per-candidate scoring rule and a flag channel. Useful for downstream portfolio sizing which must distinguish between 'high entry conviction' and 'high pre-event thrust mislabeled as entry'

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a 'breakout-orthogonal event volume' feature r_i from Test 2's OLS residual (entry_volume ~ breakout_range_ratio + close_position + close_vs_trigger), and add a stipulation that the B0 component 'entry_volume' be either r_i or zero — never the raw feature. This forces partial independence into the production input space.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Reframes entry_volume's role: rather than asking whether the raw feature is independent (a research question), the DSL declares the slot to BE the independent component. Effect: the slot cannot be redundant by construction, and the magnitude-partialing test becomes a release gate rather than a diagnostic.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Reshapes the B0 slot algebra: a candidate without breakout context cannot contribute event-volume signal at all. Useful as a primitive for downstream z-composites that want interpretable partial contributions.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Add an INTERACTION term slot: vol_ratio_5_20 × ibd_entry_volume_ratio enters the B0 only if its decile-monotonic win-rate slope exceeds the sum of the two main-effect slopes by ≥ 1 standard error. A demand-conviction mechanism predicts synergy; its absence is the strongest single falsifier for the demand-conviction narrative.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Prior tests focused on conditional independence and partial residual. An interaction test targets synergy rather than independence, which is the mechanistic content of the 'demand conviction' claim. This is a new layer of evidence the prior roles did not explicitly design.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Determines whether the B0 needs a cross-term slot or stays additive. If synergy holds, a multiplicative architecture is supported; if not, additive is sufficient and entry_volume's slot value is bounded by vol_ratio_5_20's signal.

cycles.question: For B0 component 'distinct1', determine whether its historical value comes from predictive information independent of neighboring B0 terms. State what evidence would falsify the component's claimed role and what a cleaner replacement would look like.

researcher.mechanism_claim: B0 component 'distinct1' is largely a relabeling of the momentum/relative-strength cluster {mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20}; its historical contribution to selection is mechanically confounded with neighboring terms rather than carrying independent predictive information.
evidence_for: All five momentum-cluster features load together with large negative standardized deltas between false_negatives and selected_winners (up_day_ratio_20: -1.19, vol_ratio_5_20: -1.05, mom_20: -1.00, px_vs_ma50: -0.85, ma10_slope_5: -0.68), consistent with a single latent 'trend-strength' factor, not five independent signals.

False-positive ruins sit at high momentum values (entity_6618d3e80c: mom_20=0.251, px_vs_ma50=0.337; entity_3472243e0c: mom_20=0.242; entity_b6bcccdf6a: mom_20=0.176; entity_4fdc3699fd: mom_20=0.185) — if distinct1 echoed these it would have actively *endorsed* traps that the B0 outcome label then destroyed, the signature of a non-discriminating duplicate.

False-negative missed winners cluster at uniformly low momentum (entity_de1c657364: mom_20=0.058, ma10_slope_5=0.030, px_vs_ma50=0.054; entity_535a1beed7: mom_20=0.028, px_vs_ma50=0.024), again a block movement — distinct1 cannot break the block if it is itself part of it.

ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct (std delta -0.70) and pullback_duration_weeks (std delta -0.73) carry directionally similar information, suggesting distinct1 likely also subsumes a 'tightness-of-entry' sub-signal already represented elsewhere.

Features outside the momentum cluster (base_mbox_count: +0.34, base_duration_weeks: -0.42, base_depth_pct: +0.19) show weaker but orthogonally-signed associations — these are the candidates distinct1 is *not* capturing, reinforcing that its content sits inside the redundant cluster.
evidence_against: Some ruins occur at modest momentum (entity_55c2da490e: mom_20=0.036, ma10_slope_5=0.020; entity_40ea0cfb3b: mom_20=0.024, ma10_slope_5=0.025) — if distinct1 actually encodes base/quality rather than pure momentum, these could be quality-filtered picks that still fail, leaving room for distinct1 to add info beyond neighbors.

The 0.34 standardized delta on base_mbox_count (opposite sign from momentum features) indicates a genuine orthogonal axis exists in the feature space; distinct1 could in principle be tapping this axis rather than the momentum axis.

Case-level outcome heterogeneity (e.g., entity_6618d3e80c carries both 'false_positive_ruin' and 'selected_winner' labels across snapshots) shows the B0 signal is not perfectly stable — distinct1 could be one of the components whose value drifts in ways not fully captured by static neighbor correlations.
falsifiable_predictions: Variance decomposition: regress distinct1_value on {mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20}; predicted R² > 0.70 ⇒ distinct1 is largely redundant and its claimed independent role is falsified.

Partial-correlation test: |corr(distinct1_value, W4_return_bucket | momentum-cluster features)| < 0.05 in a held-out fold ⇒ distinct1 contributes no incremental predictive information once neighbors are conditioned on.

Disagreement test: bin cases into quartiles of (distinct1_rank − mean(neighbor_ranks)); if W4 outcomes are statistically indistinguishable across these quartiles (KS or AUC ≈ 0.5), distinct1 carries no orthogonal content.

Ablation test: remove distinct1 from the B0 score and re-tune remaining weights on the same archaeology set; if selection precision@K on selected_winners vs. false_positive_ruin does not degrade beyond bootstrap noise, distinct1 is non-load-bearing.

Sign-flip stress: if distinct1 is replaced by −distinct1 in the score and selection precision remains unchanged, distinct1 is directionally indistinguishable from noise — a strong falsifier of any claimed causal role.
policy_implications: Replace distinct1 with its regression residual against the momentum-cluster neighbors (Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization); this preserves any genuine orthogonal content while removing double-counted variance.
Apply a collinearity penalty (e.g., ridge or soft collinearity prior) during B0 re-fitting so that distinct1 cannot absorb redundant momentum mass; cap effective rank of the B0 design matrix.
Reallocate freed weight toward base-structure features (base_duration_weeks, base_mbox_count, pullback_pct, base_depth_pct) which display orthogonally-signed associations with outcomes.

If ablation shows <1pp precision change, schedule distinct1 for deprecation; if ablation shows >3pp degradation, retain but require an interaction term with a base-quality feature to break the collinear structure.

Add a periodic independence audit: any B0 term whose rolling R² against its k-nearest neighbors exceeds 0.65 should be flagged for review or replacement, preventing future 'distinct*' components from silently duplicating existing signals.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The prior claim collapses three distinct possibilities into one: (a) distinct1 is a redundant duplicate of momentum features, (b) distinct1 is a non-linear transform (rank/percentile/regime flag) of those features, or (c) distinct1 carries a small but mechanism-orthogonal signal that is masked by sample size and label instability. The evidence presented only weakly supports (a); the data contains direct counterexamples that favor (b) or (c). The proposed Gram–Schmidt orthogonal replacement would not 'preserve any genuine orthogonal content' — it would, by construction, strip out anything correlated with momentum, which is exactly the regime where the original B0 was earning its keep.

attacks.issue: Standardized deltas between FALSE_NEGATIVES and SELECTED_WINNERS are being misread as R² within a regression. Two features can show nearly identical group-mean deltas while retaining large independent within-group variance that materially affects ranking.
attacks.why_it_matters: Selection is a ranking problem on individual cases, not a class-mean problem. If distinct1 and mom_20 agree on average but disagree on the borderline cases, distinct1 is doing real work. The proposed R²>0.70 falsifier conflates 'mean direction agrees' with 'feature is redundant'.

attacks.issue: N=27 cases is catastrophically underpowered for the tests proposed (partial correlation stability, KS across quartiles, ablation precision@K). With this sample, even a true independent signal of moderate size will be statistically indistinguishable from zero noise.
attacks.why_it_matters: Any 'falsifier' that runs on this set will fail to reject the null not because distinct1 is redundant but because the test has no power. Calling a test 'falsifiable' doesn't make its conclusions reliable — it makes them prematurely confident.

attacks.issue: Compound labels (entity_6618d3e80c carries both 'false_positive_ruin' and 'selected_winner'; two cases carry 'false_negative_big_winner|false_negative_relative') demonstrate that the LABELING itself is unstable across snapshots. Attributing outcome variance to feature redundancy while ignoring label instability is a confounding trap.
attacks.why_it_matters: If 'selected_winner' and 'false_positive_ruin' can co-occur on the same entity-snapshot pair, then the apparent momentum-vs-ruin contrast is partially artifactual. distinct1's perceived 'endorsement of traps' may be a labeling artifact, not a feature property.

attacks.issue: The ruins at HIGH momentum (entity_6618d3e80c mom_20=0.251, entity_3472243e0c mom_20=0.242, entity_b6bcccdf6a mom_20=0.176) and the winners at NEAR-ZERO momentum (entity_8ad5cd4795 mom_20=0.004, entity_2f86543bf6 mom_20=-0.008) are the textbook signature of a signal that is NOT just trend strength — they are the signature of distinct1 (or another component) overriding raw momentum. Treating these as evidence of redundancy inverts the actual signal.
attacks.why_it_matters: A pure momentum duplicate cannot simultaneously explain 'wins at high momentum' AND 'wins at near-zero momentum' AND 'ruins at high momentum'. If distinct1 alone tracked raw momentum, you'd expect high-momentum wins and low-momentum losses — the opposite of what's observed in the archaeology. The pattern is consistent with distinct1 carrying a distinct (possibly anti-momentum or regime-aware) signal that the prior claim dismisses.

attacks.issue: The 'cleaner replacement' (Gram–Schmidt residual against the momentum cluster) is mathematically guaranteed to retain nothing that correlates with momentum. But the original system was winning because of its correlation with momentum in specific regimes. Replacing the original with its orthogonal residual destroys the very signal that produced the wins.
attacks.why_it_matters: This is a classic error: orthogonalization removes the predictive direction, not the redundant one. The policy advice to 'preserve any genuine orthogonal content' is internally contradictory — by construction, the residual has zero correlation with momentum, which is precisely the axis along which winners are identified.

attacks.issue: The sign-flip stress test is biased toward rejecting distinct1 regardless of its true role. Flipping ANY load-bearing positive signal will degrade selection; this test cannot distinguish 'distinct1 is redundant' from 'distinct1 has positive weight'.
attacks.why_it_matters: The test as specified is evidence for distinct1 having a sign, not evidence for distinct1 having independent content. It would equally 'falsify' any monotonic feature (mom_20 itself) and therefore cannot discriminate.

attacks.issue: The archaeology set is a SAMPLE of errors and wins; it is NOT a sample of successful distinct1 contributions. The successful uses of distinct1 (where it correctly tipped the ranking in favor of a winner) are mostly absent from this view because they produced 'selected_winner' outcomes, indistinguishable from cases where distinct1 was inactive. This is selection bias on the evidence itself.
attacks.why_it_matters: We are asked to judge distinct1's information content using only the cases where something went wrong or where the system was already confident. The cases where distinct1 tipped a marginal call correctly are structurally invisible in this archaeology.

attacks.issue: The 'orthogonal axis' pointed to (base_mbox_count with +0.34 standardized delta) is itself a candidate to be redundant with distinct1 in ways not tested. The researcher concedes base_structure is orthogonal but assumes distinct1 sits inside the momentum cluster without proving distinct1 does NOT also span the base-structure axis.
attacks.why_it_matters: The argument treats distinct1 as if it must live in one cluster. A component could legitimately encode a mixture or interaction term that touches both axes; forcing it into one bin is a modeling assumption, not an empirical finding.

counterexamples_to_seek: A 'selected_winner' case with mom_20 < 0.05 AND low up_day_ratio_20 AND low vol_ratio_5_20 — a win where the entire momentum cluster said 'no'. If distinct1's value at that snapshot diverged sharply from its momentum-cluster neighbors, that is direct evidence of independent content.

A 'false_positive_ruin' case with mom_20 > 0.20 AND high vol_ratio_5_20 where distinct1's value was actually NEGATIVE or in the bottom decile — i.e., where distinct1 tried to suppress but was overridden. This would show distinct1 as a CORRECT signal being ignored, not a duplicate endorsing a trap.

A pair of cases with nearly identical momentum-cluster feature vectors but opposite W4 outcomes. If distinct1's value differs across the pair in the direction of the outcome, that is the cleanest possible falsification of the 'distinct1 is a duplicate' claim.

Cases where distinct1's rank percentile disagrees with the mean neighbor rank by >30 percentile points — a 'disagreement test' (mentioned in prior predictions) but specifically inspecting the disagreement magnitude and outcome correlation.
A held-out period where distinct1 alone (with neighbors held constant or zeroed) shows non-zero partial AUC for distinguishing winners from ruins — the cleanest possible positive evidence.
what_would_change_my_mind: An actual R² value from regressing distinct1 on the momentum cluster on a sample of at least N≥200 entities (not 27), accompanied by a bootstrap confidence interval. If the 95% CI lower bound exceeds 0.65, the redundancy claim becomes plausible. With N=27 the test cannot conclude either way.

An ablation study where distinct1 is REMOVED and the remaining B0 weights are retuned on a temporally separate validation set. If precision@K degrades by less than the bootstrap CI (i.e., within noise), I will accept redundancy as the leading hypothesis. Anything weaker (within-sample comparison, partial correlation, sign-flip on the same data) will not convince me.

Replication of the 'ruins at high momentum' pattern on an out-of-sample window. If those ruins are predominantly explained by distinct1's value being high (i.e., distinct1 endorsed them), the duplicate hypothesis gains weight. If distinct1's value was LOW or neutral on those ruins, the override/disagreement hypothesis gains weight and the redundancy claim should be retracted.

A demonstration that the Gram–Schmidt residual replacement actually improves selection on a held-out period. Until then, 'preserve any genuine orthogonal content' is an untested promise — orthogonalization by construction destroys momentum-correlated signal, and the burden of proof is on the proposer to show the original signal was indeed disposable.

Disclosure of the actual mathematical definition of distinct1. If it is a rank transform, percentile, z-score, or regime flag of momentum features, the redundancy claim is partly correct (the raw content overlaps) but the prior analysis missed the non-linearity that may be the entire point. If it is a linear combination of neighbors, redundancy is more plausible; if it is a transformation or interaction, the redundancy framing is wrong.

tests.name: Within-stratum partial rank test (separates redundancy from any-orthogonality)
tests.comparison: Stratify the discovery+replication sample into momentum-quintiles using a composite score (mean rank of the five listed features). Within each quintile, compute the Spearman rank correlation between distinct1_value and a numeric encoding of w4_return_bucket (ruin<loss<small_win<large_win, with tied handling). Average the within-stratum absolute correlations, weighted by stratum size, and report a bootstrap 95% CI over cases.
tests.success_criterion: Weighted-mean |rho| across momentum quintiles is > 0.20 with at least 4 of 5 strata showing the SAME sign and a bootstrap 95% CI lower bound above 0.10. This indicates distinct1 carries information not subsumed by the momentum cluster and falsifies the pure-redundancy claim.
tests.failure_criterion: Weighted-mean |rho| < 0.10 and no stratum shows |rho| > 0.25, OR signs flip across strata such that no consistent direction emerges. This pattern is the predicted signature of distinct1 being a near-duplicate of the momentum cluster; the redundancy hypothesis stands and the claim of independent information is falsified.

tests.name: Residual-vs-orthogonal-feature probe (separates linear-redundancy from non-linear-transform)
tests.comparison: Compute distinct1_residual = distinct1_value − OLS(distinct1_value ~ mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 + ma10_slope_5). Separately compute distinct1_residual_orth = distinct1_value − OLS(distinct1_value ~ base_mbox_count + base_duration_weeks). Test two predictions in parallel: (i) |corr(distinct1_residual, w4_return_bucket)| vs. |corr(distinct1_value, w4_return_bucket)| — does momentum-orthogonalization wipe signal? (ii) |corr(distinct1_residual_orth, w4_return_bucket)| vs. |corr(distinct1_value, w4_return_bucket)| — does base-orthogonalization wipe signal? Compare magnitudes.
tests.success_criterion: If the residual after momentum-orthogonalization is near-zero in predictive content (|corr| drops by >70% relative to raw) AND the residual after base-orthogonalization retains >50% of raw predictive content, this supports Mechanism A (linear-redundancy with momentum) and falsifies Mechanism B as currently formulated. If EITHER orthogonalization retains >70% of raw predictive content, distinct1 is NOT a linear duplicate of either cluster.
tests.failure_criterion: If both orthogonalizations retain >70% of raw predictive content (i.e., raw predictive signal survives both projections), the linear-redundancy framing is wrong — distinct1's content is not in the linear span of either the momentum cluster OR the base-structure cluster, which is the predicted signature of either a non-linear transform (Mechanism B) or a regime/interaction term (Mechanism C). Redundancy claim is then specifically falsified as 'linear' redundancy, leaving non-linear forms open.

tests.name: Override-direction case audit (separates regime-override from transform/duplicate)
tests.comparison: Identify cases where distinct1_value rank-decile disagrees with the momentum-cluster consensus rank-decile by ≥3 deciles in EITHER direction. Partition disagreements into (a) distinct1-HIGH / momentum-LOW and (b) distinct1-LOW / momentum-HIGH. Compute the empirical outcome distribution (proportion of large_win vs ruin) in each partition, with bootstrap CIs. Also compute the same partition on the archaeology set as a sanity check.
tests.success_criterion: If partition (a) — distinct1 endorsing against momentum — yields a large_win fraction ≥ 30 percentage points above the momentum-LOW baseline (i.e., distinct1 successfully upgraded otherwise-rejected names), this is direct positive evidence for Mechanism C (regime-aware override) and falsifies both pure-redundancy (A) and pure-transform (B) framings. Symmetric evidence from partition (b) — distinct1 suppressing high-momentum names that turned out to be ruins — would corroborate override behavior.
tests.failure_criterion: If BOTH partitions show outcome distributions statistically indistinguishable (overlapping bootstrap CIs) from their respective momentum-cluster baselines, distinct1 adds no detectable override behavior. Combined with a negative result on Test 1, this leaves Mechanism A (redundancy) as the best-supported explanation; combined with a positive Test 1 but negative Test 3, Mechanism B (non-linear transform without override) becomes the leading candidate.

leakage_checks: Verify distinct1_value at snapshot_t is computed using only information with timestamp ≤ t (no rolling window that includes data after t, no future-return inputs, no label-conditional transforms). Reject the test if distinct1's construction references w4_return_bucket or any post-entry window.

Confirm that the momentum-cluster features (mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20) are PIT-safe at the same snapshot boundary as distinct1, so the partial-correlation test is not contaminated by an asymmetric look-ahead window between the candidate feature and its neighbors.

Enforce entity-disjoint folds: cases belonging to the same entity_anon must not appear in both training and evaluation within any test, to avoid within-entity correlation inflating partial-correlation estimates. Report effective N after this filter.

Audit the w4_return_bucket label generation for look-back dependence (e.g., the bucket might use intra-window highs/lows not available at entry); confirm the bucket is assigned by the W4 close-on-close return only, matching the method_note definition.

Snapshot-disjoint audit: cases sharing a snapshot_anon must be split or down-weighted to prevent within-snapshot correlation (e.g., shared market regime) from being misread as distinct1-specific information. Report within-snapshot correlation of distinct1_value as a diagnostic.

Hold-out size floor: each test requires N ≥ 150 effective cases (after entity/snapshot deduplication) with at least 25 cases per outcome bucket; otherwise return UNRESOLVED rather than risk underpowered false-positive or false-negative conclusions.
priority_order: Within-stratum partial rank test (separates redundancy from any-orthogonality)
Override-direction case audit (separates regime-override from transform/duplicate)

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: Available archaeology (N=27, with compound labels and selection bias toward failures) is statistically underpowered to discriminate the redundancy hypothesis from an override/interaction hypothesis. The strongest structural argument for SOME redundancy is that the five momentum-cluster features load with same-sign, large-magnitude standardized deltas (up_day_ratio_20: -1.19, vol_ratio_5_20: -1.05, mom_20: -1.00, px_vs_ma50: -0.85, ma10_slope_5: -0.68), which is consistent with a single latent trend-strength factor distinct1 could be tapping. However, the same archaeology contains evidence INCOMPATIBLE with pure redundancy: wins at near-zero momentum (entity_8ad5cd4795 mom_20=0.004, entity_2f86543bf6 mom_20=-0.008) and ruins at high momentum (entity_6618d3e80c mom_20=0.251, entity_3472243e0c mom_20=0.242) are not the predicted signature of a momentum duplicate. A pure duplicate would predict high-momentum wins and low-momentum losses; the observed cross-pattern is the signature of either an override term or an interaction, which the redundancy framing dismisses by construction. Label instability (compound labels on entity_6618d3e80c, and two entities with 'false_negative_big_winner|false_negative_relative') further contaminates any group-mean contrast. The proposed 'cleaner replacement' (Gram–Schmidt residual against the momentum cluster) is itself problematic: by construction it zeroes out the axis along which the winners are actually being separated, so the replacement can only confirm the conclusion it was designed to produce.
falsifiers: R²(distinct1_value ~ momentum-cluster features) > 0.70 in a held-out entity-disjoint fold with N ≥ 150 effective cases AND outcome-disagreement test yields KS AUC ≈ 0.5 across distinct1-rank-vs-neighbor-rank quartiles → redundancy supported.
Partial Spearman |corr(distinct1_value, W4_return_bucket | momentum-cluster features)| < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0.10 in the same held-out fold → independent-information claim falsified.

Sign-flip stress: replacing distinct1 with −distinct1 leaves selection precision@K unchanged within bootstrap noise (|Δ| < 1pp) → distinct1 is directionally inert, falsifying any load-bearing role regardless of redundancy status.

Ablation with re-tune: removing distinct1 and re-fitting remaining B0 weights on the same training set produces selection precision@K within bootstrap noise of the full model → distinct1 is non-load-bearing and any apparent information is being double-counted by neighbors.

The 'override-disagreement' pair test: in cases where distinct1's rank decile diverges from the momentum-cluster consensus by ≥3 deciles, the outcome distribution in the divergence partition is statistically indistinguishable from the no-divergence baseline → distinct1 adds no detectable override content beyond its correlation with neighbors.

Counter-evidence that would falsify the REDUNDANCY claim instead: finding ≥10 entity-disjoint case pairs with nearly identical momentum-cluster feature vectors but opposite W4 outcomes, where distinct1's value differs across the pair in the direction of the outcome, would constitute direct evidence of independent information content.
actionable_design_principles: Do not use group-mean standardized deltas as a redundancy test — selection is a within-case ranking problem, and two features with identical group deltas can disagree on every borderline case. Use within-stratum rank correlation and disagreement-decile outcome distributions instead.

Separate three distinct questions before any 'cleaner replacement': (1) Is distinct1 collinear with neighbors? (2) Does distinct1 carry any predictive content not already in neighbors? (3) Is distinct1 load-bearing in the composite score? Each requires a different test; conflating them produces circular conclusions.
