what_would_change_my_mind: A matched-triple test on a sample of N>=500 fresh-breakout weeks drawn WITHOUT selecting on future returns (i.e., a random or rule-based cross-section, not a forward-return-weighted archaeology), with Lane operationally defined and the proxies measured contemporaneously to the Lane call (not backward-looking).

A regression of W4 return on a SCORE_BEFORE_LANE-only specification versus a SCORE_AFTER_LANE-only specification in held-out data, where both models use identical proxy features and identical training window — if SCORE_BEFORE_LANE explains >=90% of SCORE_AFTER_LANE's out-of-sample R^2 AND the coefficient on the Lane-residual component is statistically zero, the proxy hypothesis holds.

An ablation where Lane is removed from the B0 selector and the resulting portfolio is compared on (i) mean W4 return, (ii) left-tail (ruin) rate, AND (iii) cross-sectional dispersion of W4 returns — Lane removal should be tested on all three axes, not just mean. If ruin rate increases by >=2pp when Lane is removed, Lane has a non-proxy mechanism.
Evidence that the three proxy features together capture >=95% of the variance of any defensible operational definition of Lane in-sample AND out-of-sample — currently no such definition exists.

A demonstration that for every entity with multiple snapshots, when proxies are held constant Lane assignment also stays constant — i.e., Lane is a deterministic function of the proxies with no additional inputs. If Lane uses ANY non-proxied input (close position, base count, sector RS, distribution count), the proxy hypothesis is falsified.

If the matched-triple test at N>=500 still shows <1pp B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL mean W4 gap AND ruin rates equal within ±1pp AND left-tail equal, I will concede the proxy hypothesis. Until then the evidence is insufficient to retire Lane.

tests.name: Orthogonal residual test: Lane effect after partialing out proxy triple
tests.comparison: Within fresh-breakout-week cases, residualize B0_LANE indicator and SCORE_BEFORE_LANE on the FULL PIT proxy block (not just three features) via OLS. Compare (i) raw W4 return gap between B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL slots, and (ii) W4 return gap after projecting both onto the proxy-residual axis. If Lane is purely a proxy, the residual-on-residual gap should be statistically indistinguishable from zero.
tests.success_criterion: Residualized B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL mean W4 return gap < 0.8pp AND ruin-rate gap < 1pp AND the t-statistic on Lane-residual coefficient < 1.0 in a W4-return regression that already contains the full proxy block.
tests.failure_criterion: Residualized mean gap >= 2.0pp OR ruin-rate gap >= 2pp OR Lane-residual coefficient |t| >= 2.0 in the full-proxy regression.

tests.name: Tail-shape separation test: Lane as ruin-suppressor vs proxy-overconfident ruin
tests.comparison: Within fresh-breakout-week triples matched on quantile-rank of {up_day_ratio_20, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20} (joint rank, not three independent thresholds), compute left-tail metrics: (a) ruin/loss rate among B0_LANE, (b) ruin/loss rate among LANE_NEUTRAL, (c) ruin/loss rate among proxy-confident-but-Lane-neutral (top tercile on proxy composite but LANE_NEUTRAL), and (d) ruin/loss rate among proxy-weak-but-Lane-favorable (bottom tercile on proxy composite but B0_LANE). A pure-proxy mechanism predicts (a)=(b)=(c)=(d) within noise; a ruin-suppression mechanism predicts (c)>>(a) and (d)<<(b).
tests.success_criterion: Paired ruin-rate differences |(a)-(b)|, |(c)-(a)|, |(d)-(b)| each < 1.0pp AND Fisher exact p-value for ruin~Lane table > 0.20.
tests.failure_criterion: Any paired ruin-rate difference >= 2.5pp with the sign predicted by the ruin-suppression hypothesis, OR Fisher exact p-value < 0.05 in the ruin~Lane contingency.

tests.name: Score decomposition R^2 test: SCORE_BEFORE_LANE saturation
tests.comparison: Construct SCORE_BEFORE_LANE = linear combination of the FULL PIT proxy block (no Lane input) fit on a frozen training window. Regress SCORE_AFTER_LANE on SCORE_BEFORE_LANE within fresh-breakout-week cases. If Lane is purely a proxy recoding, the R^2 should be very high and the residuals should be uncorrelated with any PIT feature not already in the proxy block. Additionally, regress W4 return on SCORE_BEFORE_LANE vs SCORE_AFTER_LANE; the incremental R^2 and incremental coefficient significance is the test.
tests.success_criterion: R^2(SCORE_AFTER_LANE ~ SCORE_BEFORE_LANE) >= 0.90 AND incremental R^2 of Lane component on W4 return < 0.02 AND Lane-residual in the second-stage regression is statistically zero (|t| < 1.0).
tests.failure_criterion: R^2(SCORE_AFTER_LANE ~ SCORE_BEFORE_LANE) < 0.70 OR incremental R^2 on W4 return >= 0.05 OR Lane-residual |t| >= 2.0 in second-stage regression OR SCORE_AFTER_LANE residuals correlate (|r|>=0.3) with PIT features {ibd_entry_close_position, ibd_entry_breakout_range_ratio, base_mbox_count, base_duration_weeks, base_depth_pct}.

tests.name: Within-snapshot within-proxy-quintile ablation: Lane bin stability under proxy perturbation
tests.comparison: Within the snap_71486ed83c cluster (the densest fresh-breakout-week snapshot in the archaeology, holding market regime constant), isolate quintile-pairs on the proxy composite z(up_day_ratio_20) + z(mom_20) + z(vol_ratio_5_20). Within each quintile-pair, contrast (i) B0_LANE W4 distribution vs (ii) LANE_NEUTRAL W4 distribution. A pure-proxy mechanism predicts no within-quintile divergence; an orthogonal-axis mechanism predicts divergence concentrated in middle quintiles (where proxy signal is ambiguous).
tests.success_criterion: Across quintile-pairs, B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL W4 mean gap < 1.0pp in EVERY quintile pair AND Kolmogorov-Smirnov two-sample p-value > 0.20 in every quintile pair.
tests.failure_criterion: Mean gap >= 2.0pp in ANY quintile pair OR KS p-value < 0.05 in ANY quintile pair OR ruin-rate gap >= 3pp in middle quintile (Q2-Q3) where proxy signal is weakest.

tests.name: Rescue-and-rejection asymmetry test: orthogonal Lane contribution via 2x2 contingency
tests.comparison: Construct a 2x2 within fresh-breakout-week cases: rows = {B0_LANE, LANE_NEUTRAL}, columns = {large_win outcome, ruin/loss outcome} (using the existing w4_return_bucket labels, which are within the in-sample observation window — NOT outer-forward). A pure-proxy mechanism predicts the ruin rate conditional on Lane is independent of the proxy composite level. Test for interaction: does Lane-neutral ruin risk INCREASE with proxy confidence (proxy-overconfident ruin) AND does Lane-favorable win rate INCREASE with proxy weakness (proxy-weak rescue)? The interaction term tests whether Lane modulates proxy confidence asymmetrically.
tests.success_criterion: In a logistic regression of ruin indicator on (proxy composite rank) × (Lane indicator), the interaction coefficient is statistically zero (|z| < 1.0) AND the marginal Lane effect within top-proxy-tercile is < 1pp ruin rate.
tests.failure_criterion: Interaction coefficient |z| >= 1.96 OR marginal Lane effect within top-proxy-tercile changes ruin rate by >= 2pp OR in the proxy-weak-but-Lane-favorable cell, large_win rate exceeds the proxy-confident-and-Lane-favorable cell by >= 3pp (the rescue signal).

leakage_checks: Verify all features in the allowlist are computed at or before the IBD entry snapshot timestamp (no peeking into post-entry W4 window for feature construction). The frozen evidence's method_note already flags false_negatives as requiring future W4 >=8%, so all feature rows must be confirmed PIT and the label generation procedure must not contaminate feature selection.

Block any test from conditioning on outcome_label or w4_return_bucket during feature engineering — these are post-entry and would re-introduce the selection-on-dependent-variable bias the skeptic identified.

For the within-snapshot test on snap_71486ed83c, confirm snapshot identity is used ONLY as a stratification/blocking factor (not as a predictive feature) and that all cases in that snapshot share the same observation window so cross-sectional comparison is not confounded by regime differences.

Confirm that SCORE_BEFORE_LANE and SCORE_AFTER_LANE are both constructed from the same PIT feature allowlist and the same training window — the only difference permitted is the inclusion/exclusion of the Lane input. Any drift in feature set or window invalidates the decomposition R^2 test.

For the 2x2 contingency test, restrict to cases where the w4_return_bucket label is deterministically derivable from within-sample (not outer-forward) data. If any cell requires forward data beyond the in-sample observation window, that test is invalid and must be downgraded to UNRESOLVED.

Verify that the proxy composite z(up_day_ratio_20) + z(mom_20) + z(vol_ratio_5_20) is computed within-snapshot to avoid cross-regime z-score contamination, particularly for the snap_71486ed83c-dense and snap_d0d57b1e40 sub-clusters.

Confirm that base_duration_weeks, base_depth_pct, base_mbox_count are treated as geometry proxies only when their values are available PIT (non-null in the frozen evidence) and are NOT imputed using post-entry information.
priority_order: Tail-shape separation test: Lane as ruin-suppressor vs proxy-overconfident ruin
Orthogonal residual test: Lane effect after partialing out proxy triple
Score decomposition R^2 test: SCORE_BEFORE_LANE saturation
Rescue-and-rejection asymmetry test: orthogonal Lane contribution via 2x2 contingency
Within-snapshot within-proxy-quintile ablation: Lane bin stability under proxy perturbation

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The pure-proxy hypothesis (Lane = freshness + geometry + volume) is methodologically untestable in this evidence base. Three independent blockers: (1) Lane is never operationally defined, so any test is partially vacuous; (2) the false_negative sample is constructed by selecting on future W4 returns, contaminating the proxy-triple deltas that motivate the hypothesis; (3) N=27 with three-feature matching yields near-empty cells, so mean-gap thresholds of 1-2pp are unfalsifiable in either direction. The EVIDENCE does not support a pure-proxy reading: 8 false_positive_ruin cases show proxy readings indistinguishable from selected_winners (e.g., entity_8f0df3d38e mom_20=0.176, up_day_ratio_20=0.65, vol_ratio_5_20=1.24 = ruin; entity_b00579f203 mom_20=0.230, up_day_ratio_20=0.70, vol_ratio_5_20=1.58 = winner), and entity_6618d3e80c is dual-labeled winner+ruin despite top-decile proxies. This means the proxy composite fails at the binding constraint (left-tail ruin), not at mean W4 return — which is exactly where Lane plausibly operates if it has any real effect.
falsifiers: PROXY_HOLDS if: within snap_71486ed83c quintile-pairs matched on full proxy block, B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL ruin-rate gap <1pp in EVERY pair AND SCORE_BEFORE_LANE explains >=90% of SCORE_AFTER_LANE W4-return cross-sectional R^2. If both hold, retire Lane.

PROXY_REFUTED if: entity_6618d3e80c analogues (proxy-confident LANE_NEUTRAL ruins) exceed entity_8f0df3d38e analogues (proxy-confident B0_LANE wins) by >=3pp in ruin rate within the matched quintile-pair test, OR if proxy-weak-but-Lane-favorable rescues (low up_day_ratio_20, low vol_ratio_5_20, modest mom_20, B0_LANE) outperform proxy-strong-but-Lane-neutral rows on large_win frequency by >=3pp.
actionable_design_principles: Run the Within-Snapshot Within-Proxy-Quintile Ablation test on snap_71486ed83c first; it is the single most discriminating test because it holds regime constant and stratifies by proxy confidence, isolating any orthogonal Lane contribution to either mean return or ruin rate.

Separate distributional (ruin-rate) tests from mean-return tests before drawing conclusions; a Lane effect that operates purely through left-tail suppression is invisible to mean-gap tests at N=27 and is the pattern most consistent with the eight false_positive_ruin cases where proxies look like winners.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Lane-conditioned proxy guard: when up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 composite is in top tercile BUT Lane bin is LANE_NEUTRAL, treat as proxy-overconfident_ruin candidate and apply a haircut to position size or require a second confirming feature (ibd_entry_close_position > 0.7, distribution_day_count <= 1).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Encodes the rescue-and-rejection asymmetry the skeptic flagged: the proxy composite is necessary but not sufficient, and the failure mode of the proxy is concentrated in LANE_NEUTRAL rows at high proxy confidence — exactly the entity_6618d3e80c pattern.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Directly targets the binding constraint (ruin rate in proxy-confident LANE_NEUTRAL) identified in the failure archaeology rather than chasing mean-return improvement where evidence is uninformative at N=27.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Two-axis score decomposition: compute SCORE_BEFORE_LANE from the FULL PIT proxy block (not just the triple) and require incremental R^2 of Lane component on W4 return >=0.02 AND ruin-rate marginal effect <= -1pp within top proxy tercile before retaining Lane as a separate axis; otherwise fold Lane into the proxy composite.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Forces the proxy hypothesis to be tested against ALL 17+ non-trivial-delta features in the contrast table, not just the cherry-picked triple the researcher elevated, and uses ruin rate (not mean return) as the binding criterion — addressing both the cherry-pick and the distributional-shape critiques simultaneously.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Operationalizes the score-decomposition R^2 test from the experimental designer while closing the operational-definition gap the skeptic identified; Lane only earns a separate axis if it survives a full-block partialing test.

cycles.question: Test the hypothesis 'Lane mainly changes portfolio risk rather than expected return' specifically in fresh breakout weeks. Give discriminating predictions for B0_LANE, LANE_NEUTRAL, and SCORE_BEFORE_LANE.

researcher.mechanism_claim: In fresh breakout weeks Lane shifts the conditional return distribution's left tail more than its mean: B0_LANE names should have W4 mean return similar to LANE_NEUTRAL but materially higher ruin rate, because Lane scores momentum persistence proxies (up_day_ratio_20, mom_20) that correlate weakly with mean but better with eventual continuation; SCORE_BEFORE_LANE baseline should sit between them on dispersion.
evidence_for: Numeric contrasts: false_negatives (Lane missed winners) have median up_day_ratio_20=0.5 vs selected_winners=0.625 (std_delta -1.19) and vol_ratio_5_20=1.18 vs 1.42 (std_delta -1.05), indicating Lane is filtering on persistence/volume-strength features that map to continuation probability, not raw magnitude

Among B0 picks, 8/16 became 'false_positive_ruin' (50% ruin share in archaeology) while LANE_NEUTRAL picks in same snapshots (e.g., entity_d8e8e7b814, entity_bfb308b24a) show only small_win/loss outcomes with no ruinline; ruin concentration in B0 indicates tail-risk loading rather than mean uplift

B0 winners that became 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner' (entity_6618d3e80c: ma10_slope_5=0.075, mom_20=0.25, up_day_ratio_20=0.55) show strong slopes but mid-range up_day_ratio - Lane accepted slope-driven names that subsequently failed, consistent with risk asymmetry not mean filtering
evidence_against: Selected_winner medians exceed false_negatives on mom_20 (+0.10), px_vs_ma50 (+0.07), ma10_slope_5 (+0.015) - these are magnitude features that would shift mean, not just tail, contradicting pure risk-shift framing
pullback_pct contrast (-15.9 winners vs -7.3 false_negatives) and pullback_duration_weeks (5.5 vs 4.0) suggest Lane-favored names had deeper/longer prior bases, a structural mean predictor
IBD_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct median 0.030 winners vs 0.019 false_negatives (std_delta -0.70) indicates Lane names entered closer to trigger - a systematic mean-affecting entry timing bias
falsifiable_predictions: In a fresh breakout week, mean 4-week return rank should be B0_LANE ≈ LANE_NEUTRAL ≈ SCORE_BEFORE_LANE (no significant mean separation, paired t-test p>0.2), while ruin-rate (>15% drawdown) rank should be B0_LANE > SCORE_BEFORE_LANE > LANE_NEUTRAL with absolute gap ≥10pp

Conditional on up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.45 at entry, B0_LANE ruin rate should exceed LANE_NEUTRAL ruin rate by ≥15pp in the same snapshot week, confirming Lane loads tail risk specifically in low-persistence names it still accepts on slope
Sharpe-like ratio (mean / std of W4 return) should be lower for B0_LANE than LANE_NEUTRAL despite similar means, with the gap driven by kurtosis/excess tail mass not variance
policy_implications: If mechanism holds, replacing B0_LANE with LANE_NEUTRAL in fresh breakout weeks improves risk-adjusted return without sacrificing alpha; position sizing should be inversely proportional to B0_LANE share when ruin-rate proxy (up_day_ratio_20<0.5) is elevated

Lane should be re-tuned to penalize low up_day_ratio_20 more aggressively in breakout weeks (current scoring admits slope-only momentum that produces ruin tail), or paired with a hard filter before B0 allocation
SCORE_BEFORE_LANE dispersion test: if SCORE_BEFORE_LANE ruin rate matches B0_LANE ruin rate (rather than sitting between), Lane adds no risk-shift value and should be deprecated

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: Lane is a magnitude/momentum filter, not a risk-shifter: the same features (mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5) that elevate winners above rejected names also drive ruin tails, so decomposing mean and tail as independent is invalid. The 50% ruin share among B0 picks and the parallel -0.10/+0.10 mom_20 gap to false_negatives are two faces of one factor loading, not separate 'risk vs alpha' effects.

attacks.issue: Circular selection in failure_archaeology: the 8/16 (50%) B0→ruin count is conditioned on already being a ruin; the unconditional B0 ruin rate is unobserved, and the symmetric LANE_NEUTRAL false_negative 'big_winner' count is only 2/27 (7%), making Lane's apparent ruin concentration an artifact of how the labels are defined, not a genuine tail-loading signal.
attacks.why_it_matters: If LANE_NEUTRAL names in the same snapshots (entity_df5478102d, entity_bfb308b24a) also have ruin potential that is just not labeled because they weren't B0, the 'Lane loads tail risk' claim collapses to a conditioning artifact. The contrast should be unconditional ruin rates across all pickable names, not B0-conditioned archaeology.

attacks.issue: Snapshot confound dominates: most snapshots (snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_71486ed83c, snap_b8420124eb) appear across both B0 and non-B0 rows, but pairs are not contemporaneously matched by date; the 'Lane risk-loading' signal is really 'snapshot-week risk regime' because snapshots cluster ruin winners and false_negatives into separate calendar contexts.
attacks.why_it_matters: Without snapshot-week fixed effects, the predicted B0_LANE > LANE_NEUTRAL ruin gap could vanish once snapshot dummies absorb the regime. The discriminating prediction must compare B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL inside the SAME snapshot week before any risk-shift claim is licensed.

attacks.issue: up_day_ratio_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 are confound proxies for pre-entry regime, not Lane-specific tail behavior: low up_day_ratio simply tags choppy/range-bound names whose W4 distribution has lower mean AND lower variance; calling this 'tail risk' conflates absence of continuation with left-tail loading.
attacks.why_it_matters: If Lane-accepted low-up_day_ratio names have narrower W4 dispersion overall (not just fatter left tail), the Sharpe-gap prediction in the researcher's falsifiable test reverses: B0_LANE could be lower-Sharpe DESPITE similar mean precisely because mean is lower too, invalidating the 'similar mean, different tail' decomposition.

counterexamples_to_seek: Fresh breakout weeks where B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL within the same snapshot week show ruin rates within 5pp AND mean returns within 1pp, falsifying the 'risk-only' decomposition and supporting a coupled factor-loading view.

B0 picks with high mom_20 (>0.20) AND high up_day_ratio_20 (>0.65) that nevertheless become false_positive_ruin (entity_6618d3e80c is suggestive but mixed-label) — a clean ruin among 'safe-looking' Lane names would prove Lane picks load tail risk independent of feature magnitude, the core claim.
what_would_change_my_mind: A within-snapshot-week paired comparison of B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL showing ruin-rate gap ≥10pp with mean-return gap <0.5pp and equal sample sizes per cell (n≥20 each); absent snapshot-fixed-effects regression showing Lane coefficient significant only on ruin indicator and not on mean, the mechanism claim should be downgraded to UNRESOLVED.

Decomposition of W4 return dispersion into variance vs excess kurtosis components showing B0_LANE higher kurtosis but not higher variance relative to LANE_NEUTRAL — a result that would rescue the risk-only framing; current archaeology data cannot distinguish these two channels.

tests.name: within_snapshot_paired_mean_vs_ruin_decomposition
tests.comparison: Within each fresh-breakout snapshot-week, pair each B0_LANE name with the closest-by-euclidean-distance-on-features LANE_NEUTRAL name. Compute paired differences for (a) W4 mean return and (b) W4 ruin indicator (≤ -15% drawdown). Test H0a: mean difference = 0 vs H1a: |mean diff| ≤ 0.5pp with ruin diff ≥ 10pp. Use paired Wilcoxon for mean, McNemar for ruin.
tests.success_criterion: Across ≥15 snapshot-weeks with n≥10 B0_LANE pairs each: paired mean |Δ| < 0.5pp (Wilcoxon p>0.2) AND paired ruin rate Δ ≥ +10pp with McNemar p<0.05. Direction must be B0_LANE ruin ≥ LANE_NEUTRAL ruin; both must reject pure-mean and pure-tail alone.
tests.failure_criterion: If paired mean |Δ| ≥ 0.5pp OR ruin rate Δ < 10pp in same direction OR ruin Δ favors LANE_NEUTRAL, the 'risk-only-shift' framing is rejected. If ruin Δ ≥ 10pp co-occurs with mean Δ ≥ 1pp, mechanism becomes coupled-factor-loading, not risk-shift.

tests.name: feature_residualized_dispersion_decomposition
tests.comparison: Per snapshot-week, regress W4 return on the feature vector separately for B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL samples. Compare residual distributions: (i) variance ratio B0_LANE/LANE_NEUTRAL, (ii) excess kurtosis ratio. Mechanism predicts residual kurtosis ratio > 2.0 while residual variance ratio ≤ 1.3.
tests.success_criterion: Pooled across snapshot-weeks, B0_LANE excess kurtosis / LANE_NEUTRAL excess kurtosis ≥ 2.0 AND B0_LANE residual variance / LANE_NEUTRAL residual variance ∈ [0.8, 1.3]. Achieves the variance-vs-tail decomposition the skeptic flagged as untestable in archaeology data.
tests.failure_criterion: If kurtosis ratio < 1.5 OR variance ratio > 1.5, Lane is shifting overall dispersion (not isolating tail); mechanism must be relabeled as 'dispersion-shifter' rather than 'risk-shifter'.

tests.name: persistence_low_quartile_ruin_conditional
tests.comparison: Slice fresh-breakout names into up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.45 (low-persistence) cells within each snapshot-week. Compare B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL ruin rates in this cell only. Researcher claimed Lane loads tail specifically here; skeptic claimed this is regime confounding.
tests.success_criterion: Within low-up_day_ratio_20 cells, B0_LANE ruin rate - LANE_NEUTRAL ruin rate ≥ +15pp (Fisher exact p<0.05) across pooled snapshot-weeks. Proves Lane loads tail within homogeneous feature regime, not just snapshot regime.
tests.failure_criterion: If conditional ruin gap < 5pp OR reverses sign in ≥40% of snapshot-weeks with n≥5, Lane is not tail-loading beyond what feature magnitude already implies.

tests.name: magnitude_safe_ruin_search
tests.comparison: Identify B0_LANE names satisfying 'safe-magnitude' mask (mom_20 ≥ 0.20 AND up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.65 AND ma10_slope_5 ≥ 0.04) — the regime where researcher claims Lane should produce winners. Count ruin rate in this mask vs outside.
tests.success_criterion: B0_LANE safe-mask ruin rate ≤ 10pp AND B0_LANE outside-mask ruin rate ≥ 25pp with gap ≥ 15pp. Confirms Lane does NOT load tail in safe-magnitude names; risk is concentrated in slope-accepted/low-persistence subset.
tests.failure_criterion: If safe-mask ruin rate ≥ outside-mask ruin rate - 10pp, Lane's tail-loading is independent of feature magnitude — risk-shift claim collapses into factor-loading claim. Entity_6618d3e80c-style mixed-label cases should be clean-labeled here.

tests.name: post_lane_residual_vs_pre_lane_score
tests.comparison: Reconstruct SCORE_BEFORE_LANE from feature-derived composite (e.g., weighted z-score on the 9 features using discovery-set medians/stds from archaeology). Rank names within snapshot-week; top-decile becomes B0_LANE analog, median-decile becomes LANE_NEUTRAL analog. Compare mean and ruin across reconstructed slots.
tests.success_criterion: Reconstructed B0_LANE ruin rate - LANE_NEUTRAL ruin rate ≥ +10pp AND mean |Δ| < 0.5pp. If both hold, the 'risk-shift' is reproducible from feature composite alone — Lane is mechanical tail-loading given features. If gap does NOT hold, Lane adds non-feature information that changes risk profile.
tests.failure_criterion: Reconstructed B0_LANE ruin rate ≈ LANE_NEUTRAL ruin rate (gap < 5pp): Lane contributes tail-loading beyond feature composite alone. Reconstructed MA gap ≥ 1pp: pre-Lane score already separates mean, Lane is filter not shifter.

tests.name: portfolio_construction_isolation
tests.comparison: For each snapshot-week, hold pick identity constant but vary position-weighting between (a) equal-weight B0_LANE picks vs (b) inverse-ruin-probability-weighting of same picks. If Sharpe gap between equal-weight and ruin-weighted collapses, mechanism is selection not sizing; if it remains, Lane + construction both contribute.
tests.success_criterion: Equal-weight B0_LANE - Equal-weight LANE_NEUTRAL Sharpe gap ≥ +0.15 AND Inverse-ruin-weighted gap ≤ +0.05. Confirms the risk-shift is intrinsic to selection, not position-sizing artifact.
tests.failure_criterion: Sharpe gap under inverse-ruin-weighting remains ≥ +0.10: position sizing is propagating mechanism; original mean/ruin decomposition reflects construction, not Lane feature selection.

tests.name: var_ratio_tail_isolation
tests.comparison: Compute within-snapshot-week Value-at-Risk at 80% (VaR80) and 95% (VaR95) confidence for B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL return distributions. Mechanism predicts tail-specific risk: VaR95 ratio > VaR80 ratio (tail widens faster than body).
tests.success_criterion: B0_LANE VaR95 / LANE_NEUTRAL VaR95 ≥ 1.5 × (B0_LANE VaR80 / LANE_NEUTRAL VaR80). Confirms tail-specific (not uniform) dispersion increase. Aligned with ruin definition (≤-15%) which is ~95th percentile left-tail.
tests.failure_criterion: If VaR80 ratio ≈ VaR95 ratio (within 10%), Lane shifts entire dispersion proportionally — risk-shift reframes as generic vol-loading, not tail-loading. Returns UNRESOLVED on the tail-isolation question.

leakage_checks: Verify all features used are PIT-only: ibd_entry_*, px_vs_ma*, ma*_slope_*, mom_*, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, pullback_*, base_*, atr_*, rv_*, volume_ratio — none reference post-entry return, W4 outcome, or settlement date.
Snapshot identity used ONLY as fixed-effects block/grouping label for paired tests, never as predictive feature in any regression or distance computation.
Ticker/entity identity excluded from all tests; entity_anon appears only in archaeology reference, not in any test input.

Ruin indicator (≤-15% drawdown) must be computed from W4 cumulative return path that does NOT include any pre-entry data; confirm threshold definition matches archaeology 'false_positive_ruin' label rule (W4 ≤ -15% or ruin_bucket tag).
W4 mean return computed from same path as ruin indicator to ensure paired tests compare coherent distributions.
SCORE_BEFORE_LANE reconstruction must use ONLY the 9-feature composite; any attempt to include historical Lane decisions or feedback terms would leak post-Lane information.
Block bootstrap on snapshot-weeks (not observations) to preserve temporal clustering; standard errors clustered at snapshot level, not observation level, to avoid undercounting regime dependence.
Pre-specify ruin threshold (≤-15%) and mean-equivalence margin (0.5pp) BEFORE observing results; any post-hoc threshold adjustment invalidates the falsification.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: In fresh breakout weeks, Lane plausibly loads left-tail risk without proportional mean uplift, but the available archaeology cannot separate this from a coupled factor-loading story where the same magnitude features (mom_20, ma10_slope_5, px_vs_ma50) jointly drive both higher conditional mean and fatter ruin tail. The 50% B0 ruin share is conditioning-on-pick contaminated, and false_negatives vs winners diverge on the SAME feature set that Lane already loads on, making mean/tail decomposition underidentified without within-snapshot fixed-effects and dispersion (kurtosis vs variance) decomposition tests. Net: mechanism is testable and not yet refuted, but current evidence is consistent with three competing stories — pure risk-shift, coupled factor-loading, and snapshot-regime confound — at indistinguishable likelihoods.
falsifiers: Within-snapshot paired test: if paired |mean Δ| < 0.5pp AND ruin Δ ≥ +10pp with McNemar p<0.05 across ≥15 snapshot-weeks (n≥10 pairs each), pure risk-shift is supported; if ruin Δ ≥ +10pp co-occurs with mean Δ ≥ +1pp, mechanism reclassifies as coupled factor-loading.

Residual kurtosis/variance decomposition: if pooled B0_LANE excess-kurtosis / LANE_NEUTRAL excess-kurtosis ≥ 2.0 while residual-variance ratio stays in [0.8, 1.3], tail-specific loading is isolated; if kurtosis ratio < 1.5 OR variance ratio > 1.5, Lane is generic dispersion-shifter, not tail-shifter.

SCORE_BEFORE_LANE reconstruction: if reconstructed B0-equivalent ruin gap to LANE_NEUTRAL-equivalent is ≥ +10pp AND mean |Δ| < 0.5pp, risk-shift is mechanical from feature composite alone (Lane adds nothing); if reconstruction gap collapses (<5pp), Lane adds non-feature tail information.
actionable_design_principles: Any fresh-breakout B0 allocation must pair with snapshot-week fixed effects and explicit dispersion decomposition (variance vs kurtosis) before claiming risk-shift vs alpha-shift; do not act on raw ruin-rate deltas.

Treat Lane's breakout-week output as a candidate distribution, not a commitment: hard-cap position size proportional to (1 - up_day_ratio_20) in the accepted batch, and require reconstructed SCORE_BEFORE_LANE to sit strictly between B0 and LANE_NEUTRAL on ruin rate before trusting Lane as a risk overlay.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a DSL construct `lane_tail_isolated` that activates only when within-snapshot paired test yields ruin Δ ≥ +10pp AND mean |Δ| < 0.5pp AND kurtosis ratio ≥ 2.0 with variance ratio in [0.8, 1.3]; otherwise falls back to `lane_coupled_factor` (treat Lane as magnitude filter, not risk overlay).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Current Lane usage assumes risk-shift by default; this makes the regime conditional on empirical decomposition so the same policy cannot silently switch between risk-overlay and factor-loading interpretations.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Forces explicit acceptance criteria before Lane sizing is enabled, preventing silent tail-loading when Lane is actually a magnitude filter.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define `score_before_lane_baseline` that reconstructs a feature-only composite rank each snapshot and requires its ruin rate to land strictly between B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL; if ordering violates, emit a warning that Lane is non-informative for tail in that snapshot and down-weight B0 allocation by a pre-specified fraction.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Adds a falsification-aware guardrail rather than treating Lane as authoritative; converts the SCORE_BEFORE_LANE test into live policy enforcement.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Lets the system auto-detect when Lane stops contributing tail information beyond feature composite, which is the core ambiguity the skeptic raised.

cycles.question: Test the hypothesis 'Lane has independent predictive information' specifically in constructive pullback weeks. Give discriminating predictions for B0_LANE, LANE_NEUTRAL, and SCORE_BEFORE_LANE.

researcher.mechanism_claim: In constructive pullback weeks (pullback_duration_weeks 3-9, pullback_pct -5 to -25, ma10_slope_5>0, px_vs_ma20>0), Lane assignment carries limited INDEPENDENT predictive information beyond what ma10_slope_5, mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, and pullback geometry already encode. B0_LANE wins in this regime are largely a restatement of the technical constructive-pullback signature; SCORE_BEFORE_LANE should correlate tightly (>0.7) with the post-Lane composite, and LANE_NEUTRAL cases matched on those technicals should show non-trivially similar base win rates to B0_LANE.
evidence_for: Constructive-pullback false positives (e.g., entity_8f0df3d38e: B0=true, 7wk/-16.2% pullback, ma10_slope=0.054, up_day_ratio=0.65 -> false_positive_ruin; entity_55c2da490e: B0=true, 7wk/-12.3%, slopes positive -> ruin) show Lane endorses setups whose technicals look constructive yet fail, indicating Lane does not filter out the failure mode in this regime.

Constructive-pullback false negative big winners (e.g., entity_de1c657364: NOT B0, 8wk/-7.3%, ma10_slope=0.030, mom_20=0.058, up_day_ratio=0.65 -> false_negative_big_winner) demonstrate Lane rejects technically healthy pullbacks that subsequently rip, consistent with Lane adding noise rather than signal when the structural inputs already qualify.
evidence_against: Numeric contrasts show selected_winners separate from false_negatives on mom_20 (+0.10), vol_ratio_5_20 (+0.24), up_day_ratio_20 (+0.125), and px_vs_ma50 (+0.07) — directional leadership proxies that Lane *could* encode independently of raw slope/MA features, so a residual Lane effect cannot be ruled out without matched-cohort testing.

Mixed false_positive_ruin|selected_winner (entity_6618d3e80c) at high px_vs_ma50=0.337 shows Lane can resolve genuinely strong leadership even within constructive pullback context, hinting Lane may still discriminate on accumulation/relative-strength dimensions.
falsifiable_predictions: In a cohort of constructive pullback weeks matched on ma10_slope_5 quintile, mom_20 quintile, and pullback_duration_weeks bucket, the B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL hit-rate gap on W4>=8% should be <3pp (indifference); a gap >6pp would falsify the redundancy claim.
Spearman(SCORE_BEFORE_LANE, post-Lane composite) within the constructive-pullback subsample should exceed 0.70; values <0.55 would imply Lane injects substantial independent information.
policy_implications: De-weight or remove the Lane penalty/bonus specifically when the constructive-pullback gate fires (pullback 3-9wk, slopes positive, px_vs_ma20>0); let the technical composite drive ranking, which should reduce false_positive_ruin exposure (entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_55c2da490e archetypes) without losing the false_negative_big_winner cases Lane wrongly rejected (entity_de1c657364 archetype).

Reserve Lane as an override only in non-constructive regimes (deep bear pullbacks >-25%, flat/negative slopes, or post-breakout continuations) where the technical signature is ambiguous and Lane's leadership read provides the dominant signal.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The claim that Lane carries limited independent information in constructive pullback weeks is essentially unfalsifiable on the evidence presented. The 27-case failure archaeology is a conditional-on-error subset, the constructive-pullback slice inside it is probably n<=15, the proposed quintile-matching protocol has insufficient resolution to detect a 3-6pp effect, and the technical features used as 'controls' are themselves mediators/downstream readouts of the same leadership dimension Lane encodes. The prior researcher has not refuted Lane-independence; they have merely failed to measure it with a design capable of doing so.

attacks.issue: Selection-on-error sampling: the entire evidence base is a 'failure archaeology' pool — every case is pre-classified as something the system got wrong or right in an extreme way. Constructing a 'redundancy' claim from a sample where winners and ruin-cases are over-sampled relative to the natural base rate is a textbook conditional-on-outcome bias.
attacks.why_it_matters: If Lane is calibrated to suppress mid-decile setups, the failure archaeology is by construction enriched for cases at the tails of Lane's discrimination boundary. That is precisely where Lane-noise dominates — the wrong test to ask whether Lane has mean-shift information.

attacks.issue: Endogeneity / collider bias: ma10_slope_5, mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, px_vs_ma50, and pullback geometry are not exogenous covariates relative to Lane — they are partial proxies of the same underlying accumulation/leadership state that Lane is designed to read. Conditioning on them and testing Lane's residual is conditioning on mediators of Lane.
attacks.why_it_matters: If Lane = f(leadership, accumulation, RS-trend, sector-context) and the technicals are g(leadership), then the residual of Lane | technicals is not 'independent Lane information' but 'Lane information not yet captured by a subset of its inputs'. Claiming that residual must be zero is begging the question.

attacks.issue: Insufficient power / unstable standardized deltas: numeric_contrasts are computed on n=5 (false_negative) vs n=11 (selected_winner). With these sample sizes, a single case flip changes standardized_delta by ~0.3-0.4. The reported |z|>0.6 deltas are not statistically meaningful; bootstrap CIs would span zero on most features.
attacks.why_it_matters: The 'directional leadership proxies' the prior researcher concedes Lane 'could encode independently' are exactly the dimensions the noisy contrasts fail to rule out. The hedge in their evidence_against is actually the honest reading of the data.

attacks.issue: Quintile-matching is too coarse to test the discrimination claim. ma10_slope_5 spans roughly -0.005 to 0.09 in the sample; quintiles compress ~0.02-wide bands where within-bin residual variation in W4 outcomes is far larger than any plausible Lane effect (3-6pp).
attacks.why_it_matters: A 3pp hit-rate gap easily drowns in within-quintile outcome noise. The falsifiable_prediction '<3pp means indifference' would be triggered by random within-bin variation, not by true Lane-nullity. The bar is set where any reasonable test would always fail.

attacks.issue: Spearman(SCORE_BEFORE_LANE, post-Lane) >0.70 in n<30 is not a discriminative threshold — with that sample size, correlations of 0.65-0.85 arise routinely from noise, especially when both scores share many of the same input features (mom, slope, RS).
attacks.why_it_matters: This test cannot distinguish 'Lane is redundant' from 'Lane and pre-Lane composite share so many inputs that high correlation is mechanical'. The number is uninformative regardless of which side of 0.70 the data lands.

attacks.issue: Omitted-variable bias on sector and market regime: every case in the failure archaeology is associated with a snapshot id, several of which cluster (e.g., snap_71486ed83c has 6 cases; snap_d0d57b1e40 has 5). The shared-snapshot clustering means sector/market-regime effects are confounded with Lane assignment.
attacks.why_it_matters: If a single snapshot contributes both a B0 constructive-pullback pick and a not-B0 LANE_NEUTRAL pick, and the outcome gap tracks the snapshot, that is regime — not Lane. The prior analysis does not partial out snapshot-fixed-effects, which inflates any apparent Lane-noise reading.

attacks.issue: The mixed-label case entity_6618d3e80c (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner, px_vs_ma50=0.337, mom_20=0.251) is direct evidence that Lane correctly identified an extreme-leadership constructive pullback that the standard technical composite would have weighted similarly to entity_3adc078f01 (snap_ad495b6705, mom_20=0.172, large_win). Lane adds the RS-trend read the technicals miss.
attacks.why_it_matters: The prior researcher's own cited case cuts against their conclusion. They hand-wave it as 'Lane can resolve genuine strong leadership' but then conclude Lane is mostly redundant in this regime — that is internally inconsistent.

attacks.issue: The 'constructive pullback' definition itself is partly Lane-derivable: pullback_duration_weeks 3-9 and pullback_pct -5 to -25 with positive slopes and px_vs_ma20>0 is the canonical 'healthy basing' read, which is exactly what Lane is engineered to endorse. Restricting to this band and then testing Lane's independence is a circular conditioning set.
attacks.why_it_matters: The very filter that defines the regime is the type of pattern Lane is designed to confirm. Any signal Lane adds inside this band will look like restatement, by construction.

counterexamples_to_seek: Constructive pullback weeks where ma10_slope_5, mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, pullback_duration_weeks, and pullback_pct are matched to <0.005 / <0.01 / <0.05 / <1wk / <1pp tolerance between B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL cases — does W4-return distribution still overlap, or does Lane split them? This is the only design that can answer the question.

Constructive pullbacks with px_vs_ma50 in the top decile (>0.20) where Lane is the differentiator between entity_6618d3e80c-style extreme-RS and entity_3adc078f01-style moderate-RS cases — does Lane separate them on forward W4 in a held-out window?

Constructive pullbacks split by pullback_duration_weeks: 3-5wk shallow vs 7-9wk deep — does Lane's information content differ between shallow-base and deep-base subregimes? (The shallow-base Lane calls may be noisier than the deep-base Lane calls, which would actually argue for keeping Lane precisely where the prior researcher says to remove it.)

Constructive pullbacks conditioned on up_day_ratio_20 above 0.60 — does Lane still separate winners from ruins, or do all high-up-day-ratio constructive pullbacks perform similarly regardless of Lane? If similarly, the prior claim strengthens; if not, Lane is independently informative.

Constructive pullbacks in which the technical composite scores identically across B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL but the entity has different IBD-style RS-trend trajectory (3-month RS slope) — does Lane's match to RS-trend predict the W4 outcome better than the technical composite alone?

Cross-snapshot replication: take the snap_71486ed83c cluster (6 cases), hold it out, and re-derive the W4 separation. If the pattern is snapshot-specific, the 'Lane is noise' reading is actually a 'regime is noise' reading.
what_would_change_my_mind: A matched-cohort test with n>=100 constructive-pullback cases where B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL are matched within tolerance bands of <0.01 on ma10_slope_5, <0.03 on mom_20, <0.05 on up_day_ratio_20, <1wk on pullback_duration, <3pp on pullback_pct — and a Cox/Hazard model with Lane as the only remaining predictor shows hazard-ratio p-value >0.4 in a held-out fold. Anything weaker than this is consistent with my prior that the current evidence is inconclusive.

A principal-component / factor-loading analysis where Lane collapses onto the first PC of (mom_20, mom_60, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, up_day_ratio_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, RS-trend) at loading >0.75 AND the residual after projection is orthogonal to W4-return — both conditions must hold for the redundancy claim to be defensible.

A pre-registered A/B backtest in constructive-pullback weeks showing that the policy 'ignore Lane when constructive-pullback gate fires' improves Sharpe/Sharpe-ratio-of-returns net of slippage by >0.05 over 'keep Lane' on out-of-sample folds, with the gain surviving bootstrap CIs. Backtest-only claims without the matched-cohort step are not sufficient.

A demonstration that within the constructive-pullback subset, the cases Lane rejects (LANE_NEUTRAL or no-B0) have identical forward W4 distributions to the cases Lane accepts, after controlling for pullback_duration_weeks AND base_depth_pct AND dist_to_52w_high_pct simultaneously — not just the four features the prior researcher listed.
Until any of the above is produced, the honest verdict is UNRESOLVED, not 'Lane is redundant in constructive pullbacks'.

tests.name: Within-snapshot tight-matched cohort W4 separation
tests.comparison: Constructive-pullback cases split by B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL, matched within the same snapshot_id on tight tolerances (ma10_slope_5 |delta|<0.01, mom_20 |delta|<0.03, up_day_ratio_20 |delta|<0.05, pullback_duration_weeks |delta|<1wk, pullback_pct |delta|<3pp). Compare within-pair W4 return distribution using Wilcoxon signed-rank on paired differences and hit-rate gap on W4>=8%.
tests.success_criterion: Median paired W4 gap |delta| <1.5pp AND hit-rate gap <3pp with sign-rank p>0.4 across n>=10 pairs (Lane redundant within snapshot-controlled matched cohort).
tests.failure_criterion: Hit-rate gap >6pp with sign-rank p<0.10 on n>=10 pairs (Lane carries snapshot-controlled independent information).

tests.name: SCORE_BEFORE_LANE dominance vs PC1-orthogonal Lane residual
tests.comparison: Compute first principal component of the seven technical/momentum features, project Lane assignment onto PC1, derive Lane residual (Lane | PC1-orthogonal). Test Spearman(SCORE_BEFORE_LANE, W4_bucket) against partial Spearman(Lane_residual, W4_bucket | SCORE_BEFORE_LANE) within constructive-pullback subsample. Restricted to within-snapshot variation to strip regime.
tests.success_criterion: rho(SCORE_BEFORE_LANE, W4) > 0.55 AND partial rho(Lane_residual | SCORE_BEFORE_LANE) < 0.20 (Lane information is restatement, pre-Lane composite dominates).
tests.failure_criterion: partial rho(Lane_residual | SCORE_BEFORE_LANE) > 0.40 with bootstrap CI excluding zero (Lane residual carries independent orthogonal signal).

tests.name: Sub-regime interaction: shallow-base (3-5wk) vs deep-base (7-9wk) Lane effect
tests.comparison: Within constructive pullback, bin by pullback_duration_weeks into shallow (3-5) vs deep (7-9). Stratify B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL W4 hit-rate within each bin and test for interaction via Breslow-Day / logistic interaction term (Lane x base_depth_bin).
tests.success_criterion: Lane effect homogeneous across bins: |hit-rate gap shallow - hit-rate gap deep| < 3pp and interaction p>0.3 (Lane uniformly redundant).
tests.failure_criterion: Lane effect concentrated in one bin with |gap| > 8pp and interaction p<0.10 (Lane informative in a sub-regime the prior researcher would have flagged for removal).

leakage_checks: Confirm every B0_LANE / LANE_NEUTRAL / SCORE_BEFORE_LANE value is computed strictly from features observable at or before the constructive-pullback snapshot timestamp, with no peeking at post-pullback W4 data in construction of the Lane label.

Verify tight-tolerance matching never crosses snapshot_id boundaries and excludes pairs where pullback_pct or pullback_duration_weeks is null (non-pullback regime contamination), since those rows are not in the constructive-pullback scope by definition.

Confirm SCORE_BEFORE_LANE is computed without Lane inputs in its formula; re-derive from base feature set and check Spearman against the supplied value >0.95 before treating it as an exogenous pre-Lane composite.
priority_order: SCORE_BEFORE_LANE dominance vs PC1-orthogonal Lane residual
Sub-regime interaction: shallow-base (3-5wk) vs deep-base (7-9wk) Lane effect

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The question of whether Lane carries independent predictive information in constructive pullback weeks cannot be settled on the available evidence. The failure-archaeology pool (n=27) is conditional-on-outcome sampled, leaving an estimated n=10-15 cases inside the constructive-pullback subset where Lane and the technical composite actually disagree — well below the threshold for either confirming redundancy or detecting a 3-6pp Lane effect. The Researcher's directional reading leans toward 'Lane mostly restates the technical constructive-pullback signature' (entity_8f0df3d38e and entity_55c2da490e ruin cases with positive techs, entity_de1c657364 big-win with Lane rejection) is internally offset by entity_6618d3e80c (extreme-RS constructive pullback where Lane correctly endorsed a large winner that the pure technical composite would have weighted similarly to a moderate-RS peer). The Skeptic's methodological critiques — mediators-as-controls, circular regime definition, snapshot-clustering confound, insufficient power — are not addressable by re-arguing the existing cases; they require an exogenous-regime, properly matched-cohort, sufficient-n study that has not been run. Adding two new layers beyond the prior outputs: (a) counterfactual analysis from the displayed features suggests SCORE_BEFORE_LANE would have called entity_8f0df3d38e and entity_55c2da490e the same way as Lane (so Lane is not adding error — it is adding nothing to a techs-only call already headed the wrong way), while on entity_de1c657364 and entity_6618d3e80c the technicals and Lane disagree, meaning Lane is doing genuinely different work but in opposite directions on the two cases — net information content is ambiguous. (b) Even if Lane is mean-redundant in constructive pullbacks, it may be variance-active (tail-risk filter or tail-risk amplifier) — the W4-return distribution question is not settled by hit-rate alone. Net: UNRESOLVED with a slight lean toward CONTEXT_DEPENDENT (Lane informative on the extreme-RS tail, redundant on the middle).
falsifiers: Pre-registered A/B backtest on constructive-pullback weeks (exogenously defined by raw price geometry alone, without any RS-trend or accumulation readout in the gate) comparing SCORE_BEFORE_LANE-only ranking vs Lane-augmented ranking shows Sharpe/return differential <0.03 with bootstrap CI excluding zero — would support the redundancy reading.

Within the constructive-pullback subset, residual of Lane | PC1 of (ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, mom_20, mom_60, up_day_ratio_20, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, RS-trend-slope-3mo) shows Spearman correlation with W4-bucket below 0.15 AND factor loading of Lane on PC1 above 0.75 on n>=80 cases — would support redundancy.

In a held-out matched cohort (n>=100 pairs at <0.01 slope, <0.03 mom, <0.05 up-day-ratio, <1wk pullback-duration, <3pp pullback-pct tolerance) where Lane and SCORE_BEFORE_LANE are forced to disagree, Lane's directional accuracy on W4>=8% is within +/-2pp of 50% — would falsify any independent-information claim.

If entity_6618d3e80c-style cases (px_vs_ma50 > 0.20 with constructive pullback) show Lane separation on W4 above what SCORE_BEFORE_LANE recovers, AND entity_de1c657364-style cases (moderate-RS constructive pullback Lane-rejected) show no statistically distinguishable W4 from matched Lane-endorsed peers — then Lane is informative specifically on the extreme-RS tail and CONTEXT_DEPENDENT is the right verdict, not UNRESOLVED.

If the constructive-pullback definition is purged of any feature that overlaps with Lane's input set (e.g., redefine pullback solely by raw high-low geometry and duration, excluding slope/up-day/RS) and the resulting subset shows identical mean W4 between B0_LANE and LANE_NEUTRAL under matched controls — that would close the circularity gap and tilt the verdict toward REFUTED (Lane redundant by definition in this regime).

If snapshot-fixed-effects partial regression shows the Lane-W4 association collapses to zero once snap_id is included as a fixed effect (i.e., the apparent Lane signal is mostly snapshot/regime noise), the prior lean toward CONTEXT_DEPENDENT is upgraded to UNRESOLVED or REFUTED.
actionable_design_principles: Define 'constructive pullback' exogenously by raw price geometry (duration weeks, peak-to-trough depth, base structure) without including any feature that overlaps with Lane's leadership/accumulation inputs; otherwise the test is circular by construction.

Require matched-cohort designs with n>=100 within-snapshot tight-tolerance pairs before drawing directional conclusions; n<=20 case studies support hypothesis generation only, never verdict formation.

Always partial out snapshot_id as a fixed effect (or use within-snapshot differencing only) when testing Lane effects, because snapshot-clustering is a documented confound in this dataset (snap_71486ed83c has 6 cases, snap_d0d57b1e40 has 5).

Disaggregate 'Lane has mean effect on W4' from 'Lane has tail-risk effect on W4 distribution' — variance and hit-rate are different policy levers and the constructive-pullback evidence here is consistent with Lane being variance-active but mean-redundant.

Report bootstrap confidence intervals on any directional claim derived from this 27-case failure archaeology; the standardized_deltas shown are unstable to single-case flips and do not warrant point estimates.
Treat the constructive-pullback regime as a hypothesis-testing laboratory, not a deployment policy, until the A/B backtest with exogenous regime definition is run.

Track the disagreement cases (where Lane and tech composite split) separately from the agreement cases (where Lane and tech composite agree) — the latter cannot inform the redundancy question at all, since they are tautologically identical predictions.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Constructive-pullback Lane-soft-override: require B0_LANE endorsement OR SCORE_BEFORE_LANE percentile > 70th, but never both gates together. Within the constructive-pullback regime, Lane acts as a confirmation check, not an additional filter — a Lane rejection does not disqualify a candidate that the pre-Lane composite already rates highly.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Differs from the Researcher's 'de-weight Lane' recommendation by keeping Lane as a confirmation (not a veto) — preserves entity_6618d3e80c-style extreme-RS cases Lane correctly catches while preventing entity_de1c657364-style false negatives from being filtered out on Lane-rejection alone. Goes beyond the Experimental Designer's three tests by translating the redundancy hypothesis into a concrete composite rule.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: All features are pre-decision observable; rule is computable inside the constructive-pullback gate with no additional lookups. Treats Lane as one of two corroborating votes rather than a primary discriminator.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Two-stage constructive-pullback router: Stage 1 = raw price-geometry constructive-pullback gate (duration 3-9wk, depth -5 to -25%, base structure present, no RS-trend input). Stage 2 = within-gate ranking by SCORE_BEFORE_LANE, with Lane used only as a tail-moderation multiplier on the top and bottom deciles (extreme-RS cases) and zero weight on the middle 80%.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Directly implements the variance-vs-mean distinction surfaced in the synthesis: Lane gets credit where it plausibly helps (extreme-RS tail where entity_6618d3e80c lived) and gets neutralized where it is plausibly noise (the middle 80% where entity_8f0df3d38e and entity_55c2da490e lived). Avoids the Researcher's blanket 'de-weight Lane' by retaining Lane specifically where the data shows it discriminating, and avoids the Skeptic's 'Lane is just a mediator' by treating Lane as a separate signal at the extremes.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Requires computing px_vs_ma50 decile and a SCORE_BEFORE_LANE percentile, both available from the standard feature pipeline. Lane's role shrinks to a tail-only modifier rather than a global multiplier.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Snapshot-deconfounded constructive-pullback Lane audit: every constructive-pullback week is logged with snap_id, and Lane's W4 association is reported within-snapshot only (paired B0 vs not-B0 cases that share the same snapshot). Lane is left untouched in deployment, but the audit output feeds a quarterly review of whether the within-snapshot mean W4 gap exceeds 3pp — if not, Lane's weight in the constructive-pullback regime is automatically trimmed; if yes, kept.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the Skeptic's snapshot-clustering critique as an ongoing monitor rather than a one-time study. Avoids the 'deploy a major policy change on inconclusive evidence' risk by gating any Lane-weight adjustment on observed within-snapshot discrimination that actually crosses a measurable bar. Distinct from the Researcher's static 'remove Lane in constructive pullback' recommendation by making the policy adaptive to accumulating evidence.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Requires storing snap_id and a quarterly within-snapshot W4-gap statistic. No real-time feature engineering change; only a meta-policy layer above the existing Lane integration. Low risk because it does not change the deployed Lane weight until evidence accumulates.

cycles.question: Test the hypothesis 'Lane is only a proxy for freshness/geometry/volume' specifically in constructive pullback weeks. Give discriminating predictions for B0_LANE, LANE_NEUTRAL, and SCORE_BEFORE_LANE.

researcher.mechanism_claim: Lane is NOT a pure proxy for freshness/geometry/volume in constructive pullback weeks. It captures an orthogonal micro-structure quality signal (supply absorption / constructive pullback character: higher lows, contracting volume-on-downs, slope coherence) that survives controlling for pullback depth, pullback duration, momentum (mom_20), vol_ratio_5_20, and MA-slope features. The proxy hypothesis is falsified by the fact that matched-geometry pullback cases (e.g., -16% to -25% depth, 6-7 week duration) split cleanly into B0 winners vs B0 false_positive_ruin based on Lane, and that shallow-pullback B0 winners (entity_440e297253 at -1.5%/3w, entity_8ad5cd4795 at -6.7%/5w) succeed despite 'unconstructive' raw geometry.
evidence_for: numeric_contrasts show false_negatives systematically score LOWER on up_day_ratio_20 (-0.125), vol_ratio_5_20 (-0.245), mom_20 (-0.105), px_vs_ma50 (-0.071), ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, and pullback_pct (+8.6pp less deep) vs selected_winners — i.e., Lane's apparent lift is concentrated where these features are simultaneously constructive, but the joint distribution matters, not any single proxy

Constructive pullback subset (entities with pullback_pct and pullback_duration_weeks non-null): entity_2c58cebc59 (B0 winner, -25.1%/6w, mom_20=0.32) and entity_3adc078f01 (B0 winner, -42.3%/9w) show that DEEP, LONG pullbacks WITH constructive Lane outperform, while entity_8f0df3d38e (B0 ruin, -16.2%/7w, mom_20=0.18, up_day_ratio_20=0.65) fails despite non-trivial pullback — Lane separates these
Shallow-pullback B0 winners exist (entity_440e297253 -1.5%/3w, entity_8ad5cd4795 -6.7%/5w) proving Lane is NOT a hard threshold on pullback_depth; a pure geometry proxy would suppress these

B0 false_positive_ruin entity_3472243e0c has high mom_20=0.24 and steep slopes (ma10=0.030, ma20=0.027) yet ruins — geometry/freshness favorable, Lane must be negative; supports Lane carrying independent information

False positives cluster at low up_day_ratio_20 (entity_40ea0cfb3b: 0.5, entity_84824e6a20: 0.4, entity_b6bcccdf6a: 0.4) even when mom_20 is decent — Lane must encode the up-day character that simple momentum misses
evidence_against: All numeric_contrasts features ARE correlated with Lane-positive outcomes: pullback depth, duration, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, MA slopes all move together, so a substantial portion of Lane's lift IS explainable by these proxies
Snapshot-level clustering (multiple cases sharing snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40) means some Lane-vs-outcome association may be regime-driven rather than mechanism-driven

entity_6618d3e80c has the strongest constructive profile in the table (px_vs_ma50=0.337, mom_20=0.25, ma10_slope_5=0.075) but outcome is mixed 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner' — strong Lane does not guarantee win, weakening Lane-as-independent-mechanism claim

Pullback-duration contrast (FN median 4.0w vs winner 5.5w, std_delta=-0.728) and pullback-depth contrast (std_delta=0.640) are large enough that geometry alone could account for substantial Lane alpha
falsifiable_predictions: Within matched quintile buckets of (pullback_pct × pullback_duration_weeks × mom_20) in constructive pullback weeks, B0_LANE winner rate should exceed LANE_NEUTRAL winner rate by >8pp (W4 large_win rate); pure proxy predicts <2pp spread

Conditional on identical pullback geometry (depth within ±2pp, duration within ±1w), B0_LANE W4 mean return should exceed SCORE_BEFORE_LANE W4 mean return by >1.5pp; if Lane is pure proxy, the spread should be <0.5pp

In constructive pullback weeks, the partial correlation of B0_LANE with W4 return should remain significant (|t|>2) after regressing on pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, up_day_ratio_20 simultaneously; pure proxy predicts |t|<1

LANE_NEUTRAL should underperform SCORE_BEFORE_LANE in matched-geometry constructive pullback buckets by >0.5pp W4 — i.e., removing Lane degrades even the neutral bucket, confirming Lane carries info orthogonal to raw score
Decile spread test: B0_LANE top-decile vs bottom-decile W4 return spread should exceed 4pp within matched pullback geometry; pure proxy predicts <2pp

If Lane IS a pure proxy, then a model with (pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, slopes, MA-distance) alone should achieve ≥95% of B0_LANE's W4 IC in constructive pullback weeks; if independent, the full Lane model should retain >10% incremental IC
policy_implications: Do NOT strip Lane in constructive pullback weeks even if cross-sectional correlation with geometry is high; the orthogonal micro-structure component is the alpha source, not the proxy correlation
Increase B0_LANE position sizing in deep-constructive-pullback contexts (pullback_pct < -15%, duration 5-9w) where the proxy features and the Lane signal align constructively

Reduce or skip B0 in shallow-pullback LANE_NEUTRAL contexts where geometry proxies are weak and Lane offers no independent lift — these are the entity_ad2bfdee3f / entity_05b4c6b1f7 false_negative_relative regime where the score misses genuine winners

Treat SCORE_BEFORE_LANE as a fallback when Lane is unavailable, but expect ~1-2pp W4 IC degradation specifically in matched constructive pullback buckets — quantify this degradation before deploying without Lane

Monitor regime where geometry proxies are strong but Lane is negative (e.g., entity_3472243e0c archetype: high mom_20, steep slopes, but ruin) — these are the cases where the proxy hypothesis would over-weight and Lane-corrected model should under-weight

If the discriminating predictions fail (Lane adds nothing beyond proxies in constructive pullback weeks), then Lane should be retired and replaced by the proxy composite; current evidence tilts against retirement but is not conclusive

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: Lane is a labeled composite of (pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, and MA-slope/MA-distance features) constructed precisely by the rules that define a 'constructive pullback.' It carries no information orthogonal to those proxies. The apparent Lane-vs-outcome association is a definitional tautology (Lane-positive means 'looks constructive on multiple proxies'), compounded by small-sample snapshot pseudo-replication and survivorship into the very subset where the proxies are already strong.

attacks.issue: Definitional circularity: 'constructive pullback weeks' is itself the joint region where pullback geometry, momentum, MA slopes, and up-day character are simultaneously favorable. Conditioning on this subset by construction removes the very variation needed to test Lane's incremental value, and Lane can be redefined as any monotone function of the proxy composite without changing the conditioning sample.
attacks.why_it_matters: Every 'evidence_for' case the researcher cites (entity_2c58cebc59, entity_3adc078f01, entity_440e297253, entity_8ad5cd4795) lives inside the constructive-pullback subset. The 'Lane separates winners from ruin' claim is indistinguishable from 'being in the constructive subset separates winners from ruin.' The orthogonal-mechanism claim is not testable within the conditional sample.

attacks.issue: Severe multicollinearity across the proxy basket makes any partial-correlation test of Lane uninterpretable. The numeric_contrasts show FN-vs-winner deltas simultaneously large for up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19σ), vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05σ), mom_20 (-1.00σ), px_vs_ma50 (-0.85σ), pullback_duration_weeks (-0.73σ), ma10_slope_5 (-0.68σ), pullback_pct (+0.64σ), and px_vs_ma20 (-0.58σ). Eight features with |std_delta|>0.5 against 27 observations guarantees a near-singular design matrix.
attacks.why_it_matters: With this collinearity, t-statistics on any single feature are wildly unstable; sign and significance of Lane's coefficient will flip depending on which 2-3 proxies are included. A |t|>2 partial correlation result is uninformative and a |t|<1 result is equally uninformative — both can be produced by trivial model perturbations. The proposed falsification test is degenerate.

attacks.issue: Snapshot pseudo-replication: snap_71486ed83c contributes ≥4 cases, snap_d0d57b1e40 contributes ≥5 cases, snap_b8420124eb contributes ≥3 cases, snap_287267e812 / snap_01d3e2483b / snap_39b6f2c49e each contribute ≥2. These are the same market weeks, not independent observations. Within-snapshot correlations between Lane and outcome are dominated by contemporaneous regime (sector rotation, index breadth, VIX), inflating any apparent Lane signal.
attacks.why_it_matters: Effective independent N for the constructive-pullback subset is closer to 8-12 snapshots than 27 cases. None of the researcher's predictions (8pp spread, |t|>2, 1.5pp IC lift) is powered for this N. Conversely, the test also cannot falsify the null because confidence intervals will be too wide to reject anything.

attacks.issue: Reverse causation / label leakage: Lane is plausibly assigned by a rule that reads the same pullback/momentum/slope features the proxies capture. 'Lane-positive' is operationally 'the constructive proxy composite crossed a threshold.' The architecture labels, it does not measure.
attacks.why_it_matters: If Lane = f(proxy features) by construction, then claiming 'Lane is not a pure proxy' is claiming 'the composite is not the composite,' which is a definitional error rather than an empirical finding. The mechanism question should be reframed: does adding Lane's nonlinear transform of the proxies improve out-of-sample IC over a linear composite of the same proxies?

attacks.issue: The researcher lists 'false positives cluster at low up_day_ratio_20 (entity_40ea0cfb3b: 0.5, entity_84824e6a20: 0.4, entity_b6bcccdf6a: 0.4)' as evidence Lane encodes up-day character independently — but up_day_ratio_20 IS one of the proxy features. A pattern that B0 picks ruin when up_day_ratio_20 is low is exactly what a proxy hypothesis predicts, not what refutes it.
attacks.why_it_matters: The researcher is treating a proxy feature (up_day_ratio_20) as if its failure mode supports an orthogonal Lane mechanism. This is a labeling error: the evidence is consistent with — indeed, predicted by — the pure proxy claim.

attacks.issue: The shallow-pullback B0 winners (entity_440e297253 -1.5%/3w, entity_8ad5cd4795 -6.7%/5w) are NOT counterexamples to the proxy hypothesis. Shallow pullbacks in uptrends are continuation patterns; any momentum/MA-slope composite would naturally select them. The researcher's claim that 'a pure geometry proxy would suppress these' assumes a geometry proxy that suppresses momentum — which is not what the proxy basket contains.
attacks.why_it_matters: Straw-manning the proxy alternative. The realistic proxy composite (mom_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 + MA slopes + up_day_ratio_20) would select exactly these shallow-pullback winners because their mom_20 (0.058, 0.004), MA slopes, and up_day_ratio_20 (0.5, 0.7) are favorable. The shallow winners are predicted by the proxy hypothesis, not evidence against it.

attacks.issue: entity_6618d3e80c has the strongest constructive profile in the entire table (px_vs_ma50=0.337, mom_20=0.251, ma10_slope_5=0.075, vol_ratio_5_20=1.45) yet outcomes are mixed 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner.' The strongest proxy composite produces ambiguous results — which the researcher correctly notes weakens the Lane-as-mechanism claim, but does NOT strengthen the proxy-alternative analysis either.
attacks.why_it_matters: Both mechanistic and proxy hypotheses are inconsistent with this case. The honest reading is that this snapshot/regime contains confounding (sector collapse, idiosyncratic event) that neither Lane nor the proxies capture. The case argues against both claims, not for Lane's independence.

attacks.issue: Predicted effect sizes (8pp winner-rate spread, 1.5pp W4 mean return, |t|>2) are unreasonably large for an orthogonal micro-structure signal once proxy controls are added. A genuine orthogonal signal of small magnitude would survive in single-digit bps, not hundreds of bps. Demanding such large spreads is either unrealistic (falsifying the hypothesis too easily) or indicates the researcher is conflating proxy co-movement with Lane's true marginal contribution.
attacks.why_it_matters: The chosen prediction magnitudes look calibrated to the observed raw Lane-vs-outcome spread, which is itself inflated by the proxy co-movement. Asking the conditional-on-proxies spread to match the unconditional spread is asking Lane to be as strong as itself + proxies, which is impossible.

counterexamples_to_seek: A B0_LANE winner with mom_20<0, vol_ratio_5_20<1, ma10_slope_5<0, AND pullback_pct>-5% — would show Lane capturing information orthogonal to the entire proxy basket (none such exist in the supplied table; closest is entity_2f86543bf6 with mom_20=-0.008 and a 'selected_winner' label, but vol_ratio is high and slope is mildly negative).

A LANE_NEUTRAL case in a deep constructive pullback (pullback_pct<-20%, duration 6-9w, mom_20>0.20) that wins W4 large — would show Lane is suppressing genuine winners and is therefore net harmful, refuting informativeness. None are visible in the supplied 27 cases.

A false_positive_ruin with low pullback_pct, short duration, low mom_20, low up_day_ratio_20 — but POSITIVE Lane. Would show Lane actively harms versus the proxy composite. entity_3472243e0c and entity_55c2da490e are the closest but Lane status is unknown from the supplied fields.

Within-snapshot comparisons: for snap_71486ed83c and snap_d0d57b1e40 (the densest snapshots), do B0 winners and B0 false_positive_ruin cases have similar pullback/momentum profiles? If yes, snapshot regime dominates Lane. If no, Lane could be informative within regime.

Snapshot-level fixed effects: after adding snapshot dummies to a regression of outcome on (pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, slopes, Lane), does Lane's coefficient retain significance? With ~10 snapshots, this is feasible but underpowered.
what_would_change_my_mind: Out-of-sample (validation-set) evidence that Lane W4 IC exceeds a linear composite of (pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, up_day_ratio_20) by ≥0.02 in constructive pullback weeks, with bootstrap CIs excluding 0. Until this is shown, the within-discovery comparison is unfalsifiable.

Discovery of a non-trivial case where Lane is positive and ALL proxies are negative (or vice versa) with the Lane-aligned outcome being correct. The current 27-case table has zero such examples; every Lane-positive case sits on a stack of favorable proxies.

Within-snapshot matched-geometry pairs (same pullback_pct ±2pp, same pullback_duration ±1w, same mom_20 ±0.05, same vol_ratio_5_20 ±0.2) where one is B0 winner and the other is B0 false_positive_ruin or false_negative_relative, with the split cleanly predicted by Lane. With snapshot clustering and only 27 cases, such pairs may not exist; their absence is informative.

A blinded Lane ablation study: replace Lane with a synthetic variable that is a deterministic monotone function of the proxy basket (e.g., percentile rank of the proxy composite). If 'Lane' performance matches synthetic-proxy performance within noise, Lane is the proxy composite by another name.

Reframing the question entirely: drop Lane, build a proxy-composite-only model, and test whether its misclassifications are in the SAME cases Lane would have misclassified. If yes (high concordance of errors), Lane and the composite are the same signal under different names — the proxy hypothesis stands.

tests.name: proxy_reconstruction_audit
tests.comparison: 5-fold CV (clustered by snapshot_anon, ridge-regularized logistic regression) predicting B0_LANE vs LANE_NEUTRAL vs SCORE_BEFORE_LANE 3-slot label from the 9-feature proxy basket. Baseline = synthetic-Lane = deterministic percentile-rank of the proxy composite. Report macro-AUC and per-slot one-vs-rest AUC.
tests.success_criterion: Macro-AUC >= 0.92 AND synthetic-Lane macro-AUC within +/-0.03 of real-Lane macro-AUC (Lane is a relabeling of the proxy composite; proxy hypothesis stands)
tests.failure_criterion: Macro-AUC < 0.78 OR synthetic-Lane macro-AUC exceeds real-Lane macro-AUC by >=0.05 (Lane carries information not in the proxies; orthogonal-mechanism claim survives)

tests.name: matched_proxy_decile_lane_entropy
tests.comparison: Bin cases into deciles of the standardized proxy composite. Within each decile compute Shannon entropy (nats, base e) of the 3-slot label distribution. Report mean within-decile entropy and the share of top-decile cases assigned to LANE_NEUTRAL or SCORE_BEFORE_LANE.
tests.success_criterion: Mean within-decile entropy <= 0.30 nats AND top-decile Lane-misassignment rate <= 5% (proxy hypothesis confirmed: Lane slot is monotone in proxy composite)
tests.failure_criterion: Mean within-decile entropy >= 0.80 nats OR top-decile Lane-misassignment rate >= 15% (Lane slot is not a deterministic function of proxies within matched geometry)

leakage_checks: Cluster every CV split and decile bin by snapshot_anon so that pseudo-replicated market-week observations cannot leak across folds; effective N ~10-12 snapshots, not 27 cases
Refit the reconstruction audit with snapshot fixed effects absorbed; confirm AUC change is <0.04 so the result is not regime-clustering artifact

Reverse-causality audit: verify none of the 9 proxy features is itself an explicit input to the Lane-assignment rule by checking that removing any single proxy degrades macro-AUC by <0.08 (if one feature dominates, Lane is that feature by another name)

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The hypothesis 'Lane is only a proxy for freshness/geometry/volume in constructive pullback weeks' cannot be cleanly accepted or rejected on the supplied evidence. Three structural problems prevent resolution: (a) definitional circularity — 'constructive pullback weeks' is operationally defined by the same pullback/momentum/slope/up-day features the proxy basket contains, so conditioning on this subset by construction removes the orthogonal-variation needed to test the claim; (b) severe collinearity across 8+ proxy features with |std_delta|>0.5 against only ~27 cases (effective independent N ≈ 8-12 after snapshot de-duplication of snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_b8420124eb), making partial-correlation t-values and per-feature coefficients numerically uninterpretable; (c) no clean counterexample exists in the table — every cited B0 winner sits on a stack of favorable proxies, and every cited false_positive_ruin shows at least one weak proxy (entity_3472243e0c weak up_day_ratio_20, entity_b6bcccdf6a weak up_day_ratio_20, entity_40ea0cfb3b weak slopes and low up_day_ratio_20). The proxy hypothesis is the more parsimonious explanation and is consistent with all supplied cases, but a residual orthogonal Lane component of small magnitude (e.g., 0.5-1.5pp W4 IC) cannot be ruled out at this sample size. The Researcher's 'shallow-pullback winners' (entity_440e297253, entity_8ad5cd4795) are predicted by a momentum+slope composite, not refutations of the proxy claim; the Researcher's 'false positives at low up_day_ratio_20' argument is itself circular because up_day_ratio_20 IS in the proxy basket. The honest reading is that Lane is plausibly a labeled/thresholded version of the proxy composite, with the orthogonal-mechanism claim remaining an open empirical question that requires out-of-sample ablation with snapshot-clustered CV and a synthetic-Lane baseline.
falsifiers: Out-of-sample (held-out snapshot cluster, ≥10 independent market weeks) macro-AUC of a proxy-only model (logistic regression over pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks, mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, up_day_ratio_20) reaches within 0.02 of the B0 full model (Lane + proxies) — falsifies Lane as orthogonal mechanism.

Synthetic-Lane ablation: a deterministic monotone transform of the proxy composite (e.g., percentile rank of standardized proxies) reproduces Lane's slot assignments with ≥95% agreement and matches its W4 IC within bootstrap CI — falsifies Lane as carrying information beyond proxies.

Discovery of even one case where B0_LANE is positive while ≥7 of 9 proxies are negative and W4 outcome is large_win (or the symmetric: B0_LANE negative with ≥7 of 9 proxies positive and W4 outcome is ruin) — would prove Lane captures information orthogonal to the basket.

Decile entropy test within constructive-pullback subset: mean Shannon entropy of {B0_LANE, LANE_NEUTRAL, SCORE_BEFORE_LANE} assignments across deciles of the proxy composite exceeds 0.80 nats — falsifies Lane-as-monotone-proxy.

Snapshot fixed-effects regression: after absorbing snapshot_anon dummies and the 9 proxy features, Lane's coefficient on W4 return has |t|<1 with coefficient magnitude <0.3pp — falsifies residual Lane signal after regime and proxy control.

Reverse-causality audit reveals that removing any single proxy feature from the proxy basket degrades Lane reconstruction AUC by ≥0.08 — confirms Lane is that single feature under another name (definitional proxy).
actionable_design_principles: Treat Lane as a possibly-redundant labeled composite of proxies until out-of-sample, snapshot-clustered ablation evidence proves otherwise; default to parsimony (proxy-only model) when Lane and proxy-composite agree.

Any future Lane-vs-proxy test MUST cluster CV folds by snapshot_anon to avoid regime-leakage inflation; effective sample size after de-duplication is ~8-12, so plan power calculations accordingly (do not demand >2pp IC spreads).

Adopt the synthetic-Lane baseline as a standard validation step: build a deterministic monotone transform of the proxy composite, compare its W4 IC to real Lane's W4 IC in constructive-pullback buckets; differences <bootstrap-CI-half-width are uninformative and Lane should be flagged for retirement review.

Pre-register the disagreement set: cases where B0_LANE slot and proxy-composite decile disagree by ≥3 deciles. These are the only cases that carry discriminative information; analyze them separately from the agreement set.

Track Lane-marginal-contribution (delta-IC = IC_full − IC_proxyonly) by regime (constructive-pullback vs not, deep-pullback vs shallow, high-vol vs low-vol). Honest reporting requires regime-stratified marginal contribution, not unconditional Lane-vs-no-Lane spread.

If Lane-marginal-contribution is <1pp W4 IC in the constructive-pullback regime after snapshot-clustered validation, retire Lane as a separate feature and replace with the proxy composite; the labeling overhead is not justified.
