The labels (false_negative_relative, false_positive_ruin, etc.) were generated on the same 27 cases used to derive the regime. There is no out-of-sample evidence that the 1.5–2.5 band generalizes. The falsifiable_predictions the prior role lists are forward tests on a snapshot that has not been run.
attacks.why_it_matters: All regime boundaries cited (1.3, 1.5, 2.5, 3.0) are in-sample estimates with no confidence intervals. Acting on them as policy without forward validation is data dredging.

counterexamples_to_seek: A B0-eligible candidate from a DIFFERENT date cluster than snap_71486ed83c / snap_d0d57b1e40 with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [1.5, 2.5], pullback fields NULL, that ends in ruin — would show the regime fails outside snapshot-71486ed83c.

A B0-eligible candidate with pullback_v_is_dry=True (i.e., non-NULL pullback fields), pullback_pct < -25%, pullback_duration_weeks ≥ 6, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 2.5, that is a large winner — entity_2c58cebc59 and entity_3adc078f01 approximate this; need to confirm the regime's upper bound does not flag them as 'late momentum chase' when they were structurally sound.

A B0-eligible candidate with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct = 1.69 (the false_negative median) that is a large winner — entity_535a1beed7 and entity_de1c657364 fit this; they directly test whether the proposed lower bound 1.5 is too high.

A candidate with high mom_20 (>0.20) AND high vol_ratio_5_20 (>1.5) AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 3.0 that is a selected_winner — entity_b00579f203 (mom_20=0.23, vol_ratio=1.58, px_vs_ma50=0.23) is one; tests whether the regime over-excludes high-momentum winners.

A B0 candidate where pullback_duration_weeks is short (3) but pullback_pct is deep (<-15%) — does not exist in the 27 cases but would test the orthogonality of duration and depth, which the regime implicitly assumes.
what_would_change_my_mind: Held-out forward testing on a snapshot NOT in this 27-case discovery sample, where the 1.5–2.5 band shows a statistically significant ruin-rate reduction (p<0.05, n ≥ 50) versus a control using mom_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 alone. Without this, the regime is unfalsified speculation.

A direct measurement of pullback_v_is_dry (e.g., volume during the drawdown window vs. trailing 50-day average) showing it is NOT equivalent to 'pullback fields non-NULL' — and that the measured version separates winners from ruin at a higher standardized delta than mom_20.

A demonstration that adding (pullback_v_is_dry, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) to a logistic/gradient model with mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20, px_vs_ma50 already in it produces a significant AUC lift (ΔAUC ≥ 0.03) on out-of-sample data. If not, the regime is redundant.

Evidence that the regime's two boundaries (1.5 and 2.5) are stable across market regimes (e.g., 2022 bear vs. 2023 recovery) and not artifacts of the particular date clusters that dominate this sample.

Replacing the NULL-proxy for pullback_v_is_dry with a directly measured volume-during-base variable that shows entity_6618d3e80c-style extended winners and entity_df5478102d-style shallow-pullback eventual winners being correctly separated — i.e., the mechanism works when the proxy is replaced with the real thing.

tests.name: Proxy Validity: NULL/non-NULL vs directly-measured basing
tests.comparison: Among B0 candidates with non-NULL pullback fields (i.e., the subset where pullback_v_is_dry could even be defined), compare (a) the NULL/non-NULL dichotomy of pullback fields against (b) a directly-measured base-quality cluster defined by {base_duration_weeks in [3,6] AND base_mbox_count >= 3 AND pullback_pct <= -8}. If (b) reproduces the winner/FP_ruin separation the regime claims, the NULL proxy is replaceable; if (b) is null but (a) separates, the proxy is tautological with 'was a base tagged at all.'
tests.success_criterion: Directly-measured base cluster (b) shows >= 0.40 standardized delta on winner-vs-ruin within B0 (i.e., the regime's claim is reproducible with honest measurement).
tests.failure_criterion: Directly-measured cluster (b) shows standardized delta < 0.15 AND NULL/non-NULL proxy (a) retains > 0.30 standardized delta, confirming the regime is a missingness artifact, not a volume-during-base measurement.

tests.name: Lower Boundary Audit: the 1.69 contradiction
tests.comparison: Partition B0 candidates into four non-overlapping bands of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct: <1.30, [1.30, 1.69), [1.69, 2.50), and >=2.50. Compute large-win rate and ruin rate in each band. The Researcher's claim requires monotone ordering: <1.30 should hold the most false_negatives, [1.69, 2.50) should hold the most selected_winners, and >=2.50 should hold the most FP_ruin. The Skeptic's attack predicts the [1.69, 2.50) sub-band will NOT dominate winners because the FN median sits inside it.
tests.success_criterion: large_win_rate([1.69, 2.50)) > large_win_rate([1.30, 1.69)) AND ruin_rate(>=2.50) > ruin_rate([1.69, 2.50)) with each cell n >= 8; specifically, ruin_rate(>=2.50) - ruin_rate([1.69, 2.50)) >= 15 percentage points.
tests.failure_criterion: Either large_win_rate([1.69, 2.50)) <= large_win_rate([1.30, 1.69)) OR ruin_rate does not monotonically increase with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct across the four bands (i.e., the 1.5 lower bound the Researcher proposes is bracketed by the false-negative cluster it claims to exclude).

tests.name: Confound Independence: regime vs the strong-3
tests.comparison: Block B0 candidates into quartiles of (mom_20, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20) jointly — i.e., narrow momentum/quality bins. Within each bin, compute the ruin rate for the proposed regime sweet spot [1.5, 2.5] vs. outside it. If the regime's signal survives this within-bin stratification, the current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct band carries information orthogonal to momentum; if it collapses, the band is a re-encoding of the existing strong-3 features.
tests.success_criterion: Within at least 3 of 4 joint-momentum quartiles, ruin_rate(sweet_spot) < ruin_rate(outside) with n >= 10 per cell, and the median within-bin standardized delta on winner-vs-ruin for the band remains >= 0.20.
tests.failure_criterion: Within-bin direction flips sign in >= 2 quartiles, OR the median within-bin standardized delta drops below 0.10, indicating the regime is a redundant momentum proxy.

tests.name: Snapshot Stability: cluster contamination audit
tests.comparison: Repeat the lower-bound audit (Test 2) WITHIN each snapshot that contributes >= 4 B0 cases, instead of pooling across snapshots. Pool the within-snapshot direction-of-effect estimates (win-rate ordering across the four bands) using a sign test. The Researcher's regime is snapshot-independent if at least 75% of within-snapshot tests show the same band ordering; the Skeptic's contamination claim predicts within-snapshot effects will be noisy or direction-inconsistent because the sample is dominated by 2-3 date clusters.
tests.success_criterion: Sign test on within-snapshot win-rate ordering across the four bands yields p < 0.10 (one-sided) with >= 75% of snapshots agreeing on band direction, AND at least one snapshot is NOT in {snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40} contributing independent evidence.
tests.failure_criterion: Within-snapshot direction-of-effect is inconsistent (sign test p >= 0.20) OR all 'confirming' snapshots come from the two contaminated clusters with n < 4 elsewhere, demonstrating the regime is a single-cluster artifact.

tests.name: Direct Replacement: base_duration + base_mbox vs the regime
tests.comparison: Construct two predictive rules within B0 and compare standardized winner-vs-ruin separation: (Rule R1) base_duration_weeks in [3,7] AND base_mbox_count >= 3 AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [1.5, 2.5]; (Rule R2) pullback_v_is_dry=True AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [1.5, 2.5] (the Researcher's regime). Compute the standardized delta on selected_winner vs FP_ruin for each. R1 tests whether the regime's mechanism (quality basing) is better captured by directly-measured variables; R2 is the reference rule.
tests.success_criterion: R1 achieves standardized delta >= 0.35 on winner-vs-ruin AND R1's delta exceeds R2's delta by at least 0.10, indicating the Researcher's claim of 'quality basing' is real but the proxy encoding is suboptimal.
tests.failure_criterion: Either R1's delta < 0.20 OR R2 ties or beats R1, indicating the proxy mechanism is not actually capturing what it claims and directly-measured features add nothing incremental.

leakage_checks: Confirm base_duration_weeks, base_mbox_count, and pullback_pct are computed PIT at the B0 evaluation date and do not use forward-looking base-end detection (screener often anchors bases to breakout, which can leak).

Confirm pullback fields (NULL vs non-NULL) are determined before B0 selection, not retroactively tagged by the B0 screener after the fact — if the B0 filter assigns pullback_v_is_dry post-hoc, the proxy is tautological with B0 membership.
Verify current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is computed against the IBD candidate pivot as of the snapshot date (not the eventual pivot the stock breaks out to).
Snapshot id (snap_*) must not enter as a predictive feature in any model — using it would memorize date clusters and inflate the apparent regime signal.

is_b0_pick must be used only as a sampling-frame filter (=true to define the B0 universe), never as a model feature, since it is the eligibility indicator whose boundaries the regime is not supposed to expand.
outcome_label and w4_return_bucket must remain as labels only; any feature that is a deterministic function of these (e.g., bucketed W4 return) is a label leak.

For Test 4 (Snapshot Stability), ensure the within-snapshot estimates are NOT pooled across snapshots before computing the sign test — pooling first would re-introduce cluster contamination and defeat the test's purpose.
priority_order: Confound Independence: regime vs the strong-3
Proxy Validity: NULL/non-NULL vs directly-measured basing
Direct Replacement: base_duration + base_mbox vs the regime

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The proposed (pullback_v_is_dry, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) regime is internally inconsistent on three independent grounds: (a) pullback_v_is_dry appears operationally defined as the presence/non-presence of a detected base, conflating 'no base detected' (NULL pullback fields, common in the FP_ruin cluster) with 'volume contracted during a base' — these are not the same regime and the filter cannot address the very cases it claims to target; (b) the false-negative median current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct = 1.69 sits inside the proposed [1.5, 2.5] sweet spot, so the regime's lower bound is structurally below the cluster it claims to exclude; (c) winners pull back DEEPER (median -15.9%) than false negatives (-7.3%), inverting the 'shallow dry-up wins' narrative. What survives is a weaker, real signal: a pivot-zone + quality cluster (current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in mid-band AND high up_day_ratio_20/vol_ratio_5_20/mom_20) is consistent with winners, but current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is the second-weakest separator (std delta -0.20), and effective sample is ~8 independent market contexts after snapshot de-duplication. The specific encoding is refuted; the directional intuition is preserved but under-resolved.
falsifiers: If on a held-out snapshot with n >= 30 B0 cases, ruin_rate(sweet_spot=[1.5,2.5] AND pullback_v_is_dry=True) is NOT <= 1/3 of unconditional B0 ruin rate, the mechanism is refuted for production use.

If directly-measured base features (base_duration_weeks in [3,7] AND base_mbox_count >= 3) reproduce the winner-vs-ruin separation (std delta >= 0.40) that the dry-pullback proxy claims, then the proxy is junk and the regime is replaceable by honest measurement.

If within joint-momentum quartile bins, ruin_rate(sweet_spot) < ruin_rate(outside) holds in fewer than 2 of 4 quartiles, the regime is a redundant re-encoding of mom_20/vol_ratio_5_20 and adds zero marginal information.

If current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct band ordering (win rate monotonically increasing across <1.30 / [1.30,1.69) / [1.69,2.50) / >=2.50) is not monotone WITHIN at least 3 independent snapshots, the band boundary is a single-cluster artifact.

If cases with NULL pullback fields (i.e., never detected a base) have ruin_rate materially lower than cases with non-NULL pullback fields in [3,7] weeks, then the 'dry pullback = safety' frame is fully inverted and the filter is harmful.

Entity_6618d3e80c-style cases (high current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct AND selected_winner AND false_positive_ruin) appear at >= 10% frequency in a forward sample: any upper bound below their median is dropping alpha and the band should be widened or abandoned.
actionable_design_principles: Treat pullback_v_is_dry as SUSPECT pending the Proxy Validity Test: do not deploy it in production without the within-B0 NULL/non-NULL vs directly-measured base comparison showing the proxy carries information beyond the base-detection event itself.

Reject the specific band [1.5, 2.5] as currently specified — the 1.69 false-negative median contradiction makes it unfit. If the regime concept is retained, set the lower bound ABOVE 1.69 (e.g., [1.75, 2.50]) and document that this explicitly trades some FN_relative retention for lower-bound safety.

Apply the regime as a WITHIN-B0 conviction weight, never as an eligibility filter — this matches the researcher's policy_implications and avoids the universe-expansion trap the question explicitly forbids.

Mandate snapshot-stratified validation: any reported win/ruin rate for this regime must show consistency across at least 3 non-overlapping snapshots, otherwise the band is overfit to 1-2 date clusters.
Block the regime from being promoted to a screening feature; restrict it to sizing/hold-period modulation until effective-sample >= 30 independent cases per band cell.

Audit features entering the model: current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct, up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, and mom_20 are collinear enough to require joint-bin stratification (per Confound Independence test) before claiming incremental value of any one of them.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: B0ConvictionRegime_v0 — within-B0 confidence score = w1*I(current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [1.75, 2.50]) + w2*I(base_duration_weeks in [3,7]) + w3*I(base_mbox_count >= 3) + w4*up_day_ratio_20_normalized + w5*vol_ratio_5_20_normalized, applied as a position-size scalar (0.5x to 1.5x) without changing the B0 universe.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Drops the broken pullback_v_is_dry proxy entirely. Uses directly-measured base features plus current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in a band shifted above the FN median (1.75 instead of 1.5). Functions as a sizing modulation, not a filter — preserves the universe constraint from the question.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity-irrelevant: this is a conviction/positioning policy over an existing B0 candidate set. Output is a scalar per B0 pick; portfolio construction then sizes by this scalar. No impact on the eligible universe cardinality, so no capacity ceiling on B0 itself.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: PivotExtensionGuard_v0 — pre-trade veto rule: if current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct >= upper_thr AND vol_ratio_5_20 <= lower_thr (i.e., high extension into the candidate pivot on contracting volume), require explicit confirmation (fresh breakout volume or base re-detection) before allowing the B0 pick to size normally. Otherwise cap at 0.5x.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Targets the FP_ruin regime the Researcher correctly identified (NULL pullback + high ma10_slope + elevated ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct), but does so via extension-quality joint condition rather than the broken dry-pullback proxy. The joint condition prevents dropping alpha from cases like entity_6618d3e80c where high extension still produced a large win.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity-neutral guard: it constrains a subset of B0 picks to half size, not their eligibility. Aggregate portfolio capacity unchanged; per-trade liquidity demand reduced in the flagged subset.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: SnapshotRegimeAudit_v0 — meta-policy: at every evaluation, compute win-rate ordering across the four current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct bands PER SNAPSHOT (within-snapshot only), then sign-test across snapshots. If sign-test p >= 0.20 OR fewer than 3 independent snapshots contribute, the B0ConvictionRegime policy auto-downgrades to 0.75x default size and emits a regime-quality warning.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Directly addresses the snapshot contamination / cluster artifact problem the Skeptic identified. Treats the regime policy itself as a monitored object with its own quality gate, rather than trusting the within-B0 archaeology to generalize. Allows the policy to remain live but at reduced conviction during cluster-artifact risk.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Meta-policy; no direct capacity effect. Indirect: when active, it reduces sizing across all regime-aware trades, which can lower capacity pressure in stressed regimes.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: BaseQualityDirect_v0 — alternative conviction feature usable in place of (not in addition to) the pullback_v_is_dry proxy: base_quality_direct_score = sigmoid(base_duration_weeks/8 - |pullback_pct|/30 + base_mbox_count/5), a continuous scalar derived from directly-measured base features only. If this score's within-B0 winner-vs-ruin standardized delta exceeds 0.35, promote it to replace pullback_v_is_dry in the regime policy.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Implements the Direct Replacement test as a deployable policy, not just an offline check. If the proxy is shown to be a missingness artifact, this rule provides a clean replacement built on PIT-clean base measurements. The sigmoid form keeps the score in a bounded, interpretable range.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity-neutral replacement feature for an existing regime filter. Same cardinality, same universe. No capacity shift.

cycles.question: Explore a interaction term using pullback_v_is_dry and current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: The interaction pullback_v_is_dry × current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct identifies the regime where a B0 candidate has already extended meaningfully above its original IBD pivot (high current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) and is consolidating. When that consolidation occurs on dry volume (pullback_v_is_dry = 1), it reflects institutional accumulation/rotation and continuation is likely. When the consolidation occurs on elevated volume (pullback_v_is_dry = 0), it signals distribution into the B0 entry, which is the dominant false_positive_ruin failure regime. The interaction therefore separates 'extended-but-healthy' from 'extended-and-distributing' without needing to add new candidates.
evidence_for: Numeric contrast: selected_winner median current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct = 1.98 vs false_negative_relative median = 1.69, indicating winners sit modestly above the IBD pivot (extended, not just basing).

False_positive_ruin cases cluster on stocks with null pullback fields OR pullback_pct of −12% to −16% with vol_ratio_5_20 in the 1.2–1.5 band (entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_ccc90a671f, entity_55c2da490e) — extended names whose consolidations are accompanied by elevated volume.
False_positive_ruin entity_3472243e0c has mom_20 = 0.242, vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.21, null pullback (already extended, no dry reset) — a textbook distribution pattern.

Selected winners with deep pullbacks (entity_3adc078f01: pullback_pct = −42.3% over 9 weeks, entity_2c58cebc59: pullback_pct = −25.1% over 6 weeks) coincide with large_win buckets, consistent with dry-volume shakeouts resetting the base before continuation.

false_negative_relative cases show a slight downward shift in current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct (1.69) and shorter pullback_duration_weeks (4 vs 5.5) — these are stocks that B0 is under-buying precisely because they look un-extended, but the interaction (if made permissive) could re-include them by recognizing their early-stage dry basing.

Among labeled cases with pullback data, the false_positive_ruin row entity_8ad5cd4795 is excluded (it's a selected_winner with vol_ratio_5_20 ≈ 1.0 and shallow pullback), confirming dry-volume consolidation is a positive signal.
evidence_against: Small sample of 27 cases provides limited statistical power to confirm an interaction term distinct from the marginal effects of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct (standardized_delta = −0.1984) or vol_ratio_5_20 (standardized_delta = −1.0455 for false negatives).
Selected winner entity_440e297253 has vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.59 with a shallow pullback (pullback_pct = −1.5%), contradicting a strict 'dry volume required for any pullback' rule.

Several false_positive_ruin cases (entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_84824e6a20) have null pullback fields — these represent 'never pulled back at all' extended names where pullback_v_is_dry is undefined and must be treated as a separate, harder-to-classify failure mode.
pullback_duration_weeks is missing for many rows, so the interaction can only be evaluated on a subset of B0 candidates, reducing effective sample size further.
falsifiable_predictions: If the interaction hypothesis is correct, restricting B0 picks to those with pullback_v_is_dry = 1 AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [0.5%, 4.0%] should reduce the ruin bucket proportion below the unconditional ~30% baseline observed in the 27-case archaeology, while preserving at least 60% of the original B0 eligible set.

Within B0 picks that already have current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 1.5%, the subset with pullback_v_is_dry = 1 should have a W4 mean return at least 1.5pp higher than the subset with pullback_v_is_dry = 0.

A multiplicative rank penalty of the form score *= (0.5 + 0.5*pullback_v_is_dry)*(1 + clamp(current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct/10, 0, 0.3)) should produce a higher realized hit rate on a holdout than either term alone.

Cases with pullback_v_is_dry = null (never consolidated) AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 2% should be the highest sub-regime ruin rate, validating that 'extended-with-no-reset' is the dominant failure mode.

If a candidate has pullback_v_is_dry = 1 but current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct < 0% (trading below IBD pivot), the interaction term should NOT improve ranking — the dry-pullback benefit requires the stock to already be trending.
policy_implications: Encode the interaction as a two-step B0 refinement: (a) compute current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct at the snapshot; (b) derive pullback_v_is_dry from the volume profile of any pullback window vs trailing 20-day average. Apply as a soft rank modifier rather than a binary gate to avoid shrinking the eligible universe.

Specifically: B0_adjusted_score = B0_score * (1 + 0.15*pullback_v_is_dry) * (1 + 0.10*min(current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct/3, 1)) — the interaction emerges because pullback_v_is_dry gates whether the extension premium is rewarded (dry) or punished (non-dry).

Hard veto only for the extreme 'extended-without-dry-reset' quadrant: drop B0 candidates with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 3.0% AND pullback_v_is_dry = 0 (or null), since this quadrant concentrates false_positive_ruin.

For names with pullback_v_is_dry = null (no meaningful pullback yet), do not apply the positive arm of the interaction; instead require an additional confirmation (e.g., vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.0) before allowing the B0 pick to stand.

This encoding keeps the B0 eligible universe intact — no new candidates are added; the interaction only reorders or filters within the existing B0 set, preserving the model's candidate-generation contract.

Backtest protocol: stratify W4 outcomes by the four-quadrant interaction (pullback_v_is_dry × current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct bucket), verify the ruin-rate ordering matches the falsifiable predictions, and measure whether the interaction term adds marginal Sharpe over a model with only current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct as a feature.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The claimed pullback_v_is_dry × current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct interaction is largely a proxy artifact for the already-known vol_ratio_5_20 × mom_20 regime, not an independent signal. The 'dry pullback' flag is operationally a binarized form of vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.0 inside a specific lookback window, and the 'extension' flag is operationally a binarized form of px_vs_ma50 (or current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct). Because both inputs are themselves already represented in the feature set — vol_ratio_5_20 (std_delta −1.0455) and mom_20 (std_delta −1.0005) being the two strongest false-negative discriminators — the apparent interaction captures no marginal information once those continuous features are present, and the proposed multiplicative encoding (1+a)(1+b) is mathematically NOT an interaction term anyway, it is two independent multiplicative marginals, so the claim that the product encodes interaction is incoherent.

attacks.issue: Construct redundancy: pullback_v_is_dry is a windowed, thresholded restatement of vol_ratio_5_20
attacks.why_it_matters: vol_ratio_5_20 already shows the largest false-negative contrast in the archaeology (std_delta −1.0455). Any 'interaction' that conditions on a binarization of the strongest existing feature cannot be expected to add new ranking power; it can only re-discretize known signal and lose information through thresholding.

attacks.issue: The proposed B0_adjusted_score = B0_score * (1 + 0.15*pullback_v_is_dry) * (1 + 0.10*min(current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct/3, 1)) is multiplicative marginals, not an interaction term
attacks.why_it_matters: A genuine interaction requires a term proportional to (pullback_v_is_dry * current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct). The encoding factorizes into two independent multipliers on B0_score, so the policy does not actually test or operationalize the claimed interaction — it implements the prior main effects and labels the result 'interaction'. This is an internal inconsistency between the mechanism claim and the policy_implications.

attacks.issue: Sample is dominated by null-pullback rows, biasing any interaction estimate toward the subset where pullback_v_is_dry is defined
attacks.why_it_matters: At least 13 of 27 cases have null pullback_duration_weeks / pullback_pct, including most large_win winners (entity_ead73f4390, entity_2f86543bf6, entity_b00579f203, entity_bec51a4227). The 'interaction' is therefore evaluated on a non-random subset (only candidates that consolidated) and cannot be claimed to separate winners from losers in the full B0 universe without extrapolation.

attacks.issue: Counterexample: extended stocks with elevated volume but null pullback that won — entity_ead73f4390 (mom_20=0.32, vol_ratio_5_20=1.77, px_vs_ma50=0.185, large_win, null pullback)
attacks.why_it_matters: This is exactly the 'extended-without-dry-reset' quadrant that the mechanism predicts should be a ruin regime, yet it is a selected_winner with large_win bucket. The mechanism claim is falsified by this single case if the proposed hard-veto rule were applied to it. The 'distribution' interpretation of elevated volume is therefore wrong at least some of the time — elevated volume can also mark institutional accumulation / breakout follow-through, which is the alternative explanation the claim ignores.

attacks.issue: Counterexample: shallow-pullback, elevated-volume winner — entity_440e297253 (pullback_pct=−1.5%, vol_ratio_5_20=1.59, large_win)
attacks.why_it_matters: The Researcher cites this case as evidence against a 'dry volume required' rule, but it also contradicts the interaction claim: this is a shallow-pullback winner with non-dry volume. If the interaction were truly the dominant axis, this case should be in a 'mixed' bucket, not a clean winner — yet it dominates. The interaction hypothesis fails to explain why this extended-with-elevated-volume, non-dry-pullback candidate still produced a large_win.

attacks.issue: Confounding by mom_20 / ma slope: the 'dry pullback × extended' winners are also the 'high mom_20' stocks
attacks.why_it_matters: Look at entity_3adc078f01 (mom_20=0.172, ma10_slope_5=0.063, ma20_slope_5=0.073, large_win) versus entity_b6bcccdf6a (mom_20=0.176, ma10_slope_5=0.067, ma20_slope_5=0.045, ruin). They are nearly identical on the trend-strength features and nearly identical on pullback fields (both null), yet diverge in outcome. The interaction with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct cannot explain this divergence either; the residual is being driven by something else entirely (likely idiosyncratic news / sector rotation), making the interaction at best a noise-reduction rather than a mechanism story.

attacks.issue: Standardized delta for current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is only −0.1984 — third-quartile weakest in the archaeology
attacks.why_it_matters: If current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is itself a weak discriminator, no interaction involving it as a factor can be expected to be strong unless the interaction is very large. The numeric contrast does not support treating it as a regime-defining variable, which is what the mechanism requires. Using a weak marginal as the spine of an interaction is a recipe for overfitting on 27 cases.

attacks.issue: Lookback-window leakage risk: the pullback detection window likely overlaps with the W4 forward outcome window used in archaeology
attacks.why_it_matters: If pullback_v_is_dry is computed on data that includes the post-entry price/volume path, then any correlation with W4 outcome is contaminated by forward information. The archaeology cannot validate a feature whose construction window contains the label. This is a label-leakage concern that is independent of sample size.

attacks.issue: Hard-veto rule (drop current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 3.0% AND pullback_v_is_dry=0) contradicts the 'no universe expansion' constraint in spirit
attacks.why_it_matters: Even a 'soft' veto shrinks the eligible set; the policy frames the veto as preserving the universe while simultaneously recommending a hard drop in one quadrant. If the ruin concentration in that quadrant is as claimed (the falsifiable prediction says 'highest sub-regime ruin rate'), then the veto materially reduces candidate count and breaks the B0 contract. The Researcher is implicitly trading one constraint for another without acknowledging it.

counterexamples_to_seek: B0 candidate with pullback_v_is_dry = 1 AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct < 0% that is a large_win — would refute the gating claim that dry-pullback benefit requires trending
B0 candidate with pullback_v_is_dry = 0 AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in (1.5%, 3.0%) that is a large_win — would refute the 'extended-and-distributing = ruin' quadrant
B0 candidate with both pullback fields null AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 0.9 that is a ruin — would refute the 'no pullback yet = keep with vol confirmation' rule
Two near-identical B0 candidates differing only in pullback_v_is_dry flag but having identical vol_ratio_5_20 — would isolate whether the binarization itself adds information
A B0 candidate with current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 4% AND pullback_v_is_dry = 1 that ruins — would refute the directional claim that dry volume rescues extension

Snapshot-stratified cross-tabs: is the interaction effect concentrated in one snapshot (snap_d0d57b1e40 contains multiple mixed-outcome cases) and absent elsewhere, indicating snapshot-level regime rather than feature-level interaction?
what_would_change_my_mind: An out-of-sample holdout (not in the discovery 27) of at least 100 B0 candidates where the four-quadrant interaction shows a monotonic ruin-rate ordering with effect magnitude > 5pp between adjacent quadrants AND the interaction term adds marginal Sharpe over a baseline model that already includes vol_ratio_5_20 and current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct as continuous features

A non-parametric partial-dependence plot on a holdout showing that predicted W4 return as a function of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct visibly differs between pullback_v_is_dry = 0 and pullback_v_is_dry = 1, with non-parallel curves (the defining signature of statistical interaction)

An ablation demonstrating that adding pullback_v_is_dry × current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct as a true cross-term (not multiplicative marginals) improves a held-out log-loss / brier score over a model with the two main effects alone
Evidence that pullback_v_is_dry is constructed from data strictly before the W4 measurement window, ruling out label leakage

Resolution of the null-pullback winners: if most null-pullback selected_winners can be shown to share a structural property (e.g., they were bought on breakout day, never had a pullback to evaluate) then the interaction claim can be restricted to a clean subpopulation and tested — until then it remains confounded with sample selection

tests.name: interaction_vs_binarized_volratio_ablation
tests.comparison: On a held-out B0 sample (not the 27 archaeology cases), fit two nested models predicting W4 bucket from the same continuous base: (M1) vol_ratio_5_20 + current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 as continuous terms; (M2) M1 plus the explicit cross-term pullback_v_is_dry * current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct (a true interaction, not multiplicative marginals). Compare partial-dependence curves of W4 outcome vs current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct separately for pullback_v_is_dry=0 and =1. Test non-parallelism (slope difference > 0.5pp per 1pp of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) and brier/log-loss improvement of M2 over M1.
tests.success_criterion: M2 improves brier score by >=2% relative AND partial-dependence curves for the two pullback_v_is_dry strata cross or differ in slope by >=0.5pp/1pp extension, with the dry-stratum curve showing positive marginal return on extension and the non-dry stratum flat or negative.
tests.failure_criterion: Curves are statistically parallel (slope difference < 0.2pp/1pp, overlapping CIs) AND M2 brier improvement < 1%; in that case pullback_v_is_dry adds no information beyond vol_ratio_5_20 and the interaction claim collapses to a binarization artifact.

tests.name: four_quadrant_ruin_rate_with_null_separation
tests.comparison: Stratify B0 candidates into 6 cells: (i) pullback_v_is_dry=1 & current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [0,3%], (ii) pullback_v_is_dry=1 & current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct >3%, (iii) pullback_v_is_dry=0 & current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct in [0,3%], (iv) pullback_v_is_dry=0 & current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct >3%, (v) pullback_v_is_dry=null, (vi) pullback_v_is_dry=1 & current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct <0. Compute ruin rate per cell. The null cell is kept separate so the interaction is not evaluated on the sample-selected subset.
tests.success_criterion: Ruin rate in cell (iv) > cell (iii) by >=10pp AND cell (iv) > cell (ii) by >=10pp, with cell (v) ruin rate NOT exceeding cell (iv) by more than 5pp — confirming the 'extended-and-non-dry = ruin' quadrant and showing null-pullback cases do not silently dominate the result.
tests.failure_criterion: Cell ordering is flat (any adjacent pair differs by <5pp) OR the null cell (v) has the highest ruin rate, which would mean the interaction hypothesis is driven by sample selection on the pullback-defined subset and cannot be generalized to the full B0 universe.

leakage_checks: Verify pullback_v_is_dry is computed from a window that ends at least N trading days before the W4 measurement anchor (pre-specified N, e.g., 5 trading days). If the pullback detection window includes post-entry price/volume, any apparent interaction is forward-contaminated and the test must be rerun with the window truncated to data strictly available at snapshot time.

Verify current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct at the snapshot uses the IBD pivot level that was fixed at the original IBD candidate formation date (not updated retroactively to the snapshot close), so the 'extension' measurement is a PIT value and not a restated post-hoc pivot.

Confirm that for any matched-pair subgroup in the ablation, both arms share the same snapshot date, so snapshot-level regime effects (e.g., snap_d0d57b1e40 contamination seen by the Skeptic) cannot masquerade as the interaction.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The hypothesized interaction claims that a B0 candidate's volume profile during pullback (pullback_v_is_dry) modulates whether extension above the original IBD pivot (current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) is healthy continuation or distribution-into-strength. The mechanism story is internally coherent: dry-volume consolidation after extension is consistent with institutional accumulation resetting the base; elevated-volume consolidation after extension is consistent with rotation/distribution. However, three independent analytical layers (researcher evidence, skeptic counterexamples, designer leakage checks) collectively weaken the claim from 'supported' to 'conditional': (1) the marginal discriminative power of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct itself is third-quartile weak in the archaeology (std_delta -0.1984); (2) pullback_v_is_dry is operationally a windowed binarization of vol_ratio_5_20, which already shows the strongest false-negative contrast (std_delta -1.0455), creating severe construct redundancy; (3) at least two labeled cases (entity_ead73f4390, entity_440e297253) are direct counterexamples to the 'extended + non-dry = ruin' quadrant yet are large_win winners. The most defensible reading is that the interaction captures a real but narrow regime that is partially aliased onto the existing vol_ratio_5_20 + mom_20 × px_vs_ma50 signal cluster, and any operationalization must be tested as a TRUE cross-term (additive interaction in the linear predictor), not as multiplicative marginals on B0_score.
falsifiers: On an out-of-sample holdout (>=100 B0 candidates not in the 27 archaeology cases), a generalized additive model containing pullback_v_is_dry * current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct as an explicit cross-term shows parallel partial-dependence curves (slope difference < 0.2pp per 1pp of extension, with overlapping 95% CIs), demonstrating no statistical interaction — the apparent effect is a re-binarization of vol_ratio_5_20.

After including vol_ratio_5_20 and mom_20 as continuous covariates in a held-out model, adding the proposed interaction term fails to reduce brier score by >=1% relative and fails to improve log-loss at the 5% level on a likelihood-ratio test — confirming the interaction is fully absorbed by continuous main effects.

Stratifying by snapshot_id, the four-quadrant ruin-rate ordering holds in only one snapshot (e.g., snap_d0d57b1e40) and inverts or flattens in the others — falsifying the feature-level mechanism and replacing it with a snapshot-regime story.

Among B0 picks with pullback_v_is_dry = 1 and current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 3.0%, the ruin rate is NOT lower than the unconditional baseline by >=10pp on holdout data — refuting the directional 'dry rescues extension' claim.

Pullback_v_is_dry computed using a lookback window truncated to end >=5 trading days before the W4 anchor shows substantially weaker association with W4 bucket than the unrestricted version (Spearman drop >=0.15) — exposing forward-contamination in the original archaeology feature.

Matched-pair test: pairs of B0 candidates matched on vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50, and snapshot_id but differing only in pullback_v_is_dry show no significant difference in W4 return (paired t-test p > 0.3) — proving the binarization adds no information once the continuous volume ratio is known.
A B0 candidate with pullback_v_is_dry = 0, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct = 5.0%, mom_20 = 0.05, vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.4 produces a large_win on holdout — directly refuting the hard-veto quadrant.

Bootstrap-resampled ruin rates in the 'extended-with-no-dry-reset' (pullback_v_is_dry null AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > 2%) cell have 95% CI that overlaps the unconditional B0 ruin rate — showing the predicted 'highest sub-regime ruin' is not statistically distinguishable from baseline.
actionable_design_principles: Encode the interaction as a TRUE cross-term in the linear/predictor space (e.g., score += beta_int * pullback_v_is_dry * current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct), not as multiplicative marginals on B0_score — multiplicative marginals are mathematically equivalent to independent rank shifts and cannot represent interaction.

Hard-cap the universe modification: any policy derived from the interaction must not exclude more than 5% of the B0 eligible set in expectation; if the four-quadrant veto would breach this, downgrade the rule to a rank penalty (>=0.7x multiplier) instead of a binary drop.

Pre-register the lookback: pullback_v_is_dry must be computed from a window ending at least 5 trading days before the W4 measurement anchor, and the same truncation must be applied at evaluation time — otherwise the policy is non-deployable on forward data.

Control for continuous confounders at design time: any reported effect of the interaction must be conditional on vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, and px_vs_ma50 being in the model as continuous terms; otherwise the apparent interaction is a confounded re-binarization.

Separate the regime-eligible subset from the full B0 universe in evaluation: report the interaction effect on (a) the pullback-defined subset and (b) the pullback-null subset independently; do not pool — this prevents sample-selection-driven overfitting.

For the pullback-null subset (no consolidation observed), define a separate guardrail (e.g., vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.0 confirmation) rather than borrowing the dry-pullback arm of the interaction — the mechanism does not transfer cleanly.

Snapshot-stratify all evaluations: if the interaction effect is concentrated in one snapshot or one calendar quarter, treat it as a regime artifact and withhold deployment until it replicates across at least three independent snapshots.

Track realized capacity impact: if the interaction-induced re-ranking shifts more than 20% of the candidate slots relative to the B0 prior, the policy is effectively redefining the candidate set — flag this for explicit B0-contract review even if the formal eligible universe is unchanged.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a policy `interaction_dry_x_extension` that emits a continuous interaction score = pullback_v_is_dry * current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct and adds it to the linear predictor with a single learnable coefficient, rather than two separate multiplicative modifiers on the base score.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Prior proposed encoding used score *= (1 + a)*(1 + b), which is mathematically two independent multipliers and cannot represent interaction; this design forces the coefficient to be learned jointly and exposes whether the cross-term is statistically distinguishable from main effects.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Adds one continuous feature (the cross-product) and one learnable weight; does not expand the eligible universe; capacity impact is negligible (single scalar addition).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a policy `dry_extension_quadrant_guard` that applies a soft rank penalty (multiplier in [0.5, 1.0], continuous in current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct) only when pullback_v_is_dry = 0 AND current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > threshold, with the penalty magnitude calibrated to avoid excluding >5% of B0 candidates.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Converts the 'extended-without-dry-reset = ruin' rule from a hard binary drop into a smooth, capacity-bounded penalty; preserves the eligible universe while still allowing the hypothesis to express itself; explicitly bounds the universe-shrinkage contract.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Does not add candidates; may reorder existing candidates within a bounded rank window; capacity-neutral by construction.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a policy `null_pullback_separate_path` that routes pullback_v_is_dry = null candidates into a separate evaluation track requiring vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.0 confirmation, rather than treating the null case as equivalent to either dry or non-dry.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Acknowledges that ~half of the archaeology sample is null-pullback, that the interaction hypothesis does not naturally extend to this subset, and that pooling it with the defined cases is a sample-selection bias; the policy isolates the bias rather than averaging over it.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Does not expand B0; instead applies a stricter confirmation requirement within the existing eligible set; may reduce effective candidate count but does so transparently rather than via an interaction artifact.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Define a policy `leak_safe_pullback_dry` that recomputes pullback_v_is_dry using a lookback window whose end is parametrically tied to the W4 anchor minus a buffer (e.g., end = W4_anchor - 5 trading days), and asserts that this recomputed feature shows the same quadrant ordering as the original archaeology — otherwise fall back to using only vol_ratio_5_20.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Operationalizes the experimental designer's leakage check as a runtime policy: if the forward-safe version of the feature does not preserve the interaction signal, the policy self-disables rather than deploying a contaminated feature.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Pure guardrail; capacity-neutral, may disable the interaction policy entirely if leakage is detected.

cycles.question: Explore a conditional ranking plus adaptive capacity using pullback_v_is_dry and current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: Within the fixed B0 candidate set, stocks whose recent pullback was orderly ('dry': low intraday vol, narrow range, contained drawdown) AND whose current price sits near or just above the IBD candidate pivot (current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct modest, ~1.5–2.0x band) carry the highest risk-adjusted runway; conversely, B0 picks that are simultaneously extended relative to IBD pivot AND whose pullback showed vol expansion are late-stage, prone to false_positive_ruin because the breakout has already consumed the move and the correction was technically messy (supply not absorbed). Adaptive capacity here = the joint condition (dry_pullback × room_to_pivot) acting as a re-ranking modifier, not an eligibility gate.
evidence_for: Numeric contrast shows selected_winners have deeper pullbacks (median -15.9% vs FN -7.3%, std_delta +0.64) but LONGER durations (5.5w vs 4.0w), consistent with 'dry' = controlled grind down over time, not sharp V-rebound — exactly the vol-absorbed signature.

Selected_winners carry higher vol_ratio_5_20 (1.42 vs FN 1.18, std_delta -1.05) AND higher up_day_ratio (0.625 vs 0.50) post-pullback, indicating the dry pullback transitions into a vol-expanding, up-biased accumulation — adaptive capacity confirmed by post-entry behavior, not pre-entry hope.

False_positive_ruin cases cluster in two signatures: (a) high-mom + elevated px_vs_ma50 (entity_6618d3e80c at +33.7%, entity_3472243e0c at +24% mom_20) where current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is implicitly far above pivot — late extension with no runway; (b) shallow mom + mid-extension with up_day_ratio 0.4–0.5 (entity_84824e6a20, entity_40ea0cfb3b) — technically 'dry' but trend-weak, a failure mode of the dry filter when applied without the pivot-distance clause.
evidence_against: current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct alone is weakly discriminative (std_delta only -0.20 between FN and SW), so the mechanism depends on interaction with pullback quality; if used linearly it adds noise rather than signal.

entity_6618d3e80c is labeled both false_positive_ruin AND selected_winner, showing the dry-pullback signature can coexist with ruin when the pivot-distance clause is loose — the interaction must be conjunctive, not disjunctive.

Several selected_winners have null pullback fields (entity_ead73f4390, entity_28a6ec4601, entity_b00579f203), meaning the 'dry pullback' condition is undefined for IPO/breakout-from-base names — the encoding must gracefully degrade (e.g., fall back to base tightness proxies) rather than exclude, otherwise it silently shrinks the effective B0 set.
falsifiable_predictions: Within B0 picks, a re-rank that penalizes (high current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct > ~2.2x) AND (non-dry pullback: vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.5 with up_day_ratio < 0.55) should reduce ruin_rate more than it reduces hit_rate; the test is ruin_rate drop ≥ 3pp with hit_rate drop ≤ 1pp on held-out discovery slice.

If adaptive_capacity is genuinely conjunctive, then restricting the modifier to ONLY the dry_pullback axis (ignoring pivot distance) should produce a small ruin reduction but a meaningful hit_rate reduction — i.e., the mechanism fails its isolation test unless both axes interact.

On the false_negative_relative cohort (entity_df5478102d, entity_d8e8e7b814), applying the modifier should UP-rank them because their current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is below median and their pullback quality is acceptable; if these still underperform after re-rank, the mechanism is mis-specified for the 'missed winner' leg.
policy_implications: Encode as a continuous rank-modifier score s_mod = f(pullback_dry_score) × (1 − sigmoid((cvibd − pivot_mid)/band)) applied AFTER the existing B0 score, with the null-pullback fallback to base_depth_pct + base_duration_weeks to avoid silently shrinking eligibility.

Set the modifier's neutral zone (no up/down-rank) around the empirical SW medians (current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct ≈ 1.98, vol_ratio_5_20 ≈ 1.42, up_day_ratio ≈ 0.625) so the B0 universe, hit rate, and recall are preserved by construction — only intra-pool ordering changes.

Stress-test in two regimes: (i) high-dispersion uptrend where current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct is universally inflated (expect modifier to lose signal, monitor regime flag); (ii) choppy market where pullback_v_is_dry is ambiguous (expect vol_ratio to be noisy; consider gating with 20-day realized vol floor before applying).

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The conjunctive dry-pullback × pivot-distance modifier is an artifact of snapshot-level dispersion, not a stable within-B0 mechanism: in snap_d0d57b1e40 the same feature ranges produce both FP_ruin (entity_84824e6a20, entity_6618d3e80c) AND selected_winner (entity_bec51a4227), and the 'adaptive capacity' inputs (vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20) are contemporaneous proxies already correlated with the existing B0 score (e.g., current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct tracks ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct with std_delta -0.70). The modifier is a near-zero-information reshuffle that will not survive held-out testing.

attacks.issue: Same-snapshot outcome inversion: snap_d0d57b1e40 contains entity_84824e6a20 (FP_ruin, mom_20=0.067, up_day_ratio=0.40) and entity_bec51a4227 (SW, mom_20=0.166, up_day_ratio=0.70) with similar pullback=null signatures; snap_b8420124eb contains SW entity_d2ca7853ba (mom_20=0.159) and FP_ruin entity_40ea0cfb3b (mom_20=0.024). Any conjunctive rule applied within-snapshot must discriminate these — but the proposed modifier relies on the very features (mom, vol_ratio, up_day_ratio) that already co-move with the original B0 score, making the marginal lift effectively zero.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the modifier cannot separate FP_ruin from SW within the same regime snapshot using the proposed conjunctive rule, then the claimed mechanism is either redundant with B0 or regime-dependent; either way it fails the 'without expanding B0' constraint because any conditional split must carve a sub-pool — and sub-pools in this N=27 sample are too thin (2–3 cases per snapshot-cell) to estimate reliably.

attacks.issue: The null-pullback 'graceful degrade to base_depth_pct + base_duration_weeks' fallback is itself an eligibility change: it substitutes a different feature representation for ~10/27 cases (all top performers, including entity_ead73f4390, entity_28a6ec4601, entity_b00579f203 are SW with null pullbacks AND high mom_20/px_vs_ma50). Encoding a different feature for these rows means the B0 scoring is no longer the same model — the 'no expansion' constraint is violated at the representation layer, not the universe layer.
attacks.why_it_matters: Researcher claims universe preservation, but representation substitution changes what B0 effectively scores; the held-out test of 'B0 universe, hit rate, and recall preserved by construction' is unfalsifiable because the score function itself changes for a large minority of cases.

counterexamples_to_seek: Within snap_d0d57b1e40 and snap_b8420124eb, compute the proposed s_mod for the FP_ruin vs SW pairs and verify the modifier flips the ordering — if it does not, the conjunctive rule has zero within-snapshot lift and the cross-snapshot lift is just regime mean reversion.

Test whether current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct adds information beyond ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct in a bivariate regression on outcome: if partial R^2 < 1%, the 'room to pivot' axis is a redundant proxy and the modifier collapses to the dry-pullback axis alone.
what_would_change_my_mind: A within-snapshot leave-one-out test showing the conjunctive modifier flips ≥2 of the 3 same-snapshot FP/SW pairs in the discovery set, OR a held-out slice (≥30 cases, multiple snapshots) where ruin_rate drops ≥3pp with hit_rate drop ≤1pp — anything weaker is indistinguishable from regime-noise reshuffling.

tests.name: within_snapshot_isolation_test
tests.comparison: Within each regime-snapshot stratum (e.g., snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_b8420124eb), compute the conjunctive modifier s_mod = f(dry_pullback_score) × (1 - sigmoid((cvibd - mid)/band)) for every entity_rr. Pre-specify the dry_score as z(vol_ratio_5_20 inverse) + z(up_day_ratio_20) using only the within-snapshot distribution. Test whether s_mod flips the rank of FP_ruin entities (entity_84824e6a20, entity_40ea0cfb3b) BELOW their same-snapshot SW counterparts (entity_bec51a4227, entity_d2ca7853ba).
tests.success_criterion: Modifier flips ≥2 of the 3 same-snapshot FP/SW pairs in the discovery set (per skeptic's specified bar), with the flipped ordering reproducing on a held-out snapshot slice containing ≥6 FP_ruin and ≥6 SW within-snapshot pairs.
tests.failure_criterion: Modifier fails to flip ≥2 same-snapshot pairs, OR the direction of the flip is inconsistent across snapshots (e.g., up-ranks FP in one snapshot, down-ranks in another). Either outcome indicates the mechanism is regime-mean-reversion rather than a stable within-B0 signal.

tests.name: partial_information_test_for_room_to_pivot
tests.comparison: Run a pre-specified bivariate logistic regression of outcome_label (selected_winner=1 vs ruin=0) on current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct conditional on ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, ibd_entry_close_position, and dist_to_52w_high_pct. Compute the partial Spearman correlation between current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct and outcome after partialling out the three existing B0 proxies. Repeat holding out one snapshot at a time.
tests.success_criterion: Partial |Spearman| ≥ 0.15 with consistent sign across leave-one-snapshot-out folds, indicating current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct contributes information orthogonal to existing B0 features. Researcher-specified threshold band ~1.5–2.0x must fall inside the interquartile range of the held-out slice.
tests.failure_criterion: Partial |Spearman| < 0.05 or sign instability across folds means the 'room to pivot' axis is a redundant proxy for ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct and the conjunctive modifier collapses to dry-pullback alone.

tests.name: null_pullback_representation_invariance_test
tests.comparison: Restrict to the 10 rows where pullback_duration_weeks is null (entity_ead73f4390, entity_28a6ec4601, entity_b00579f203, and 7 others including FP_ruin and SW). Compute B0 score S_b0a using base proxies alone, then S_b0b using the proposed fallback (base_depth_pct + base_duration_weeks substitution into the dry_score). Test whether the rank correlation (Spearman) between S_b0a and S_b0b on this null subset is ≥0.85.
tests.success_criterion: Spearman(S_b0a, S_b0b) ≥ 0.85 on the null-pullback subset AND the cross-subset rank correlation between null-pullback SWs and non-null SWs is preserved (no systematic up- or down-shift). This proves the fallback is representation-invariant and does not silently expand eligibility.
tests.failure_criterion: Spearman < 0.70 OR the null-pullback SWs systematically receive different effective scores than their non-null counterparts — confirming the skeptic's claim that representation substitution is a covert expansion of the B0 scoring surface.

tests.name: three_slot_adaptive_capacity_bucket_test
tests.comparison: Encode adaptive capacity into exactly 3 slots using pre-specified thresholds from the SW empirical medians (vol_ratio_5_20 ≈ 1.42, up_day_ratio_20 ≈ 0.625, cvibd ≈ 1.98). Slot definitions: high_capacity = (up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.60 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≤ 1.50 AND cvibd ≤ 2.20); low_capacity = (up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.45 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.45 AND cvibd ≥ 2.50); neutral = everything else. Apply slots as a rank modifier only (no eligibility change) and verify ruin_rate ordering: low_slot_ruin > neutral_ruin > high_slot_ruin within the B0 picked subset.
tests.success_criterion: Monotonic ruin_rate ordering low > neutral > high with ≥10pp spread between extreme slots AND hit_rate high_slot ≥ 0.55 (no degradation of the best bucket). Researcher-predicted ≥3pp ruin drop with ≤1pp hit drop must hold.
tests.failure_criterion: Non-monotonic ordering OR <5pp ruin spread between extreme slots OR high_slot hit_rate < neutral_slot hit_rate. Any of these fails the conjunctive-mechanism isolation requirement.

tests.name: regime_dispersion_stress_test
tests.comparison: Slice the discovery set by rv_20 quartile. Within the top quartile (highest realized vol, mimicking choppy regime), recompute the 3-slot modifier from scratch using only that quartile's empirical distribution (no peeking at full-set medians). Compare ruin_rate ordering to the bottom-quartile slice. Also test: when cvibd is universally inflated (>3.0) within a snapshot, the modifier's pivot-distance axis loses discriminative power — measure ruin_rate spread collapse.
tests.success_criterion: Top-quartile ruin ordering matches bottom-quartile direction (sign-consistent monotone) OR, if direction inverts, the inversion is explainable by a pre-specified regime flag (e.g., rv_20 > empirical_p75). The modifier must either generalize or fail-gracefully — it must not produce anti-signal silently.
tests.failure_criterion: Top-quartile ordering inverts without satisfying the regime-flag condition OR ruin spread collapses to <2pp in either quartile — indicating the conjunctive mechanism is a within-regime artifact rather than a portable signal.

leakage_checks: Verify all 27 rows used in any test have snapshot_anon drawn from the discovery-train set only; explicitly exclude any outer-forward outcomes, ticker identity, or calendar identity. Cross-check that no test re-uses an entity_anon whose snapshot_anon differs from the in-sample distribution.

Confirm the 3-slot thresholds (1.42, 0.625, 1.98, 1.50, 0.45, 1.45, 2.50) are derived from the SW median contrasts in the supplied failure_archaeology JSON and not from any post-hoc tuning on FP_ruin labels. Re-derive medians using leave-one-snapshot-out to detect threshold overfitting.

For the null-pullback representation test, verify the 10 null-pullback rows are not a biased subset of SWs only — count FP_ruin/null and SW/null ratios; if null-pullback SWs dominate, the fallback stability test is itself selection-biased and must be down-weighted.

Ensure within-snapshot isolation test does not inadvertently use pullback features that are undefined (null) in either member of the pair; if either entity has null pullback fields, restrict the comparison to non-pullback features only or exclude the pair and pre-specify this exclusion.

Check that vol_ratio_5_20 and up_day_ratio_20 are measured at the SAME PIT timestamp as current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct; if they are computed over different lookback windows or end at different dates, the conjunctive interaction leaks forward information and must be re-synchronized before any test is run.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: Within the fixed B0 universe, conjunctive re-ranking by (dry_pullback_score = high up_day_ratio + contained vol_ratio) × (room_to_pivot = low current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct near 1.5–2.0x) plausibly down-ranks late-stage, vol-expanding false positives and up-ranks orderly, roomy continuation candidates. The mechanism is theoretically consistent with the SW vs FN medians (up_day_ratio 0.625 vs 0.50, vol_ratio 1.42 vs 1.18, current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct 1.98 vs 1.69), but the pivot-distance axis alone has std_delta only -0.20 and the conjunctive lift has not been demonstrated within snapshot cells where regime is held constant.
falsifiers: Within-snapshot leave-one-out isolation test fails to flip ≥2 of the 3 FP/SW same-snapshot pairs (entity_84824e6a20 vs entity_bec51a4227; entity_6618d3e80c vs entity_bec51a4227; entity_40ea0cfb3b vs entity_d2ca7853ba), indicating the modifier carries no within-regime information beyond existing B0.

Partial Spearman of current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct vs outcome after partialling out ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct and ibd_entry_close_position falls below 0.05 across leave-one-snapshot-out folds, collapsing the conjunctive rule to dry-pullback alone and exposing it as a redundant reshuffle.

Null-pullback substitution (base_depth_pct + base_duration_weeks fallback for ~10/27 cases including top SW entity_ead73f4390, entity_28a6ec4601, entity_b00579f203) shifts the B0 scoring surface enough that rank correlation between original B0 and modified B0 on the null subset drops below 0.70, violating the 'no expansion' constraint at the representation layer.

Three-slot adaptive capacity ordering fails monotonic ruin_rate(low > neutral > high) or extreme-slot ruin spread collapses below 5pp under rv_20-quartile slicing, indicating the signal does not survive regime dispersion.
actionable_design_principles: Encode dry_pullback_score as z(vol_ratio_5_20, inverse) + z(up_day_ratio_20) using WITHIN-snapshot z-scores only; never pool across snapshots because cross-snapshot dispersion is the primary confounder.

Treat current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct as a soft pivot-distance band around the empirical SW median (~1.5–2.0x), not as a hard threshold; the std_delta of -0.20 means it is too weak to gate but viable as a continuous modifier term.

For the null-pullback fallback, define a representation-invariant substitution test (Spearman ≥0.85 vs base B0) BEFORE deployment; if it fails, the 'no expansion' constraint is violated and the modifier must be applied only to the 17/27 non-null subset, accepting reduced coverage as the honest cost.

Never use entity_anon or snapshot_anon as features; gate the conjunctive modifier on a pre-specified regime flag (e.g., rv_20 < empirical_p75 of the slice) so the modifier either fires or degrades explicitly rather than producing silent anti-signal in choppy regimes.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_rank_modifier_dry_pullback_x_pivot_room
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Re-ranks within the existing B0 eligible set using a conjunctive product of dry-pullback quality and pivot-distance room; does not add or remove candidates, preserving the B0 universe by construction.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Adaptive capacity = ability of recent price action to absorb supply (dry pullback) while still leaving geometric room above pivot; the conjunction isolates continuation candidates from late-stage, vol-expanding false positives.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_null_pullback_representation_fallback
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Handles the ~37% of B0 picks with null pullback fields by substituting base_depth_pct + base_duration_weeks via a pre-tested representation-invariant mapping, explicitly guarding against silent scoring-surface expansion.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Preserves B0 universe coverage for IPO/breakout-from-base names (entity_ead73f4390, entity_28a6ec4601, entity_b00579f203) where pullback_v_is_dry is undefined; without it the modifier would silently shrink eligibility and inflate apparent hit rate.

cycles.question: Explore a piecewise threshold using pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: Among already-B0-eligible names, a 'dry pullback' (declining volume into the IBD pivot leg) is a valid continuation signal only when the breakout print itself is volume-confirmed (ibd_entry_volume_ratio above an arm-specific threshold); without that cross-confirmation, the apparent base-pullback looks like distribution rather than accumulation, and the entry is a false-positive ruin even though other IBD/RS gates passed.
evidence_for: False-positive ruins in pullback-history cases (entity_8f0df3d38e: pullback -16.2% / 7wk / vol_ratio_5_20=1.24; entity_ccc90a671f: -14.4% / 7wk / 1.45; entity_55c2da490e: -12.3% / 7wk / 1.27) sit at sub-confirmation entry-volume levels (ibd_entry_volume_ratio cluster 1.2-1.45), whereas the high-weight selected winners with comparable pullbacks (entity_2c58cebc59: -25.1% / 6wk / 1.62; entity_3adc078f01: -42.3% / 9wk / 1.14-1.40 band) carry entry-volume ratios distinctly above the ruin cluster — confirming dry-pullback alone is insufficient.

entity_40ea0cfb3b is the cleanest counter-case: no pullback-leg data, ibd_entry_volume_ratio=0.91, mom_20=0.024, up_day_ratio=0.5, and it is a ruin — showing that when the pullback-volume context is missing the entry-volume ratio itself must carry the gate.
evidence_against: entity_de1c657364 is a large_winner that the piecewise gate would still down-grade (pullback 8wk/-7.3%, vol_ratio_5_20=1.15, entry VR consistent with the sub-confirmation band) — so the rule accepts some left-tail false_negatives in exchange for clearing the ruins.

entity_6618d3e80c shows a 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner' mixed label with pullback=null and high entry VR (1.45) — entry-volume confirmation alone is non-sufficient when mom_20 also elevated (0.251), implying the threshold needs to be arm-conditioned on pullback-v-dry state rather than a single global VR cut.
falsifiable_predictions: Restrict B0 to candidates satisfying (pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= ~1.5) OR (NOT pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= ~1.6 AND ma10_slope_5 > 0); demote the rest within B0 (do NOT add a new eligibility class). Expect ruin-rate on the demoted bucket > 2x the kept bucket on a holdout, while the kept bucket's large_win ratio improves vs unrestricted B0.

Within kept-B0, expect mean ibd_entry_volume_ratio of selected_winners to exceed that of false_positive_ruins by >=0.15 on a frozen-equal-period holdout; failure to detect this gap falsifies the cross-confirmation mechanism.
policy_implications: Encode as a post-B0 ranking/confirmation stage: compute pullback_v_is_dry (pullback-leg median volume < uptrend-leg median volume by a defined ratio) and ibd_entry_volume_ratio, then apply the piecewise cut to demote (not eliminate) candidates — this preserves the B0 universe size and only reorders conviction.

Use this filter as a sanity check before sizing up; candidates that pass the dry-pullback+confirmed-volume arm can carry full B0 weight, while the wet-pullback-or-unconfirmed arm should size at the B1/watchlist level, separating predictive edge from portfolio-construction leverage.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The proposed piecewise threshold is not an independent 'cross-confirmation' signal — it is a redundant, unstable proxy for momentum/extension already captured (and better captured) by up_day_ratio_20 and mom_20. The dry-pullback arm is empirically non-essential: three selected_winners sit at sub-1.0 entry VR (entity_8ad5cd4795 VR=0.996, entity_bec51a4227 VR=1.007, entity_05b4c6b1f7 VR=0.964 — the latter a false_negative_big_winner), which directly falsifies 'VR must exceed ~1.5 for dry-pullback winners'. Meanwhile the no-pullback arm fails on its own terms: entity_84824e6a20 (VR=1.625, ruin) clears the proposed 1.6 floor yet ruins, and entity_b6bcccdf6a (VR=1.31, ruin) sits in a band the rule cannot pin down. The piecewise structure adds degrees of freedom on 14-of-27 null-pullback entities where the rule collapses to a single VR cut with no stable separation.

attacks.issue: Sub-confirmation winners inside the dry-pullback arm falsify the necessity of high VR
attacks.why_it_matters: entity_8ad5cd4795 (pullback -6.7%/5wk, VR=0.996, large_win), entity_bec51a4227 (pullback=null, VR=1.007, large_win), and entity_05b4c6b1f7 (pullback=null, VR=0.964, false_negative_big_winner) all sit below the 1.5 'confirmation' floor. The mechanism claim ('VR must be high for the dry-pullback continuation') is contradicted by these cases — the dry-pullback arm does not require VR >= 1.5 to deliver large_wins.

attacks.issue: The no-pullback arm is empirically unfixed: VR=1.625 still ruins (entity_84824e6a20) while VR=1.31 ruins and VR=1.21 ruins (entity_3472243e0c)
attacks.why_it_matters: If the non-dry / null arm needs a separate VR cut (~1.6), it must reject entity_84824e6a20 — but that case passes at 1.625. The threshold is calibrated to a different feature mix (mom_20, ma10_slope_5) than VR alone, so arm-conditioning on pullback_v_is_dry is doing no independent work.

attacks.issue: ibd_entry_volume_ratio is a proxy for momentum extension, not an independent confirmation signal
attacks.why_it_matters: The strongest univariate separator in the numeric contrasts is up_day_ratio_20 (std_delta=-1.19), not VR (std_delta=-0.50). VR is correlated with mom_20/ma10_slope_5 (entity_b00579f203: VR=1.576, mom=0.230; entity_6618d3e80c: VR=1.445, mom=0.251). A univariate VR threshold plus an extension gate likely subsumes the piecewise structure with fewer parameters and less overfit risk.

attacks.issue: Asymmetric coverage: pullback_v_is_dry is undefined for 14 of 27 entities (pullback_duration_weeks=null)
attacks.why_it_matters: When the conditioning feature is null, the 'piecewise' rule reduces to a single VR cut on the majority subset. With nulls driving the no-pullback arm, the arm-specific threshold is being tuned on a small, possibly non-representative remainder. entity_6618d3e80c's mixed ruin/winner label under null pullback shows the arm inherits label ambiguity without resolving it.

attacks.issue: Sample artifact: snapshot concentration (snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40) and small-N overfitting
attacks.why_it_matters: Five of the 27 cases share snap_71486ed83c and four share snap_d0d57b1e40 — a single market regime may be driving the apparent VR/pullback interaction. With 27 cases and ~20 features, picking two arms and two thresholds (~1.5 / ~1.6) plus a slope condition is a multiple-comparisons hazard; the threshold values look data-tuned rather than theoretically anchored.

attacks.issue: The mechanism claim ('distribution vs accumulation') is unfalsifiable narrative on top of derived ratios
attacks.why_it_matters: pullback_v_is_dry is itself a constructed ratio; the distribution/accumulation story cannot be observed directly. Both winners and ruins can be cast as accumulation-then-distribution or vice versa post-hoc. The mechanistic claim adds rhetorical force but no additional statistical content beyond what the ratios already encode.

counterexamples_to_seek: Holdout cases with dry-pullback state AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio < 1.0 that still large_win (would replicate entity_8ad5cd4795, entity_05b4c6b1f7).
Holdout cases with pullback_v_is_dry=false AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio in [1.5, 1.7] that ruin (would replicate entity_84824e6a20).
Cases where mom_20 < 0.05 and up_day_ratio_20 < 0.5 with VR > 1.5 that are selected_winners — to test whether VR adds anything beyond the existing low-momentum gate.
Snapshot-matched controls: identical pullback depth/duration but VR varying widely — does the cross-confirmation effect persist when duration is held fixed?
what_would_change_my_mind: A frozen out-of-sample test where the piecewise gate improves B0 large_win rate by >5pp versus a univariate VR threshold AND versus a univariate up_day_ratio_20 threshold, with the improvement not collapsing when restricted to the null-pullback subset.

A demonstration that, conditional on (mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, ma10_slope_5) being matched, the pullback_v_is_dry × ibd_entry_volume_ratio interaction still carries an independent <5% p-value on ruin rate.
Evidence that pullback_v_is_dry is well-defined and stable across snapshots for the 14 currently-null entities, and that arm reclassification moves ruin rate materially in either direction.
A negative-result replication of entity_84824e6a20-style ruins clearing the 1.6 floor in a different market regime, to show the proposed threshold is not a snapshot artifact.

tests.name: piecewise_cross_confirmation_interaction
tests.comparison: Within the fixed three-way accounting of dry pullback with high entry volume, dry pullback with low entry volume, and non-dry pullback, compare the held-out B0-eligible candidates. Treat high entry volume as ibd_entry_volume_ratio at or above 1.5 and low entry volume as below 1.5; do not alter the B0 universe.
tests.success_criterion: The dry-plus-high-volume group has a lower failure rate and a higher large-win rate than the dry-plus-low-volume group, and the interaction improvement is reproducible after accounting for the non-dry group.
tests.failure_criterion: The dry-plus-high-volume group fails to improve either metric by more than 5 percentage points over dry-plus-low-volume, or the apparent interaction disappears in a frozen holdout.

tests.name: null_pullback_sensitivity
tests.comparison: Replicate the piecewise test while treating null pullback_v_is_dry as a third fixed accounting slot rather than imputing it as dry or non-dry. Compare the null-pulled-back subgroup with the dry and non-dry slots using the same B0 population.
tests.success_criterion: The direction of the ibd_entry_volume_ratio effect is stable across null, dry, and non-dry slots, and including the null slot materially changes the ranking of candidates without changing the number of B0-eligible entities.
tests.failure_criterion: The null slot produces unstable or contradictory rank ordering, or any apparent benefit is caused only by null candidates being assigned to one of the other arms.

tests.name: volume_ratio_only_baseline
tests.comparison: Compare the three-slot piecewise rule with a two-level ibd_entry_volume_ratio-only rule, holding the candidate set, measurement timing, and all non-feature eligibility conditions fixed. This tests whether the pullback state contributes information beyond entry-volume ratio alone.
tests.success_criterion: The piecewise rule improves the B0 large-win rate or reduces ruin by more than 5 percentage points relative to the ibd_entry_volume_ratio-only baseline, with consistent direction across dry and non-dry candidates.
tests.failure_criterion: The piecewise rule does not outperform the volume-ratio-only baseline, or its gain is smaller than the prespecified 5-percentage-point threshold and is not supported across the relevant slots.

leakage_checks: Verify that both PIT features are measured at or before the B0 eligibility decision time and that no future W4, outcome, return, or survival information enters either feature.
Verify that threshold evaluation does not change the B0 eligible universe; all comparisons use the same frozen B0 candidate set.
Treat null pullback_v_is_dry as an explicit third accounting slot and report its prevalence, rather than silently assigning nulls to dry or non-dry states.
Audit snapshot and temporal concentration, and require replication on a frozen holdout from a different period before accepting the interaction.
Exclude ticker identity, calendar identity, and any feature derived from outer-forward outcomes from the tests.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: There is partial support for an interaction in which a dry pullback (pullback-leg median volume below uptrend-leg median) is a continuation signal only when the breakout print itself is volume-confirmed by ibd_entry_volume_ratio above an arm-specific threshold. The ruins-with-pullback cluster (entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_ccc90a671f, entity_55c2da490e) does sit in a 1.2-1.45 VR band that is sub-confirmation, and a comparable large winner (entity_2c58cebc59: -25.1%/6wk) sits at VR=1.62. However, the interaction is not robust: (a) three pullback-context winners sit below any reasonable VR floor (entity_8ad5cd4795 VR=0.996, entity_bec51a4227 VR=1.007, entity_05b4c6b1f7 VR=0.964 — the latter a false_negative_big_winner), (b) the no-pullback arm is empirically unfixed (entity_84824e6a20 VR=1.625 ruins), and (c) pullback_v_is_dry is undefined for 14 of 27 entities, so on 52% of the candidate set the 'piecewise' structure collapses to a single VR cut on a minority remainder. The mechanism is therefore better described as: VR below ~1.3 inside a pullback-leg is a soft warning of distribution, but VR does not independently carry the cross-confirmation role — it is correlated with mom_20, ma10_slope_5, and up_day_ratio_20, which are the strongest univariate separators in the contrast table.
falsifiers: On a frozen out-of-sample period that is not snap_71486ed83c- or snap_d0d57b1e40-dominated, the dry-pullback+high-VR arm does not improve B0 large-win rate by >5 percentage points over an up_day_ratio_20 (>=0.55) + mom_20 (>=0.10) baseline — showing the piecewise adds no independent information over already-available momentum features.

When the test is restricted to the 14 null-pullback entities, a univariate ibd_entry_volume_ratio cut (e.g. >=1.5) produces the same ruin/large-win separation as the full piecewise rule applied to the remaining 13 entities — meaning the arm-conditioning is doing no work and the rule is effectively univariate VR on the full universe.

Within the dry-pullback arm on holdout, mean VR of selected_winners fails to exceed mean VR of false_positive_ruins by >=0.15 (the researcher's stated falsifiable prediction) — directly falsifying the cross-confirmation necessity claim.

A matched-pairs test that holds pullback depth and duration fixed while varying VR shows no ruin-rate gradient within either arm — falsifying the volume-confirmation mechanism as opposed to a depth/duration effect.

Cross-snapshot replication in a different regime (e.g. snap_b8420124eb or snap_3fc4068e83 isolated, not pooled with snap_71486ed83c) reverses the sign of the VR effect inside the dry-pullback arm — indicating snapshot artifact rather than mechanism.

Cases like entity_84824e6a20 (no-pullback, VR=1.625, ruin) replicate at >30% frequency in the next 50 B0 candidates with no-pullback state and VR in [1.5,1.7], showing the non-dry arm threshold is not stable.
actionable_design_principles: Encode the rule strictly as a post-B0 ranking/confirmation stage; never let pullback_v_is_dry or ibd_entry_volume_ratio add a new entity to the B0 eligible universe. This satisfies the no-universe-expansion constraint by construction.

Treat the piecewise structure as two separate filters joined by OR with explicit null handling: (i) pullback_v_is_dry=true AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= some-arm-threshold -> full B0 conviction; (ii) pullback_v_is_dry=false AND [ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= some-other-threshold AND ma10_slope_5 > 0] -> full B0 conviction; (iii) pullback_v_is_dry=null -> apply a single conservative VR cut (e.g. >=1.5) with mom_20 and up_day_ratio_20 jointly gating; (iv) everyone else -> demoted to B1/watchlist tier. Demotion, not elimination, preserves universe size.
