Anchor the dry-pullback VR threshold near 1.5 (the empirical ruins-with-pullback cluster sits at 1.2-1.45; large-winners cluster at 1.6+), but do not lock the threshold until the volume_ratio_only_baseline test in the experimental designer's plan shows >=5pp improvement AND the null-arm sensitivity test shows the same direction on the 14 null entities.

Because VR is correlated with mom_20 and up_day_ratio_20 (the strongest contrast features), do not run the piecewise rule without also computing its incremental value over a mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 baseline. If mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 alone matches the piecewise separation, the piecewise structure is redundant and should be deprecated.

Separate the predictive gate from position sizing: candidates that pass the dry-pullback+VR-confirmed arm can carry full B0 weight, candidates that fail the arm but still pass a univariate VR cut should be sized at the B1 level. This separates mechanism from portfolio construction and prevents over-weighting a marginal signal.

Do not tune arm thresholds jointly across the 27-case archaeology because snapshot concentration (5 cases in snap_71486ed83c, 4 in snap_d0d57b1e40) and small N (~20 features vs 27 cases) create multiple-comparison overfit risk; require at least one frozen out-of-sample period before adopting thresholds operationally.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_piecewise_volume_confirmation_demote: For each B0-eligible entity, compute pullback_v_is_dry (boolean; null = explicit UNKNOWN state) and ibd_entry_volume_ratio (continuous). Apply the piecewise rule to assign a tier_rank tag (full, half, demoted) within B0; never modify the B0 eligible set. Demoted entities are routed to B1/watchlist behavior at the execution layer.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Unlike a hard filter, this rule preserves the universe size exactly and only reorders conviction. Unlike a single VR threshold, it conditions the VR cut on pullback-leg volume state, which the evidence suggests has weak but non-zero additional information. The null state is a third first-class slot rather than an imputation, which avoids the silent-failure mode where null pullbacks are assigned to the dry or non-dry arm arbitrarily.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Three feature lookups per B0 entity per evaluation, all point-in-time, no joins to forward outcomes. Capacity impact is negligible at typical B0 sizes (dozens to low hundreds of entities); the rule adds at most one boolean and one tier tag to the candidate record. The cost is dominated by the requirement to compute pullback_v_is_dry for entities that currently lack it (14 of 27 in the archaeology), which is a one-time feature-engineering addition rather than a per-decision cost.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_volume_baseline_audit: Alongside any piecewise rule, emit a parallel univariate VR cut (e.g. ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= 1.5) and a momentum baseline (mom_20 >= 0.10 AND up_day_ratio_20 >= 0.55). Track per-tier large-win and ruin counts for all three rules. Promote the piecewise rule to active policy only if it improves B0 large-win rate by >5pp over the better of the two baselines; otherwise default to the simpler rule.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: This is a meta-policy rather than a feature rule: it prevents the piecewise structure from being adopted when a simpler rule dominates. The skeptic's strongest counterclaim is that VR is a proxy for momentum extension; the only way to refute that counterclaim operationally is to require the piecewise rule to beat the momentum baseline on a frozen holdout. Encoding the audit as a DSL-level gate makes the falsification automatic rather than discretionary.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Zero additional feature cost beyond what is already computed for B0 evaluation; the rule is purely a comparison of three existing per-entity tier counts. Operationally it adds one aggregation step per evaluation cycle.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_null_pullback_conservative_arm: When pullback_v_is_dry is UNKNOWN, apply a strict conjunction: require ibd_entry_volume_ratio >= 1.5 AND ma10_slope_5 > 0 AND up_day_ratio_20 >= 0.55 to grant full B0 conviction. Otherwise demote to B1. This isolates the null-state entities from the dry and non-dry arms so that arm-specific thresholds are not contaminated by null classifications.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: The standard naive approach is to treat null pullback as either dry or non-dry by default, which silently biases the arm thresholds. The archaeology shows 14 of 27 entities are null, so the choice of default materially shifts the apparent interaction. By giving null its own conservative arm, this rule separates the question 'does pullback volume matter?' from 'is missing pullback data itself informative?', which is the actual confounding variable in the data.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Same per-entity feature cost as the main piecewise rule; the difference is a single conditional branch. Capacity-neutral.

cycles.question: Explore a interaction term using pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: pullback_v_is_dry functions as a context flag whose sign-flip depends on ibd_entry_volume_ratio: dry-pullback + expanding entry volume = genuine accumulation resolving into continuation; dry-pullback + flat/shrinking entry volume = quiet distribution where the 'calm' is supply being absorbed off-exchange, and the B0 entry is a bull-trap that resolves into the ruin regime.
evidence_for: False_positive_ruin entity_8f0df3d38e had a 7-week -16.2% pullback with vol_ratio_5_20=1.24 (entry volume not expanded) and ruinated despite positive ma10/ma20 slopes; entity_ccc90a671f similar 7-week -14.4% pullback but vol_ratio_5_20=1.45 still ended ruin — consistent with dry-pullback without sufficient entry-volume confirmation. By contrast, winner entity_440e297253 had a 3-week -1.5% pullback paired with vol_ratio_5_20=1.588 (entry volume clearly expanded), and large_win entity_3adc078f01 had a 9-week -42.3% pullback with vol_ratio_5_20=1.14 plus mom_20=0.17.

Numeric contrast: ibd_entry_volume_ratio shows winners median 1.813 vs false_negatives 1.599 (standardized_delta -0.50), confirming entry-volume expansion is a discriminating axis that is missing in missed-winners, while pullback features alone (duration, pct) have weaker/mixed deltas, supporting that the interaction — not either term in isolation — carries the signal.
evidence_against: Winner entity_b00579f203 and entity_6618d3e80c succeeded with null pullback fields (no pullback setup at all), so the interaction only describes a subset regime and should not be applied as a hard requirement to every B0 candidate. Deep-pullback winner entity_3adc078f01 (-42.3%) shows that extreme pullback_pct can still resolve bullishly, implying pullback_v_is_dry may be mis-specified (or 'dry' is not just low-volume but also bounded-depth) — risk of encoding on a mislabeled binary.

Some false_positive_ruin cases (entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_3472243e0c, entity_84824e6a20, entity_b6bcccdf6a) have null pullback fields and high entry momentum/mom_20, indicating the dry-pullback×low-volume trap is not the only ruin pathway; the interaction only filters one failure mode.
falsifiable_predictions: Within current B0 picks, conditional ruin rate when pullback_v_is_dry=true AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio<1.3 should be ≥2× the ruin rate when pullback_v_is_dry=true AND ratio≥1.5; FPR parity when pullback_v_is_dry=false. Testable on holdout snapshots.

Applying an interaction veto (demote B0 picks satisfying dry-pullback ∧ low_entry_volume) to historical B0 outputs should reduce false_positive_ruin count by ≥30% while changing selected_winner count by <10%, i.e., the interaction acts as a precision lever without universe expansion.
policy_implications: Encode as a within-B0 modifier, not a new gate: compute interaction term only on tickers already in B0, so eligible universe is unchanged. Use a soft reweight (e.g., rank penalty or hard demote) keyed on (pullback_v_is_dry AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio below adaptive threshold such as 25th-percentile of recent winners).

Because the interaction filters rather than adds, it pairs naturally with the existing numeric-contrast finding that ibd_entry_volume_ratio alone carries a -0.50 standardized delta on false negatives — the interaction amplifies a feature already in the scoring stack rather than introducing a new axis, reducing overfitting risk on the 27-case archaeology sample.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The pullback_v_is_dry × ibd_entry_volume_ratio interaction is an artifact of three confounding layers: (a) ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20 are conflated in the narrative but measure different things (entry-day vol vs. 5/20-day short/long vol ratio), (b) 'dry' is undefined for the substantial subset of B0 picks with null pullback fields, meaning the encoding silently degrades into a NaN-handling rule rather than a real interaction, and (c) the regime where dry-pullback co-occurs with low entry volume is too thin (≤8 false_positive_ruin cases, several of which had null pullbacks anyway) to support a precision claim. The prior mechanism story ('supply absorbed off-exchange') is unfalsifiable narrative, and the n=27 discovery sample provides no held-out evidence that the interaction generalizes beyond the snapshot window it was excavated from.

attacks.issue: Feature conflation: the case examples report vol_ratio_5_20 (5-day vs 20-day volume ratio) while the numeric contrasts cite ibd_entry_volume_ratio (entry-day volume normalized). These are distinct features; the 'evidence' is mixing them as if equivalent, so the interaction claim is built on a proxy variable rather than the named feature.
attacks.why_it_matters: If ibd_entry_volume_ratio measures a single entry-day print vs vol_ratio_5_20 measures a smoothed short/long ratio, the sign-flip mechanism ('expanding entry volume = accumulation') applies only to the latter, not the former. Encoding on ibd_entry_volume_ratio specifically, as the question demands, has no direct support from the shown cases.

attacks.issue: Null pullback fields dominate the false_positive_ruin bucket: entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_3472243e0c, entity_84824e6a20, entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_40ea0cfb3b all have null pullback_pct/pullback_duration_weeks, meaning pullback_v_is_dry is undefined for them — yet they are ruins the interaction is supposedly explaining.
attacks.why_it_matters: Half the false_positive_ruin sample cannot be tagged with the dry flag, so the interaction cannot mechanistically cause these ruins; the residual that CAN be tagged is too small (≤4 cases) to power a precision claim. Encoding the interaction as a soft reweight forces arbitrary NaN handling that effectively decides outcomes for half the universe.

attacks.issue: Direct counterexample to the mechanism: entity_3adc078f01 had a 9-week -42.3% pullback with vol_ratio_5_20=1.14 (low) and mom_20=0.17, which by the dry×low-volume mechanism should be a high-ruin regime, yet it produced large_win. The prior researcher dismisses this as 'extreme depth can still resolve bullishly' — pure special pleading.
attacks.why_it_matters: A single confirmed counterexample in the discovery sample means the interaction's ruin-classification accuracy is <100%; combined with 8 false_positive_ruin cases, the precision of the dry×low rule is bounded above by ~73% on in-sample data, with unknown recall. This is not a 'precision lever' — it is a heuristic with a documented failure in the regime it claims to flag.

attacks.issue: The ibd_entry_volume_ratio contrast has standardized_delta = -0.50, which is the weakest of the top-five numeric contrasts in the archaeology. Combining a weak marginal with a noisy interaction term on n=27 cases is statistically reckless; even a small amount of sample noise flips the sign of the interaction coefficient.
attacks.why_it_matters: With 8 false_positive_ruin cases and ~11 selected_winners, splitting each group by 'dry' (≤4 per cell) gives effective df≈3 per cell. Any conditional comparison has a p-value >0.05 by construction. The 'interaction effect' is not statistically distinguishable from zero in the discovery set.

attacks.issue: Mechanism is unfalsifiable: 'supply absorbed off-exchange' cannot be observed, only inferred post-hoc. The same low-vol data is equally consistent with (a) illiquidity vacuum where buyers also left, (b) institutional dark-pool accumulation, (c) index reconstitution noise. All three produce identical surface features but opposite return implications.
attacks.why_it_matters: Without a stated causal chain that is independently testable (e.g., dark-pool print data, options flow), the mechanism cannot be falsified, which means it also cannot be validated — and encoding it into a scoring stack bakes narrative bias into the model.

attacks.issue: Multi-snapshot confounding: the 27 cases span at least 9 different snapshot IDs (snap_724342c280, snap_287267e812, snap_eb3d8128cc, snap_c7fa0b9bb6, snap_12ebd0d057, snap_71486ed83c, snap_ad495b6705, snap_39b6f2c49e, snap_3fc4068e83, snap_8aa9111909, snap_edaba651c2, snap_d0d57b1e40, snap_01d3e2483b, snap_b8420124eb). Each snapshot is a different market regime; pooling them assumes the interaction is regime-invariant.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the dry×low-volume ruin pattern is concentrated in 1-2 snapshots (e.g., a low-volatility 2017-style regime), the encoding captures a market-regime artifact, not a structural feature of how pullbacks resolve. Out-of-sample, when regimes shift, the interaction reverses sign.

attacks.issue: The constraint 'without expanding B0 eligible universe' is treated as a feature, but it is actually a hard ceiling: a within-B0 modifier can only demote, never promote. The model's recall is bounded by B0 precision; the interaction claim of '≥30% ruin reduction with <10% winner change' is in-sample and cannot be verified without out-of-sample testing.
attacks.why_it_matters: If out-of-sample testing shows the interaction reduces both ruin AND winners by similar amounts, it becomes a uniform down-weight, not a precision lever — net neutral on Sharpe. The within-B0 framing hides this risk.

counterexamples_to_seek: A B0 pick with pullback_v_is_dry=true, ibd_entry_volume_ratio<1.3, that wins (large_win) — this exists already: entity_3adc078f01 is the cleanest case (deep pullback, low short-term vol, large_win). Re-running it through the interaction veto would demote a real winner.

A B0 pick with pullback_v_is_dry=false, ibd_entry_volume_ratio>1.8, that ruins — search the labeled false_positive_ruin set for cases where the interaction flags 'safe' but the outcome is ruin. If found, the interaction has inverse precision in the complement regime.

A B0 pick with null pullback fields AND high ibd_entry_volume_ratio, that ruins — e.g., entity_4fdc3699fd (high ma10_slope, high mom_20, null pullback, ruin). This tests whether the NaN-handling rule silently maps to a different failure mode.

A held-out snapshot (post-discover-train window) where the interaction's predicted ruin set actually underperforms — i.e., the model demotes winners it should have kept. Without this, the claim is unfalsified in-sample only.
Sector/time clustering: are the dry×low-volume ruins concentrated in 1-2 sectors or in a single calendar window? If yes, the interaction is a regime artifact and not a structural B0 modifier.
what_would_change_my_mind: A pre-registered test on ≥2 holdout snapshots (not in the discovery 27) showing that the interaction veto reduces ruin rate by ≥25% while keeping ≥90% of large_wins, with a documented NaN-handling rule for null pullbacks.

A monotonic dose-response: ruin rate should decrease as ibd_entry_volume_ratio increases within the dry-pullback subset across all snapshots, not just the discovery ones. A non-monotonic or single-snapshot effect is regime noise.

An out-of-sample falsification of the alternative mechanisms (illiquidity, dark-pool accumulation) via independent data (e.g., short interest change, options skew, 13F delta) that pins down the supply-absorption story.
A replication of the ibd_entry_volume_ratio median gap (1.813 vs 1.599) on a different cohort where pullback_v_is_dry is fully populated (not null), with a confidence interval that excludes parity.

An explicit ablation showing the interaction term adds precision over a baseline that already includes ibd_entry_volume_ratio as a marginal — if marginal ibd_entry_volume_ratio already captures the signal, the interaction is redundant and just adds overfitting surface.

tests.name: PIT_pre_registered_interaction_with_NaN_stratum
tests.comparison: Within B0-eligible universe only, compute ruin_rate separately for the 3x3 grid: pullback_v_is_dry in {True, False, NaN} x ibd_entry_volume_ratio in {low, mid, high} tertile. NaN pullback must be its OWN row, not pooled with dry=False. Pre-specify the ibd_entry_volume_ratio cut points on discovery data only, then freeze them for holdout.
tests.success_criterion: Within dry=True row, ruin_rate(mid) <= 1.5x ruin_rate(low) and ruin_rate(high) <= 0.5x ruin_rate(low) (monotonic dose-response on entry volume); AND within dry=False row, ruin_rate is FLAT across ratio tertiles (|max-min| <= 5pp), confirming the interaction is conditional not additive.
tests.failure_criterion: Dry=True row is non-monotonic; OR flatness in dry=False is violated (>5pp spread); OR the monotonicity in dry=True disappears when NaN rows are pooled into dry=False (i.e., signal lives only in the NaN-handling artifact).

tests.name: Volume_axis_disambiguation_vs_vol_ratio_5_20
tests.comparison: Within B0 picks with pullback_v_is_dry=True, compute Spearman rank correlation between ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20. Then compute ruin_rate by ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertile AND by vol_ratio_5_20 tertile. If the two features are near-proxies, the named interaction has no unique mechanism.
tests.success_criterion: Spearman(rho) < 0.7 between the two volume features within B0 picks; AND ruin_rate monotonicity under ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertiles is preserved (sign unchanged) within each vol_ratio_5_20 tertile stratum (partialling-out test), proving the named feature adds unique signal.
tests.failure_criterion: Spearman >= 0.7 (named feature is a proxy for the 5/20 ratio already in the stack); OR ruin_rate monotonicity under ibd_entry_volume_ratio flips sign inside at least one vol_ratio_5_20 stratum (the interaction is fully explained by the confounded variable).

leakage_checks: Verify pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio are both stamped at snapshot t using only price/volume data observable at t; reject the test if either field requires post-entry W4 price to compute.
Confirm ibd_entry_volume_ratio is the entry-day normalized volume feature (not a smoothed 5/20 ratio relabeled); reject if the archaeology data shows them as the same column.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The interaction proposes that pullback_v_is_dry is a conditional regime flag whose sign reverses with ibd_entry_volume_ratio: dry-pullback coincident with expanding entry volume implies genuine accumulation resolving into continuation, whereas dry-pullback coincident with flat or shrinking entry volume implies quiet distribution (the 'calm' reflects supply being absorbed off-exchange), so the B0 entry resolves into the ruin regime rather than a continuation base. The likely failure regime is the dry×low-volume quadrant, but this regime is empirically fragile in the discovery archaeology because (a) ibd_entry_volume_ratio is only present as a marginal contrast (delta -0.50, the weakest of the top-tier numeric signals) and not at the case level in the shown data — the per-case examples instead carry vol_ratio_5_20, which is a different axis — and (b) ≥50% of false_positive_ruin cases have null pullback fields, meaning 'dry' is undefined for them and the interaction cannot mechanistically explain those ruins. Net: the interaction is a plausible within-B0 precision lever for a narrow subpopulation, not a general B0 modifier.
falsifiers: On ≥2 holdout snapshots not in the discovery 27, the 3x3 (dry × volume tertile) grid must show ruin_rate monotonic in ibd_entry_volume_ratio within dry=true AND |max-min| ruin_rate ≤ 5pp within dry=false; either failure collapses the conditional-mechanism claim back to additive marginals.

NaN-handling sensitivity: ruin_rate(mid|high) within the NaN pullback stratum must NOT equal ruin_rate(mid|high) within the True stratum — if pooling NaN into dry=false reproduces the same gradient, the signal is the NaN-handling rule, not a true dry×volume interaction.

Spearman(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, vol_ratio_5_20) ≥ 0.70 within B0 picks would prove the named feature is a proxy for the volume axis already in the stack and the interaction is a relabeled version of an existing rule.

Partialling-out test: ruin-rate monotonicity under ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertiles must preserve sign within each vol_ratio_5_20 tertile stratum; sign-flip in any stratum means the interaction is fully explained by the confounded variable.

Replication of the winners-vs-false_negatives ibd_entry_volume_ratio median gap (1.813 vs 1.599) on an out-of-discovery cohort where pullback_v_is_dry is fully populated (not null), with a bootstrap CI excluding parity — otherwise the marginal signal is in-sample noise.

Ablation: a B0 baseline that already includes ibd_entry_volume_ratio as a marginal scoring feature must NOT regain the precision improvement when the interaction term is added; if it does, the interaction adds overfitting surface without new signal.

Entity_3adc078f01-class counterexample replication: any out-of-sample B0 pick satisfying dry=true AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio<1.3 that ends as large_win caps the rule's precision below 100% and forces the encoding to be soft, not hard.
actionable_design_principles: Encode ONLY as a within-B0 rank penalty, never as a hard veto, because (i) the within-B0 ceiling is a demote-only channel and a hard veto can starve the universe if the dry-true subpopulation is small, and (ii) the n=27 discovery sample does not support threshold certainty for a hard cutoff.

Treat null pullback fields as a third explicit stratum, not as 'dry=false' or 'dry=true'. The NaN handling rule is the single largest modeling decision in this feature, and silently pooling NaN into either bucket is what the falsifier #2 is designed to catch.

Stamp both features at snapshot t using only data observable at t (no W4 leakage in pullback_duration_weeks or pullback_pct), and freeze ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertile cut points on discovery data only before touching holdout.

Disambiguate ibd_entry_volume_ratio from vol_ratio_5_20 at the schema level: ibd_entry_volume_ratio is a single entry-day normalized print, vol_ratio_5_20 is a smoothed 5/20-day ratio. They must be computed from disjoint inputs and labeled differently, because the discovery archaeology case-level data shows vol_ratio_5_20, not ibd_entry_volume_ratio, and conflating them is the strongest single point of failure.

Gate activation behind pre-registered monotonic-dose evidence: do not ship the interaction policy until both Experimental Designer tests pass on ≥2 holdout snapshots; in the interim, log the predicted-demote set as a parallel channel without acting on it.

Capacity check before enabling: if the dry=true subpopulation within B0 is <5% of the eligible universe, the policy has near-zero effect on outcomes even if correct — confirm the subpopulation size is large enough to move ruin rate by a detectable amount.

Re-test per regime window: because the discovery 27 cases span ≥14 snapshots, run the 3x3 grid per snapshot and report the interaction coefficient's dispersion; a snapshot-concentrated effect is regime noise, not a structural B0 modifier.

Add an ablation row that scores B0 with ibd_entry_volume_ratio marginal only (no interaction); if marginal-only already captures the precision improvement, the interaction is redundant and should be removed to reduce overfitting surface on a thin sample.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: soft_demote_dry_low_volume_within_b0
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Encodes the interaction as a multiplicative rank penalty inside B0, never as a hard veto and never as a new gate. The penalty is applied only when both pullback_v_is_dry=True AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio is below an adaptive cutoff (default: 25th percentile of recent B0 winners, recomputed per snapshot). Null pullback is an explicit no-op (no penalty, no boost) so the NaN-handling rule is visible in the DSL rather than embedded in a preprocessor.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Low capacity cost: the modifier operates on an already-filtered subset, so the score volume is unchanged. A soft rank penalty preserves the ability to recover in case of falsification, whereas a hard veto would require feature removal and re-backtest.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: dry_volume_stratified_score_audit
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: A read-only DSL audit that materializes the 3x3 grid (pullback_v_is_dry in {True, False, NaN} × ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertile) per snapshot and emits ruin_rate, win_rate, and selection_count for each cell. The audit is the pre-registration harness — the policy that ships is a function of the audit's output, not the other way around.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Zero portfolio impact (audit only); primary capacity is engineering — must compute and freeze ibd_entry_volume_ratio tertile cut points on discovery data only, then propagate to holdout without re-fitting.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: volume_axis_disambiguation_guard
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: A schema-level DSL guard that rejects any rule where ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20 are co-featured in the same scoring expression without an explicit partialling-out term, because the discovery data conflates them and the strongest single confound in this interaction is feature-identity ambiguity. The guard forces the policy author to declare whether the rule acts on entry-day volume or short/long smoothed volume — and rejects the rule if the declaration is inconsistent with feature provenance.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Static-analysis capacity only: zero runtime cost, but it blocks the highest-risk encoding pattern (re-using a feature under a new name without re-testing the mechanism).

cycles.question: Explore a conditional ranking plus adaptive capacity using pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: A pullback whose downside candles print on below-average volume (pullback_v_is_dry = True) is a sign that the prior decline absorbed supply WITHOUT capitulation distribution; when this is combined with an above-average ibd_entry_volume_ratio at the IBD trigger break, the two together identify stocks where institutional accumulation has both (a) cleared overhead supply quietly and (b) re-engaged on the breakout candle. The adaptive capacity comes from treating (pullback_v_is_dry, ibd_entry_volume_ratio) as an interaction, not two independent ranks: dry-pullback + high-entry-volume up-weights, dry-pullback + low-entry-volume or wet-pullback + high-entry-volume down-weights. This is implemented strictly as a WITHIN-B0 conditional re-rank and a position-size scaler on the existing eligible universe.
evidence_for: selected_winners median ibd_entry_volume_ratio = 1.8134 vs false_negative median = 1.5987 (Δ −0.2147, −0.50σ); the selected cohort specifically buys more volume on the breakout day than the rejected-but-profitable cohort.

selected_winners median pullback_duration_weeks = 5.5 with pullback_pct = −15.9% vs false_negative 4.0 weeks and −7.3% depth — false_negatives look like 'shallow, brief dips' rather than true basing, consistent with under-absorbed supply.

Selected_winners show up_day_ratio_20 = 0.625 vs false_negative 0.50 (−1.19σ); a dry pullback that ALSO produced above-random up-day frequency during the base is the constructive pattern archaeology flags.

vol_ratio_5_20 separates winners (1.424) from losers (FN 1.179, Δ −0.245, −1.05σ) — higher recent relative volatility combined with high entry-volume ratio marks the genuine 'volatility-on-the-trigger' pattern.
Mom_20 median 0.163 (winners) vs 0.058 (FN, −1.00σ) supports the model that breakout volume and dry pullback are coincident with restored momentum, not fighting it.
evidence_against: false_positive_ruin cases often have HIGH vol_ratio_5_20 (entity_84824e6a20 = 1.625, entity_ccc90a671f = 1.449, entity_8f0df3d38e = 1.240) yet still ruined — high 'recent relative volume' alone is NOT protective if the pullback was wet or the basing incomplete; the interaction is necessary, not each feature alone.

entity_40ea0cfb3b (false_positive_ruin) has vol_ratio_5_20 = 0.906 (LOW) and mom_20 = 0.024 with a near-flat MA50 (px_vs_ma50 = 0.014) — low-volatility quiet breakouts WITHOUT pullback absorption also fail; rules out a 'dry pullback always rescues' claim.

entity_b00579f203 is a selected_winner with pullback_pct = null and vol_ratio_5_20 = 1.576: high-conviction breakouts with no prior pullback can still work, meaning the conditional only applies to a SUBSET of the B0 universe and must not be turned into a hard filter.

pullback_pct / pullback_duration_weeks are NULL for ~half of both winners and ruins (entities ead73f4390, bec51a4227, 28a6ec4601, etc. — winners without a measured pullback; 4fdc3699fd, 3472243e0c, 84824e6a20, b6bcccdf6a, etc. — ruins without a measured pullback). The conditional cannot be enforced unconditionally; a fallback rule for the 'no-pullback' cohort is required.

False_negative cases with pullback_duration_weeks = 8.0 and pullback_pct = −7.3% (entity_de1c657364) prove LONG + SHALLOW pullbacks can precede big winners — the 'long+deep+high entry-vol' gate must be probabilistic, not deterministic, or it will suppress a known-good archetype.
falsifiable_predictions: Within B0 picks, the bucket (pullback_v_is_dry = True AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.5) will deliver a W4 median return at least 2 percentage points higher than the bucket (pullback_v_is_dry = False AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.5), holding mom_20 and px_vs_ma50 fixed.

Among B0 picks where pullback_pct is NOT null, the ruin rate in the cell (wet pullback AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio < 1.3) will exceed 25%, versus < 10% in the cell (dry pullback AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.5).

Position sizing proportional to ibd_entry_volume_ratio (capped at 2.5x) when pullback_v_is_dry = True will produce a higher Sharpe at the same gross exposure than a binary size step (full vs half), because it preserves participation in low-volume dry-pullback breakouts that the step function would suppress.

If the interaction term (pullback_v_is_dry × ibd_entry_volume_ratio) is added as a secondary rank within B0 (no universe expansion), the top-quartile re-ranked cohort will contain ≥ 60% of the eventual large_winners that the original B0 selection missed (i.e., it recovers some of the false_negative_relative cohort).

A 'no-pullback' fallback that requires ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 2.0 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.4 will reproduce most of the no-pullback winners (e.g., entity_b00579f203 archetype) but will exclude ≥ half of the no-pullback ruins (e.g., entity_84824e6a20, entity_b6bcccdf6a).
policy_implications: Do NOT promote pullback_v_is_dry / ibd_entry_volume_ratio to B0 eligibility gates. Keep B0 membership unchanged and apply the two features as a within-B0 conditional re-rank and a position-size scaler; this directly satisfies the 'no universe expansion' constraint.

Implement a 3×2 contingency table: rows = {pullback_v_is_dry True, False, N/A} × cols = {ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.5, < 1.5}, with a pre-registered action (rank-up, neutral, rank-down, size multiplier 1.0/0.5/0.0) per cell. This makes the conditional encoding auditable and prevents one-off overrides.

Treat pullback_v_is_dry = False with high entry volume as a 'suspicious breakout' (potential blow-off) — assign HALF size and shorter review horizon, not full skip; this preserves the b00579f203 archetype while still hedging.

When pullback data is NULL (no measurable pullback window), fall back to a pure volume-confirmation rule using ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20 only, because a hard gate on pullback_v_is_dry would systematically exclude the 'no-pullback breakout' winners observed in the archaeology.

Adaptive capacity: scale position size by min(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, 2.5) when pullback_v_is_dry = True, but cap at 1.0 when pullback_v_is_dry = False. This exploits the interaction rather than treating features as additive, which the archaeology's low standalone signal of either feature (−0.50σ and −0.58σ) demands.

Add a regime-aware override: in low-volatility market regimes (systemic vol_ratio_5_20 < 1), raise the ibd_entry_volume_ratio threshold by ~0.3 because entity_40ea0cfb3b shows low-vol quiet breakouts can still fail when there is no pullback absorption; this prevents the 'dry-but-anemic' failure mode.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The proposed pullback_v_is_dry × ibd_entry_volume_ratio conditional is functionally a re-labelled vol-targeting/sizing rule whose marginal contribution to within-B0 selection is statistically indistinguishable from zero once one accounts for sample size, the NULL-pullback selection bias, and the features already inside B0; the 'institutional accumulation' narrative is a post-hoc story for a univariate difference whose standardized delta (≈ −0.50σ for ibd_entry_volume_ratio, ≈ −0.58σ for pullback features) lies inside the bootstrapped noise band of a 27-case archaeology dominated by a single snapshot cluster.

attacks.issue: Statistical power collapse across the proposed 3×2 contingency
attacks.why_it_matters: With N=27 split across 3 row states (dry / wet / NULL) × 2 column states (entry-vol ≥1.5 / <1.5) = 6 cells, expected cell sizes are 1–8 cases. The researcher claims a 'pre-registered action per cell' but with these counts each cell's outcome distribution is dominated by 0/1 outcomes (e.g., the only NULL-pullback ruin with vol_ratio_5_20 ≥1.4 — entity_3472243e0c — would single-handedly define the 'no-pullback fallback' policy). The 3×2 table is overfitting architecture, not auditable signal.

attacks.issue: Selection bias from conditioning pullback_v_is_dry on a non-random subset
attacks.why_it_matters: pullback_v_is_dry is only defined when pullback_pct is non-null. ~50% of B0 picks (entities ead73f4390, 4fdc3699fd, 3472243e0c, 84824e6a20, b6bcccdf6a, 6618d3e80c, 90a828939a, b00579f203, bec51a4227, d2ca7853ba, 40ea0cfb3b, 28a6ec4601, ad2bfdee3f, 05b4c6b1f7, etc.) are excluded from the dry/wet partition by construction. The 'fallback' for this cohort is a pure ibd_entry_volume_ratio + vol_ratio_5_20 rule — which means the conditional is silently reduced to a univariate volume rule on the larger subsample, and the dry-pullback signal is being asked to do work on a non-random 50% slice of the data where the failure mode (no measured basing) is structurally different.

attacks.issue: Internal contradiction in the recovery claim
attacks.why_it_matters: Falsifiable prediction #4 asserts the re-rank will 'recover ≥60% of false_negative_relative large_winners,' yet the same researcher's evidence_for states 'false_negatives look like shallow, brief dips.' entity_de1c657364 (the false_negative_big_winner archetype: pullback_duration_weeks=8, pullback_pct=−7.3%) is the canonical shallow-but-winning case. A conditional that up-weights deep, dry pullbacks cannot simultaneously down-rank shallow pullbacks AND recover a shallow-pullback winner. The two claims are mutually exclusive; the researcher is hedging by talking about 'probabilistic' gates without specifying the threshold that resolves the contradiction.

attacks.issue: Deep-pullback counterexamples directly within the archaeology
attacks.why_it_matters: entity_ccc90a671f (pullback_pct=−14.4%, ruin), entity_55c2da490e (pullback_pct=−12.3%, ruin), entity_8f0df3d38e (pullback_pct=−16.2%, false_positive_ruin) all sit in the 'deep + has-measured-pullback' regime — the very cells the researcher claims should be up-weighted. The mechanism story ('deep pullback on dry volume = supply absorption') cannot explain why three of the eight ruins come from exactly this archetype. The 'dry' qualifier is doing all the work, but vol_ratio_5_20 does not reliably distinguish these ruins from winners (ccc90a671f=1.449 vs winner 440e297253=1.588 — winners have HIGHER recent relative vol than this ruin).

attacks.issue: ibd_entry_volume_ratio is a proxy already partially captured by existing B0 features
attacks.why_it_matters: px_vs_ma50 (winners 0.127 vs FN 0.056, −0.85σ), mom_20 (−1.00σ), and vol_ratio_5_20 (−1.05σ) are all in the existing B0 stack and move in the same direction as ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Adding ibd_entry_volume_ratio as an independent within-B0 rank risks double-counting a signal already priced into B0; the 'incremental Sharpe' after orthogonalisation is plausibly zero. The researcher has not shown partial-correlation or Shapley decomposition evidence.

attacks.issue: Position-size scaler is vol-targeting in disguise, not signal
attacks.why_it_matters: Scaling position by min(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, 2.5) is approximately scaling by the breakout day's volume relative to a baseline. High-volume breakouts have wider intraday ranges; equal-dollar positions are therefore smaller-vol positions. Any standard vol-targeting scheme (risk-parity, ATR-scaling) already does this. The claim that this scaler improves Sharpe 'at the same gross exposure' is therefore either tautological or under-specified — the relevant comparison is Sharpe at the same RISK exposure, where the scaler may add nothing.

attacks.issue: Cluster/multi-snapshot contamination of the 27-case count
attacks.why_it_matters: snap_71486ed83c contributes 6 of 27 cases; if the same entities appear across multiple snapshots, the effective N is smaller than 27 and the median contrasts are computed on partially overlapping observations. The 'standardized_delta' values in numeric_contrasts assume i.i.d. sampling; with snapshot clusters, the effective degrees of freedom are reduced and the deltas reported (−0.50σ, −0.58σ) may not clear a multi-comparison-corrected significance bar.

attacks.issue: Mixed-outcome case refutes the high-vol+high-entry-vol cell
attacks.why_it_matters: entity_6618d3e80c is dual-labelled false_positive_ruin|selected_winner with vol_ratio_5_20=1.446 and high entry metrics — the prototype 'volatility-on-the-trigger' pattern the researcher claims is constructive. If the same feature vector produces both ruin and winner outcomes, the cell-level action cannot be a single multiplier; the researcher's 'shorter review horizon + half size' patch is a hand-wave that does not solve the underlying signal-to-noise problem.

attacks.issue: The 'regime-aware override' is unfalsifiable post-hoc policy
attacks.why_it_matters: Adding 'in low-vol regimes raise the threshold by 0.3' without archaeological evidence on cross-sectional regime interactions is exactly the kind of policy patch that looks rigorous but is unconstrained by the frozen evidence. entity_40ea0cfb3b (low-vol, low-vol-ratio ruin) is a single case being used to justify an entire regime-conditional layer.

attacks.issue: The 'institutional accumulation' mechanism is a narrative, not a tested transmission
attacks.why_it_matters: No footprint data (13F, block trades, dark-pool prints, ETF creations) is in the archaeology; the 'supply absorption without capitulation' story cannot be distinguished from half a dozen equally plausible alternative stories (mean-reversion from oversold, short-covering, sector rotation, options-dealer hedging). The researcher treats a stylized mechanism as load-bearing, but the frozen evidence is purely correlational on price/volume aggregates.

counterexamples_to_seek: A B0 pick with pullback_v_is_dry=True AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.5 that nonetheless produced a ruin — would prove the cell is not constructive on its own terms (look for vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.4 AND deep pullback_pct ≤ −15%, e.g., the entity_ccc90a671f / 55c2da490e archetype where vol_ratio_5_20 ≈ 1.27–1.45).

A false_negative_relative case with pullback_v_is_dry=True AND ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 1.8 — would show the rule should have caught it, but if no such case exists in the archaeology, the recovery claim fails.

A no-pullback (NULL pullback_pct) B0 pick with low ibd_entry_volume_ratio (<1.2) that nonetheless was a large_winner — would expose the 'fallback' rule as over-aggressive on the no-pullback cohort (entity_90a828939a with vol_ratio_5_20=1.402 is borderline; need a cleaner low-entry-vol winner).

A pair of B0 picks in the same sector and snapshot, matched on mom_20, px_vs_ma50, and vol_ratio_5_20, differing ONLY in pullback_v_is_dry status, where outcomes are identical — would refute the conditional as a within-B0 discriminator once matched on existing features.

A bootstrap of the 27-case archaeology (resampling at the snapshot level) showing that the median contrast for ibd_entry_volume_ratio has a 95% CI that crosses zero — would push the claim to UNRESOLVED.

A counterfactual: run the existing B0 rank with and without the proposed re-rank on the same archaeology; show the re-rank's incremental lift in hit-rate on large_winners is ≤ the lift from random reshuffling within B0.

An out-of-time test: pull a fresh snapshot not in the frozen evidence, compute pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio, and show the conditional cell ranking matches or underperforms a vol-targeting-only baseline.
what_would_change_my_mind: A partial-correlation or Shapley analysis on the archaeology showing ibd_entry_volume_ratio contributes ≥5% incremental rank-IC after B0's existing features are conditioned on — currently absent from the evidence.

Bootstrap CIs (resampling at the snapshot level, not the case level) that exclude zero for the within-cell win-rate differential between (dry, high-entry-vol) and (wet, high-entry-vol) cells — i.e., the interaction term is statistically credibly non-zero, not just a point estimate from 27 cases.

Evidence that the proposed 3×2 cell actions produce monotonic ordering of ruin rates: rank-up cell ruin rate < neutral < rank-down cell, with ≥ 2× separation and each cell containing ≥ 5 independent observations.

A demonstration that scaling position size by ibd_entry_volume_ratio improves Sharpe vs an ATR-14 vol-targeting baseline at the SAME risk budget (not the same gross exposure) — this would prove the scaler is signal, not risk management.

A mechanism test: footprint / Level-2 / options-OI data showing actual institutional accumulation patterns consistent with the 'supply absorption without capitulation' narrative in the cells the rule up-weights; absence of such evidence reduces the mechanism to a story.

An out-of-sample snapshot (not in the frozen evidence) showing the recovery rate on false_negative_relative large_winners is ≥ 60% as predicted, and the ruin rate in the (wet, low-entry-vol) cell exceeds 25% as predicted — currently the falsifiable predictions are untested within the available archaeology.
Replication of the signal across at least 3 distinct snapshot clusters (not just snap_71486ed83c which contributes 6/27 cases) with consistent cell-level ruin-rate ordering.

tests.name: T1_incremental_rank_IC_orthogonality
tests.comparison: Within B0 picks, compute Spearman rank-IC of ibd_entry_volume_ratio with w4_return after partialling out mom_20, px_vs_ma50, and vol_ratio_5_20 via OLS residuals, vs the unadjusted rank-IC of each of those three B0 features. Snapshot-level bootstrap (cluster on snapshot_anon, n=27 cases across observed snapshots) supplies the 95% CI.
tests.success_criterion: Partial rank-IC of ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 0.10 AND its bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero, AND its absolute value ≥ 50% of the largest unadjusted |rank-IC| among mom_20, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20 (proves it adds signal beyond what B0 already prices).
tests.failure_criterion: Partial rank-IC bootstrap CI crosses zero OR |partial IC| < 25% of best B0 feature → returns UNRESOLVED on mechanism A vs double-counting.

tests.name: T2_collapsed_3cell_ruin_monotonicity
tests.comparison: Collapse the proposed 3×2 contingency into 3 pre-registered cells using a single split on ibd_entry_volume_ratio at 1.5 AND pullback_v_is_dry restricted to non-NULL pullback cohort: Cell-A = dry ∧ entry_vol≥1.5 (up-weight), Cell-B = dry ∧ entry_vol<1.5 OR wet ∧ entry_vol≥1.5 (neutral), Cell-C = wet ∧ entry_vol<1.5 (down-weight). Compute ruin_rate per cell on the pullback-defined cohort only. Snapshot-cluster bootstrap provides CI.
tests.success_criterion: ruin_rate(Cell-A) < ruin_rate(Cell-B) < ruin_rate(Cell-C) with monotonic ordering AND ≥2× separation between A and C AND each cell ≥4 independent cases. Confirms interaction, not additive features.
tests.failure_criterion: Non-monotonic ordering OR A-vs-C separation <1.5× OR any cell <3 cases → interaction hypothesis UNRESOLVED; supports skeptic's 'noise on small N' attack.

tests.name: T3_scaler_vs_ATR_vol_targeting
tests.comparison: Within B0 picks, construct two position-size schemes at equal RISK budget (not gross): (i) size ∝ min(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, 2.5) when pullback_v_is_dry=True, 1.0 otherwise (researcher's proposal); (ii) size ∝ 1/atr_14_pct (pure ATR vol-targeting baseline). Compute w4 Sharpe of the equal-weighted B0 portfolio re-weighted by each scheme on the archaeology cases. Snapshot-level bootstrap CI on Sharpe difference.
tests.success_criterion: Sharpe(scheme-i) − Sharpe(scheme-ii) ≥ 0.10 with bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero → scaler is signal, not risk management.
tests.failure_criterion: CI crosses zero OR Sharpe difference <0.05 → scaler is functionally vol-targeting; UNRESOLVED between mechanism A and skeptic's risk-management-in-disguise claim.

leakage_checks: Confirm ibd_entry_volume_ratio, pullback_v_is_dry, pullback_pct, pullback_duration_weeks are computed using only data ≤ snapshot_anon timestamp; reject any construction that uses w4_return or outcome_label in feature derivation.

Cluster-bootstrap at snapshot_anon level (not case level) for all CIs because snap_71486ed83c contributes ~22% of cases and entity_6618d3e80c carries dual labels — case-level resampling would over-state significance.
Exclude entity_6618d3e80c (mixed false_positive_ruin|selected_winner) from cell-monotonicity numerators; report it only in a robustness appendix to prevent label-arbitrage bias.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The hypothesized transmission is that pullback_v_is_dry=True marks downside candles printing on below-average volume (i.e., decline absorbed supply without capitulation distribution), and ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ ~1.5 marks institutional re-engagement on the breakout candle. As an INTERACTION the economic story is coherent: a quieter-during-decline + louder-on-breakout pattern fits an accumulation narrative. As two independent additive ranks the story fails redundancy because the standing B0 stack already prices generic volume (vol_ratio_5_20, Δ −1.05σ), momentum (mom_20, Δ −1.00σ) and relative strength (px_vs_ma50, Δ −0.85σ), and ibd_entry_volume_ratio is a shorter-window, same-family volume ratio that is almost certainly collinear with vol_ratio_5_20. Separately, pullback_v_is_dry is undefined for ~50% of the archaeology (no measured basing window), so the conditional is asked to discriminate only on a non-random subset; the NULL-pullback cohort is a different statistical population and any conditional implementation requires an explicit fallback branch for it. Three deep-pullback false-positive ruins in the archaeology (ccc90a671f −14.4%, 55c2da490e −12.3%, 8f0df3d38e −16.2%) sit inside the very 'deep + has-measured-pullback' regime and must be reconciled before claiming 'dry-pullback rescues.' The position-size scaler (size ∝ min(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, 2.5) when dry) is partially vol-targeting by construction and must be benchmarked against an ATR-risk-parity alternative at equal risk budget, not equal gross exposure. Until the three Tier-1 experiments (T1 partial rank-IC, T2 collapsed-3-cell monotonicity, T3 scaler-vs-ATR Sharpe) clear their pre-registered bars, the interaction is a plausible-but-untested story rather than a confirmed signal.
falsifiers: T1 result: partial rank-IC of ibd_entry_volume_ratio (after partialling out mom_20, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20 via OLS residuals) has bootstrap 95% CI (snapshot-cluster, n=27, cluster=snapshot_anon) crossing zero OR |IC| < 25% of the strongest unadjusted feature → mechanism is double-counting, not incremental.

T2 result: ruin_rate(Cell-A: dry ∧ entry_vol≥1.5) NOT strictly less than ruin_rate(Cell-B) < ruin_rate(Cell-C: wet ∧ entry_vol<1.5), OR A-vs-C separation < 1.5×, OR any cell < 4 independent cases → the interaction hypothesis is undecidable on this N; collapse to additive or fall back to a single feature.

T3 result: Sharpe(scheme-i) − Sharpe(scheme-ii) with bootstrap CI excluding zero fails to reach 0.10 → the position scaler is functionally ATR-vol-targeting and provides no incremental rank-alpha to the B0 portfolio; reject size-scaling branch of policy.

Reconciliation test: the three deep-pullback false-positive ruins (ccc90a671f, 55c2da490e, 8f0df3d38e) MUST be re-explainable under the proposed 3×2 contingency as 'wet pullback' (pullback_v_is_dry=False) with ibd_entry_volume_ratio < 1.5, otherwise the up-weight on 'deep + dry' is in-sample overfit to the winners alone.

Sensitivity test on the no-pullback (NULL pullback_pct) cohort: the proposed fallback rule (ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 2.0 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.4) must separate no-pullback winners (entity_b00579f203 archetype) from no-pullback ruins (84824e6a20, b6bcccdf6a, 4fdc3699fd) at hit-rate ≥ 70%; otherwise the NULL branch is unreliable and cannot be silently folded into B0.

Multiplicity test: bootstrap the entire 27-case archaeology with snapshot-cluster resampling (excluding entity_6618d3e80c from cell numerators per leakage check); if the −0.50σ median delta on ibd_entry_volume_ratio loses significance after Benjamini-Hochberg correction at q=0.10 across the 5 reported features, the standalone signal is not robust enough to be load-bearing in policy.
actionable_design_principles: Never expand the B0 eligible universe: any use of pullback_v_is_dry and ibd_entry_volume_ratio must be implemented as a within-B0 conditional re-rank AND/OR a position-size scaler; gating B0 membership on either feature violates the directional constraint and re-introduces the false_negative_relative suppression the B0 design explicitly forbids.

Separate predictive mechanism from construction effect: the rank-score branch and the size-multiplier branch must each be evaluated against distinct baselines (vs unadjusted B0 rank for the rank branch; vs ATR-risk-parity at equal dollar-vol for the size branch) and must not be justified on the same evidence.

Treat the no-pullback (NULL pullback_pct) cohort as a separate statistical population with its own fallback rule and its own archaeology; do not silently reduce the policy to a univariate ibd_entry_volume_ratio rule on the larger subsample, because doing so buries the selection bias and overstates the dry-pullback signal.

Pre-register the contingency and the cell-action map before seeing test outcomes; forbid cell actions keyed to single cases (e.g., the entity_3472243e0c NULL-pullback ruin and the entity_6618d3e80c dual-label entity should not be allowed to define policies on their own).

Make every conditional auditable from raw inputs at evaluation time: pullback_v_is_dry, ibd_entry_volume_ratio, mom_20, px_vs_ma50, vol_ratio_5_20 must be reproducible from data ≤ snapshot_anon timestamp without using w4_return or outcome_label in any derivation step; pin the snapshot and lock the cluster-bootstrap seed.

Distinguish vol-targeting from signal in the size branch: the scaler's lift must be measured at equal expected dollar-volatility (not equal gross), and the test must include an ATR-vol-targeting baseline as an explicit comparator; otherwise the policy is vol-targeting in disguise and adds no alpha.

Keep the regime-aware override (vol_ratio_5_20 < 1 → raise ibd_entry_volume_ratio threshold by ~0.3) out of any pre-registered policy until the archaeological evidence supports cross-sectional regime interactions; a single-case justification (entity_40ea0cfb3b) does not license an entire regime layer.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Within-B0 interaction re-rank: compute score_plus = base_b0_score + α · pullback_v_is_dry · max(0, ibd_entry_volume_ratio − 1.5), with α tuned via cross-validated rank-IC on snapshot-cluster bootstrap; apply ONLY when pullback_pct is non-null. Universe size equals |B0|; this is a strict re-rank, not a filter.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Encodes the interaction as a single penalty/reward term rather than as two additive linear ranks, addressing the researcher's claim that the signal lives in the conditioning; keeps B0 membership identical; is inauditable-free because α is fit on a frozen snapshot and evaluated out-of-sample.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Adaptive capacity enters only through the interaction term scaling with entry-volume; flattening α → 0 recovers vanilla B0, so the policy is continuously tunable and the lift is bounded by the conditional signal alone, not by universe expansion.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Position-size scaler with risk-budget neutrality: size = risk_budget / (atr_14_pct · (1 − β · max(0, 1.5 − ibd_entry_volume_ratio))), with β > 0 only when pullback_v_is_dry=True; the multiplier on entry-volume is bounded by cap (≤2.5) and falls to 1.0 when pullback_v_is_dry=False. Compare to ATR-vol-only baseline at equal risk budget, not equal gross.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Decouples the scaler from gross-dollar equivalence and explicitly isolates the conditional term (β); requires a Sharpe difference ≥ 0.10 against the ATR baseline (T3) to be promoted, which is the only way to tell signal from vol-targeting.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: This IS the adaptive-capacity branch of the policy — it scales risk up on dry-pullback + high-entry-volume breakouts where the interaction predicts constructive follow-through, and trims risk otherwise; it does not change the eligible set, only the per-name risk contribution.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: NULL-pullback fallback branch: when pullback_pct IS null, replace the interaction re-rank with a two-feature gate: keep B0 pick iff ibd_entry_volume_ratio ≥ 2.0 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ≥ 1.4; otherwise route to a 'review bucket' (full size but earlier review horizon) rather than an automatic drop. The fallback is a SEPARATE policy branch with its own archaeology audit, not a silent fuse into the dry-pullback rule.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Forces explicit treatment of the ~50% NULL cohort as a distinct statistical population, addressing the skeptic's selection-bias attack; uses two volume-family features jointly to reduce single-feature overfit; routes ambiguous cases to review rather than exclusion, which is the only honest policy when the archaeological evidence on no-pullback winners and no-pullback ruins is balanced.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity here is binary per name (full vs review-bucket); it is intentionally NOT a continuous scaler because the no-pullback cohort has too few cases to estimate a continuous response curve, and pretending otherwise would manufacture precision the data cannot support.

cycles.question: Explore a piecewise threshold using base_depth_pct and mom_20. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: Within the B0 universe, base_depth_pct and mom_20 interact: in shallow bases (base_depth_pct > -25%), elevated mom_20 (>0.15) flags a parabolic extension prone to ruin, while in deep bases (<-30%) the same momentum reflects a legitimate breakout; low momentum (<0.05) is also destructive in shallow bases due to insufficient demand.
evidence_for: Three ruin cases (mom_20=0.176, 0.185, 0.242) coexist with winners at similar momentum (0.230, 0.320), showing momentum alone is not protective and base context differentiates them; selected winners with very low mom_20 (0.004, -0.008, 0.036) align with the deeper pullback median (-15.9%) vs false-negative (-7.3%), supporting base depth substituting for momentum.
evidence_against: Standardized delta for base_depth_pct between selected and false-negative is only 0.19, a weak univariate signal, so the mechanism depends on an interaction that may be unstable given n=27 archaeology cases; entity_6618d3e80c (mom_20=0.251) carries both ruin and winner labels, showing even conditional rules will misclassify some parabolic runners.
falsifiable_predictions: In a held-out B0 cohort, ruin rate for the subset (mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct>-25%) will exceed 50%, while (mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct<-30%) will be below 20%.
A logistic model adding a piecewise indicator I(base_depth_pct<-30%) or interaction mom_20*base_depth_pct will raise ruin-classification AUC by >=0.05 over a mom_20-only baseline.
policy_implications: Encode as an internal B0 re-ranking filter: reject candidate if (mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct>-25%) OR (mom_20<0.05 AND base_depth_pct>-25%); otherwise accept, with deep-base names (<-30%) passing on any mom_20>0. This tightens selection without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The apparent base_depth_pct–mom_20 interaction is probably a small-sample, correlated-variable artifact rather than a stable threshold. Elevated mom_20 partly remeasures MA10_slope_5, MA20_slope_5, px_vs_ma20, and low volatility; shallow-base status may merely identify mature or structurally different patterns. Label contamination and multiple outcome definitions further weaken the proposed ruination mechanism.

attacks.issue: Proxy and conditioning effects
attacks.why_it_matters: The proposed cutoff treats mom_20 as locally authoritative, but false-negative cases differ most clearly from winners in up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, and moving-average slope. If these variables explain outcomes after controlling for the threshold, adding mom_20 or base_depth_pct should produce little incremental gain. Estimated predictions such as >50% ruin or <20% ruin are unsupported and are probably statistically unstable at this sample size.

attacks.issue: Selection, censoring, and label ambiguity
attacks.why_it_matters: The archaeology is not an independent cohort of B0 candidates: labels are defined relative to other B0 picks, and null pullback fields indicate informative censoring. One entity has both false_positive_ruin and selected_winner labels, directly violating a clean binary separation. Thus threshold validation must use pre-specified prospective B0 cohorts, not these discovery-selected errors.

counterexamples_to_seek: B0 names with mom_20>0.15 and base_depth_pct>-25% that are selected winners despite weak MA slopes or low volume; these would show the rule rejects recoverable extensions rather than only parabolic ruinations.
Deep-base B0 names (base_depth_pct<-30%) with high mom_20 and slope, volume, or volatility profiles matching shallow-base ruinations; these would indicate base depth is an unreliable moderator.
what_would_change_my_mind: A temporally held-out, universe-fixed B0 sample showing incremental improvement from a prespecified deep-vs-shallow threshold after including MA slopes, breadth, and volatility, with confidence intervals excluding zero and stable cutoffs across splits.

tests.name: T1_pre_specified_piecewise_ruin_rate_in_held_out_B0
tests.comparison: Within a temporally held-out B0-eligible cohort (snap_03cf_split held fixed before archaeology), compute ruin rate (w4_return_bucket == 'ruin' or w4_return_bucket == 'loss') for the pre-specified reject set A = {mom_20 > 0.15 AND base_depth_pct > -25%} and the pre-specified accept set B = {mom_20 > 0.15 AND base_depth_pct < -30%}. Apply identical B0 slot accounting (top-3 by base ranking) before and after the filter; do not enlarge the candidate pool.
tests.success_criterion: Ruin rate(A) >= 0.50 AND ruin rate(B) <= 0.20, AND both rates differ by >= 0.30 absolute, AND accept-set B contains >= 50% of snapshot's w4_return_bucket == 'large_win' mass among the original B0 slot-3 candidates.
tests.failure_criterion: Either rate contrast < 0.20 absolute, OR ruin rate(B) >= 0.30, OR 'large_win' retention in B drops below 30% of original slot-3 'large_win' count.

tests.name: T2_proxy_discrimination_vs_slopes_and_volatility
tests.comparison: Fit on discovery archaeology cases only (excluding held-out split from T1): fit a logistic regression (a) mom_20-only baseline, (b) slopes+volatility model using {ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20}, (c) full model adding mom_20, base_depth_pct, and the pre-specified interaction I(mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct>-25%). Compare AUC on the held-out split. Run bootstrap (B=200) within archaeology cases to estimate CI; pre-specify that adding the interaction must improve held-out AUC by >= 0.05 over the slopes+volatility model with CI lower bound > 0.
tests.success_criterion: AUC(full) - AUC(slopes+volatility) >= 0.05 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0; equivalently, the interaction term's coefficient in the full model has sign matching piecewise claim and p < 0.10 on the held-out split.
tests.failure_criterion: AUC improvement < 0.03, OR slopes+volatility model alone reaches within 0.02 AUC of full model, OR interaction coefficient flips sign across bootstrap resamples.

tests.name: T3_pure_mom_20_additive_null_vs_interaction
tests.comparison: Within archaeology + held-out B0 cohort combined, fit (a) mom_20-only logistic, (b) mom_20 + base_depth_pct additive linear logistic, (c) pre-specified interaction logistic. Use the same fixed cutoffs. Determine via likelihood-ratio test whether the interaction term significantly improves over additive. This isolates whether base_depth_pct acts as a moderator (interaction hypothesis) versus an independent linear effect (additive null).
tests.success_criterion: Interaction model AIC < additive model AIC by >= 2, AND interaction LR test p < 0.10; ruin rate response to mom_20 must be qualitatively different between base_depth_pct>-25% and base_depth_pct<-30% strata (e.g., ruin-vs-mom_20 slope sign-flip or magnitude ratio >= 2).
tests.failure_criterion: Additive model AIC within 1 of interaction model, OR ruin-vs-mom_20 slope signs match across base strata, OR coefficient on base_depth_pct is the dominant driver (|coef| > 2x interaction coefficient magnitude).

tests.name: T4_three_slot_accounting_invariance_check
tests.comparison: Within each snapshot in the held-out cohort, compute the original B0 top-3 by baseline rank; then apply the pre-specified re-ranking filter and recompute top-3. Tabulate the set-difference at slot level (which entities get swapped in/out) and attribute each swap to (i) parabolic-rejection removal, (ii) low-momentum shallow-base removal, (iii) deep-base pass-through. Count 'large_win' slots gained vs lost at the slot level (no expansion of universe, only reordering of the same 3 candidates per snapshot).
tests.success_criterion: Net change in 'large_win' slots per snapshot >= 0 in >= 60% of held-out snapshots; ruin slots in top-3 reduced by >= 40% relative to original; no snapshot loses a 'large_win' that the original B0 contained unless a 'ruin' replaces it.
tests.failure_criterion: In >= 40% of snapshots net 'large_win' slot count <= 0, OR any snapshot loses a 'large_win' that is replaced by a 'small_win'/'loss' (i.e., filter destroys more winners than it removes ruinations).

tests.name: T5_label_contamination_and_robustness_to_exclusions
tests.comparison: Re-run T1 and T3 under three alternative label sets on the archaeology cases: (a) exclude entity_6618d3e80c (dual-labelled 'false_positive_ruin|selected_winner') entirely, (b) relabel dual-labelled cases as 'selected_winner' only, (c) relabel dual-labelled cases as 'false_positive_ruin' only. Also drop any case where pullback_pct or pullback_duration_weeks is null AND outcome requires pullback context. Re-estimate each model's claim (sign, magnitude, significance) under each relabeling.
tests.success_criterion: Direction and qualitative magnitude of ruin-rate contrast (A vs B from T1) hold across all three relabelings: sign-flip count = 0 and absolute contrast changes by < 0.15 in any relabeling.
tests.failure_criterion: Sign-flip in any relabeling, OR absolute ruin-rate contrast changes by >= 0.20 under any relabeling, OR interaction coefficient in T3 becomes insignificant in >= 2 of 3 relabelings.

leakage_checks: All cutoffs (mom_20 = 0.15, 0.05; base_depth_pct = -25%, -30%) are taken from the researcher's prior policy_implications and frozen here; they must NOT be re-fit on the held-out B0 cohort or on archaeology cases.
Snapshot/case partitioning into archaeology (training) vs held-out must occur BEFORE any model fit; document the partition and reuse it identically across T1-T5 to prevent selection-driven leakage.
No use of w4_return_bucket, outcome_label, pullback_pct, or pullback_duration_weeks as inputs to the filter; these are evaluation-only.
Base ranking input used to order the 3 fixed B0 slots per snapshot must be computed from PIT features only (no W4 information); audit the ranker for any leakage of forward-looking fields.
Re-ranking in T4 must not introduce any candidate outside the original B0-eligible universe; verify universe cardinality before and after the filter is identical.
Bootstrap resamples in T2 must respect the architecture of the data (case-level resampling with cases as units, not feature-level sampling) to avoid optimistic variance estimates.
All feature transformations (e.g., indicator construction I(mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct>-25%)) must use thresholds frozen in T1-T3; no threshold search inside the test loop.
Entity_6618d3e80c dual-label must be treated as defined in T5 BEFORE any other test runs, so that downstream tests are interpretable under a single documented label convention.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: Base_depth_pct and mom_20 may co-moderate ruin risk for a SUBSET of B0 picks: specifically, high-mom_20 (>0.15) parabolic extensions in shallow bases (>-25%) cluster with false_positive_ruin (entity_8f0df3d38e, 4fdc3699fd, 3472243e0c, b6bcccdf6a, and dual-labelled 6618d3e80c). However, 3/8 ruin cases (entity_ccc90a671f mom_20=0.074, 84824e6a20 mom_20=0.067, 55c2da490e mom_20=0.036, 40ea0cfb3b mom_20=0.024) are LOW-momentum events the rule cannot address, and 5 selected_winners have mom_20>0.15 (entity_ead73f4390=0.320, 2c58cebc59=0.321, b00579f203=0.230, 3adc078f01=0.171, bec51a4227=0.166). Standardized delta for base_depth_pct is only 0.19 (weakest signal in the contrast table), versus up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19), vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05), and mom_20 (-1.00). The piecewise rule therefore covers only the parabolic-ruin sub-regime and cannot be the sole filter.
falsifiers: If held-out B0 cohort shows ruin-rate contrast between (mom_20>0.15 & base_depth_pct>-25%) and (mom_20>0.15 & base_depth_pct<-30%) below 0.30 absolute, or if accept-set ruin rate exceeds 0.30 (per T1 failure criterion), the interaction is not stable.

If slopes+volatility model reaches within 0.02 AUC of the full piecewise model (per T2), base_depth_pct adds no incremental discrimination beyond MA slopes and volatility — mom_20 is partially a proxy for ma10_slope_5 (correlation visible in cases: entity_6618d3e80c ma10=0.075, ma20=0.020).
If non-parabolic ruins (mom_20<0.10, e.g., entity_ccc90a671f, 40ea0cfb3b, 55c2da490e) dominate new held-out ruin mass, the rule's recall on the ruin class is insufficient regardless of precision.
actionable_design_principles: Encode the threshold as an INTERNAL re-ranking filter over the existing B0 top-3 (no universe expansion). Only intervene if a flagged candidate sits in slot 1, 2, or 3 of the PIT base ranking; compute the swap against the original slot's w4 outcome to measure net slot-quality change.

Pair the parabolic-rejection rule with a SEPARATE filter for non-parabolic ruins using the stronger univariate signals (up_day_ratio_20<0.55, vol_ratio_5_20<1.2, or ma20_slope_5<0.01) — these address the ruin cases the mom_20/base_depth_pct rule misses (ccc90a671f, 40ea0cfb3b, 55c2da490e, 84824e6a20).

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_parabolic_reject: drop candidate iff mom_20>0.15 AND base_depth_pct>-25% AND ma10_slope_5>0.04 (triple conjunction: parabolic momentum + shallow base + steep short-term slope). Otherwise pass through. Applied as swap-into-slot logic, not universe expansion.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Adds ma10_slope_5 conjunct because mom_20 alone is correlated with slope; the conjunction isolates true parabolic extensions (entity_3472243e0c ma10=0.030 misses, entity_b6bcccdf6a ma10=0.067 hits — calibration needed in held-out). Pure mom_20 + base_depth_pct would also reject entity_2c58cebc59 (winner, mom_20=0.321) needlessly.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Treats base_depth_pct as a moderator on a momentum-slope condition rather than as a standalone filter, reducing false-rejection of legitimate high-momentum breakouts from deep bases.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: b0_low_mom_shallow_reject: drop candidate iff mom_20<0.05 AND base_depth_pct>-25% (catches demand-failure shallow-base setups that the parabolic rule misses, e.g., entity_40ea0cfb3b mom_20=0.024, entity_55c2da490e mom_20=0.036).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Mirrors the researcher's second clause but limits it to shallow bases to avoid killing low-mom deep-base winners (entity_8ad5cd4795 mom_20=0.004 with deep base context passed through; entity_90a828939a mom_20=0.036 also passed). Distinct from parabolic rule because it operates on opposite momentum tail.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Covers a ruin sub-regime the parabolic-reject filter cannot see; together the two clauses address both tails of the ruin distribution while preserving mid-momentum winners and steep-base deep-base breakouts.

cycles.question: Explore a interaction term using base_depth_pct and mom_20. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: 20-day momentum's predictive value is conditional on base depth: when base_depth_pct is shallow (>-25%) AND mom_20 is high (>0.15), the breakout lacks the institutional accumulation cushion needed to sustain thrust, creating a 'news-gap momentum chase' failure regime; conversely, deep bases (<-30%) with moderate-to-high mom_20 reflect proper accumulation followed by thrust confirmation and have structurally lower ruin risk.
evidence_for: Numeric contrasts show selected winners have median base_depth_pct of -29.5% vs false-negative median of -25.8% (delta +3.7pp, deeper bases predict success), while mom_20 median gap is -10.5pp (winners ~0.163 vs FN ~0.058); the ruins cluster in the shallow-base/high-mom quadrant (entity_8f0df3d38e: mom_20=0.176, px_vs_ma20=0.048; entity_b6bcccdf6a: mom_20=0.176, px_vs_ma20=0.124; entity_3472243e0c: mom_20=0.242)

Winners that survived extreme momentum (entity_ead73f4390 mom=0.320, entity_2c58cebc59 mom=0.321, entity_b00579f203 mom=0.230) all show deep relative-to-base extension signals (px_vs_ma50 >=0.17), consistent with thrust emerging from a properly formed base rather than a shallow one
evidence_against: Some winners carry low/negative mom_20 (entity_2f86543bf6 mom=-0.008, entity_8ad5cd4795 mom=0.004, entity_90a828939a mom=0.036), meaning the interaction alone is insufficient and base_depth_pct must combine with other PIT signals (up_day_ratio, vol_ratio_5_20)

Sample n=27 limits statistical power; base_depth_pct standardized_delta is only +0.19 vs mom_20's -1.00, so the marginal information from base_depth is modest when momentum is already known; entity_6618d3e80c (mixed label, mom=0.251, px_vs_ma50=0.337) shows deep extension + high momentum can also fail, suggesting an upper-bound regime
falsifiable_predictions: Within current B0 picks, the subset with base_depth_pct > -25% AND mom_20 > 0.15 should exhibit W4 ruin rate >=40% and median W4 return <=0%, while base_depth_pct < -30% AND mom_20 in [0.05, 0.25] should show median W4 return >+5pp above the B0 overall median

If we apply a multiplicative penalty score P = mom_20 x max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) as a re-ranker (not eligibility filter) to existing B0 picks and demote the top-decile P by one rank, realized W4 ruin count in the test sample should drop by >=25% versus status quo without reducing selection count
policy_implications: Encode the interaction as a continuous re-ranking score (mom_20 x standardized base_depth_pct_shortfall) applied AFTER B0 eligibility is determined, so the eligible universe size is unchanged; use soft demotion (1-3 rank slots) rather than hard exclusion to avoid losing asymmetric upside

Compute base_depth_pct on a frozen 6-12 month pre-entry window with a minimum base_duration_weeks gate (~30 weeks) to prevent the score from being contaminated by post-base noise; combine with up_day_ratio_20 >= 0.55 and vol_ratio_5_20 in [1.0, 1.8] to suppress the 'news-spike shallow-base' subtype specifically observed in entity_b6bcccdf6a and entity_84824e6a20

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The base_depth_pct x mom_20 interaction is largely spurious: mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, and vol_ratio_5_20 carry nearly all the predictive signal (standardized deltas -1.00, -1.19, -1.05 respectively), while base_depth_pct's own standardized delta is +0.19 — within the noise band of every other weak feature (mom_60, atr_14_pct, dist_to_52w_high_pct, ma50_slope_10, base_mbox_count) that the dataset itself flags as non-discriminating. The proposed multiplicative re-ranker would primarily re-weight mom_20 by a near-noise multiplier, while introducing rank churn that threatens to demote high-momentum asymmetric winners.

attacks.issue: Magnitude mismatch between claimed interaction effect and base_depth's marginal information: base_depth_pct standardized_delta = +0.19 vs mom_20 = -1.00, up_day_ratio_20 = -1.19, vol_ratio_5_20 = -1.05. Multiplying a weak feature by a strong one is mathematically equivalent to a soft threshold on the strong one.
attacks.why_it_matters: If base_depth_pct carries <0.2 SD of information on the outcome conditional on mom_20, the 'interaction' is dominated by the mom_20 main effect. The researcher has not shown that P = mom_20 x base_depth outperforms mom_20 + base_depth additively, nor that it outperforms mom_20 alone with the other two PIT features as co-predictors. Without that ablation, the interaction claim is not falsifiably distinct from 'mom_20 already does the work'.

attacks.issue: Confounding with up_day_ratio_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 — the two strongest signals: the 'shallow-base high-momentum ruin' cluster (entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_84824e6a20, entity_b00579f203's ruin component) ALL have up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.45 or vol_ratio_5_20 in the high-vol-spike band. The same cluster's base_depth could be coincidental.
attacks.why_it_matters: The researcher's own narrative ('news-spike shallow-base subtype') names vol_ratio and up_day as suppressors, but the policy implementation (P = mom_20 x base_depth_shortfall) does NOT include them. If a high-momentum ruin has up_day_ratio=0.4 (entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_84824e6a20), the proposed score will not demote it strongly because base_depth alone is not the binding constraint. The encoding ignores the very confounders the narrative invokes.

attacks.issue: Selection-on-B0 universe bias: the 27 cases are already filtered through IBD-style entry rules. We never observe the (base_depth_pct, mom_20) plane outside the B0 set, so the interaction coefficient is identified only within a pre-screened subpopulation. The thresholds the researcher proposes (>−25%, >0.15) describe B0-internal strata and have no validation against the broader eligible universe.
attacks.why_it_matters: An interaction term estimated within a censored sample can produce arbitrary-looking quadrant boundaries (e.g., 'deep base + moderate mom wins' may simply be 'B0 picks that already passed trend filters'). Applying it back to B0 picks as a re-ranker double-counts filters the universe already passed, inflating apparent precision while shrinking the number of unique candidates.

attacks.issue: Post-hoc mechanism story ('institutional accumulation cushion', 'news-gap momentum chase'): base_depth_pct is a single summary statistic of past price action with no proven link to accumulation behavior, and the +3.7pp median delta between winners and FNs is smaller than the within-winner dispersion (winners span -1.5% to -42.3% pullback_pct).
attacks.why_it_matters: A mechanism that cannot be tied to a specific microstructure (block trades, dark-pool prints, share-rotation, etc.) is a narrative, not a hypothesis. The 'institutional cushion' framing could equally explain why shallow-base breakouts work (fresher supply, less trapped longs) or why base depth is irrelevant. Mechanism plausibility is being used to compensate for weak effect size.

attacks.issue: Risk that the proposed re-ranker demotes asymmetric winners: entity_3adc078f01 has mom_20=0.172, ma20_slope_5=0.073, px_vs_ma20=0.136, pullback_pct=-42.3% and is a 'selected_winner' with large_win — exactly the kind of name the proposed score might demote because its extreme pullback (which feeds base_depth) interacts with momentum in an atypical pattern.
attacks.why_it_matters: In a small-sample regime with one or two large wins, a single mis-demoted asymmetric winner can wipe out the ruin-prevention benefit of demoting four middling names. The proposed ≥25% ruin-count reduction target is plausible but not safety-checked against asymmetric-upside loss.

attacks.issue: Threshold arbitrariness (−25%, −30%, mom_20=0.15): these are not cross-validated; they are eyeballed from the empirical medians. The +5pp 'winners − median improvement' the falsifiable prediction claims is the same order as the standard error of the median on n=11 winners.
attacks.why_it_matters: With 11 winners and ~7 false negatives, any median-difference claim has enormous uncertainty. The researcher treats −25% and −30% as if they were theoretically motivated breakpoints (e.g., Wyckoff accumulation depth), but they are sample-conditional quartiles. Out-of-sample, the optimal cut will move.

attacks.issue: Encoding assumes multiplicative interaction when the data is consistent with additive or no interaction: A1 winners (entity_2f86543bf6, entity_8ad5cd4795) have near-zero or negative mom_20 — meaning the interaction must be near-zero there. Winners with high mom_20 also tend to have positive px_vs_ma50 (extension), which is itself an outcome of momentum, not independent of base depth. Collinearity is unaddressed.
attacks.why_it_matters: Re-ranking on mom_20 x base_depth is collinear with mom_20 x (px_vs_ma50) because px_vs_ma50 ≈ mom_20 weighted. The proposed score may be picking up an extension-cushion effect, not an independent base-depth effect, and could be replicated with a simpler 'cap mom_20 at the extension percentile' rule.
