counterexamples_to_seek: A B0 pick with base_depth_pct > −20% (shallow) AND mom_20 > 0.15 that turned out to be a 'large_win' or 'selected_winner' — to falsify the shallow-base ruin regime. None yet observed, but the case count is small.

A B0 pick with base_depth_pct < −35% (deep) AND mom_20 < 0.05 (low) that is 'false_positive_ruin' — to test whether deep bases rescue momentum-less breakouts. entity_2f86543bf6 (mom=−0.008, won) and entity_8ad5cd4795 (mom=0.004, won) suggest deep bases are not necessary for wins.

A non-B0 entity in the (shallow base, high mom_20) quadrant that became a 'false_negative_big_winner' — to test whether the interaction threshold shifts when leaving the B0 universe. entity_de1c657364 (base not shown but mom_20=0.058) and entity_535a1beed7 (mom_20=0.028) are low-momentum FNs, not the relevant cell.

A B0 pick with the proposed interaction score P in the top decile that is a 'large_win' — to test whether the re-ranker would demote real winners. entity_3adc078f01, entity_6618d3e80c, entity_b00579f203 likely sit in the high-P region and are winners or mixed.

An entity with up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.45 and high mom_20 where base_depth is deep but the outcome is 'false_positive_ruin' — to test whether up_day_ratio is the actual suppressor and base_depth is incidental.
what_would_change_my_mind: An out-of-sample backtest (n ≥ 100 B0 picks, held out from this 27) where the interaction re-ranker shows W4 ruin-count reduction ≥25% AND does not reduce the mean W4 return of the surviving top-N by more than 50bp, after controlling for mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 additively.

An ablation table comparing (i) mom_20 alone, (ii) mom_20 + base_depth_pct additive, (iii) mom_20 x base_depth_pct multiplicative, (iv) mom_20 + up_day_ratio + vol_ratio, showing that (iii) uniquely dominates (iv) on a stable cross-sectional IC metric. If (iv) ≥ (iii), the interaction is unnecessary.

A documented link between base_depth_pct and a microstructure proxy (e.g., block-trade share, short-interest residual, days-to-cover change) in the pre-entry window — converting the 'accumulation cushion' narrative into a measurable, PIT-feature. Until then the mechanism is unfalsifiable folklore.

Evidence that the proposed threshold cut-points (−25%, −30%, 0.15) are stable across multiple non-overlapping discovery-train splits. If the optimal cut moves by >5pp between splits, the thresholds are sample-specific and the re-ranker is overfit.

A demonstration that the B0 eligible universe can be held constant under the re-ranking (no change in selection count, no change in expected rank distribution beyond the targeted 1-slot demotions) AND that turnover costs of the re-rank are net positive after T+1 friction. The current proposal does not check that re-ranking does not induce forced sells of marginal positions.

tests.name: interaction_ablation_table_within_b0
tests.comparison: Within the 27-case B0 archaeology, fit four rank-correlation (Spearman) models against w4_return_bucket ordinal on the SAME B0 picks only: (A) mom_20 alone, (B) mom_20 + base_depth_pct additive (with standardized z-scores), (C) mom_20 x max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) multiplicative with the researcher's P, (D) mom_20 + up_day_ratio_20 + vol_ratio_5_20 additive. Compute rank-IC per model. Compare |IC_C - IC_D|; if |IC_C - IC_D| < 0.02 in absolute terms AND IC_A is within 0.01 of IC_C, the interaction is statistically indistinguishable from main effects.
tests.success_criterion: IC_C (multiplicative) exceeds IC_D (additive with up_day + vol_ratio) by >=0.02 in absolute rank-IC, AND IC_C exceeds IC_A (mom_20 alone) by >=0.02.
tests.failure_criterion: IC_D >= IC_C, OR IC_C - IC_A < 0.02. Either shows the interaction is not adding information beyond either mom_20 alone or the known strong controls.

tests.name: shallow_high_mom_quadrant_ruin_enrichment
tests.comparison: Pre-specify the cell base_depth_pct > -0.25 AND mom_20 > 0.15 as the 'shallow-high-mom' quadrant. Within the 27 B0 cases, compute ruin rate (outcome_label contains 'false_positive_ruin') in this cell vs the complement cell (base_depth_pct <= -0.25 OR mom_20 <= 0.15). Repeat the same quadrant split STRATIFIED by up_day_ratio_20 >= 0.55 vs < 0.55 to test whether the quadrant effect survives the known strong suppressor.
tests.success_criterion: Shallow-high-mom cell ruin rate >= 2x the complement cell ruin rate, AND the enrichment persists (>=1.5x) within the up_day_ratio_20 >= 0.55 stratum. The second condition is necessary to claim base_depth is not just proxying for up_day.
tests.failure_criterion: Shallow-high-mom enrichment < 1.5x in the high-up_day stratum, OR overall cell ruin rate <= complement ruin rate (i.e., the cell is not a coherent failure regime).

tests.name: deep_low_mom_rescue_test
tests.comparison: Pre-specify the 'deep-low-mom' rescue cell: base_depth_pct <= -0.30 AND mom_20 < 0.05. Within the 27 cases, check whether any ruin cases occupy this cell (entity_2f86543bf6 and entity_8ad5cd4795 are winners here, but entity_40ea0cfb3b has mom=0.024, base_depth not reported, and is a ruin — verify whether base_depth <= -0.30). If ruins are present in this cell, deep base does NOT rescue low-momentum breakouts, falsifying the 'accumulation cushion' rescue narrative.
tests.success_criterion: Zero ruin cases in the deep-low-mom cell (n in cell >= 3), supporting the rescue claim.
tests.failure_criterion: Any ruin in the deep-low-mom cell OR fewer than 3 observations in the cell (insufficient evidence, mark UNRESOLVED).

tests.name: reranker_demote_asymmetric_winner_audit
tests.comparison: Compute P = mom_20 x max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) for each B0 pick. Rank all 27 cases by P desc. Identify cases in the TOP tercile of P that are labeled 'selected_winner' with w4_return_bucket = 'large_win' (e.g., entity_3adc078f01, entity_6618d3e80c, entity_b00579f203, entity_2c58cebc59, entity_ead73f4390). The proposed soft-demote-one-slot policy would re-rank these into lower slots. Calculate the count of large_wins that would be demoted past the top-N cutoff where N = floor(0.5 x 27) = 13.
tests.success_criterion: Fewer than 2 large_wins would be demoted below the 50th-percentile rank slot, AND no 'large_win' is demoted below the 40th-percentile slot. The re-ranker should not systematically cannibalize asymmetric upside.
tests.failure_criterion: >= 3 large_wins demoted below the 50th-percentile slot, OR any single large_win with pullback_pct worse than -30% (asymmetric profile) demoted past the 40th-percentile slot — because the ruin-prevention benefit on 4 middling names is unlikely to exceed the loss from mis-demoting one extreme winner.

tests.name: collinearity_base_depth_vs_extension_proxies
tests.comparison: Compute pairwise rank correlations among base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma20, px_vs_ma50, pullback_pct, mom_20 across the 27 cases. The skeptic claims base_depth_pct may be proxying for extension. If |rank_corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma50)| > 0.5, then base_depth is largely redundant with extension, and the 'multiplicative with base_depth' encoding is approximately equivalent to 'multiplicative with px_vs_ma50'.
tests.success_criterion: |rank_corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma50)| < 0.4 AND |rank_corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma20)| < 0.4, establishing base_depth as a non-redundant dimension orthogonal to current extension.
tests.failure_criterion: Either rank correlation exceeds 0.5; the interaction should be re-encoded using px_vs_ma50 (or its residual) instead of base_depth_pct.

tests.name: reranker_universe_size_invariant_check
tests.comparison: The re-ranker P = mom_20 x max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) operates on EXISTING B0 picks only. Confirm: (i) the eligible-universe count BEFORE re-ranking equals the count AFTER re-ranking (no new picks added, none removed), (ii) rank-slot churn is bounded — no pick moves more than 3 slots, (iii) the set of top-N picks after re-ranking shares >=80% membership with the top-N before re-ranking (Jaccard >=0.8 at N = 13). This enforces the 3-slot accounting rule.
tests.success_criterion: Universe size unchanged AND Jaccard(top-N before, top-N after, N=13) >= 0.8 AND max slot-shift <= 3.
tests.failure_criterion: Universe size changes, OR Jaccard < 0.7, OR any pick shifts > 3 slots — the re-ranker is effectively re-defining the eligible universe rather than re-ranking within it.

tests.name: threshold_split_stability
tests.comparison: Randomly split the 27 B0 cases into two non-overlapping halves (seed fixed at 42, 100 bootstraps). On each half, find the optimal base_depth_pct threshold that maximizes the difference in ruin rate between 'shallow' and 'deep' cells at mom_20 > 0.15. Record the optimal threshold on each half. If the optimal threshold varies by >5pp between halves (e.g., -22% on one, -30% on the other), the cut-points (-25%, -30%) are sample-specific and not pre-specifiable.
tests.success_criterion: Optimal threshold std across splits <= 3pp AND median optimal threshold lies within [-27%, -23%] (bracketing the proposed -25%).
tests.failure_criterion: Optimal threshold std > 5pp OR median outside [-27%, -23%] — the proposed thresholds are unstable and the re-ranker would need to be re-tuned per cohort.

leakage_checks: Verify all features are PIT (point-in-time): base_depth_pct must be computed on a frozen pre-entry window ending at least 1 day BEFORE the IBD entry trigger date — confirm window definition matches the snapshot_anon labels in the archaeology data.

Confirm mom_20 is the trailing 20-day return as of the same PIT cutoff date as base_depth_pct; if mom_20 uses a different anchor (e.g., close of entry day vs trigger day), the multiplicative product will leak post-trigger information into the score.

Verify that up_day_ratio_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 used in test 'shallow_high_mom_quadrant_ruin_enrichment' are computed on the SAME 20-day and 5-day windows as the candidate's mom_20 — mismatched windows would invalidate the conditional-on-up_day test.

Confirm that w4_return_bucket outcomes are assigned using only data through T+4 weeks from the entry trigger; any use of post-week-4 data to retroactively label 'false_negative_big_winner' could leak forward information into the falsifiable predictions.

Ensure the 3-slot accounting test ('reranker_universe_size_invariant_check') uses the SAME eligibility rules as the B0 baseline (same IBD-style filters applied at the SAME PIT date) — if the re-ranker runs on a different snapshot than the baseline B0 set, the universe-size claim is invalid.

Check that none of the 27 cases share the same snapshot_anon and entity_anon across train/holdout splits in the threshold stability test; if duplicates exist, the split-stability result is biased downward by within-entity correlation.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The base_depth_pct × mom_20 interaction encodes a 'thrust-without-cushion' failure regime: when 20-day momentum is elevated (>0.15) but the prior basing structure is shallow (>-25%), breakouts lack the supply-absorption history needed to sustain post-breakout thrust and are over-represented in W4 ruins (cluster includes entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_3472243e0c, entity_84824e6a20, entity_ccc90a671f). However, base_depth_pct carries only ~0.19 standardized delta of marginal information vs ~1.0 for mom_20, up_day_ratio_20, and vol_ratio_5_20, and the shallow-high-mom ruin cluster is itself dominated by up_day_ratio ≤ 0.50 and elevated vol_ratio spikes — meaning the observed ruin enrichment is partially confounded with the two strongest PIT features. The mechanism is therefore real but weak, and its policy expression is only viable as a soft re-ranker conditionally gated on the dominant PIT controls.
falsifiers: Out-of-sample: shallow-base/high-mom quadrant (base_depth_pct > -25% AND mom_20 > 0.15) ruin rate within B0 falls below 1.5x the complement quadrant — interaction fails to enrich the failure regime.
Rank-IC of P = mom_20 × max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) fails to exceed mom_20 alone by ≥0.02 AFTER partialing out up_day_ratio_20 and vol_ratio_5_20 — interaction is fully redundant with main effects.

Pairwise rank correlation |corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma50)| > 0.4 in the discovery cohort — base_depth is a proxy for current extension and the multiplicative encoding collapses to 'cap mom_20 at extension percentile'.
Bootstrap split-stability (100 resamples, seed 42) of the optimal base_depth threshold yields std > 5pp OR median outside [-27%, -23%] — the -25% cut is sample-specific, not pre-specifiable.

Pre-registered rerank audit shows ≥3 large_wins (especially pullback_pct ≤ -30% archetypes such as entity_3adc078f01) demoted below the 50th-percentile slot — ruin-prevention gain is offset by asymmetric-upside loss.

Any ruin appears in the deep-base/low-mom cell (base_depth_pct ≤ -30% AND mom_20 < 0.05) with n ≥ 3 — falsifies the symmetric 'deep base rescues momentum-less breakouts' sub-claim (entity_2f86543bf6 and entity_8ad5cd4795 currently provide only n=2 supportive cases).
Re-ranker universe-size invariant check shows Jaccard(top-N before, top-N after, N=13) < 0.7 OR any pick shifts > 3 slots — the encoding is silently expanding the eligible universe.
actionable_design_principles: Encode as a POST-B0 re-ranker only; never promote to an eligibility gate. The B0 eligible universe is the binding constraint and any interaction that expands or contracts it violates the universe-size invariant.

Make the interaction conditional on the dominant PIT controls (up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.55 AND vol_ratio_5_20 in [1.0, 1.8]). Without this conditional, the score demotes names whose ruin risk is already captured by the stronger features — false-positive precision at the cost of slot churn.
Bound slot churn: max ±3 rank slots, Jaccard(top-N) ≥ 0.8 at any N ≤ universe size. Encode this as a hard constraint in the policy so the re-ranker cannot functionally redefine B0.
Soft demote, never exclude. Asymmetric winners (extreme pullback_pct ≤ -30% with high mom_20) must survive the re-rank; one mis-demoted large_win can offset several prevented ruins on n < 30 cohorts.
Compute base_depth_pct on a PIT-frozen pre-entry window (≥ 30 weeks, ending at least 1 trading day before the IBD trigger). Mismatched windows with mom_20 cause post-trigger leakage into the score.

Prefer base_depth over px_vs_ma50 IF the collinearity audit confirms |rank_corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma50)| < 0.4 AND |rank_corr(base_depth_pct, px_vs_ma20)| < 0.4. Otherwise substitute a residualized extension measure to preserve orthogonality.

Treat -25% and 0.15 as illustrative anchors, not load-bearing constants. Threshold monitoring should be continuous; per-cohort refit is permitted but bounded to ±3pp of the discovery anchor to prevent silent regime drift.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Conditional interaction re-ranker: P = mom_20 × max(0, base_depth_pct + 0.25) applied as a soft score ONLY when up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.55 AND vol_ratio_5_20 ∈ [1.0, 1.8]; cases failing the gate default to their existing B0 rank.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Researcher's bare P ignores the dominant confounders the narrative invokes; gating on up_day + vol_ratio isolates the base_depth × mom interaction from the up_day-driven ruin cluster, and the multiplicative form (vs additive) concentrates penalty on the worst quadrant without a separate interaction-feature column.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Operates entirely within the existing B0 eligible universe; does not add entities or expand slots. Net capacity effect = 0 entities, ~5-10% slot churn at top-N=13.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Asymmetric-upside guardrail: any B0 pick with pullback_pct ≤ -30% AND large_win historical bucket membership (or equivalent PIT proxy: mom_60 > 0.10) is flagged and exempted from demotion beyond a single rank slot, regardless of P.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Skeptic's primary failure mode is mis-demoting names like entity_3adc078f01 (pullback_pct = -42.3%, large_win). A guardrail that couples deep prior drawdown with sustained intermediate momentum isolates the 'recovered thrust' archetype from the 'shallow-momentum-chase' archetype, which a single interaction score cannot distinguish.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Universe size unchanged; flag is a slot-churn limiter (caps maximum demotion depth on a subset) rather than a new selection rule. No net capacity expansion.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Threshold stability monitor: each re-rank cycle, record the empirical base_depth_pct cutoff that maximizes ruin-vs-complement separation at fixed mom_20 > 0.15 within the B0 cohort; emit a policy warning if the cutoff moves > 5pp from the discovery anchor (-25%) or if the cell sample size falls below 5.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Researcher's -25% anchor is eyeballed from medians; on n=27 cohorts the optimal cut is noisy. A continuous stability monitor prevents the policy from silently over-fitting to a single snapshot and gives an explicit UNRESOLVED signal when evidence is insufficient — addressing the threshold-arbitrariness attack without requiring a redesign.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Diagnostic only; does not modify selection. Capacity effect = 0. Enables safe contraction (tightening anchor) or UNRESOLVED emission (expanding to wider band) without changing the universe.

cycles.question: Explore a conditional ranking plus adaptive capacity using base_depth_pct and mom_20. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: Within the B0 universe, base_depth_pct sets structural risk capacity and mom_20 sets directional capacity; their interaction is non-monotonic because shallow bases (base_depth_pct near -10 to -15) combined with elevated mom_20 (>~0.17) identify late-stage breakouts that revert, while deep bases (>~-30) with moderate mom_20 (0.05-0.16) sustain continuation. Adaptive capacity = scale B0 rank position by a penalty that activates when mom_20/base_depth_pct ratio exceeds a threshold, shrinking but not eliminating exposure so the B0 membership set is unchanged.
evidence_for: 8 false_positive_ruin cases cluster at mom_20 in 0.07-0.24 with px_vs_ma50 in 0.05-0.34 and up_day_ratio_20 often 0.5-0.65 (e.g., entity_8f0df3d38e mom_20=0.176 pullback -16.2%, entity_ccc90a671f mom_20=0.074 pullback -14.4%, entity_6618d3e80c mom_20=0.251 with px_vs_ma50=0.337 marked both ruin and winner) — shallow-base/high-mom shows 5-7 week -12% to -42% reversals.

numeric_contrasts show mom_20 has the largest standardized separation between false_negatives (0.058) and selected_winners (0.163), with base_depth_pct near zero standardized delta (-0.19), confirming mom_20 is the discriminating axis and base_depth_pct is the regime modifier, not an independent filter.
evidence_against: entity_ead73f4390 (selected_winner) has mom_20=0.320 with px_vs_ma20=0.194 — a high-momentum deep-base case that did NOT ruin, showing the penalty must be soft, not a hard cutoff, or it will deselect legitimate leaders.

entity_3adc078f01 (selected_winner, large_win despite pullback -42.3% over 9 weeks) had moderate mom_20=0.172 with deep base, indicating deep bases can absorb drawdowns that ruin shallow-base analogs.
falsifiable_predictions: Within B0, bucketing picks by mom_20 quintile × base_depth_pct tertile should show the worst 4-week forward return in the high-mom_20/shallow-base cell and the best in mid-mom_20/deep-base cell; ranking purely on base_rank or purely on mom_20 will underperform the interaction score out-of-sample.

Applying a multiplicative shrinkage factor = clip(1 - alpha*(mom_20 - threshold)*exp(-k*|base_depth_pct|), floor, 1) to B0 position sizes should reduce false_positive_ruin count by >=30% without reducing selected_winner count by more than ~10%, holding B0 membership fixed.
policy_implications: Encode as a post-B0 capacity multiplier rather than a pre-filter, so the eligible universe stays exactly B0; the gate uses only PIT-observable fields (mom_20, base_depth_pct) and operates on rank score or weight, not on inclusion.

Monitor a 'capacity utilization' diagnostic = fraction of B0 names hitting the penalty zone; sustained >50% utilization signals regime shift toward late-cycle momentum and should trigger tightening of the alpha coefficient or a switch to base-depth-weighted sizing.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The proposed 'adaptive capacity' is functionally a redundant mom_20 filter wrapped around a phantom base_depth_pct axis. The numeric_contrasts themselves show base_depth_pct has standardized delta = 0.19 with the WRONG SIGN (selected_winners are 3.7pp shallower than false_negatives, not deeper as the mechanism requires), so there is no statistical basis for base_depth_pct acting as a regime modifier. The interaction story is post-hoc narrative around a sample where mom_20 alone (standardized delta -1.00) and its colinear proxies (vol_ratio_5_20 = -1.05, up_day_ratio_20 = -1.19, px_vs_ma50 = -0.85) carry virtually all the lift. The claim should be reduced to 'shrink B0 exposure when mom_20 > some threshold' with base_depth_pct playing at most a tie-breaking role.

attacks.issue: base_depth_pct has near-zero and sign-reversed separation between false_negatives (-25.8) and selected_winners (-29.5) in the discovery sample; the mechanism claims deep bases sustain continuation, but winners are actually slightly shallower.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the supposed 'capacity' axis does not separate outcomes and points the wrong way, the interaction term is fitting noise. Any penalty tied to exp(-k*|base_depth_pct|) is structurally unanchored and will be calibrated against a non-effect, producing spurious interaction signal that will not replicate.

attacks.issue: A threshold of mom_20 ≈ 0.17 captures only 5 of 8 false_positive_ruin cases (misses entity_ccc90a671f at 0.074, entity_55c2da490e at 0.036, entity_84824e6a20 at 0.067) while penalizing 4 of 11 selected_winners (entity_ead73f4390=0.320, entity_2c58cebc59=0.321, entity_3adc078f01=0.172, entity_b00579f203=0.230).
attacks.why_it_matters: The mechanism's own prediction is violated by the sample: high-mom/shallow-base ruins and high-mom/deep-base winners co-exist in nearly equal numbers. Net selection damage is comparable to the ruin reduction claimed. The '≥30% ruin cut, ≤10% winner cut' falsifiable prediction in the prior output fails internally before any out-of-sample test.

attacks.issue: mom_20 is correlated with vol_ratio_5_20 (rho not shown but both have ~-1.0 standardized delta on FN vs winner), up_day_ratio_20, and px_vs_ma50 — all three of which independently separate FN from winner in the contrast table. The proposed mom_20 penalty is a proxy for late-stage exhaustion that vol_ratio or up_day_ratio would catch more directly.
attacks.why_it_matters: Adding mom_20 on top of features that B0 likely already uses (or that are more proximate to the ruin mechanism: vol expansion, distribution days) double-counts the same signal and inflates apparent conditioning effect. The 'adaptive capacity' will look effective in-sample because it overweights an already-priced factor.

attacks.issue: Selected winners exist with NEGATIVE mom_20 and shallow bases (entity_2f86543bf6: mom_20=-0.008, px_vs_ma20=0.025, up_day_ratio_20=0.35, large_win) and with mom_20≈0 and weak slopes (entity_8ad5cd4795: mom_20=0.004, ma10_slope=-0.006, ma20_slope=-0.003, large_win with pullback -6.7%).
attacks.why_it_matters: These are direct counterexamples to the monotonic-with-direction logic implicit in the 'capacity = base × momentum' formulation. If low-momentum shallow-base setups can be large winners, the proposed penalty must be very soft — soft enough that it barely changes sizing, which makes the whole intervention a no-op.

attacks.issue: 27 cases with 8+11 split across an interaction of two continuous variables produces a quintile×tertile grid where most cells have 0-2 observations; the proposed non-monotonic surface is severely overfit and the 'capacity utilization diagnostic' will be uninformative.
attacks.why_it_matters: With ~5 cells per quintile×tertile and most cells empty, the apparent 'worst cell at high-mom/shallow-base, best cell at mid-mom/deep-base' pattern is unstable. A single case reassignment flips the conclusion. The policy recommendation of triggering regime shifts at >50% capacity utilization is therefore unsupported.

attacks.issue: The proposed penalty formula 1 - alpha*(mom_20 - threshold)*exp(-k*|base_depth_pct|) introduces three free parameters (alpha, threshold, k) with no held-out estimation protocol disclosed, and the floor/ceiling are unconstrained.
attacks.why_it_matters: With three knobs fit to 8 ruin cases, any apparent reduction in ruin rate is curve-fitting. Without nested cross-validation or a frozen test set, the falsifiable prediction (≥30% ruin reduction, ≤10% winner reduction) cannot be honestly evaluated; it is a target the formula will hit by construction.

attacks.issue: B0 selection itself almost certainly already incorporates momentum ranking (median mom_20 of selected_winners is 0.163 vs false_negatives 0.058). Adding a within-B0 mom_20 penalty is endogenously correlated with the existing filter, so the marginal information is overstated.
attacks.why_it_matters: If B0 is partially defined by mom_20 quantile, then conditioning inside B0 on mom_20 is conditioning on a variable that is correlated with inclusion. The within-B0 mom_20 distribution is truncated, so the same threshold that discriminates between B0 and non-B0 has reduced variance and weaker signal inside B0 — this is regression-to-mean territory, not a stable late-stage marker.

counterexamples_to_seek: B0 picks with mom_20 > 0.20 and base_depth_pct < -30% that became large winners (e.g., entity_ead73f4390, entity_2c58cebc59) — count how often this signature produces winners vs ruins; if >50% winners, the high-mom/deep-base 'safe' zone in the proposed interaction is fictitious.

B0 picks with mom_20 < 0.08 and base_depth_pct > -20% that became ruins — entity_55c2da490e (mom_20=0.036, ruin), entity_ccc90a671f (0.074, ruin), entity_84824e6a20 (0.067, ruin) all qualify. Confirm whether these share a common sub-feature (vol_ratio, distribution days) that mom_20 alone does not capture.

Cases where is_b0_pick=false but mom_20 is in the upper tail of the selected_winner distribution (e.g., entity_df5478102d mom_20=0.125, false_negative_relative) — if B0 missed high-mom names, the proposed within-B0 momentum penalty has nothing to add.

Snapshots where the same entity appears with different outcomes — any snapshot showing entity_6618d3e80c carrying BOTH ruin and winner labels signals label noise that swamps the mom_20/base signal; the discovery sample's reliability is the limiting factor on conditional ranking claims.

Look for cases where vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.5 and up_day_ratio_20 < 0.5 within B0 (e.g., entity_84824e6a20 vol=1.63, up=0.4 → ruin) regardless of mom_20 — if this combination identifies ruins better than mom_20/base interaction, the proposed encoding captures a proxy, not the mechanism.
what_would_change_my_mind: A held-out validation (not the same 27 cases) showing monotonic ruin probability across mom_20 quintiles within B0, with base_depth_pct tertiles shifting the curve in a statistically significant interaction (interaction p < 0.05 with stable cell counts ≥10).

Demonstration that the mom_20/base_depth_pct interaction adds incremental lift (e.g., +2pp hit rate or +0.1 Sharpe) after controlling for vol_ratio_5_20, up_day_ratio_20, and px_vs_ma50 in a multivariate model. If lift disappears when proxies are included, the interaction is a proxy artifact.

Evidence that the proposed soft penalty formula achieves the falsifiable prediction (≥30% ruin reduction, ≤10% winner reduction) out-of-sample with frozen alpha, threshold, k — not refit on the evaluation set.

Reconciling the sign-reversal: showing base_depth_pct has correct directional effect in a larger sample where selected_winners are DEEPER (more negative base_depth_pct) than false_negatives, not the 3.7pp shallower seen here.

A within-B0 stratified analysis confirming that the ruin mechanism is genuinely 'late-stage breakout exhaustion' (which requires specific micro-structure: climactic volume, distribution day counts) rather than generic over-extension — without micro-structure evidence, mom_20 is just a proxy for 'already up a lot.'

tests.name: test_mom20_monotonic_within_b0
tests.comparison: Within B0 picks only, stratify into mom_20 quintiles (Q1 lowest, Q5 highest) and compute ruin_rate per quintile. Apply a one-sided Jonckheere-Terpstra trend test for monotonic ruin_rate Q1->Q5; require >=10 B0 picks per quintile as cell-stability gate.
tests.success_criterion: Monotonic ruin_rate (Q5>Q4>Q3>Q2>Q1, ties allowed) with trend p<0.05 frozen in advance; this would establish mom_20 as a within-B0 discriminator independent of the interaction.
tests.failure_criterion: Non-monotonic (Q5 not strictly above Q1) OR trend p>=0.05 — refutes mom_20 as a within-B0 ruin driver and supports Mechanism A (mom_20 is a selection/proxy axis, not a late-stage exhaustion marker).

tests.name: test_interaction_vs_proxy_horse_race
tests.comparison: On B0 picks, apply two soft-penalty encodings with identical floors (0.5) and frozen params: (A) mom_20 x |base_depth_pct| interaction, (B) vol_ratio_5_20 x (1-up_day_ratio_20). Measure ruin_count_reduction and selected_winner_count_retention vs unshrunk B0 baseline; compare via paired test on binary ruin outcome.
tests.success_criterion: Encoding A reduces ruin count >=30% with <=10% winner loss AND beats encoding B by >=2pp on composite (ruin_reduction - 2*winner_loss) — would establish the interaction as the genuine channel beyond known proxies.
tests.failure_criterion: Encoding A does not outperform B by >=2pp (or sign-reversed) — supports Mechanism C: mom_20/base_depth_pct interaction is a proxy artifact for vol/distribution signal already available in PIT.

tests.name: test_base_depth_sign_and_soft_vs_hard
tests.comparison: Two-part: (1) within B0, regress outcome-rank on base_depth_pct with mom_20 controls; test sign against mechanism's prediction (deeper base => better, negative coefficient); (2) compare soft capacity multiplier (penalty w/ floor=0.5) vs hard exclude (drop bottom-quartile by penalty score) on ruin count and winner retention.
tests.success_criterion: (1) Coefficient on base_depth_pct negative with p<0.10, reconciling the discovery sign-reversal; (2) soft multiplier achieves >=80% of hard-exclude's ruin reduction with strictly fewer winner losses — confirms adaptive-capacity encoding over binary filter.
tests.failure_criterion: (1) Coefficient positive or insignificant (base_depth_pct is noise, Mechanism B refuted); (2) hard-exclude matches soft multiplier on ruin reduction with <=same winner loss — soft multiplier is unnecessary complexity and the encoding collapses to a filter, expanding effective B0 selectivity.

leakage_checks: Verify all features are timestamped at-or-before the B0 entry decision date; explicitly exclude pullback_pct and pullback_duration_weeks (post-trigger) — these would be look-ahead bias.

Confirm is_b0_pick status and mom_20/base_depth_pct snapshots share the same decision timestamp per entity-snapshot pair; reject any case where feature snapshot post-dates B0 inclusion or where the same entity appears with conflicting labels across snapshots.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The proposed adaptive-capacity channel is theoretically coherent (post-B0 multiplicative penalty using mom_20 x |base_depth_pct| preserves the eligible set) but the empirical evidence in the 27-case archaeology does not isolate an interaction. mom_20 carries the bulk of the separation (standardized delta -1.00) and its colinear proxies vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05) and up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19) are equally or more diagnostic, while base_depth_pct shows near-zero effect (delta 0.19) with the WRONG sign (selected winners are 3.7pp shallower than false_negatives). The 'deep base sustains continuation' narrative is contradicted by entity_ead73f4390 (mom_20=0.32, px_vs_ma50=0.18, large_win) and entity_2c58cebc59 (mom_20=0.32, pullback -25%, large_win). What is supported is the weaker claim that B0 picks with mom_20 above ~0.15 paired with weakening distribution/up_day stats carry elevated ruin probability; base_depth_pct should be downgraded from regime modifier to optional tie-breaker until reconciled sign evidence appears.
falsifiers: Held-out (not the same 27 cases) monotonic ruin probability across mom_20 quintiles within B0 with interaction term base_depth_pct statistically significant (p<0.05) and stable cell counts (>=10 per cell) after controlling for vol_ratio_5_20 and up_day_ratio_20.

Larger-sample reconciliation that selected_winners are DEEPER (more negative base_depth_pct) than false_negatives, reversing the +3.7pp shallowness observed here; absent this, base_depth_pct has no directional mechanism.
actionable_design_principles: Encode adaptive exposure as a soft post-rank weight on the existing PIT signal set; never as a pre-filter that expands or contracts B0 membership. The shrinkage floor (e.g., 0.5x) must be respected so high-mom/deep-base winners (entity_ead73f4390, entity_2c58cebc59) are not deselected.

Parameter calibration must be done with frozen alpha/threshold/k on a held-out split distinct from the 27 discovery cases; report ruin-count and winner-count deltas with binomial confidence intervals and pre-register the composite criterion before evaluation.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Within-B0 capacity_weight = clip(1 - alpha*(mom_20 - threshold)*penalty_modifier, floor, 1.0), where penalty_modifier defaults to 1.0 and is optionally scaled by (1 - min(base_depth_pct / base_ref, 1.0)) so base_depth enters only as a soft tie-breaker, never as the regime gate.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Demotes base_depth_pct from regime modifier (whose evidence sign is reversed) to tie-breaker; lets mom_20 alone drive the penalty (which is what the data supports), while preserving the soft-floor protection against deselecting high-mom/deep-base winners.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Scales B0 position size without altering eligible universe; alpha and base_ref jointly control regime sensitivity.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: Proxy-conditioned capacity gate: trigger penalty only when vol_ratio_5_20>1.4 AND up_day_ratio_20<0.55 co-occur; mom_20 acts as continuous secondary factor, not primary. Falls back to no-shrinkage when proxies are absent.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Uses the strongest PIT proxies (standardized delta -1.05, -1.19) as the gating condition rather than mom_20 alone; avoids the colinearity/double-penalization attack raised by the skeptic.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Capacity shrinks only in the high-vol / low-up-day cluster where ruins cluster (e.g., entity_84824e6a20 vol=1.63 up=0.4 ruin); capacity stays full otherwise.

cycles.question: Explore a piecewise threshold using ibd_entry_close_position and ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: ibd_entry_volume_ratio and ibd_entry_close_position form a nonlinear gating interaction on breakout persistence: when the entry close finishes in the upper third of its intraday range (close_position >= 0.85) AND entry-day volume exceeds ~1.7x baseline, the breakout carries institutional commitment that resists mean-reversion; when close_position is high but volume_ratio is below ~1.3, the late-session price extension is an exhaustion move on thin order flow that snaps back within W4. The piecewise interaction is asymmetric — volume_ratio sets the floor, close_position amplifies conviction above the floor, but neither alone is sufficient.
evidence_for: Numeric contrasts show ibd_entry_volume_ratio separates false-negatives from selected-winners with std_delta -0.50 (median 1.60 vs 1.81) and ibd_entry_close_position with std_delta -0.46 (median 0.824 vs 0.863), placing both features in the moderate-effect regime.

Ruin cases (8 labeled false_positive_ruin) predominantly have vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.45: entity_8f0df3d38e (1.24), entity_3472243e0c (1.21), entity_55c2da490e (1.27), entity_b6bcccdf6a (1.31), entity_4fdc3699fd (1.38), entity_40ea0cfb3b (0.91), entity_ccc90a671f (1.45), entity_84824e6a20 (1.63) — the low-volume floor is where ruin concentrates.

entity_40ea0cfb3b is the cleanest signature: vol_ratio_5_20=0.906 (deep below floor) with close_vs_trigger=0.061 (extended), ma10_slope_5=0.025, up_day_ratio_20=0.5 — the textbook exhaustion-without-confirmation profile ending in ruin.

Selected winners with high conviction show vol_ratio_5_20 > 1.5 paired with non-trivial close_vs_trigger: entity_ead73f4390 (1.77, 0.002), entity_440e297253 (1.59, 0.050), entity_b00579f203 (1.58, 0.047), entity_2c58cebc59 (1.62, 0.034), entity_6618d3e80c (1.45, 0.051) — the upper-volume band persists.

False-negative cluster (not-B0 picks) shows systematically lower vol_ratio_5_20 (entity_535a1beed7=1.17, entity_bfb308b24a=1.19, entity_de1c657364=1.15, entity_d8e8e7b814=1.40, entity_df5478102d=1.41, entity_05b4c6b1f7=0.96) — B0's current rule is underweighting the volume gate, causing it to pass these up despite their subsequent large_win outcomes.

entity_6618d3e80c carries dual labels (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner), illustrating that the same close/volume combination can be ambiguous — consistent with a soft threshold rather than a hard switch.
evidence_against: entity_bec51a4227 is a selected_winner with vol_ratio_5_20=1.007 (below the proposed floor) yet close_vs_trigger=0.0104 and up_day_ratio_20=0.7 — low volume did not preclude a large_win, weakening a strict floor at 1.3.
entity_2f86543bf6 wins large with negative ma10_slope_5=-0.0076 and ma20_slope_5=-0.0078 and up_day_ratio_20=0.35, showing the close/volume gate is not the sole determinant of outcome.
entity_ccc90a671f and entity_84824e6a20 are ruins at vol_ratio_5_20=1.45 and 1.63 respectively, indicating the volume floor alone does not separate winners from losers in the mid-band.

entity_ad2bfdee3f is a false-negative with vol_ratio_5_20=1.179 and ma20_slope_5 negative, suggesting some low-volume setups still produce small wins the B0 model misses — the gate is not a perfect sieve.

Standardized deltas of -0.50 and -0.46 are only moderate; if volume_ratio were truly the dominant gate, separation would be larger, indicating confounding from up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19 std delta), mom_20 (-1.00), and px_vs_ma50 (-0.85).
falsifiable_predictions: Among current B0 picks, the subset with ibd_entry_volume_ratio < 1.2 will exhibit ruin rate > 50% in W4, while the subset with volume_ratio > 1.7 AND close_position > 0.85 will exhibit large_win rate > 60%.

The interaction term volume_ratio * close_position will carry a positive and statistically significant coefficient (p < 0.05) in a logistic regression on ruin vs win labels after controlling for ma10_slope_5 and mom_20.

Demoting B0 picks in the 'low-volume-extended' cell (volume_ratio < 1.3 AND close_vs_trigger_pct > 0.04) will reduce portfolio ruin rate by > 20% relative to B0 baseline without changing the eligible universe size.

False-negative recovery: re-ranking the snap_71486ed83c batch (5 FN cases) using a piecewise rule that admits volume_ratio > 1.5 OR (volume_ratio > 1.2 AND close_position > 0.90) will recover > 60% of the currently-missed large_win outcomes.
The mid-band (1.3 <= volume_ratio < 1.7) will show bimodal outcomes contingent on close_position: close_position > 0.88 leans large_win, close_position < 0.80 leans loss/ruin.
policy_implications: Encode a two-cell piecewise gate as a post-B0 filter (not a universe expander): pass when volume_ratio >= 1.7 AND close_position >= 0.85; soft-pass with size discount when 1.3 <= volume_ratio < 1.7 AND close_position >= 0.80; demote when volume_ratio < 1.3 regardless of close_position, OR when close_position < 0.75 regardless of volume.

Use the gate to shrink position size in the mid-band rather than hard-exclude, since entity_bec51a4227-class setups (low-volume but tight close_vs_trigger with high up_day_ratio_20) still produce winners.
Treat entity_6618d3e80c-class dual-labeled cases as position-sizing signals: same features can resolve either way, so cap exposure in the ambiguous upper-mid cell.

Pair the gate with the existing strong separators (up_day_ratio_20, mom_20) to avoid over-fitting to a single interaction — the standardized deltas indicate close_position and volume_ratio are necessary but not sufficient.

Monitor entity_bec51a4227-style exceptions (low volume_ratio but winner) as a regime-shift signal: if their frequency rises, the volume floor may need recalibration rather than being treated as fixed.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The proposed piecewise close_position × volume_ratio gate is not an independent signal — it is a recoded proxy for the same latent construct (short-term price extension + participation momentum) that B0 already captures via up_day_ratio_20, mom_20, and px_vs_ma50, and its apparent separability derives from a 27-case single-window discovery sample with heavy clustering in two snapshots and conditioning on B0 survivors. The 'institutional commitment' mechanism is unfalsifiable post-hoc narration; the data are equally consistent with the well-documented short-term drift / one-day reversal pattern in which names that close near the high on above-average volume continue to drift in the direction of the close for the next few weeks. Any predictive gain will collapse out-of-sample once the snapshot regime and the up_day_ratio_20 / mom_20 / px_vs_ma50 controls are included jointly.

attacks.issue: Collider conditioning on an unobserved universe
attacks.why_it_matters: B0 is itself a non-random selector — it preferentially admits names that 'look like breakouts.' Conditioning a downstream rule on B0 picks opens a collider: any feature correlated with B0 admission (and volume_ratio_5_20 is one, because low-volume names rarely look like breakouts) will appear predictive of post-admission outcome even if it has zero causal effect on the underlying universe. The claim that the gate 'doesn't expand B0' disguises that it is conditioning the analysis on a non-representative subset; the FN cases (is_b0_pick=false) are precisely the test set the model would need, and their distribution is confounded with snapshot rather than with the gate itself.

attacks.issue: Severe confounding with up_day_ratio_20 and mom_20 (the strongest standardized deltas in the evidence)
attacks.why_it_matters: The numeric contrasts show up_day_ratio_20 (std delta -1.19) and mom_20 (-1.00) separate FN from SW much more strongly than close_position (-0.46) or volume_ratio (-0.50). close_position and volume_ratio_5_20 are mechanically correlated with these: a name with high up_day_ratio_20 has been trending up, which elevates volume_ratio relative to a 20-day baseline and pushes close_position higher on the breakout day. Without a multivariate model showing the gate adds information beyond up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50, the piecewise structure is at best redundant and at worst a leakage channel for overfitting.

attacks.issue: Snapshot-level clustering dominates feature-outcome associations
attacks.why_it_matters: Six of eight false_positive_ruin cases and all five false_negative cases come from just two snapshots (snap_71486ed83c and snap_d0d57b1e40). The ruins cluster not by feature values but by snapshot regime; entity_ccc90a671f (ruin, vol=1.45) and entity_440e297253 (SW, vol=1.59) come from different snapshots with nearly identical volume profiles. Any cross-snapshot rule derived from this sample is fitting snapshot identity, not a generalizable gate. A within-snapshot fixed-effects analysis would likely shrink the apparent gate effect.

attacks.issue: Mechanism claim is post-hoc and contradicts the short-term reversal literature
attacks.why_it_matters: The 'institutional commitment resists mean-reversion' story is a narrative imposed on a pattern. The observed correlation (high close_position + high volume_ratio → continuation) is precisely what the short-term drift / continuation literature predicts for any name, and it does not require a special 'institutional' mechanism. Furthermore, the prior claim treats close_position>=0.85 + high volume as 'commitment,' but in standard microstructure, a close near the high on elevated volume is also the textbook signature of an exhaustion day that marks a swing high. The mechanism is therefore ambiguous in both directions; the data cannot distinguish commitment from exhaustion.

attacks.issue: The cell structure admits counterexamples in nearly every cell
attacks.why_it_matters: Looking at the proposed cell boundaries: high-volume-high-close has entity_b6bcccdf6a (ruin/loss at vol=1.31, close_vs_trigger=0.032, close_position presumably high); mid-volume with tight close has entity_bec51a4227 (SW large_win at vol=1.007) which the policy calls a 'soft-pass' but would actually be demoted under the strict floor; high-volume with low close has entity_2f86543bf6 (SW large_win with negative slopes and low up_day_ratio_20=0.35). The proposed four-cell partition misclassifies multiple of the 11 selected winners, and the 'soft-pass with size discount' workaround is ad hoc and untested.

attacks.issue: Entity_6618d3e80c carries mutually exclusive labels in the same evidence
attacks.why_it_matters: The dual annotation (false_positive_ruin|selected_winner) at vol_ratio=1.45, close_vs_trigger=0.051, up_day_ratio_20=0.55 is presented as evidence for the 'soft threshold' interpretation, but it more directly indicates label noise or label ambiguity in the discovery method. A model that needs to explain a contradiction within a single observation cannot claim a clean threshold; the data-generating process for the labels is itself in question, and any threshold fit to noisy labels will replicate the noise.

attacks.issue: Sample-size constraint and multiple-testing burden are not addressed
attacks.why_it_matters: With 27 cases, the proposed four-cell partition yields an average of <7 cases per cell; the falsifiable predictions (e.g., 'large_win rate > 60% in upper cell') require dozens of observations per cell to be distinguishable from sampling noise. No correction for the number of candidate thresholds (1.2/1.3/1.5/1.7/1.8 across two features and a continuous close_position) is offered. The threshold values are cherry-picked to fit the discovery set.

attacks.issue: The 'without expanding the B0 universe' framing hides effective shrinkage and is not a neutral constraint
attacks.why_it_matters: The constraint forbids expanding the eligible set but allows shrinking it. A post-B0 hard-exclude cell (e.g., volume<1.3) would drop entity_3472243e0c, entity_55c2da490e, entity_40ea0cfb3b, entity_b6bcccdf6a-class setups that the data show can be winners; a soft-pass in the mid-band shrinks expected edge per name. The 'universe-neutral' language disguises a portfolio-construction choice (concentration of bets) that affects realized ruin rate but not the underlying edge. This is a portfolio effect dressed as a predictive signal.

attacks.issue: volume_ratio_5_20 is a regime-dependent feature with no regime conditioning
attacks.why_it_matters: volume_ratio relative to a 20-day baseline has a regime-dependent mean: in low-volatility regimes (VIX<15) typical volume_ratio is ~1.0-1.2, so a 1.7 floor would exclude the entire universe; in high-volatility regimes, the same 1.7 floor would be common. The proposed thresholds are calibrated to a specific regime in the discovery window and will misfire in other regimes. No VIX/bin/realized-vol interaction is specified, and entity_40ea0cfb3b (vol=0.91 → ruin) and entity_05b4c6b1f7 (vol=0.96 → FN large_win) demonstrate that the same low-volume value has opposite consequences.

attacks.issue: The threshold boundaries are not data-derived; they are round-number defaults that fit the sample
attacks.why_it_matters: 1.3, 1.5, 1.7, 0.80, 0.85 — these are aesthetic numbers, not optimized cutoffs with reported cross-validation or sensitivity analysis. With 27 cases, many threshold partitions will produce cells that 'look right.' The lack of any stability check (jackknife, bootstrap, leave-one-snapshot-out) means the reported cells are overfit.

counterexamples_to_seek: B0 picks with volume_ratio < 1.2 that nonetheless produce large_win W4 outcomes across multiple non-discovery snapshots — particularly entity_bec51a4227 (vol=1.007, SW large_win) and entity_05b4c6b1f7 (vol=0.964, FN large_win) classes.

B0 picks in the high-volume-high-close cell (vol>1.7, close_position>0.85) that end in ruin or loss — needed to break the 'commitment' mechanism. entity_b6bcccdf6a (vol=1.31, ruin) is in the same general neighborhood; entity_d2ca7853ba (vol=1.09, SW) shows that low-vol winners exist too.
Two B0 picks in the same snapshot with nearly identical (volume_ratio, close_position) tuples but opposite outcomes (ruin vs SW). If found, the gate cannot separate them.
A snapshot where the proposed gate would have excluded > 30% of subsequently-winning picks, demonstrating regime fragility.
Within-snapshot fixed-effects coefficients showing the gate adds zero incremental log-likelihood beyond up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50.
A B0 pick in the proposed demote cell (vol<1.3 OR close_position<0.75) that goes on to be a top-decile winner — to test whether the demotion systematically forfeits alpha.
what_would_change_my_mind: An out-of-sample test on at least two snapshots not in the discovery set, with reported cell-by-cell outcome rates and a confidence interval showing the gate separates from the up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 baseline at p<0.05.
A leave-one-snapshot-out cross-validation showing the threshold values (1.3/1.7, 0.80/0.85) are stable across folds rather than collapsing toward a single number.

A multivariate logistic or gradient-boosted model in which the close_position × volume_ratio interaction term enters with a coefficient that is statistically significant and robust to feature permutation, after the controls up_day_ratio_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5 are included.

A demonstration that the proposed demotion of the low-volume-extended cell reduces forward ruin rate by > 20% in a backtest without simultaneously reducing large_win rate by a comparable amount (i.e., not just shifting the distribution of outcomes but actually improving conditional expected value).
A regime-conditioning specification (e.g., volume floor scaled by realized 20-day vol or VIX bucket) that improves the gate's predictive accuracy in both calm and stressed regimes.
Replication of the cell-outcome rates on an independent dataset of equal or greater size, with the same labels generated by the same discovery method.

tests.name: Within-snapshot incremental-information test
tests.comparison: Compare two nested logistic specifications on the discovery set stratified by snapshot: (A) baseline = up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 + ma10_slope_5; (B) baseline + ibd_entry_close_position + ibd_entry_volume_ratio + ibd_entry_close_position*ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Compute likelihood-ratio chi-square and per-snapshot sign concordance of the interaction term across >=2 non-discovery snapshots in the validation window.
tests.success_criterion: Interaction term is positive in >=3 of 4 within-snapshot fits AND LR test p<0.05 AND AUC uplift >=0.03 over baseline.
tests.failure_criterion: Interaction term flips sign across folds OR LR test p>=0.10 OR AUC uplift <0.01, indicating the gate is a recoded proxy.

tests.name: Leave-one-snapshot-out threshold stability
tests.comparison: For each snapshot in {snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40, others}, fit a grid of (volume_ratio, close_position) thresholds on the remaining snapshots and compute optimal W4 ruin-rate separation on the held-out snapshot. Compare optimal volume floor distribution and close_position cut distribution across folds.
tests.success_criterion: Optimal volume floor lies in [1.4, 1.8] and optimal close_position cut lies in [0.82, 0.88] in >=3 of 4 folds (stability band).
tests.failure_criterion: Optimal thresholds span >0.4 in either dimension across folds, or collapse to a single-feature rule, indicating the proposed 1.3/1.7/0.80/0.85 cells are discovery-set artefacts.

leakage_checks: Verify ibd_entry_close_position and ibd_entry_volume_ratio are computed using only data available at the IBD entry decision timestamp (no peeking at post-entry close or post-entry volume prints).
Confirm that the proposed gate is applied as a hard post-B0 filter on the eligible B0 set only — no implicit universe expansion via relaxed B0 criteria.
Audit that snapshot id is not used as a feature in either test and that fold assignment is on snapshot identity alone, not on outcome label.

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: ibd_entry_volume_ratio and ibd_entry_close_position show only moderate univariate separation (std deltas -0.50 and -0.46) between false-negatives and selected-winners, well below up_day_ratio_20 (-1.19), mom_20 (-1.00), and px_vs_ma50 (-0.85). The apparent interaction is consistent with a recoded proxy for short-term price extension plus participation momentum that B0 already partially captures; the 'institutional commitment' narrative is equally consistent with the textbook one-day reversal / exhaustion microstructure. Six of eight ruins and all five false-negatives cluster in two snapshots (snap_71486ed83c, snap_d0d57b1e40), and every proposed cell admits counterexamples (entity_bec51a4227 wins at vol=1.007; entity_2f86543bf6 wins with negative slopes and low up_day_ratio; entity_b6bcccdf6a ruins in the high-volume neighborhood). The 1.3/1.7/0.80/0.85 thresholds are round-number defaults without optimization. Status: conditional signal plausibly exists but cannot be disentangled from confounding, snapshot regime, and the existing B0 controls on the current 27-case single-window discovery sample.
falsifiers: Leave-one-snapshot-out CV: optimal volume floor outside [1.4, 1.8] in >=2 of 4 folds, OR optimal close_position cut outside [0.82, 0.88] in >=2 of 4 folds, falsifies the proposed cells as discovery artefacts.

Within-snapshot logistic with the gate added to a baseline of up_day_ratio_20 + mom_20 + px_vs_ma50 + ma10_slope_5 yields LR test p >= 0.10 OR AUC uplift < 0.01, falsifying the claim that the piecewise interaction is incremental information rather than a recoded proxy for B0's existing features.

Backtest of the low-volume-extended demote cell (volume_ratio < 1.3 AND close_vs_trigger_pct > 0.04) shows large_win rate reduction >= 50% of the ruin-rate reduction, falsifying the claim that the gate improves conditional expected value rather than merely shrinking exposure.
actionable_design_principles: Encode the gate as a soft position-size multiplier keyed to the four cells (full / discount / half / zero), not a hard binary selector, because the cell misclassification rate among the 11 selected-winners is non-trivial and the policy must survive label noise.
Volume ratio must be regime-conditioned (realized-vol or VIX bin) before any threshold is applied, since a fixed 1.7 floor misfires in low-volatility regimes where typical volume_ratio is ~1.0-1.2.

Never apply the close_position x volume_ratio gate without jointly controlling for up_day_ratio_20, mom_20, and px_vs_ma50 in the same model — treating it as incremental over B0's existing feature set is what prevents it from collapsing into a recoded proxy.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: piecewise_volume_close_softgate(ibd_entry_volume_ratio, ibd_entry_close_position, base_size) -> size_multiplier in {0.0, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} based on a four-cell partition with regime-conditioned thresholds (volume bands shifted by realized_vol_bin).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Differs from a hard filter by preserving exposure in ambiguous mid-cells and from a universe expansion by only modulating size on the B0-eligible set; the regime conditioner separates it from naive round-number cutoffs.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Computes only at the B0 admit timestamp using data on the eligible B0 set; no new names are admitted, so the eligible universe size is preserved by construction.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: volume_close_residual(interaction_term, controls={up_day_ratio_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50, ma10_slope_5}) -> orthogonalized score used to demote or shrink only when the residual is materially negative, ensuring the gate adds information beyond the existing B0 feature set.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Differs from the raw piecewise cell by first regressing out the four strongest standardized-delta separators, so the policy acts only on the orthogonal component; this is the only construction that can falsify the 'recoded proxy' attack.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Still operates as a post-B0 filter; the regression coefficients are fit once on the discovery window and frozen, so live scoring is a fixed linear transform plus a cell lookup with no universe expansion.

cycles.question: Explore a interaction term using ibd_entry_close_position and ibd_entry_volume_ratio. Explain the mechanism, likely failure regime, and how to encode it without expanding the B0 eligible universe.

researcher.mechanism_claim: ibd_entry_close_position × ibd_entry_volume_ratio acts as a chase-vs-conviction discriminator: a high close_position (close near top of trigger range) without proportional volume expansion (vol_ratio <~1.4) flags thin late-day buying that resolves into mean reversion, while high close_position paired with vol_ratio >=1.5 indicates genuine breakout continuation. The multiplicative interaction is non-linear: marginal high close_position is only toxic when volume fails to confirm.
evidence_for: Among B0 picks labeled false_positive_ruin, 6/8 cluster at close_vs_trigger_pct >= 0.05 with vol_ratio_5_20 in 0.91-1.63 (e.g., entity_8f0df3d38e 0.069/1.24, entity_4fdc3699fd 0.069/1.38, entity_ccc90a671f 0.070/1.45, entity_40ea0cfb3b 0.061/0.91), whereas selected_winners with close_vs_trigger >0.04 generally carry vol_ratio >=1.45 (entity_440e297253 0.050/1.59, entity_b00579f203 0.047/1.58).

False-negative_relative cases sit at low-to-moderate close_vs_trigger (<=0.04) with mid-range vol_ratio (1.15-1.40), suggesting the current B0 filter underweights the combination rather than penalizing it - the signal exists in eligible candidates, not in a missing universe.
evidence_against: entity_6618d3e80c carries close_vs_trigger 0.051 with vol_ratio 1.45 and is double-labeled selected_winner|false_positive_ruin, showing the interaction is probabilistic, not deterministic, and entity_2c58cebc59 wins large despite close_vs_trigger 0.034 - so the regime, not the point estimate, drives the hazard.
falsifiable_predictions: Within the frozen B0 universe, the subset {close_vs_trigger_pct > 0.05 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.4} will exhibit ruin+loss rate >=55% OOS, vs <=25% for the complementary subset with vol_ratio_5_20 >=1.4.

The composite rank feature f = close_vs_trigger_pct * vol_ratio_5_20 will deliver higher cross-sectional IC against W4 return than either marginal alone, with the gain concentrated in the top quartile of close_vs_trigger.
policy_implications: Encode as an in-universe penalty rather than a universe expansion: chase_score = max(0, close_vs_trigger_pct - 0.045) * (1.4 - min(vol_ratio_5_20, 1.4)); subtract chase_score from the B0 composite so high-close-low-volume picks are demoted but not excluded, preserving eligible-universe size and avoiding leakage from the false-negative pool.

Add a 'wait-for-pullback' override: when chase_score exceeds a threshold, defer entry one bar rather than skip, capturing the false-negative_relative entities that became winners after a controlled pullback.

skeptic.strongest_counterclaim: The proposed close_position × volume interaction is not a real cross-sectional discriminator but a snapshot-regime artifact amplified by sample clustering. Only ~3 cases actually occupy the strict {close_vs_trigger > 0.05 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.4} zone that the claim says drives ruin; the threshold values 0.045 and 1.4 are hand-picked to fit those 3 points. Meanwhile low-close + low-volume picks (entity_bec51a4227 at 0.010/1.01, entity_8ad5cd4795 at 0.009/1.00, entity_90a828939a at 0.026/1.40) routinely win large, directly refuting the 'chase = toxic' causal story. The composite f = close × vol therefore encodes noise rather than signal, and a within-snapshot demeaning test would likely collapse it.

attacks.issue: Severe snapshot confounding: 15/27 cases (≈56%) come from just two snapshots (snap_71486ed83c with 7 cases, snap_d0d57b1e40 with 5 cases). The interaction pattern is therefore partly a market-regime-day effect masquerading as a per-stock feature interaction.
attacks.why_it_matters: Any cross-sectional claim built on this archaeology must be snapshot-cluster-robust. The numeric_contrasts do not condition on snapshot, so the standardized deltas for ibd_entry_close_position (-0.46) and vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05) are likely inflated by regime heterogeneity. The 'interaction' may be picking up 'which snapshot' more than 'which stock'.

attacks.issue: Sample-size collapse in the supposed toxic zone. The researcher claims '6/8 cluster at close_vs_trigger_pct >= 0.05 with vol_ratio_5_20 in 0.91-1.63' but does not enforce the conjunctive condition vol_ratio < 1.4. Strict intersection {close > 0.05 AND vol < 1.4} yields only 3 cases (entity_8f0df3d38e 0.069/1.24, entity_4fdc3699fd 0.069/1.38, entity_40ea0cfb3b 0.061/0.91). Fitting a hand-engineered penalty with two breakpoints on 3 points is p-hacking, not mechanism discovery.
attacks.why_it_matters: With n=3 in the operational region, every threshold choice is overfit by construction. Any 'IC > marginal' claim for the composite f cannot be statistically distinguished from a chance ordering under bootstrap on this subsample.

attacks.issue: Direct counterexamples to the 'chase = late-day thin buying' mechanism: multiple selected_winners have low close_position AND low-to-mid volume (entity_bec51a4227 close=0.010/vol=1.01, entity_8ad5cd4795 close=0.009/vol=1.00, entity_90a828939a close=0.026/vol=1.40, entity_ad2bfdee3f close=0.002/vol=1.18). If the toxic story were 'high close without volume', low close without volume should be benign, but these cases span ruin to large_win across the same feature region.
attacks.why_it_matters: The proposed mechanism fails its own negative-control test. Low values on both inputs produce the full outcome distribution, so the interaction cannot be the underlying causal channel — at best it captures one corner of a multivariate surface and leaves the rest unmodeled.

attacks.issue: Feature conflation: ibd_entry_volume_ratio (median delta -0.21, std delta -0.50) and vol_ratio_5_20 (median delta -0.24, std delta -1.05) are listed as separate features but the researcher uses vol_ratio_5_20 as a proxy for the 'volume' side of the interaction. These are different constructs (entry-day volume vs short-vs-medium-term volume ratio). The composite f therefore mixes two unnormalized scales and may double-count or conflict.
attacks.why_it_matters: Encoding the interaction without reconciling which volume measure is the confirmatory one introduces hidden degrees of freedom. The 'chase_score' could equivalently be built on either measure and yield different rankings, making the B0 in-universe penalty sensitive to an arbitrary modeling choice rather than an economic mechanism.

attacks.issue: entity_2c58cebc59 is selected_winner with close=0.034/vol=1.62 yet suffered a -25.1% pullback over 6 weeks before resolving large_win. entity_6618d3e80c is double-labeled selected_winner|false_positive_ruin. The 'hazard' framing treats these as binary but outcome_label reflects W4, not max drawdown or tail risk. A B0 pick can be a 'winner' by 4-week return yet destroy capital via path.
attacks.why_it_matters: If the interaction is meant to protect against ruin, equating 'winners' with 'safe' is a label-construction error. The proposed policy may filter out names that look dangerous but actually have high-W4 + manageable drawdown, while retaining names that win on the W4 metric but execute the -25% path.

attacks.issue: Multiplicative encoding amplifies weak marginals. Both standardized deltas are already modest (-0.46 and -1.05); multiplying them does not increase signal-to-noise — it can only reduce it because each marginal's standard error compounds. The claim that 'f = close × vol delivers higher IC than either marginal' is unfalsified here and conflicts with basic error propagation.
attacks.why_it_matters: A composite that is statistically weaker than either input cannot be used as an in-universe penalty without net IC drag. The researcher proposes subtracting chase_score from B0 composite, but if chase_score is noise, this subtraction actively degrades the existing ranking.

attacks.issue: Policy leaks via 'wait-for-pullback' override. The proposal to defer entry one bar when chase_score is high adds a temporal decision rule. With only 3 cases in the trigger zone and unknown forward overlap across snapshots, this rule is unobservable in the archaeology and cannot be validated without outer-forward outcomes, which the rules forbid inferring.
attacks.why_it_matters: This makes the policy unfalsifiable within the current evidence and risks adding lookahead through 'deferred entry' logic that implicitly assumes a path not visible in the snapshot.

counterexamples_to seek: Within-snapshot test: compute the proposed chase_score for all stocks within snap_71486ed83c alone and check whether the high-close-low-vol subset ranks worse than low-close-low-vol subset on W4 — if the interaction is genuine, this should hold *within* the snapshot.

Randomization-style audit: permute the snapshot labels across the 27 cases and recompute the numeric_contrasts; if the standardized deltas for close_position and vol_ratio_5_20 collapse toward zero, the original signal is a snapshot artefact.

Sensitivity to breakpoints: evaluate chase_score under all 4 breakpoint combinations of {0.04, 0.045, 0.05} × {1.3, 1.4, 1.5}; if the 'toxic' subset membership changes by >30% under any adjacent threshold, the rule is overfit to the specific 3-case cluster.

Counterfactual using ibd_entry_volume_ratio (not vol_ratio_5_20): does the same interaction pattern hold when the volume leg is the alternative volume measure? If not, the researcher has been measuring a different construct than the one in the composite.

Outcome-by-path check: for the 8 false_positive_ruin cases, plot individual weekly return paths (if derivable) to see if the -16%, -14%, -12% drawdowns cluster in weeks 2-3 vs weeks 3-4 — this tests whether high-close-low-vol ruins are about entry-timing vs regime-rotation.

Conditional-on-momentum: subset to mom_20 > 0.15 and check whether close × vol still discriminates winners from ruins. If mom absorbs the signal, the interaction is a proxy for momentum, not an independent mechanism.
what_would_change_my_mind: A walk-forward OOS replication showing the strict {close > 0.05 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.4} region has ruin rate ≥55% across at least 5 disjoint snapshots not in the archaeology, with the effect surviving within-snapshot ranking.

Demonstration that after snapshot-demeaning or fixed-effects regression, the close × vol term has a statistically significant coefficient (p < 0.05) with a sign and magnitude consistent with the chase-score encoding.

An ablation showing chase_score computed on ibd_entry_volume_ratio (the alternative measure) produces a within-snapshot-robust IC > the B0 composite by at least 0.02 in absolute IC, with the gain stable across bootstrap resamples.

A larger sample (n ≥ 100) where the low-close-low-vol corner also shows ruin concentration — i.e., evidence that low values are protective, not just evidence that high values without volume confirmation are toxic. Without this, the mechanism is one-tailed and asymmetric in a way the data does not yet support.

Identification of an economic channel (e.g., order-flow imbalance, options OI skew, short-interest data) that independently predicts the high-close-low-vol regime, distinguishing it from a mere snapshot-cluster artifact.

tests.name: WithinSnapshotRankPersistence
tests.comparison: For each snapshot_anon stratum with >=3 cases, compute Spearman rank correlation between chase_score = max(0, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct - 0.045) * (1.4 - min(vol_ratio_5_20, 1.4)) and W4_return_bucket ordinal; compare mean within-snapshot rho to pooled rho across all 27 cases. Also test sign consistency: fraction of within-snapshot rho that share the pooled sign.
tests.success_criterion: Mean within-snapshot |rho| >= 0.6 * pooled |rho| AND sign-consistency >= 70% across snapshots with n>=3. Effect must survive snapshot-clustering.
tests.failure_criterion: Pooled |rho| > 1.5 * mean within-snapshot |rho| OR sign-consistency < 50%, indicating the signal is regime-driven rather than cross-sectional.

tests.name: VolumeConstructAblation
tests.comparison: Build chase_score_5_20 using vol_ratio_5_20 as in Test 1, and chase_score_entry using ibd_entry_volume_ratio with breakpoints {0.045, median of ibd_entry_volume_ratio in sample}. Compare (a) Spearman rank correlation between the two chase_score variants, (c) per-feature IC vs W4 bucket.
tests.success_criterion: Spearman(chase_score_5_20, chase_score_entry) >= 0.65 AND both chase_score variants show within-snapshot IC directionally consistent with chase interpretation.
tests.failure_criterion: Spearman < 0.40 OR chase_score_entry shows opposite sign in >=50% of snapshots, indicating the volume leg is construct-specific and the encoding choice is arbitrary.

tests.name: LowLowCornerNegativeControl
tests.comparison: Partition all 27 cases into 4 quadrants using medians of close_vs_trigger (~0.030) and vol_ratio_5_20 (~1.40). Compare ruin+loss rate in Q1 (high-close, low-vol, the researcher-flagged toxic zone) vs Q3 (low-close, low-vol, the symmetric negative control). Also compute Q2 and Q4 as reference.
tests.success_criterion: Q1 ruin+loss rate exceeds Q3 ruin+loss rate by >=25 percentage points AND Q1 rate >= 55%. Symmetry between extremes is required for the chase mechanism.
tests.failure_criterion: Q3 ruin+loss rate >= Q1 rate, OR Q1 rate < 35%. If low-low corner is not protective, the chase mechanism is asymmetric in a way the data does not support, and the high-close-low-vol rule is one-tailed noise.

leakage_checks: All features must be point-in-time computable from the snapshot date: confirm ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct, vol_ratio_5_20, ibd_entry_volume_ratio are defined using data available at or before the entry signal without using post-W4 returns.
No use of snapshot_anon, ticker identity, or calendar features as predictive inputs in any test; they appear only as stratification/clustering variables.
Verify the deferred-entry override does not implicitly reference W4 outcomes; any wait rule can only use pre-entry chase_score threshold.
Confirm pullback_pct and pullback_duration_weeks are not used as predictors (they are outcome-adjacent and would leak post-entry path information).

synthesizer.mechanism_summary: The hypothesized mechanism — that a high ibd_entry_close_position (close near top of trigger range) unaccompanied by proportional volume expansion flags thin late-day buying that mean-reverts, while the same close_position paired with confirmatory volume indicates genuine breakout continuation — is consistent with a subset of the archaeology (≈3 B0-pick ruins at close_vs_trigger ≥ 0.06 with vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.4) but fails its own asymmetric negative control (low-close-low-vol picks span ruin to large_win), is supported by only a single conjunct of evidence that does not survive snapshot demeaning, and conflates two distinct volume constructs (entry-day ibd_entry_volume_ratio vs short/medium-term vol_ratio_5_20). The composite multiplicative encoding compounds the modest marginal signal-to-noise rather than amplifying it, and the 'wait-for-pullback' override introduces an unobservable temporal rule. The mechanism is best characterized as a plausible but unproven conditional hypothesis whose operational signature (high close + low volume → ruin) is confounded with snapshot regime, momentum state, and the arbitrary choice of which volume measure populates the composite.
falsifiers: Walk-forward OOS on ≥5 disjoint snapshots not present in the archaeology: the strict {close_vs_trigger > 0.05 AND vol_ratio_5_20 < 1.4} subset must show ruin+loss rate ≥55% AND the effect must survive within-snapshot demeaning (rank-preserving) on every snapshot, not pooled.

Volume-construct cross-check: the composite built on ibd_entry_volume_ratio (instead of vol_ratio_5_20) must produce a within-snapshot Spearman correlation ≥0.65 with the vol_ratio_5_20 version AND directional agreement on W4 rank in ≥70% of snapshots; otherwise the encoding is construct-ambiguous and the B0 penalty is arbitrary.

Conditional-on-momentum test: restricting to mom_20 > 0.15, the close × vol interaction must retain a signed coefficient (p < 0.10 in a snapshot-fixed-effects regression). If momentum absorbs the signal, the interaction is a momentum proxy rather than an independent chase-vs-conviction discriminator.

Symmetric-direction test: in the low-close-low-vol corner, ruin+loss rate must be ≤25% across at least 3 disjoint snapshots. If it is ≥40%, the mechanism is not asymmetric in the way the data currently suggest and the 'chase = toxic' framing collapses.

Snapshot-permutation audit: randomly permuting snapshot labels across the 27 cases and recomputing the standardized delta for ibd_entry_close_position must shift the delta by less than half its observed magnitude. If the delta collapses under permutation, the original signal is regime-driven rather than cross-sectional.

Threshold-sensitivity audit: under all adjacent breakpoint combinations in {0.04, 0.045, 0.05} × {1.3, 1.4, 1.5}, the strict-toxic-zone membership must change by <20%. If it shifts by ≥30%, the rule is overfit to the 3-case cluster and cannot be ported OOS.

Bootstrap IC comparison: 1000 bootstrap resamples of the composite f vs either marginal must show |IC(f)| > |IC(marginal_best)| in ≥80% of resamples. If the composite wins less than half the time, the multiplicative form is noise-degrading rather than signal-amplifying.
actionable_design_principles: Snapshot-clustered validation is a precondition, not an optional check: any in-universe penalty derived from cross-sectional archaeology must be evaluated against within-snapshot rank persistence before deployment, because the current evidence is ≈56% concentrated in two snapshots and the regime-day effect dominates.

Demote, do not exclude: any composite should subtract from the B0 composite score rather than hard-filter, preserving eligible-universe size and avoiding the false-negative pool (which sits at low-to-moderate close_vs_trigger with mid-range volume and would be silently destroyed by exclusion).

Reconcile the volume construct before encoding: ibd_entry_volume_ratio and vol_ratio_5_20 measure different things (entry-day vs 5d/20d expansion). The DSL should expose both and require a construct-selection guardrail (e.g., agreement test) before a chase_score is committed.

Avoid hand-picked conjunctive thresholds on n≈3: a penalty whose operational region contains three cases is overfit by construction. Either collect more evidence or degrade the encoding to a continuous monotone penalty without hard thresholds.

Separate predictive signal from path/label issues: W4-return-bucket is not the same outcome as ruin protection. The DSL should expose W4 return, max drawdown, and pullback_pct as distinct outcome channels, and any 'chase' penalty should be evaluated on the path-relevant channel, not the W4 label.

No temporal overrides without outer-forward evidence: the 'wait one bar' idea is unfalsifiable inside the archaeology. Defer any temporal decision rule to a separate, forward-validated experiment; in the current cycle, encode only the static penalty.

Calibration guardrail: any chase_score should ship with a self-test that compares its within-snapshot rank IC against the B0 composite's IC and disables the penalty if the comparison fails over a rolling window.

Don't conflate interaction discovery with universe expansion: the mechanism claim, even if true, is an in-universe ranking refinement. The DSL must not silently promote this into a new eligibility filter.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: chase_score_demote: compute chase_score = max(0, ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct - c1) * (c2 - min(vol_ratio_5_20, c2)) with c1, c2 calibrated by data-driven breakpoints (e.g., median + 1.5 IQR) rather than hand-picked constants, and subtract it from the B0 composite as a continuous soft penalty (not a hard filter).
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Unlike the researcher's proposed hard thresholds (0.045, 1.4) and the 'wait-for-pullback' override, this is a continuous demotion that preserves universe size, eliminates the n=3 overfitting risk by using data-driven breakpoints, and is reversible by adjusting c1/c2 rather than recoding rules.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Neutral to universe size: subtracts from score, does not gate eligibility. Preserves B0 capacity envelope.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: volume_construct_agreement_gate: before any chase_score is applied, compute chase_score_entry (using ibd_entry_volume_ratio) and chase_score_5_20 (using vol_ratio_5_20); apply the penalty only when both agree on direction (e.g., both above their respective 75th percentiles OR both below), and halve the penalty weight when they disagree.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Addresses the feature-conflation critique directly. Rather than picking one volume measure, it uses agreement as a confidence-weighting mechanism, which is observable in the archaeology and degrades gracefully under construct ambiguity.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Neutral; degrades to zero penalty on disagreement rather than excluding names, so capacity is preserved.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: snapshot_clustered_validation_wrapper: wrap any chase-derived feature in a per-snapshot rank-correlation audit; the feature is enabled only if its within-snapshot Spearman against W4_return_bucket has the expected sign in ≥70% of snapshots with n≥3 AND the pooled |rho| is not more than 1.5× the mean within-snapshot |rho|.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Treats the snapshot-confounding problem as a first-class deployment gate rather than a post-hoc audit. Encodes the skeptic's WithinSnapshotRankPersistence test as a runtime guardrail, so a feature that fails OOS is automatically disabled.
dsl_policy_ideas.capacity_relevance: Neutral; the wrapper changes whether a penalty is applied, not which names are eligible.

dsl_policy_ideas.idea: momentum_conditional_chase: condition chase_score application on mom_20 > 0 (or mom_20 > 0.10); suppress the penalty entirely for negative-momentum names because the chase mechanism is only plausible in already-trending regimes and is unlikely to discriminate in counter-trend setups.
dsl_policy_ideas.why_distinct: Targets the conditional-on-momentum falsifier directly.
